Chapter 51

A few days later.

“Steward Li, congratulations!”

Lee Hyun looked at the young disciple bowing deeply to him.

“I’m not a steward yet.”

“But I heard a letter came from the main sect telling you to receive a Foundation Establishment Pill. With you, Senior Li, I’m certain you’ll succeed in reaching Foundation Establishment.”

The young disciple held out the wooden box he had been carrying in his arms.

“It’s only a small token of my regard.”

A faint medicinal fragrance wafted from the wooden box. Lee Hyun did not open the lid.

“I appreciate the thought.”

“It’s nothing valuable.”

“Even so, I can’t accept something from a junior. You’ll have use for it yourself in the future, so keep it safe.”

The young disciple reluctantly tucked the wooden box back into his robes.

“Then I’ll come pay my respects again after you succeed in reaching Foundation Establishment.”

“Very well.”

...

Less than three days after the letter from the main sect arrived, word that Li Dongsan had been allotted a Foundation Establishment Pill spread throughout the Immortal Veneration Court.

Even the rogue cultivators and martial artists employed by the royal family heard the news.

Whenever Lee Hyun passed by, people approached to congratulate him, and some had already begun addressing him as Steward or Senior.

Some offered expensive spirit wine, while others tried to give him talismans and spirit stones.

There were those who were sincerely happy for him, but most were trying to establish ties in advance, thinking ahead to when Li Dongsan reached Foundation Establishment.

Lee Hyun declined every gift. Receiving a Foundation Establishment Pill did not guarantee success, and there was no reason to incur unnecessary debts. After he made his position clear several times, no one tried to press gifts on him anymore.

Even so, the gazes directed at him still went beyond envy and approached outright admiration. It was as though they were looking at someone about to cross alone into the next era.

Their reactions brought something home to Lee Hyun anew.

The gulf between Qi Refining and Foundation Establishment was almost impossible to put into words.

For a Qi Refining cultivator who could live a hundred to a hundred and fifty years to become someone who could live two hundred to three hundred years was like being granted an entirely new life. It would hardly be an exaggeration to compare it to being given the chance to start life over from the beginning in a vastly better family.

It was, quite literally, being granted the right to live into a new century. A single pill could completely alter the course of one’s remaining life.

Lee Hyun had transmigrated into a body that did not age from the very beginning, so he had never properly considered what extending one’s lifespan truly meant.

‘I see. Compared to my past life, crossing a major realm really is like receiving a blessing from God. Would it feel like a modern person nearing the end of their lifespan in 2030 suddenly being given the chance to live until 2160?’

‘If someone could live into the next century, there might be another chance to extend their lifespan there as well... And they’d probably expect to experience things so extraordinary that they would surpass anything they could imagine.’

Having already lived for more than a thousand years, Lee Hyun had grown indifferent to the value of time. Only after seeing the expressions of those around him did he recover some small part of the feeling he had forgotten.

...

Fifteen days later.

Lee Hyun handed over the ledgers of the Immortal Veneration Court’s pill storehouse to the resident cultivator who would succeed him.

Six thick ledgers, the keys to the pill storehouse, and a small jade token controlling the formation in the alchemy chamber were neatly arranged on the table.

“I’ve recorded the current stock in the ledgers.”

The Qi Refining Stage 9 outer disciple appointed as his successor checked the ledgers page by page.

“All the quantities match.”

“Inspect the medicinal ingredients delivered by the Anling royal family every ten days. Even if they’ve already been checked by the royal Inner Medicine Court, don’t simply trust them as they are.”

“I’ll keep that in mind.”

“The pill furnace’s burner was repaired four months ago, so it should be fine for the time being. Even so, you’d best inspect the fire-kindling formation inscription on the floor again before the next rainy season.”

Lee Hyun went on to explain the procedures for issuing and receiving pills, the merchant companies they traded with, how to contact the royal physicians, and which items needed to be moved inside the defensive grand formation in an emergency.

When he finished, the disciple succeeding him cupped his hands.

“Thank you for all your hard work.”

“It was hardly anything worth calling hard work.”

Lee Hyun stared at the empty table for a moment.

Now that he had handed over the pill storehouse ledgers and keys, even the formation jade token, there truly was nothing left under his responsibility.

A memory from a very long time ago came to mind.

He had felt something similar on the day he was discharged from the military in his past life. Even after handing his duties over to his successor and emptying his locker, it had been difficult to grasp that he would never have to return again.

‘I stayed here much longer than I did back then.’

Lee Hyun had spent thirty years as Anling Kingdom’s resident cultivator.

Even for him, that was no short span of time.

“I’ll be going, then.”

“I pray that you succeed in reaching Foundation Establishment.”

Lee Hyun took one last look around the pill storehouse before stepping through the door.

...

That afternoon.

Pale pink petals floated across the broad lake south of Anling Kingdom’s royal palace.

It was the season when the cherry trees along the lakeshore were in full bloom, and every gust of wind scattered petals across the surface of the water.

A small royal villa stood on the western side of the lake.

As Lee Hyun approached the pavilion, the three men who had arrived before him rose from their seats.

“Immortal Li.”

Ruan Qingzhao cupped his hands.

The hair at his temples and his beard were entirely white. He had been in his forties when they first met, but before Lee Hyun knew it, he had become an old man past seventy.

Beside him stood Lu Jingtian, leaning on a short iron staff like a cane. His once-imposing frame had grown slightly stooped, and his long beard was white as snow.

Now ninety-one, Lu Jingtian had stepped down as commander of the Royal Guard more than ten years ago. These days, he retained only the honorary title of instructor emeritus at the royal Martial Arts Academy. The iron staff in his hand had been made by cutting down the shaft of the long spear he once wielded.

The last of the three was Zhang Jingyi.

His hair and eyebrows had likewise gone completely white. Deep wrinkles covered his face, and the wrists visible beyond the sleeves of his long robe were thinner than before.

Zhang Jingyi had received a second Foundation Establishment Pill fifteen years ago, but his breakthrough had failed once again. Because he had pushed himself despite his declining qi and blood, several of his meridians were damaged, and it took nearly three years just to recover.

In the end, he gave up on Foundation Establishment and retired from his kingdom garrison duties as well.

Recognizing his decades of service leading the Immortal Veneration Court, the Anling royal family granted him the status of Honorary Retainer. The villa by the lake and its attendants had also been provided by the royal family.

These days, all Zhang Jingyi did was occasionally mediate between the royal family and cultivators or listen to those who came seeking him out.

“Senior Brother Zhang.”

Lee Hyun cupped his hands.

“How have you been feeling?”

“Same as before.”

Zhang Jingyi smiled and patted his chest.

“They say I can live another ten years or so as long as I don’t move too much spiritual power. The royal family serves delicacies from land and sea at every meal, and from time to time they summon musicians and dancers to entertain me. Men of letters from the royal capital come to recite poetry or play Go with me, so I never have a chance to be bored.”

He gestured for Lee Hyun to sit.

The four men settled into the pavilion.

Spirit tea, fruit, and several simple dishes had been laid out on the table.

Lu Jingtian looked at Lee Hyun.

“I heard you’re going to receive a Foundation Establishment Pill.”

“That’s right.”

“Congratulations.”

At that moment, Zhang Jingyi spoke.

“Breaking through to Foundation Establishment is not easy even with a Foundation Establishment Pill. Junior Brother Li, whatever you do, don’t become impatient.”

“I’ll keep that in mind.”

After they drank tea for a while, Lu Jingtian spoke again.

“The young fellows at the Martial Arts Academy will be very disappointed when you leave, Immortal Li.”

“Aren’t you still there, Commander Lu?”

Lu Jingtian looked down at the iron staff in his hand.

“These days, even wielding a spear to my heart’s content is difficult.”

Ruan Qingzhao joined in.

“I still can’t understand that technique of yours, Immortal. I practiced it for so long, yet I never managed to get the slightest feel for it.”

Ruan Qingzhao looked down at his wrinkled hands, then raised his head.

“Still, if I ever have the chance to see you again, next time I’ll make certain I understand that technique.”

Lu Jingtian nodded as well.

“The next time we meet, I’ll show you the spear arts of my new disciples.”

Lee Hyun looked at the two men.

There was almost no chance he would ever be assigned to the Immortal Veneration Court in Anling Kingdom again. If he succeeded in reaching Foundation Establishment, he would become an inner disciple and take on different duties. Even if some reason brought him back here, the chances that these two men would still be alive by then were not high.

...

After finishing their tea, the four men walked out to the lakeshore.

Countless petals fell from the cherry trees swaying in the wind.

Lee Hyun took the Flowing Cloud Disc from his storage pouch.

Hummm―

The white jade plate expanded into a flight magic tool three zhang (about 9.9 m) long.

As Lee Hyun stepped onto the Flowing Cloud Disc, Lu Jingtian, Ruan Qingzhao, and Zhang Jingyi cupped their hands.

“May you attain the immortal path.”

“Thank you. May the three of you remain in good health as well. If fate allows, we shall meet again.”

The Flowing Cloud Disc slowly rose into the air.

Rustle―

The petals drifting across the lake were swept upward by the wind.

Pale pink petals brushed the edges of the white jade plate and scattered in swirling arcs.

Below stood an aged cultivator and two grandmasters of the martial path.

Beyond them, Lee Hyun could see the royal gardens and halls, along with the hills of the Immortal Veneration Court where he had spent thirty years.

With the hem of his long robe fluttering lightly, Lee Hyun rose above the clouds.

‘Taking to the skies on a day like this... I really do feel like an Immortal.’

The royal palace, the lake, and the villa rapidly shrank below him.

When he turned his gaze, sunlight streaming through the clouds softly illuminated the mountains and grasslands in every direction. It seemed as though even the heavens were blessing the road ahead of him.

Before long, the Flowing Cloud Disc changed course and flew toward the Danxiao Range.

...

Ten days later.

Danxiao Range.

From afar, clouds and the curtain of a formation surrounding the vast mountain range came into view.

Lee Hyun took out his identity token.

Hummm―

A passage opened in the curtain.

As the Flowing Cloud Disc entered, dense heaven-and-earth spiritual qi surged toward him from every direction.

“Just as good as ever.”

Countless peaks stretched through the clouds.

At first glance, little seemed to have changed since he had first entered this place about forty-two years ago to participate in the Special Selection for Skilled Practitioners.

But on closer inspection, there were more halls than before, and the positions of the bridges linking the mountain peaks had shifted here and there.

Li Dongsan’s appearance was no longer the same either. The man who had once appeared thirty-five was now a seventy-seven-year-old cultivator.

Some of his hair had turned white, and wrinkles had formed around his eyes and mouth. His back remained straight, but his movements carried a touch more caution than they had in his youth.

Of course, all of it had been created with the Seven-Aspect Disguise Method. Before leaving Anling Kingdom, he had also taken Bone-Forging Powder to make his target bone age seventy-seven in preparation for the bone-age examination.

...

Lee Hyun headed to the Outer Alchemy Court first.

In the valley surrounded by three gently sloping peaks, countless alchemy chambers still belched flames and smoke.

Boom!

An explosion erupted from an alchemy chamber halfway up the cliff.

As black smoke poured from the window, the disciples waiting nearby calmly activated a formation as though they were used to it.

Whoosh―

The smoke and heat were sucked into a rounded barrier.

‘This place hasn’t changed either.’

After descending into the valley, Lee Hyun looked toward the mountainside where he had lived long ago.

In front of the stone dwelling he had first used, an unfamiliar young disciple was drying medicinal ingredients.

Lee Hyun turned away and headed into the woods near the Outer Alchemy Court.

At the place where a stream carrying the mingled scents of various medicines joined the valley water, the small pavilion still stood exactly where it had before.

The roof and pillars looked as though they had been repaired several times, but its location had not changed.

A white-haired old cultivator was sitting inside the pavilion.

When Lee Hyun approached, surprise appeared on the man’s face a moment later.

“Fellow Daoist Li?”

“Fellow Daoist Lü.”

Lü Wende sprang to his feet.

“It really is you, Fellow Daoist Li!”

He had not been particularly young even the last time Lee Hyun saw him, but Lü Wende was now unmistakably an old man.

His once-round face had grown much thinner, and nearly all his hair and beard had turned white.

His realm was still Qi Refining Stage 9.

“Have you returned from Anling Kingdom?”

“That’s right.”

“You look healthier than I expected.”

“You look healthy as well, Fellow Daoist Lü.”

Lü Wende smiled and invited him to sit.

Three teacups had already been placed on the table.

“Is someone else coming?”

“Senior Sister Wen said she would.”

Just then, a faint blue spirit light descended from above the forest.

A leaf-shaped flight magic tool stopped in front of the pavilion.

A female cultivator stepped down from it.

It was Wen Xiaohe.

She, too, had still not broken through to Foundation Establishment and had by now become unmistakably middle-aged.

“Junior Brother Li.”

Wen Xiaohe smiled warmly.

“It really has been a long time.”

“It has, Senior Sister Wen.”

“I heard you came back to receive a Foundation Establishment Pill. I suppose I’ll have to call you Senior Li soon.”

“Haha, we don’t know that yet.”

The three poured tea.

For a while, they reminisced about the time they had spent together in the Outer Alchemy Court.

Tang Yanfei had left the sect eight years ago.

They said that after her father, who had been the head of the family’s merchant company, died and a dispute broke out among her siblings, she left sect life behind and returned south.

Steward Yang and Steward Quan were still in the Outer Alchemy Court, though they had stepped back from directly managing the disciples.

Chen Xiaoying of the Danxia Chen clan, on the other hand, who had passed the Special Selection for Skilled Practitioners alongside them, had succeeded in reaching Foundation Establishment long ago. She was now a Tier-2 alchemist of the Inner Alchemy Court and a disciple of a Golden Core Elder.

...

The next day.

The Foundation Establishment Court in the central Danxiao Range.

Inside the high walls, dozens of similarly sized stone chambers were arranged at regular intervals.

Each stone chamber extended deep into the interior of the mountain peak.

Formations had been laid throughout the area to block outside divine sense and sound and to prevent unauthorized people from approaching.

Lee Hyun presented the letter he had received from the main sect and his outer-disciple identity token.

After checking both items, the disciple in charge led him into an inner hall.

“Outer disciple Li Dongsan has arrived.”

Three Foundation Establishment cultivators were waiting inside the hall.

Lee Hyun’s gaze changed slightly when he saw one of them.

A female cultivator wearing a pale vermilion robe.

It was Chen Xiaoying, who had taken the Special Selection for Skilled Practitioners alongside him forty-two years ago.

She looked only slightly more mature than she had back then and otherwise had not changed much.

Chen Xiaoying recognized Lee Hyun immediately as well.

“It’s been a long time.”

“Greetings, Senior Chen.”

...

They first checked his bone age and realm.

When Lee Hyun placed his hand on a large silver mirror, the Foundation Establishment cultivator conducting the examination observed its reaction.

“Bone age, seventy-seven. Qi Refining Great Perfection. Wood, Fire, and Earth triple spiritual root.”

Next, Lee Hyun stepped between twelve stone pillars.

Different-colored lights swept across his body one after another.

A moment later, all the formation lights faded.

“No traces of demonic cultivation arts or blood sacrifice. No parasitic spirit insects or Life-Bound Gu. No damage to the meridians.”

Finally, they checked his accumulated contribution points and whether he had attempted Foundation Establishment before.

“No previous Foundation Establishment attempts.”

“That’s correct.”

“Twelve years of service in the Outer Alchemy Court. Thirty years on a kingdom garrison assignment in Anling Kingdom. No particular issues with alchemy duties or external assignments either....”

The cultivator examining the ledger raised his head.

“You’ve passed the eligibility assessment for Foundation Establishment.”

Chen Xiaoying handed Lee Hyun a jade token lying beside her.

「Qi-Condensation Chamber No. 7」

“You’ve been assigned a superior Qi-Condensation Chamber.”

“What is a Qi-Condensation Chamber?”

“A cave abode prepared for disciples undergoing secluded cultivation. Superior Qi-Condensation Chambers, in particular, are usually assigned only to disciples preparing to break through to Foundation Establishment.”

Chen Xiaoying pointed toward the interior of the Foundation Establishment Court.

“It is directly connected to a residual vein of a Tier-3 spirit vein, so it should help with your breakthrough. You may use it for twenty days.”

“Thank you.”

“The Foundation Establishment Pill will be issued after you enter the chamber.”

“Understood.”

...

Qi-Condensation Chamber No. 7.

Thoom.

The moment the thick stone door closed, every sound from outside vanished.

The chamber seemed to have been carved directly out of a single enormous mass of rock.

Even Lee Hyun’s techniques could not pass through the rock surrounding this place. There were no seams in the walls or ceiling, and countless formation inscriptions had been engraved across their surfaces.

A blue meditation cushion lay at the center of the floor.

Dense heaven-and-earth spiritual qi continuously flowed from the Qi-Gathering Formation beneath it.

Lee Hyun inserted the jade token into a groove in the wall.

Click.

Part of the wall opened, revealing a small stone pedestal.

A jade bottle rested on top of it.

A Spirit-Sealing Talisman was attached to the bottle’s mouth, and the Danxiao Sect’s pill-inspection seal was clearly stamped into the red sealing wax.

It was a Foundation Establishment Pill.

Lee Hyun picked up the bottle.

“Finally....”

Forty-two years had passed since he entered the Danxiao Sect in pursuit of a Foundation Establishment Pill.

Nearly thirty years had passed even since his lower dantian reached Qi Refining Great Perfection.

He peeled off the Spirit-Sealing Talisman and removed the sealing wax.

Pop.

The stopper came free from the jade bottle.

A subtle yet rich medicinal fragrance drifted out.

Lee Hyun tilted the bottle, and a pill about the size of his thumbnail rolled into his palm.

The Foundation Establishment Pill was ivory-colored.

Three blue pill markings resembling clouds spiraling toward a single point were etched across its surface.

When he examined it with the Aura-Reading Art and his divine sense, an enormous amount of medicinal strength was packed densely into its core. It was difficult to compare it to any pill he had ever seen before.

A Foundation Establishment Pill was difficult to obtain even with spirit stones. From what Lee Hyun had learned, a single pill had recently been valued within the sect at more than fifty mid-grade spirit stones.

Fifty mid-grade spirit stones were equivalent to five thousand low-grade spirit stones, far too great a sum for a Qi Refining Great Perfection cultivator to earn.

Of course, that was only a conversion of its value. The Danxiao Sect’s Foundation Establishment Pills were not something one could simply purchase just because one possessed enough spirit stones.

It was the pill a Qi Refining Great Perfection cultivator needed most desperately, yet one that was nearly impossible to obtain through a Qi Refining cultivator’s abilities alone.

Lee Hyun settled into the lotus position and calmed his mind.

More than 1,421 years had passed since he transmigrated into a nineteen-year-old body and began living in this world. He had spent most of that time cultivating the Primordial One-Qi Art in a half-asleep state, yet even the memories that remained clear exceeded the combined lifetimes of several people.

Lee Hyun slowly reviewed the mnemonic formula of the Primordial One-Qi Art that he had practiced for so long.

A short while later, after steadying himself, Lee Hyun placed the Foundation Establishment Pill into his mouth.

Gulp.

As the medicinal effects spread through his body, Lee Hyun began his qi circulation according to the Primordial One-Qi Art.

After about one shichen (about two hours), a small warmth arose in his lower abdomen.

The heat rapidly intensified until it felt as though his internal organs were burning. The pain was enough to make his mind grow hazy, but Lee Hyun held his focus firm and continued his qi circulation.

Dense medicinal strength surged toward the Sea of Qi Acupoint.

Thump!

His lower dantian shook violently.

The Primordial True Qi that had reached Qi Refining Great Perfection was swept up by the medicinal strength and began spinning rapidly.

Whooooosh―

With each rotation, the density of the spiritual power contained within the same space increased.

The medicinal strength of the Foundation Establishment Pill also seeped into the flesh and meridians surrounding his lower dantian. The area around the Sea of Qi Acupoint hardened like a sealed vessel.

‘Don’t rush.’

Hummmmm―

The spiritual pressure inside his lower dantian continued to rise.

When the spiritual pressure grew too high, the medicinal strength pushed toward the edges of his lower dantian began trying to leak outward.

Lee Hyun’s awareness followed its flow.

For an ordinary cultivator, this was where the danger began.

To them, the flesh and meridians outside the lower dantian were not spaces capable of storing spiritual power. As the breakthrough progressed, the difference in spiritual pressure inside and outside the lower dantian widened, and the high-pressure spiritual power and medicinal strength tried to burst toward the lower-pressure region.

This backflow scattered the medicinal strength of the Foundation Establishment Pill and damaged flesh and meridians that were not yet prepared to withstand liquid true essence. It was one of the main reasons other cultivators failed at Foundation Establishment.

But Lee Hyun was different. His entire body was one dantian, and even outside his lower dantian, it was filled with Primordial True Qi at roughly the level of someone who had just entered Qi Refining Stage 9.

Because the difference in spiritual pressure between the inside and outside was relatively small, the medicinal strength did not erupt outward uncontrollably.

‘I see. Since my whole-body dantian supports the spiritual pressure outside, it’s much easier to hold on to the Foundation Establishment Pill’s medicinal strength!’

He drew the medicinal strength back in.

He held the Primordial True Qi throughout his body perfectly still and moved only the currents within his lower dantian.

His entire body remained calm like a vast sea.

Only the small whirlpool at its center spun faster and faster.

Two shichen, three shichen...

Thump!

The hazy currents began clinging together.

Drip.

There was no actual sound, yet to Lee Hyun it felt as distinct as a drop of water falling.

A single drop of clear liquid formed at the center of his lower dantian.

The Primordial True Qi that had once spread like a gas had transformed into liquid true essence.

‘It worked.’

But Lee Hyun neither celebrated nor stopped his qi circulation.

Foundation Establishment was not yet complete.

With the liquid true essence at the center, the surrounding Primordial True Qi gathered even faster.

Drip. Drip. Patter―

The liquid true essence, once no more than a tiny bead of dew, gradually spread wider.

The more the spiritual power within his lower dantian liquefied, the higher the spiritual pressure rose. Several times, the Primordial True Qi was pushed outward, only to be blocked by the spiritual pressure of the whole-body dantian and immediately return.

...

A day passed.

The spiritual qi drawn in by the Qi-Gathering Formation of the Qi-Condensation Chamber continued seeping into Lee Hyun’s body.

His lower dantian had now begun refining the newly absorbed spiritual qi into liquid Primordial True Qi without relying on the power of the Foundation Establishment Pill.

Hummmmmm―

It felt as though a small, clear lake had formed beneath the Sea of Qi Acupoint.

The surface of the lake was still, but within it lay power of a density incomparable to before.

Lee Hyun circulated the mnemonic formula from the Foundation Establishment Section of the Primordial One-Qi Art.

Whoooosh―

The liquid true essence completed one circuit through his lower dantian, then became a thin stream and entered his meridians.

The rest of his body outside the lower dantian was still at Qi Refining Stage 9.

However, it was far tougher than the body of an ordinary cultivator and was already accustomed to high spiritual pressure.

As the thin stream of true essence traveled through the meridians and completed a circuit of his entire body, it caused no damage anywhere.

The true essence returned to his lower dantian.

Hummm―

The changes within and around his lower dantian completely stabilized.

Foundation Establishment Stage 1!

Lee Hyun had finally become a full-fledged Foundation Establishment cultivator, at least as far as his lower dantian was concerned.

After examining his body internally, Lee Hyun took a wooden board from his storage pouch and updated his handmade status window.

【Age: 1,440】

【Realm: Foundation Establishment Stage 1 (lower dantian)】

【Spiritual Power: 1,340 → 1,376】

‘An ordinary Foundation Establishment Stage 1 cultivator has around 70 spiritual power.... My whole-body dantian has fifty times that capacity, so if all of it reaches Foundation Establishment Stage 1, that would put me at around 3,500.’

...

After examining the changes in his body for a while, Lee Hyun simply lay back.

“That went more smoothly than I expected. Hm?”

Lee Hyun saw that his entire body was coated in a slick yellowish substance. He removed his long robe and used the Cleansing Art.

The impurities covering his body were swept away cleanly and vanished.

...

Even afterward, Lee Hyun did not immediately leave the Qi-Condensation Chamber.

He spent another four days fully absorbing the remaining medicinal strength of the Foundation Establishment Pill and stabilizing his lower dantian.

For the next ten days, he repeatedly practiced circulating the liquid Primordial True Qi throughout his body while adjusting the Spirit-Concealing Art and Aura-Concealing Art to suit his new realm.

He also disguised the fluctuations of spiritual power visible from the outside to resemble those of a cultivator who had only just reached Foundation Establishment and had not yet fully consolidated his realm.

He adjusted the appearance he had created with the Seven-Aspect Disguise Method as well.

He needed to look as though his qi and blood had been rejuvenated by reaching Foundation Establishment, but not so young that his appearance no longer matched his bone age.

In the mirror, some of Li Dongsan’s hair had turned black again, and his eyes looked more vigorous than before. The wrinkles on his face had also faded slightly.

“This should do.”

It was the fifteenth day since he had entered the Qi-Condensation Chamber.

...

Foundation Establishment Court.

A late-stage Qi Refining disciple responsible for managing the Qi-Condensation Chambers looked toward Qi-Condensation Chamber No. 7.

‘It’s taking rather long. Did he fail?’

Li Dongsan was a seventy-seven-year-old outer disciple.

He was hardly young, so breaking through to Foundation Establishment could not have been easy.

Just then.

Hummmmmm―

The formation inscriptions on Qi-Condensation Chamber No. 7 lit up.

Rumble.

The thick stone door slowly opened.

The disciple in charge rose from his seat.

A cultivator walked out from the darkness within.

“You... succeeded in reaching Foundation Establishment.”

Lee Hyun cupped his hands.

“I was fortunate.”

The disciple’s expression brightened.

He, too, cupped his hands and returned the courtesy.

“Congratulations, Senior.”

Chapter 52

“Thank you.”

Lee Hyun also gave a slight bow before looking back at the Qi-Condensation Chamber.

“Inspect the chamber as well.”

The attendant disciple made a round of the chamber, then collected the jade token.

“Everything is in order. Please wait a moment.”

A short while later, the attendant disciple returned with a sealed letter bearing the seal of the Foundation Establishment Court.

“Take this to the Internal Affairs Court, and they will issue you an inner-disciple identity token. Your division and cave abode will also be assigned there.”

“Where is the Internal Affairs Court?”

“It is on Qingyu Peak, about fifty li (about 19.6 km) to the east.”

“Understood.”

...

As Lee Hyun left the Foundation Establishment Court, a gentle breeze slipped through the folds of his long robe.

He stopped and looked around.

Though they were the same mountains and forests, they felt different from before.

The flow of spiritual qi along the mountainside was far clearer, and he could sense the wind passing between the trees and rocks from much farther away.

Just then, a shadow streaked swiftly overhead.

Lee Hyun looked up.

A cultivator was flying through the air without standing on any magic tool. Beneath his feet, faint spirit light rippled into existence before fading away.

‘A Foundation Establishment cultivator?’

It was said that upon reaching Foundation Establishment, cultivators could fly through the air using spiritual power alone, without relying on a flight magic tool.

Lee Hyun cast the Wind-Riding Art beneath his feet.

Whoooosh―

The wind alone lifted his body nearly three chi (about 1 m) into the air.

“Oh.”

When Lee Hyun tried to move forward, his body suddenly tilted to the right. He hurriedly withdrew his spiritual power and landed, then straightened his robes.

‘This doesn’t seem to be how it’s done.... Come to think of it, Foundation Establishment cultivators who don’t know the Wind-Riding Art can still fly, can’t they? I’ll have to ask when I get the chance.’

Lee Hyun took the Flowing Cloud Disc out of his storage pouch.

Hummm―

The Flowing Cloud Disc rose into the air.

...

The Internal Affairs Court on Qingyu Peak had been built where several mountain ranges converged.

From below, it looked like a six-story hall, but countless rooms and passages also extended into the cliff behind it.

Foundation Establishment cultivators constantly came and went before the hall.

Off to one side, a cultivator demanding repairs to his old cave abode was arguing loudly with the steward in charge.

“I’m telling you, water leaks through the wall.”

“As long as it’s properly connected to the spirit vein, what does a little leaking water matter? Seal it with a technique.”

“I don’t know any Earth techniques. Can’t the Internal Affairs Court repair it for me?”

Lee Hyun watched the two for a moment before heading inside the hall.

He handed the sealed letter to a Foundation Establishment cultivator from the Internal Affairs Court sitting behind the reception desk, and the man broke the seal.

“Li Dongsan. Twelve years in the Outer Alchemy Court, thirty years on a kingdom garrison assignment in Anling Kingdom....”

The man paused while reading and looked at Lee Hyun.

“You spent a long time in Anling Kingdom.”

“It wasn’t a bad place to live.”

“Congratulations on reaching Foundation Establishment, fellow Daoist.”

“Thank you.”

The cultivator in charge stamped the letter with the seal of the Internal Affairs Court.

He then took Lee Hyun’s outer-disciple identity token and placed it atop a crystal-clear formation plate.

Hummm―

Light flowing from the formation plate enveloped the identity token.

The symbol denoting an outer disciple vanished, and in its place appeared a pattern of three layers of flames and clouds.

“Your division is the Inner Alchemy Court, and your master’s lineage is under Elder Tan Yunsheng of Yanxia Peak.”

“Elder Tan....”

“He is a Tier 3 alchemist at the mid-stage Golden Core realm. He excels at Harmonizing medicinal potency and warm nurturing. Since you worked as an alchemist in the Outer Alchemy Court and possess a Wood, Fire and Earth triple spiritual root, we judged his lineage to be a good fit for you.”

The cultivator handed the completed identity token to Lee Hyun.

“Your master’s lineage refers to whom you learn from, while your division refers to where you work. Elder Tan also happens to be one of the Elders of the Inner Alchemy Court, so in your case, the two naturally overlap.”

“I see.”

“For your cave abode, you can use Qingyu Ravine, northwest of Yanxia Peak.”

The cultivator reached toward a map hanging on the wall. As spiritual power flowed into it, the mountains and valleys on the map rose into three dimensions.

Several thin branches of a spirit vein extended in every direction from Yanxia Peak. A red dot appeared over a small valley roughly thirty li to the northwest.

“It is connected to a Tier 2 spirit vein. It has been vacant for about a year. The cave abode contains a cultivation chamber and a small storeroom, and there should also be a spirit field outside.”

“The entire Qingyu Ravine is being assigned to me?”

“That’s right. The valley isn’t very large, though.”

The cultivator took a long wooden case from beneath the table.

Click.

Inside the case lay twelve formation flags, each one chi long, neatly arranged in a row.

Their surfaces were embroidered with formation inscriptions resembling white clouds and mountains. In the center lay a bronze formation plate about the size of a palm, and a single mid-grade spirit stone rested in a small recess beside it.

“This is the Cloud-Barrier Abode-Guarding Formation. It is a Tier 2 low-grade defensive formation issued to inner disciples when they receive a new cave abode. The mid-grade spirit stone is part of the annual allotment given to inner disciples.”

From beneath the wooden case, he also took out a thin booklet titled Essentials of Deploying the Cloud-Barrier Abode-Guarding Formation.

“It explains how to position the formation flags, how to connect the formation plate to the cave abode’s Qi-Gathering Formation, and how to deploy the formation using spirit stones if that connection is severed. The deployment method differs for valleys, mountain peaks, and waterside terrain, so install it according to the terrain once you reach your cave abode.”

Lee Hyun opened the booklet. Cross-sectional diagrams of valleys and mountain peaks showed where each formation flag should be placed, and the later pages even described in considerable detail the order in which damaged flags should be replaced.

“An alarm will sound whenever someone with spiritual power approaches. It can also withstand attacks from an early Foundation Establishment cultivator for a while.”

He handed Lee Hyun the wooden case and a map of Qingyu Ravine.

“The formation is issued only once, when a cave abode is first assigned to you. If you lose or damage it, you’ll have to obtain a replacement yourself, so take care of it. We have also sent word to Yanxia Peak. Someone should arrive shortly.”

Lee Hyun put the wooden case into his storage pouch.

Half a shichen (about one hour) later, a middle-aged cultivator entered the hall.

He was tall and broad-shouldered, but his face was long and lean. The scent of medicinal ingredients clung to the sleeves of his long robe.

“Is Junior Brother Li Dongsan here?”

“I am Li Dongsan.”

The middle-aged cultivator looked at Lee Hyun.

“I am Tao Wenqian. I am Master’s head disciple and your Eldest Senior Brother.”

Lee Hyun cupped his hands.

“Greetings, Eldest Senior Brother Tao.”

Tao Wenqian nodded, then looked at the cultivator in charge.

“Is the registration complete?”

“It was just completed. His cave abode has been assigned, and the Cloud-Barrier Abode-Guarding Formation was issued as well.”

Tao Wenqian turned around.

“Follow me.”

...

The two left Qingyu Peak.

Tao Wenqian stepped out into empty air, and faint crimson spirit light appeared beneath his feet.

His body rose directly above the mountainside.

When Lee Hyun took out the Flowing Cloud Disc, Tao Wenqian slowed down.

“You haven’t learned the Skywalking Art yet?”

“I only came out of the Qi-Condensation Chamber today.”

“I see.”

The two flew side by side toward Yanxia Peak.

Before long, two black-rock peaks blocked the way ahead. There was neither a road nor a hall between them, only a pale, misty curtain stretching vertically through the air.

Tao Wenqian stopped before the curtain.

“Take out your identity token. We need to register your aura with the formation.”

Lee Hyun raised his newly issued identity token.

The three-layered flame pattern engraved on it lit up. Light flowing from the curtain swept over Lee Hyun’s identity token once, and a circular passage opened directly ahead.

As soon as they passed through, denser heaven-and-earth spiritual qi enveloped his entire body.

The Danxiao Sect’s Inner Gate came fully into view.

Peaks that had been hidden by clouds from the outer mountain ranges stretched endlessly into the distance.

Far away, an enormous crimson formation covered an entire valley.

“That is the Inner Alchemy Court’s communal Alchemy Hall.”

Tao Wenqian pointed at the valley.

“Flames drawn up from the earth-fire vein are divided among dozens of alchemy chambers. It saves the spiritual power that would otherwise be spent heating a pill furnace directly, and the heat remains comparatively steady, which makes it convenient. Not only the disciples of our Yanxia Peak lineage, but most Tier 2 alchemists in the Inner Alchemy Court also use the communal Alchemy Hall.”

Whoooom―

Beneath the crimson formation, round stone chambers stood at regular intervals. Each chamber contained a pill furnace and formations for controlling the earth fire, while a large opening had been cut into the roof.

Suddenly, purple smoke shot up from one of them.

A Foundation Establishment cultivator nearby hurriedly spread out a large cloth, which sucked in every trace of the purple smoke.

A moment later, something shot out of the stone chamber.

Bang!

It was a blackened pill-furnace lid.

Tao Wenqian glanced in that direction.

“Don’t be alarmed. It happens fairly often.”

Lee Hyun looked at the cultivators flying between the mountain peaks.

Some used flight magic tools, but more than half traveled through the air under their own power.

“Eldest Senior Brother, how do you fly without a flight magic tool?”

“A Foundation Establishment cultivator’s spiritual power does not easily dissipate even after leaving the body. You use that spiritual power to support yourself beneath your feet and around your body, maintaining your balance in the air.”

The crimson spirit light beneath Tao Wenqian’s feet spread outward.

“At first, it’s slower than using a flight magic tool and consumes more spiritual power, but once you get used to it, it’s extremely convenient.”

“Do I need to obtain a separate technique?”

“Don’t worry. Master will teach you the Skywalking Art.”

Tao Wenqian turned his gaze ahead.

“There are twenty-four disciples under Master now, counting you. Every one of us belongs to the Inner Alchemy Court, and everyone except you is qualified as a Tier 2 alchemist.”

“Are they all on Yanxia Peak?”

“Those currently staying within the Mountain Gate... probably fifteen. The others are away on external assignments.”

Tao Wenqian pointed ahead.

“That is Yanxia Peak.”

A verdant peak wrapped in mist and clouds came into view.

Spirit fields of various sizes spread in terraces along the mountainside.

Above them, blue-tiled halls and small pavilions stood scattered among ancient pine trees.

Tao Wenqian descended onto a broad stone terrace halfway up the mountain.

Lee Hyun followed on the Flowing Cloud Disc and landed behind him.

An ancient pine tree grew behind the terrace.

Beneath it, a middle-aged man in a pale blue long robe sat on a flat rock. He looked a little over forty, with a gentle expression and slightly drooping eyes. The fingers beneath his rolled-up sleeves were stained purple and blue.

Rather than a Golden Core Elder, he gave the easygoing impression of a spirit-plant cultivator who had spent many years tending spirit fields.

At the stone table beside him, Chen Xiaoying and a man with a short beard were discussing a pill that had been split in half.

“The heat was too strong.”

The man shook his head.

“It was just before Pill Condensation. If the heat was the cause, shouldn’t there be scorch marks on the surface?”

The middle-aged man picked up the pill and examined the split interior.

“You’re both wrong. Bring me another answer by tomorrow.”

“Yes, Master.”

Only then did the middle-aged man turn his gaze toward Lee Hyun.

Tao Wenqian stepped forward.

“Master. I have brought Junior Brother Li Dongsan.”

Chen Xiaoying’s eyes widened.

“Li Dongsan? You succeeded at Foundation Establishment! So you’ve become a disciple of Yanxia Peak? I suppose I should call you Junior Brother Li now.”

“Good to see you, Senior Sister Chen.”

Tan Yunsheng set down the pill and smiled gently.

“So you are Li Dongsan. Come here.”

Tao Wenqian lifted the teapot on the stone table and poured spirit tea into an empty cup. He handed the cup to Lee Hyun, then lightly gestured toward Tan Yunsheng with his chin.

Lee Hyun held the teacup respectfully in both hands.

“Disciple Li Dongsan greets Elder Tan.”

Tan Yunsheng accepted the tea and took a sip.

“I heard you spent thirty years on an assignment away from the sect, then returned and successfully reached Foundation Establishment. You have a steadfast will. You’ve worked hard.”

“Thank you.”

“From now on, call me Master, not Elder.”

“Yes, Master.”

Tan Yunsheng looked at Tao Wenqian.

“Wenqian, introduce him to his fellow disciples.”

“Yes.”

Tao Wenqian first gestured toward Chen Xiaoying.

“This is Junior Sister Chen Xiaoying. It seems the two of you are already acquainted.”

“We are. We took the entrance examination for the Special Selection for Skilled Practitioners together many years ago.”

Tao Wenqian gestured toward the man with the short beard.

“This is my Junior Brother Fang Jiyun. To you, he is Senior Brother Fang.”

“Greetings, Senior Brother Fang.”

Fang Jiyun gave a brief nod.

“Good to meet you.”

Tan Yunsheng indicated the opposite side of the stone table.

“Sit.”

“Yes.”

Tan Yunsheng spoke again.

“You only just broke through to Foundation Establishment, correct? Does the cultivation art you were practicing extend through a Foundation Establishment Section?”

“Yes.”

“What spiritual root do you possess?”

“A Wood, Fire and Earth triple spiritual root.”

“I see. Then this works out nicely. To commemorate you becoming my disciple, I’ll teach you a technique.”

Tan Yunsheng took a red jade slip from his storage pouch.

“This is the Flame-Threading Art. Examine its contents.”

Lee Hyun accepted the jade slip, pressed it to his forehead, and infused it with divine sense.

The technique’s mnemonic formula and several diagrams of spiritual power circulation flowed into his consciousness.

The Flame-Threading Art was a technique that divided a single flame into dozens of slender flame threads.

During alchemy, it allowed different levels of heat to be applied to each medicinal ingredient inside the pill furnace. In combat, dozens of flame threads could obstruct an opponent’s movements or persistently burn away at their body-protecting spirit light.

Tan Yunsheng said,

“Simply dividing a flame into multiple strands is not enough. Only when you can control the heat of each strand independently can you use it for alchemy and combat.”

“I will practice diligently.”

Tan Yunsheng took out another jade slip.

“This is the Skywalking Art. Now that you are a Foundation Establishment cultivator, you should learn how to fly as well.”

“Thank you.”

“Return both jade slips to me once you have learned them.”

“Yes.”

Tan Yunsheng looked at Lee Hyun again.

“Until you qualify as a Tier 2 alchemist, you will assist your Senior Brothers and Senior Sisters with their alchemy in the communal Alchemy Hall and begin by learning how to prepare Tier 2 spirit plants.”

“Yes.”

“For now, organize your cave abode and stabilize your realm. Come back in fifteen days.”

...

Before Lee Hyun left Yanxia Peak, Chen Xiaoying approached him.

“Junior Brother, which cave abode were you assigned?”

“Qingyu Ravine.”

Fang Jiyun spoke as he passed beside them.

“Qingyu Ravine... Not a bad place. The spirit vein is stable, and there should be a small spirit spring there as well.”

Tao Wenqian pointed northwest.

“Go about thirty li northwest and you should see a waterfall. If you run into any trouble while settling your cave abode, come find me.”

“Understood.”

Lee Hyun saluted the three of them before stepping onto the Flowing Cloud Disc.

The Flowing Cloud Disc left Yanxia Peak and headed northwest.

...

Qingyu Ravine was a narrow valley enclosed on both sides by steep cliffs. The cliffs were covered in blue-green moss and vines, and water flowing down from above formed a small waterfall farther inside the valley.

Lee Hyun circled the valley twice on the Flowing Cloud Disc.

“Where is the cave abode supposed to be?”

Lee Hyun landed in front of the waterfall and cast the Aura-Reading Art.

Faint spiritual qi was being drawn in behind the waterfall.

When he reached out, spiritual power split the torrent to either side.

Roooar―

A stone door covered in vines and moss appeared behind the waterfall.

When Lee Hyun exerted his strength, the stone door slowly opened inward.

Damp air flowed out along with the stale scent of old earth.

Lee Hyun flicked a finger, and a small sphere of light appeared, illuminating the cave abode.

Inside was a spacious stone chamber with two smaller rooms. A Qi-Gathering Formation connected to a Tier 2 spirit vein was engraved into the floor of the room on the right, while stone shelves for storing items lined the room on the left.

A narrow passage behind the stone chamber led to the spirit field outside the mountain.

Instead of spirit herbs, the spirit field was overgrown with weeds. Clear water flowed between the rocks from a small spirit spring off to one side.

“Better than I expected.”

Lee Hyun carefully inspected every corner of the cave abode.

There were no traces of hidden formation inscriptions. The only thing the previous owner had left behind was an old stone mortar.

After using the Cleansing Art to remove the dust and moss, Lee Hyun set the wooden case in the middle of the stone chamber and opened Essentials of Deploying the Cloud-Barrier Abode-Guarding Formation.

‘They’ve explained it quite thoroughly.’

He spent half a day bonding the formation plate and twelve formation flags, then installed them one by one around the valley entrance, the cliffs, the waterfall, and the spirit spring.

When the formation plate was finally connected to the Qi-Gathering Formation, the twelve cloud patterns on its surface lit up simultaneously.

Lee Hyun infused spiritual power into the formation plate.

Whoooosh―

The mist scattered throughout the valley slowly spread over the waterfall, cliffs, and stone door of the cave abode. The outline of the stone door blurred, and a short while later, nothing remained in its place but an ordinary moss-covered cliff.

“When I have time, I should spruce up the cave abode a little. No, before that, I should learn the Skywalking Art.”

Lee Hyun took out the Skywalking Art jade slip and pressed it to his forehead.

The Skywalking Art was not an attribute-based technique tied to the Five Elements or to wind, lightning, light, or darkness. As long as a cultivator possessed spiritual power at the Foundation Establishment level, they could use it regardless of their spiritual root.

...

Several days later.

A figure slowly rose above the cliffs of Qingyu Ravine.

Faint spirit light spread beneath Lee Hyun’s feet. His movements, cautious at first, gradually quickened until his body swept over the waterfall and soared into the blue sky.

Whoooosh―

The hem of his long robe snapped fiercely in the wind.

There was nothing beneath his feet, and although he was still somewhat unsteady, he could freely move in whatever direction he wished.

Lee Hyun made a wide round above the valley.

“Haha.”

Laughter escaped him before he realized it.

He increased his speed a little more, cut through the clouds, then descended once again onto the cliffs above Qingyu Ravine.

“Now I finally feel like I’ve become a Foundation Establishment cultivator.”

Lee Hyun spent a long while flying back and forth between the valley and the surrounding peaks, only returning to Qingyu Ravine when the sun began to set.

Two years later.

Inner Alchemy Court communal Alchemy Hall.

Earth fire burned quietly beneath a pill furnace.

Seated before the pill furnace, Lee Hyun formed the final hand seal, and the flames rising through the burner quickly subsided.

Hummm―

The pill furnace gave a low hum.

Lee Hyun waited for the medicinal qi inside the pill furnace to settle before reaching out.

Click.

The heavy lid opened, releasing a faint medicinal fragrance.

Three blue pills the size of thumbnails rested at the bottom of the pill furnace.

Fang Jiyun, who had been watching from behind, picked up one of the pills.

He examined its surface and medicinal fragrance, then split the pill in half.

“About seventy percent of the medicinal strength remains, and the impurities are within acceptable limits.”

Fang Jiyun inspected the remaining two pills one after another.

“All three are usable.”

Lee Hyun let out a quiet breath.

According to the Inner Alchemy Court’s regulations, one had to successfully refine a basic Tier 2 pill three times in succession to qualify as a Tier 2 alchemist.

This was his third success.

“Did I pass?”

“Yes. I suppose we can call you a Tier 2 alchemist now.”

“It’s thanks to your instruction, Senior Brother Fang.”

Two years had already passed since Lee Hyun entered Tan Yunsheng’s lineage.

For the first half year, he followed Fang Jiyun, preparing Tier 2 spirit plants and assisting other alchemists with their alchemy. After that, he learned to handle the pill furnace and earth fire himself, and three months ago, he began refining Tier 2 Qi-Restoring Pills.

The only Tier 2 pill he could refine so far was the Qi-Restoring Pill. Neither his success rate nor the quality of his pills could compare with Fang Jiyun’s or Chen Xiaoying’s.

Even so, he was now a Tier 2 alchemist officially recognized by the Danxiao Sect.

Lee Hyun asked,

“Now that I’m recognized as a Tier 2 alchemist, will I have access to more pill recipes?”

“Of course. You can spend contribution points to access the Tier 2 pill recipes held by the Inner Alchemy Court. The Foundation Establishment Pill recipe is among them.”

Lee Hyun was surprised.

“I can access the Foundation Establishment Pill recipe as well?”

Fang Jiyun gave a faint chuckle.

“People are often surprised when they first hear that.”

He closed the pill-furnace lid and continued.

“Within our Danxiao Sect, the Foundation Establishment Pill recipe itself isn’t as closely guarded a secret as you might think. Of course, copying it or passing it outside the sect is forbidden....”

“Then why are Foundation Establishment Pills so scarce?”

“The problem is the ingredients. Most of the supplementary medicinal ingredients can be grown in the Danxiao Sect’s spirit fields, but several main ingredients cannot. Some of them even grow only in special secret realms.”

Fang Jiyun continued,

“We also have to purchase certain spirit plants from outside. Even after gathering all the ingredients, they’re so expensive that we prefer to entrust the alchemy only to experienced alchemists. So merely knowing the pill recipe does not mean you can make a Foundation Establishment Pill.”

...

That evening.

At his residence in Qingyu Ravine, Lee Hyun opened his right hand.

Fwoosh―

The crimson flame blooming above his palm divided into dozens of slender flame threads.

The flame threads intertwined, forming the shape of a butterfly the size of his palm.

The crimson butterfly fluttered its wings.

It circled Lee Hyun once before settling on a dry blade of grass at the edge of the spirit field.

Despite touching the flame, the blade of grass did not char.

Lee Hyun moved a finger, and the butterfly unraveled back into dozens of flame threads before being drawn into his palm.

“At this level, I can say I’ve reached Novice proficiency in the Flame-Threading Art.”

Unlike the Skywalking Art, the Flame-Threading Art had taken him nearly two years to learn.

Lee Hyun flopped onto his back on the floor.

By now, he had grown accustomed to life as an inner disciple. Each month, he received Tan Yunsheng’s teachings on Yanxia Peak, while on the other days he traveled back and forth between the communal Alchemy Hall and Qingyu Ravine.

Now that he was also qualified as a Tier 2 alchemist, there was far more he could do than before.

‘I can keep honing my alchemy as I have been.’

Although he had become a Tier 2 alchemist, he could hardly claim to have properly mastered Tier 2 alchemy. Lee Hyun was still only at the Novice level.

‘I can also look through the Scripture Pavilion’s Inner Pavilion now. I should pick out some techniques that Foundation Establishment cultivators can learn and see which ones would be useful to me.’

‘I should upgrade my magic tools too. I’m a Foundation Establishment cultivator now, and I had plenty of spirit stones to begin with.’

There was a great deal to do, but what he needed to check first was obvious.

‘First, the Foundation Establishment Pill recipe. I should also look for pill recipes that use Bone-Rot Flower, Purple Poison Orchid, Yin Soul Grass, and Spirit-Storing Ginseng.’

Chapter 53

Three days later.

The Pill Recipe Pavilion of the Inner Alchemy Court.

Lee Hyun slowly examined the inheritance list hanging on the wall.

The Pill Recipe Pavilion was much smaller than the Inner Pavilion of the Scripture Pavilion. Instead, the listings were divided according to the grade and effects of each pill, with the qualifications required to view each pill recipe written alongside them.

His gaze stopped on one wooden plaque.

「Foundation Establishment Pill.

Tier 2 pill recipe.

Available for viewing only to alchemists of Tier 2 or higher recognized by this sect.

240 contribution points.

Unauthorized transmission prohibited.」

‘So they really do have it.’

Lee Hyun held out his identity token to the cultivator in charge.

“I would like to view the Foundation Establishment Pill recipe.”

The cultivator placed the identity token on a formation plate. Three layers of flame patterns lit up, and Lee Hyun’s affiliation and alchemist qualification appeared in midair.

“Fellow Daoist Li Dongsan of Yanxia Peak, I see. You have not held your Tier 2 alchemist qualification for very long, have you?”

“That is correct.”

“You are qualified to view it. However, simply reading the pill recipe does not mean you will be entrusted with refining it.”

“I understand.”

After deducting the contribution points from his identity token, the cultivator pointed toward a small stone chamber farther inside.

“Go to the third inheritance chamber.”

...

Clack.

The stone door closed.

Lee Hyun picked up the jade slip resting on the stone platform and pressed it to his forehead.

「Foundation Establishment Pill recipe, quantities for one furnace batch.

All ages listed below refer to medicine age.

One Spirit-Storing Ginseng root, 250–470 years.

One Jade-Condensing Grass plant, 230–460 years.

One Fire-Heart Orchid plant, 220–430 years.

Twenty-six additional auxiliary medicinal ingredients...」

There were three main ingredients, followed by twenty-six kinds of auxiliary medicinal ingredients.

‘Spirit-Storing Ginseng?’

Lee Hyun’s attention stopped on the familiar name.

He carefully examined the explanation concerning Spirit-Storing Ginseng first.

The Spirit-Storing Ginseng used in the Foundation Establishment Pill had to be more than 250 years old. It required a far older root than when used for a Barrier-Breaking Pill, but it was not a different variety.

‘Spirit Fields No. 2-1 through No. 2-5 are all Spirit-Storing Ginseng fields!’

Pleased, Lee Hyun went through the remaining ingredients one by one.

There were many kinds of auxiliary ingredients, but they were all commonly traded spirit plants. There was no need to grow them himself when he could simply buy them at a cultivator market.

The problem was the three main ingredients.

First, Spirit-Storing Ginseng was a medicinal ingredient whose entire root was used. Fortunately, his own spirit fields already contained plenty that were suitable.

Jade-Condensing Grass was a spirit plant that formed a jade-colored bulb underground. The greater its medicine age, the more medicinal potency condensed within the bulb, and alchemy required one complete plant with both bulb and roots intact.

In other words, every furnace batch consumed an entire Spirit-Storing Ginseng root and an entire Jade-Condensing Grass plant that had each been cultivated for hundreds of years.

Jade-Condensing Grass was also cultivated in the sect’s spirit fields, but it took a long time to develop sufficient medicinal potency.

‘I should get some seeds for this and plant them too.’

Fire-Heart Orchids were different.

They were spirit plants with fine red streaks along the inner surfaces of their petals, and the medicinal potency required for the Foundation Establishment Pill gathered within those streaks. However, that medicinal potency formed only after absorbing the earth qi found in a particular secret realm.

There had been cases where mother plants were successfully transplanted and kept alive outside, but no matter how long they were cultivated, they could never develop the same medicinal potency as those grown inside the secret realm. The Danxiao Sect harvested mature Fire-Heart Orchids by the roots from a place under its control called the Huatian Secret Realm, using them to supply the amount needed for refining Foundation Establishment Pills, but the yield was extremely low.

‘So this is what Senior Brother Fang was talking about.’

After committing all the relevant information to memory, Lee Hyun examined the alchemy sequence.

From preparing the medicinal ingredients, through detoxification and Refining, Ingredient Combining and Pill Condensation, all the way to the warm nurturing immediately before completion.

He could more or less understand the earlier parts. But once the number of medicinal ingredients increased and the process reached the stage of handling several different medicinal potencies at once, he keenly realized that reading the words and actually carrying them out were two entirely different matters.

According to the pill recipe, even while adjusting the fire control for one medicinal ingredient, the states of all the other ingredients continued to change. The smallest difference in an earlier step affected both the subsequent distribution of medicinal strength and the amount of firepower required.

‘The difficulty of refining this is in a completely different league from the other pill recipes I’ve seen so far....’

For now, Lee Hyun focused on engraving the contents accurately into his mind. His memory itself surpassed that of mortals, but the pill recipe was both complex and extensive.

...

After leaving the inheritance chamber, Lee Hyun did not immediately leave the Pill Recipe Pavilion. Instead, he examined the listings again, this time looking for pill recipes that used spirit plants familiar to him as ingredients.

Normally, he had no way of knowing which pill recipe a particular ingredient was used in, but he did have a few clues.

The Tier 2 Bone-Forging Powder recipe immediately caught his eye. He already knew that the Bone-Rot Flowers growing in his spirit fields were used in it, so this recipe was certainly worth viewing.

Next was the Tier 2 Poison-Warding Pill recipe. He also knew that one of the spirit plants he had already cultivated, the Purple Poison Orchid, was used in it, so he decided to view that one as well.

The last thing he searched for was the Spirit-Calming Pill. Long ago, Senior Brother Lu Baishan of Qinghe Valley had told him that Yin Soul Grass was an ingredient in Spirit-Calming Pills.

However, there was no pill recipe called the Spirit-Calming Pill in this Pill Recipe Pavilion.

It was possible that Yin Soul Grass was used in some other pill recipe, but he could not blindly spend his contribution points viewing every recipe in sight.

‘The Tier 2 Bone-Forging Powder and Tier 2 Poison-Warding Pill recipes are already more than enough of a haul.’

Lee Hyun viewed those two pill recipes in turn as well. They required far fewer contribution points than the Foundation Establishment Pill recipe, so the cost was no great burden.

...

A few days later.

Danxiao Immortal City.

This place, practically the Danxiao Sect’s cultivator market, had a hall called the Spirit Materials Hall.

Large and small pots and wooden crates were lined up in front of it, each bearing a wooden plaque listing the variety, medicine age, and suitable cultivation environment.

Lee Hyun slowly looked around inside. Among the spirit plants used in the Foundation Establishment Pill and the other pill recipes he had newly viewed, he intended to buy those whose seeds or young seedlings were available.

He did not intend to grow every spirit plant required by his newly acquired pill recipes.

Once some varieties reached the age required by the pill recipe, leaving them to grow even older provided little additional benefit, so there was no real advantage in using his own spirit fields to cultivate them.

Increasing the number of spirit plant varieties he personally grew too much would only make the spirit fields harder to manage.

Timing every harvest to the proper medicine age, replanting afterward, and separately preserving the necessary parts was also more troublesome than it seemed. Now that he was not short on spirit stones, there was no reason to put himself through all that trouble.

Lee Hyun crossed most of the varieties off the list in his mind.

‘Let’s only plant things that become more valuable the longer they’re left to grow.’

He approached a late Qi Refining cultivator tending a table farther inside.

“I’d like some Jade-Condensing Grass seeds.”

“Have a look.”

The cultivator brought out a thin wooden box with seeds neatly arranged inside.

Lee Hyun examined the life force within each seed in turn.

“I’ve heard that an aged bulb only fetches its full value if it has no blemishes. Is there anything in particular I should watch out for while growing them?”

“Jade-Condensing Grass is not difficult to cultivate. Keep the soil from drying out, but do not allow water to pool and rot the bulb. Give the roots plenty of room to spread, and once planted, it is best not to move them unless necessary.”

“Would they still be useful if cultivated for more than five hundred years?”

“My apologies. This humble Junior does not know that much. But judging from the characteristics of Jade-Condensing Grass, one cultivated beyond five hundred years may become a Tier 3 spirit plant.”

When Lee Hyun nodded, the cultivator cautiously added,

“Senior, are you aware that Jade-Condensing Grass with a low medicine age is not particularly useful? It is a variety that must be cultivated for a long time before it becomes valuable.”

“Do not worry. I know what I am buying.”

“In that case... the seeds are three low-grade spirit stones each.”

“That is not cheap for a seed.”

“For some reason, demand is fairly high.”

Lee Hyun paid ninety low-grade spirit stones and bought thirty Jade-Condensing Grass seeds. It was an almost negligible sum for him.

Ten days later.

Tunnel No. 3.

Buzzzzz–

As Lee Hyun entered the cavern, golden balls of fur flew toward him from every direction.

“Yes, yes. Have you all been well?”

Chirp! Chirp chirp!

Several landed on his shoulders, while a few others clung to the hem of his robe.

Of them all, the three fellows with especially powerful auras naturally claimed Lee Hyun’s head and the backs of both hands. Whenever other fuzzbees approached, they even raised their short forelegs to shove them away.

They were the fellows that had broken through to Tier 2 spirit insects.

Lee Hyun lifted the fuzzbee perched on the back of his hand and brought it before his eyes.

The flow of spiritual power within it was considerably more stable than before. When it had first broken through, only the energy inside its body had grown stronger, but now that strength seemed to flow naturally all the way into its wings and short legs.

“You are Tier 2 spirit insects now... so what are you actually good at besides eating and sleeping?”

Chirp!

The fuzzbee stiffened its antennae.

“Don’t take it the wrong way. Let’s see what you can do.”

Lee Hyun pointed toward a stone pillar on the opposite side of the cavern and sent a simple command through the Spirit-Nurturing Seal.

He told it to fly to the pillar and return.

Buzz!

The streak of gold vanished from the back of his hand.

By the time the delayed sound of its wings brushed his ears, the fuzzbee was already rounding the stone pillar on the far side.

“Oh....”

Before Lee Hyun could even hold out his hand, the fellow landed on top of his head.

Chirp chirp!

The other two immediately took flight as well.

Three streaks of golden light shot across the cavern. They banked around the pillars, passed through cracks near the ceiling, then circled Lee Hyun as though competing to overtake one another.

He focused his divine sense and examined their movements.

Even when they abruptly stopped or changed direction after flying at high speed, their bodies barely wavered.

“A Qi Refining cultivator probably wouldn’t even be able to see you clearly.”

Chirp!

The fuzzbee that returned first rubbed its forelegs together atop Lee Hyun’s finger. The other two settled beside it in a row and waved their antennae.

Somehow, they looked rather proud of themselves.

...

After inspecting the irrigation reservoir and the existing spirit fields, Lee Hyun looked for a suitable place to create a new spirit field.

Jade-Condensing Grass preferred shade and soil that did not dry easily. As long as its bulbs were not submerged in water, it did not seem difficult to manage, provided he set up the drainage properly.

‘Near Spirit Field No. 3-1 should work.’

As Lee Hyun walked along the familiar passage, a wooden plaque embedded in the wall caught his eye.

「Spirit Field No. 3-1」

It was where he had planted the Ringless Divine Tree.

Lee Hyun casually glanced inside, then suddenly stopped.

“Hm?”

Something was protruding from the black soil.

A single dark blue-green stem stood upright on its slender body. At its tip, two seed leaves smaller than his fingernail had unfolded opposite each other.

Lee Hyun immediately approached, crouched down, and activated the Aura-Reading Art.

A faint trace of life force extended from the two seed leaves down the stem and into the soil. At its end, the shell of the seed that had remained closed for so long had split apart on both sides.

“It sprouted...?”

It really had.

Lee Hyun took the spirit field ledger from his storage pouch and placed a finger on the page where he had recorded the sowing date.

‘It’s already been about forty-one years.’

Whenever he visited the tunnel over all that time, he had only checked that some life force remained. Since there had been no visible changes, he had not expected much.

And yet it had finally sprouted!

Lee Hyun reached out to touch the soil beside the stem, then stopped.

‘Better not mess with it for no reason.’

Under the sowing record in the ledger, he wrote down today’s date.

「Germination confirmed.」

After staring at it for a moment, he added another line.

「Two seed leaves.」

“Haha.”

He could not help laughing.

Lee Hyun remained seated there for a while, gazing at the tiny sprout.

Buzz–

A fuzzbee took off from his shoulder and hovered near the seed leaves.

“You have to protect this fellow well. Don’t let any spirit insect touch it.”

Chirp!

...

Lee Hyun cleared out a cavern near Spirit Field No. 3-1 and prepared Spirit Field No. 3-2 for the Jade-Condensing Grass.

Following the method he had been told at the Spirit Materials Hall, he tilled the soil deeply and dug shallow waterways along the edges. He also made a separate drainage channel to carry away excess water.

After leaving plenty of space for the bulbs and roots to grow, he planted the thirty Jade-Condensing Grass seeds one by one.

Next, he connected bamboo pipes leading from the existing irrigation reservoir in the upper section, then installed basic formation inscriptions that sensed the moisture in the soil as well as a Water-Drawing Inscription on the reservoir side.

‘I’ll probably have to experiment a little to figure out the watering interval...’

For now, he set the new spirit field’s watering interval to roughly match the other fields and added a note to the ledger. Once he accumulated more records while coming and going from Tunnel No. 3, he should be able to determine the proper watering method.

「Spirit Field No. 3-2」

Once he installed the wooden plaque as well, everything was finished.

One year later.

A rumor spread across Yanxia Peak that Tan Yunsheng would personally refine Foundation Establishment Pills.

That evening, on the day Lee Hyun heard the news while preparing medicinal ingredients in the communal Alchemy Hall, Eldest Senior Brother Tao Wenqian came to Qingyu Ravine.

“Junior Brother Li. Have you ever viewed the Foundation Establishment Pill recipe?”

“I viewed it last year.”

“Excellent. Master is looking for disciples to assist him.”

Lee Hyun looked up.

“May I participate?”

“He needs someone to inspect and prepare the medicinal ingredients. I told him you could be trusted with that much. I haven’t said so before, but I’ve watched you work in the communal Alchemy Hall a few times. I have never seen a Junior Brother as steady and skilled as you. You almost give the impression of an experienced alchemist....”

“Haha... thank you.”

“In fact, only disciples whose viewing of the Foundation Establishment Pill recipe has been officially verified may assist or observe. We’ll check the Pill Recipe Pavilion’s records tomorrow, so bring your identity token.”

Pill recipes had to be formally viewed by paying contribution points. The contribution points spent by disciples were an important source of income for the sect, and that income was directly tied to the shares received by the Golden Core Elders. Because of that, it was forbidden to transmit an inheritance to a disciple who had not viewed it, even under the pretext of assisting with alchemy.

Of course, inheritances not possessed by the sect were a different matter. For example, the Flame-Threading Art Lee Hyun had received in the past was a technique absent from the Danxiao Sect’s Scripture Pavilion, something Tan Yunsheng had personally acquired and kept.

Lee Hyun nodded.

“I’ll be prepared.”

...

The next day.

An alchemy chamber deep within Yanxia Peak.

When Lee Hyun arrived, Tao Wenqian and several other Senior Brothers and Senior Sisters were already inspecting the medicinal ingredients.

At the center stood a purple pill furnace taller than a person. Formation inscriptions that drew up earth fire were engraved beneath its three legs, while clear water flowed slowly through narrow grooves extending across the floor.

Tao Wenqian handed Lee Hyun two jade trays.

“Junior Brother Li, take care of these auxiliary medicinal ingredients. First check for any hidden damage or loss of medicinal potency that cannot be seen from the outside. If there are no problems, prepare them according to the marked quantities.”

“Understood.”

Lee Hyun examined the auxiliary medicinal ingredients on the trays with the Aura-Reading Art. He had handled them before, and they had been stored well.

He drew a thin knife, and his hands moved smoothly without pause.

Slice. Slice.

He neatly removed the soil clinging to the surface and trimmed away damaged fine roots.

While Lee Hyun prepared the medicinal ingredients, the other disciples finished their respective tasks as well. Tao Wenqian repeatedly checked the condition of the three main ingredients, while Fang Jiyun inspected the connection between the pill furnace and the earth-fire formation.

In front of Tao Wenqian lay a thick Spirit-Storing Ginseng root, a Jade-Condensing Grass plant with a jade-colored bulb, and a Fire-Heart Orchid with vivid red streaks. It was Lee Hyun’s first time seeing a real Fire-Heart Orchid, so his gaze lingered on it for a moment.

“Is everything ready?”

“Yes, Master.”

Tan Yunsheng examined the ingredients separated onto the trays one by one. When he reached the auxiliary ingredients Lee Hyun had prepared, his hand paused for a moment. He picked up a thin slice and held it against the light before speaking with interest.

“Hm? The youngest is remarkably good at preparing medicinal ingredients. That is unexpected.”

“Thank you.”

Tan Yunsheng sat down in front of the pill furnace.

“Once the alchemy begins, do not extend your divine sense into the pill furnace without my permission. You may observe the flow from outside.”

“We will remember.”

Tan Yunsheng lightly raised a hand.

Hummmm–

The formation inscriptions on the floor lit up one after another.

Earth fire rose from the burner and enveloped the bottom of the pill furnace. Red light climbed along its legs, and the patterns engraved across the furnace’s surface emerged one by one.

Clack.

The lid opened and hovered in midair.

As Tan Yunsheng moved his fingers, the medicinal ingredients on the jade trays flew into the pill furnace in a predetermined order.

At that moment,

Fwoosh–

The flames inside the pill furnace split apart into strands as fine as thread.

‘The Flame-Threading Art.’

It was a technique Lee Hyun had learned as well.

Of course, the flame threads wielded by Tan Yunsheng before him were incomparably more precise than Lee Hyun’s own. Lee Hyun might have lived for a long time, but he had only learned the Flame-Threading Art recently.

Tan Yunsheng’s Flame-Threading Art was exceptionally profound, making it mesmerizing to watch.

Beside a brightly blazing flame thread passed another whose glow was barely visible. Though they crossed close enough to seem on the verge of touching, their flames never merged or wavered.

Novice alchemists primarily refined pills by heating the lower portion of the pill furnace, but at Tan Yunsheng’s level, it seemed some alchemists instead manipulated the fire directly within the upper part of the furnace like this.

Rustle.

One of the first medicinal ingredients placed inside broke down.

The impurities were pushed toward the wall of the pill furnace, while the refined medicinal strength condensed into a clear liquid and gathered in one place.

Without pausing, Tan Yunsheng handled the remaining medicinal ingredients one after another. As more ingredients were introduced, the flow became so complex that merely watching it made Lee Hyun dizzy, while Tan Yunsheng’s fingers moved too quickly for the eye to follow.

Just before medicinal liquids of different properties merged into one, portions of the churning liquid would suddenly turn clear for the briefest instant.

Ssssss–

The rippling surface soon settled calmly.

‘Calling this precision measured in seconds wouldn’t even do it justice....’

Even as dozens of medicinal ingredients constantly merged and separated, tracing dazzling trajectories, not once was the overall flow interrupted.

‘This is really difficult....’

Lee Hyun was busy enough simply following the order written in the pill recipe.

It was true that he himself had once diligently practiced refining Barrier-Breaking Pills. But Lee Hyun had always made only simple pills whenever he needed them, so the level of alchemy Tan Yunsheng was displaying came as a profound shock.

...

Two shichen (about four hours) later.

The medicinal potencies of the three main ingredients and the auxiliary medicinal ingredients finally fused into one.

The medicinal strength gathered inside the pill furnace was dense and heavy. Even after forming a single mass, multiple colors continued to cross through its interior.

Tan Yunsheng formed a hand seal with both hands.

Hummmmmm–

The merged medicinal strength split apart once more into five portions.

The flames surrounding each portion rotated in a circle. When Lee Hyun concentrated, he noticed slight differences in the movements of all five sets of flames. Tan Yunsheng was independently adjusting each one according to the condition of the pills undergoing Pill Condensation.

Once the rotation of the medicinal strength stabilized, the lid hovering in midair slowly descended.

Clack.

The pill furnace closed.

The inside was no longer visible, but Tan Yunsheng’s hands did not stop even as the warm nurturing continued. Lee Hyun tried to take in every last one of those minute changes.

...

How much time had passed?

The flow of spiritual power inside the pill furnace suddenly began to fluctuate violently.

At that moment, Tan Yunsheng flicked a finger and the lid opened.

Flash!

Brilliant radiance erupted from inside the pill furnace.

The light faded in an instant, but in that fleeting and mysterious glow, Lee Hyun felt as though he could sense a trace of profound mystery.

A moment later, five ivory-colored pills flew out and landed on a jade tray.

Lee Hyun’s gaze locked onto the pills.
