Blue pill markings traced their surfaces. Their medicinal fragrance was subtle, but the medicinal strength condensed within them was anything but faint.

He still did not know exactly what level of achievement was represented by pill markings appearing on the surface of a pill, but there was no doubt that what lay before him were genuine Foundation Establishment Pills.

After inspecting the pills one by one, Tan Yunsheng handed them to Tao Wenqian.

“Have them undergo pill inspection and deliver them to the pill storehouse.”

“Yes.”

While Tao Wenqian prepared to seal them, Tan Yunsheng looked around at his disciples and spoke.

“If there is anything you are curious about, ask.”

The moment those words left his mouth, Lee Hyun and several other disciples began firing questions at him.

...

That night.

After returning to Qingyu Ravine, Lee Hyun did not go straight to bed. Instead, he sat at the table.

He took out a blank sheet of paper and wrote down everything he had seen that day without leaving anything out. Yet the more he organized his notes, the more keenly he realized that he had understood less than half of Tan Yunsheng’s handling.

“Hmm....”

Lee Hyun made several marks on the paper.

‘I’ll have to ask him during the next lecture!’

...

From then on, whenever Lee Hyun had an opportunity to assist with alchemy, he participated without fail, observing every movement of Tan Yunsheng’s hands and recording it all.

...

Lee Hyun also selected a combat technique from the Inner Pavilion of the Scripture Pavilion.

《Condensed-Essence Grasping Hand》.

It resembled a technique once used by one of the two Foundation Establishment alliance elders who had fought him on Chiyao Island, an island of the Qingchao Merchant Alliance in the southern part of the Lan Kingdom.

The technique formed a gigantic hand from the condensed spiritual power of a Foundation Establishment cultivator. Since it could shape spiritual power directly without relying on a separate magic tool, it seemed highly versatile.

...

Time continued to pass.

The Jade-Condensing Grass in the tunnel sprouted and gradually grew more leaves. After several years, small bulbs began forming beneath the soil. However, they still had a long way to grow before they possessed enough medicinal potency to be useful in a Foundation Establishment Pill.

The Ringless Divine Tree was especially slow.

Even the next year, and the year after that, the changes were so slight that Lee Hyun could only notice them by comparing the tree against the records in his ledger.

Whenever Lee Hyun visited the tunnel, he would inspect the spirit fields and fuzzbees, refill the irrigation reservoir, linger for a while in front of the Ringless Divine Tree, and then leave.

In the tenth year after he successfully reached Foundation Establishment.

The cultivation chamber at Qingyu Ravine.

Hummmm–

The spiritual qi drawn in by the Qi-Gathering Formation seeped into Lee Hyun’s body.

Whoooosh–

The flow beneath the Sea of Qi Acupoint completed one great revolution.

The liquid true essence filling his lower dantian settled more heavily, and the spiritual pressure surged upward. Unable to withstand that force, the layer blocking his path was pushed aside from within.

Thump.

The hem of Lee Hyun’s robe fluttered lightly.

A moment later, he slowly opened his eyes.

“I did it!”

He had reached Foundation Establishment Stage 2.

More precisely, his lower dantian had reached Foundation Establishment Stage 2. He still had to raise the rest of his entire body to Foundation Establishment.

Lee Hyun took a wooden board from his storage pouch.

【Age: 1,450 years】

【Realm: Foundation Establishment Stage 2 (lower dantian)】

【Spiritual Power: 1,376 → 1,396】

Lee Hyun nodded as he looked at the newly carved characters.

“Hehe.”

...

A few days later.

A red paper crane appeared before the waterfall at Qingyu Ravine.

The paper crane circled the edge of the Cloud-Barrier Abode-Guarding Formation, then unfolded on its own, transforming into a voice-transmission talisman that clung to the formation’s barrier.

“Hm?”

Sensing the disturbance in the formation, Lee Hyun gestured, and the voice-transmission talisman flew inside. When he unfolded it, Eldest Senior Brother Tao Wenqian’s voice emerged.

[Master has issued a summons. All disciples under him are to come to Yanxia Peak.]

‘What’s going on...?’

Chapter 54

The Lecture Hall of Yanxia Peak.

More than twenty disciples sat on their respective cushions. Aside from the few who had left the Mountain Gate on outside missions, nearly every disciple currently staying at Yanxia Peak had gathered.

A short while later, Tan Yunsheng opened the inner door and entered. The disciples rose as one and bowed.

“Greetings, Master.”

“Sit.”

Tan Yunsheng extended a hand, and a large map unfolded in midair.

“Today, I have something to discuss regarding the Huatian Secret Realm. Since the end of last month, cultivators of unknown origin have been appearing inside the secret realm. At first, only a few spirit plants around the outskirts disappeared, but ten days ago, they attacked one of our sect’s spirit fields.”

The Lecture Hall fell silent.

“The disciples guarding the spirit field were injured and forced to withdraw, and a considerable number of the spirit plants cultivated there were taken. We have now withdrawn from the two neighboring spirit fields as well.”

Fang Jiyun asked,

“Were they sent in by another sect?”

“From what we have confirmed so far, they are not from the cultivation world of the Kun Kingdom. Some of the methods they used are rarely seen in the nearby cultivation nations. And...”

Tao Wenqian added,

“There is also no sign that they passed through the entrance to the secret realm on our side.”

“Are you saying there is another entrance?”

At one disciple’s question, Tan Yunsheng nodded.

“That is our current judgment. Until now, we believed the realm gate managed by our sect was the only one leading into the Huatian Secret Realm, but it seems the secret realm is also connected to a cultivation world very far away.”

A quiet stir spread among the disciples.

“There have also been reports of disturbances in the earth veins inside the secret realm recently. We still do not know whether the realm gate on their side opened at that time, or whether it had always existed and they only began using it now.”

Tan Yunsheng lightly tapped the map.

“Many kinds of spirit plants are cultivated in the Huatian Secret Realm. As you all know, some of them are difficult to grow outside the secret realm. That is because lesser yang qi seeps from the secret realm’s earth veins.”

Tan Yunsheng looked over the disciples.

“For that reason, our sect cannot abandon the Huatian Secret Realm. This is not a problem that will end with the loss of a few spirit fields. If we lose that place, both the variety and quantity of pills we can refine in the future will decrease.”

At that moment, Zheng Yanshu, who was seated toward the back, raised his hand. He was an early Foundation Establishment cultivator who had entered Tan Yunsheng’s tutelage several years before Lee Hyun.

“Master. Could the Golden Core Elders not enter personally and subdue them?”

Tan Yunsheng shook his head.

“The Huatian Secret Realm is a Tier 2 grotto-heaven. Golden Core cultivators cannot enter.”

When doubt remained on Zheng Yanshu’s face, Tan Yunsheng thought for a moment before speaking.

“Some of you have never entered a secret realm before, so I should explain that first.”

...

“Planes and realm heavens, heaven and earth and grotto-heavens... There are many names for worlds. The places we commonly call secret realms are often a type of grotto-heaven space as well.”

Lee Hyun listened closely.

“A naturally formed grotto-heaven can be regarded as a small plane. If it grows over countless years, it may even develop into a plane in its own right. In that sense, the human realm in which we live could also be considered an enormous grotto-heaven. Every grotto-heaven... no, every plane has its own Heavenly Dao. The Heavenly Dao governs the laws that operate within that world. One such law is the upper limit of the cultivation realms it can accept.”

“Does that mean a cultivator whose realm exceeds that limit cannot enter?”

“That is correct. The Heavenly Dao of the Huatian Secret Realm permits cultivators up to Foundation Establishment to enter. The moment a being who has formed a golden core attempts to pass through the realm gate, the realm force rejects them.”

Zheng Yanshu asked again,

“Even if they conceal their aura?”

“Concealing one’s true strength before the Heavenly Dao is exceedingly difficult. If that were possible, the great Immortals of the upper realm could descend into the human realm whenever they pleased. In any case... that is why the Foundation Establishment cultivators of our sect must step forward and deal with these foreign cultivators. Since only their Foundation Establishment cultivators can enter the secret realm as well, we should be fully capable of standing against them.”

After thinking for a moment, Tan Yunsheng continued.

“For reference, our sect has already requested assistance from the Biluo Sect, and they have agreed. The Danxiao Sect will dispatch around a hundred Foundation Establishment cultivators to the Huatian Secret Realm, while the Biluo Sect will send roughly fifty. If the situation worsens, we may have to commit even more Foundation Establishment disciples.”

Once actual numbers were given, the disciples’ expressions grew serious as the scale of the situation sank in. Deploying this many Foundation Establishment cultivators was practically the same as going to war.

One disciple asked,

“Master, can we trust the cultivators of the Biluo Sect?”

“The Biluo Sect’s cultivators are not particularly skilled in alchemy, and they receive a considerable supply from our sect of pills refined from medicinal ingredients produced in the Huatian Secret Realm. They want to protect the Huatian Secret Realm nearly as much as we do.”

Another disciple cautiously asked,

“Will the alchemists of our Inner Alchemy Court also be sent?”

“Yes. Our sect has well over ten thousand Qi Refining disciples, but fewer than a thousand Foundation Establishment cultivators. And some among those must continue handling outside missions.”

Tan Yunsheng slowly swept his gaze across the disciples.

“The Danxiao Sect is a sect whose primary craft is alchemy. If we excluded everyone belonging to the Inner Alchemy Court, how many cultivators would we have left to deploy?”

When no one answered, Tan Yunsheng continued.

“Yanxia Peak will send four people. Wenqian will lead them, and three others will accompany him. I will give priority to volunteers.”

Silence settled over the Lecture Hall, and Lee Hyun studied the map of the secret realm Tan Yunsheng had suspended in the air.

It was the secret realm where Fire-Heart Orchids, an ingredient of the Foundation Establishment Pill, grew. If he could personally examine the soil, water, and flow of earth qi there, he might discover things that could never be learned from pill recipes and written records alone.

‘If I can dig up the source that produces the lesser yang qi from underground... couldn’t I grow Fire-Heart Orchids in Tunnel No. 3 as well?’

Lee Hyun spoke.

“May this disciple volunteer?”

Tao Wenqian turned his head.

“Junior Brother Li?”

“Yes.”

Tan Yunsheng asked,

“Do you have a particular reason for volunteering?”

“I am relatively accustomed to combat. I also wish to contribute to the sect. In the past, I spent thirty years serving as a resident cultivator in the Anling Kingdom. During that time, I learned martial arts from experts of the mundane world and exchanged moves with gu warriors from the Qianyang Kingdom.”

Tan Yunsheng looked at Lee Hyun for a moment.

“Good. That is commendable. I will give you one of the positions.”

“Thank you, Master.”

A short while later, two more disciples volunteered.

...

Once the members of the dispatch had been decided, the discussion moved on to preparations. One month remained until departure.

The sect would provide basic recovery pills and communication talismans, as well as a communal formation to be installed at their encampment. Naturally, everyone would have to prepare their own magic tools and consumables for combat.

Upon completing the mission, they would receive more contribution points than usual, with additional rewards for anyone who rendered distinguished service.

When the explanation ended, Tan Yunsheng said,

“If you have any questions, ask Wenqian. Those who remain will have to divide up the alchemy duties handled by these four, so settle that before you leave as well.”

The disciples cupped their hands.

“Yes, Master.”

...

On the way back to Qingyu Ravine, Lee Hyun flew slowly through the clouds.

‘The Huatian Secret Realm....’

Lee Hyun had volunteered despite the danger partly because he had confidence in himself. He felt that he could handle any Foundation Establishment cultivator he encountered.

Of course, a cultivator at Foundation Establishment Great Perfection might possess hidden methods he could not anticipate.

But the amount of spiritual power Lee Hyun possessed should be at least twice that of a cultivator at Foundation Establishment Great Perfection, even by the most conservative estimate. On top of that, he had techniques and martial learning honed over many years, and he could use Earth-Origin Force. If necessary, he was also confident he could escape underground.

‘Still, there are no absolutes in this world.’

Lee Hyun glanced down at his storage pouch.

He had thought about replacing his magic tools after reaching Foundation Establishment. He had only put it off because there had been no pressing need.

Now things were different.

‘It’s time to spend some spirit stones.’

The next day, at the Artifact Court in the Danxiao Range.

When Lee Hyun presented his inner disciple identity token, the Qi Refining disciple at the counter bowed respectfully.

“Senior. What are you looking for?”

“First, can I sell the magic tools I’ve been using?”

“Of course. You can have them appraised first.”

Lee Hyun was guided to a small hall farther inside. There, a middle-aged cultivator at early Foundation Establishment was appraising magic tools.

When Lee Hyun took out the Force-Dispersing Inner Armor, Mountain-Suppressing Sword, and the Earth Shovel Sword he had used long ago, the other cultivator picked them up one by one.

“You’ve used these for quite a long time.”

The man tapped the blade of the Mountain-Suppressing Sword.

Ting–

A clear note rang out briefly.

“They’re still in decent condition. Though they are only mid-grade magic tools....”

Lee Hyun did not take out his six bronze flying swords, black-iron longspear, or Protective Bell. All of them were high-grade magic tools, and he was already accustomed to using them, so there was no reason to replace them yet.

...

After selling off his mid-grade and lower magic tools, Lee Hyun decided to buy a new defensive magic tool first.

As he looked around the Artifact Court, his eye was drawn to a suit of inner armor made from overlapping black scales.

“The Black Scale Inner Armor. Even among high-grade magic tools, its defensive power is excellent.”

“What is the price?”

“Twelve mid-grade spirit stones.”

“I’ll take it.”

The next item he selected was a small shield called the Profound Iron Buckler. Normally, it was only the size of a palm, but once spiritual power was poured into it, it expanded enough to cover the upper body.

“This is also a high-grade magic tool. It is excellent for blocking attacks coming from a single direction.”

“How much?”

“Fourteen mid-grade spirit stones.”

Lee Hyun paid the price.

...

Next, he went to look at swords. The Artifact Court had separate sections displaying longswords and flying swords, and the attendant cultivator first took out a blue longsword.

“The Wind Spirit Sword. Its blade is light, and it is fast when using Sword Control.”

Lee Hyun examined it briefly before shaking his head.

“Do you have anything a little longer and sturdier? Preferably something suited for close combat.”

“In that case, take a look at this.”

The attendant brought out a broad, thick-bladed sword. However, Lee Hyun set it back down soon after gripping the hilt. For a high-grade magic tool, its capacity for spiritual power did not seem much greater than that of the Mountain-Suppressing Sword.

“Do you have anything better?”

“A high-grade magic tool still isn’t enough?”

“I would prefer something capable of accepting a large amount of spiritual power. The blade and its restrictions also need to withstand it without being damaged easily.”

The attendant cultivator thought for a moment, then headed deeper into the display area. When he pressed his identity token against a restriction on the wall, a locked wooden case slid forward.

Click.

The lid opened, revealing a longsword.

Its blade was about one chi (about 33 cm) longer than an ordinary longsword. The blade was broad and thick, but it narrowed gradually toward the point, preventing it from looking cumbersome.

There were no particular decorations on its surface. Only a single black line that barely reflected any light ran straight down the center of the blade.

“The Profound Gate Sword. Even among high-grade magic tools, it is particularly capable of withstanding large amounts of spiritual power.”

Lee Hyun gripped the hilt. It was heavy, but he liked its balance.

“The primary material is Heavy Spirit Profound Iron, and particular care was put into the Adamantine Form-Fixing Restriction that keeps the blade solid and stable.”

Lee Hyun poured Primordial True Qi into it.

Hummm–

As he fed in a little more spiritual power, the black line down the center glowed faintly. He could barely feel any vibration through the hilt.

‘Not bad.’

Lee Hyun withdrew his spiritual power.

“The price?”

“Thirty-two mid-grade spirit stones.”

“I’ll take it.”

...

After leaving the Artifact Court, Lee Hyun entered the Spirit Talisman Pavilion. The old cultivator sitting behind the counter rose to his feet.

“Greetings, Senior.”

“I’m here to look at some talismans. Before that, can I sell these here?”

Lee Hyun took several old wooden cases from his storage pouch. Inside were talismans he had obtained as spoils long ago, sorted by type.

All of the talismans had lost much of their spiritual power over the years.

Of course, Lee Hyun could force them to activate by pushing spiritual power into them. However, their age made their power inconsistent, so they were too unreliable to trust in an emergency.

The old cultivator picked up one talisman and held it up to the light. Red talisman inscriptions remained on its yellowed surface.

“These are quite old.”

“They are.”

“Still, the material used for the talisman paper is good. Some of it should be worth salvaging.”

The old cultivator separated the talismans whose materials could be recovered. He said the rest could also be passed on to talisman makers studying talisman inscriptions, but they would not fetch much.

After selling all of them, Lee Hyun examined the new talismans.

He chose talismans that protected the body, talismans that blinded opponents with intense light, and talismans that covered the surroundings in dense fog. Most were Tier 2 talismans.

Even as the old cultivator sorted the talismans by function and placed them into small jade cases, Lee Hyun continued choosing more. As one jade case after another accumulated on the table, the old cultivator finally spoke.

“Senior. This defensive talisman serves much the same purpose as one you chose earlier.”

“I know.”

“Are you planning to activate them together?”

“When the talisman I use first runs out, shouldn’t I use the next one?”

The old cultivator was momentarily taken aback.

‘Is this fellow planning to start a war or something?’

...

After buying enough talismans, Lee Hyun also stopped by the place that sold pills.

The pills provided by the sect might well be sufficient, but Lee Hyun decided to stock up on a few additional recovery and antidote pills.

...

After purchasing the pills, he decided to acquire a defensive formation as his final preparation.

The Formation Equipment Pavilion in western Danxiao Immortal City.

Once inside, he saw shelves lined with wooden cases containing formation plates and formation flags. Some cases held only four formation flags, while others contained dozens. The formation plates were equally varied, ranging from round and square ones to those divided into several separate pieces.

Lee Hyun explained what he wanted to the cultivator manning the counter.

“I’m looking for a defensive formation that can be transported easily and deployed quickly in an emergency.”

“You’re not installing it in a cave abode?”

“I intend to use it outside.”

“In that case, one powered by spirit stones would be better.”

The cultivator brought out several wooden cases. Among them, the one that caught Lee Hyun’s attention contained a dark yellow formation plate and nine small formation flags.

The formation plate was engraved with patterns resembling flowing sand, while the flags were embroidered with designs reminiscent of winding mountain ranges.

“The Nine-Bend Dust and Sand Formation. A Tier 2 mid-grade formation.”

The cultivator planted the nine formation flags around a demonstration formation plate, and faint yellow light connected them.

Whoooosh–

A palm-sized cloud of sand rose. Within it, layers of veils wound and overlapped, blurring the view inside.

“The sand gathered within the formation forms multiple layers of barriers. Even if an attack breaks through one layer, it will be stopped by the next. Since the sand is constantly flowing, damaged sections will gradually be filled in again using the power of the spirit stones.”

The cultivator fired a thin beam of light from his fingertip.

Thump.

The edge of the sand cloud caved inward for a moment before filling back in.

“Of course, it cannot withstand continuous powerful attacks. And the more attacks it takes, the faster it consumes spirit stones.”

“How long does it take to deploy?”

“If the formation flags are positioned properly, only a few breaths. But doing that from the start is difficult. You will need practice.”

The cultivator opened a thin booklet. Diagrams showed the spacing and direction in which the formation flags should be placed.

“The price?”

“Eighteen mid-grade spirit stones.”

Lee Hyun thought briefly, then nodded.

“I’ll take it.”

Since he had purchased the Nine-Bend Dust and Sand Formation, Lee Hyun took the opportunity to ask the cultivator a few questions about formations.

Strictly speaking, formation plates and formation flags were magic tools as well.

In antiquity, formations had not originally been used in this way. The standard method had been for a formation master well versed in formations to personally survey the terrain, inscribe formation inscriptions, and lay out the formation.

However, formations were so difficult that after long years of research, cultivators eventually learned how to embed formations into magic tools and deploy them that way.

This method brought many conveniences. Even cultivators who knew little about formations could now deploy them, and as formations became more widespread, formation masters were also able to earn far more spirit stones.

Lee Hyun knew some basic formation inscriptions, but understanding and deploying a formation himself was still beyond him. Formations were practically an entire academic discipline, and studying them was exceedingly tedious and dull.

‘Buying them really is much easier.’

He examined the formation plate again. Lines extended from the grooves where spirit stones were inserted, repeatedly splitting and rejoining before connecting to the patterns at the center and along the edges.

‘Hmm....’

The restrictions engraved into magic tools, the talisman inscriptions on talismans, and the formation inscriptions on formation plates bore certain similarities in shape. They also seemed alike in that they directed spiritual power along predetermined paths and caused it to function under specific conditions.

‘They’re like circuits from my past life. You determine the path the power flows through and make it produce the response you want.’

He had heard that there was also a craft called the Puppet Art. The formation inscriptions and restrictions engraved inside puppets that could move on their own and follow simple commands likely determined their movements as well.

‘Maybe I don’t need to study all these fields separately. Puppets, formations, artifact refining, talisman crafting... there may be principles shared between them to some extent. It might not be a bad idea to study them little by little whenever I’m bored.’

Qingyu Ravine.

Lee Hyun took out the remaining spirit stones and placed them on the table.

Clatter.

After purchasing new magic tools, a formation, talismans, and emergency pills, he had around twenty mid-grade spirit stones left. He had spent most of the spirit stones he possessed.

But his greatest asset was Tunnel No. 3’s spirit field anyway.

‘If I need spirit stones, I can just sell a few plants.’

He put away the spirit stones, then took out the Profound Gate Sword. It was time to begin bonding the magic tools he had purchased.

Within a few days, Lee Hyun finished bonding all of the magic tools.

Bonding them was not difficult. However, it seemed he would need more time before he could wield them as naturally as the bronze flying swords and black-iron longspear that had accompanied him for centuries.

He also practiced deploying and retrieving the formation flags of the Nine-Bend Dust and Sand Formation.

...

Before departing, he also visited Tunnel No. 3, filled the water tank to capacity, and checked the irrigation system again. The Jade-Condensing Grass he had planted relatively recently showed no problems.

The Ringless Divine Tree was still growing, little by little.

Squeak! Squeak squeak!

The fuzzbees circled around him.

Lee Hyun placed some of the fuzzbees into his spirit-insect pouch, including the three that had broken through to Tier 2.

“I might be going somewhere a little far away this time.”

Squeak.

The fellows did not seem particularly interested.

After ordering the remaining fuzzbees to guard the spirit field, Lee Hyun inspected the tunnel one final time and slipped into the wall.

By the time he returned to the sect, only a few days remained before they were scheduled to depart for the secret realm.

The day of departure.

A deep gorge north of the Danxiao Range.

Tall, thick stone pillars stood in rows along both cliffs. Formation light connecting the pillars enveloped the depths of the gorge in layer after layer.

Beyond them, a long vertical fissure split a massive rock wall, and faint red light slowly rippled within. It was the realm gate leading to the Huatian Secret Realm.

More than a hundred and fifty Foundation Establishment cultivators had gathered on the broad stone platform. More of them wore the long robes of the Danxiao Sect, while the cultivators of the Biluo Sect had gathered separately to check their personnel and supplies.

Their appearances varied widely. Some had high-grade magic tools strapped to their backs, while others stood empty-handed with their arms crossed. Voices calling one another’s names in greeting could be heard throughout the area.

‘This is the first time I’ve seen so many Foundation Establishment cultivators gathered in one place.’

Lee Hyun stood at one side of the stone platform with his fellow disciples from Yanxia Peak.

A short while later, a deep bell rang from the front of the gorge.

Dooong–

As the cultivators’ voices quieted, three Golden Core Elders standing before the realm gate raised their respective jade tokens and began reciting complex incantations.

Hummmmmm–

The stone pillars surrounding the gorge lit up one after another. The red light spilling from the fissure in the rock wall gradually widened, and within its center, the hazy outlines of unfamiliar mountains and forests appeared.

Chapter 55

The crack in the rock wall had widened enough for three or four people to pass through side by side.

Wind blew in from beyond the fissure. The warm scent of earth carried a faint smell of burning.

Of the three Golden Core Elders standing guard before the realm gate, the white-haired Elder in the center spoke in a grave voice.

“Listen well. The invaders use insidious methods and are exceptionally skilled at ambushes and killing. A moment’s carelessness means death.”

The Elder’s gaze swept across the cultivators’ faces one by one.

“Each group is to prioritize harvesting its assigned spirit field and holding its position. If you become isolated, retreat to the nearest stone fort without delay. The reinforcements will relieve you in fifteen days. We still do not know the enemy’s numbers or the locations of their hidden entrances. Come back alive.”

The cultivators cupped their hands in unison.

“We will keep it in mind.”

The Foundation Establishment cultivators at the front passed through the realm gate one after another.

Tao Wenqian looked back.

“Follow me.”

Lee Hyun followed him with his two fellow disciples.

The man on his left was Senior Brother Yue Wugou. He had high cheekbones and thick eyebrows, and three black iron plaques hung side by side at his waist.

The female cultivator on his right was Senior Sister Mei Sujun. Her hair was pinned up with a single jade hairpin, and her sleeves were tightly fastened at the wrists. For some time now, she had been repeatedly checking the map of the secret realm in her hands.

Both were Foundation Establishment Stage 6 cultivators.

Lee Hyun stepped into the realm gate.

Ssssh–

A strange sensation brushed over his body.

It felt as though he had passed through a thin membrane of water, yet his robe remained dry. For a moment, the ground seemed to recede beneath his feet. The next instant, both feet landed on rough stone slabs.

“Mm....”

When he raised his head, he saw a sky tinged red.

Low, long mountain ridges overlapped beneath the clouds. Trees densely covered the slopes, and pale mist drifted along the valleys.

Lee Hyun paused to feel the warm energy rising from beneath his feet.

‘Is this lesser yang qi? It does seem subtly different from ordinary Fire attribute spiritual qi....’

“Do not linger in front of the realm gate! Move farther inside!”

At the shout from ahead, Lee Hyun turned his gaze.

Low stone walls and several halls had been built around the realm gate. Formation flags stood densely outside the walls, and cultivators could be seen keeping watch here and there.

Wounded cultivators sat beneath the eaves on one side of a hall.

One had his entire arm wrapped in bandages, while another sat with his eyes closed, placing an antidote pill into his mouth. The chest of one cultivator’s robe was stained black, yet he showed no reaction even as a fellow disciple beside him cut the fabric away.

‘Things don’t look good.’

...

A short while later.

The leaders from each peak gathered around a map inside a spacious hall.

A cultivator at Foundation Establishment Great Perfection pointed to the red marks on the map.

“While the reinforcements were preparing, we withdrew from three more spirit fields. They never stay in one place for long. When we gather in force, they retreat, then reappear wherever our numbers are thin.”

Tao Wenqian asked,

“So they do not seem to be garrisoning the spirit fields they seize?”

“They remain at some of them. But when we approach, we must not assume everyone we can see is their full force. The enemy is extremely skilled at fighting as a group, and they are cunning. Unlike the cultivators of our Kun Kingdom, they seem to have extensive experience in warfare.”

He pointed to the eastern side of the map.

“We will clear this area first. Yanxia Peak will take charge of harvesting and defending Chishui Garden. I will assign personnel from the Biluo Sect to you as well.”

“Understood.”

...

After leaving the hall, Tao Wenqian explained the mission to the other three.

Chishui Garden was a spirit field located 200 li (about 78 km) east of the realm gate.

“Even when moving separately, remain close enough to keep track of one another’s positions. And even if the enemy flees, do not pursue them recklessly.”

Just then, someone called out to Lee Hyun from behind.

“Fellow Daoist Li?”

Lee Hyun turned around.

A middle-aged cultivator in a pale green robe was looking at him.

The face was familiar.

“Fellow Daoist Su?”

“So it really is Fellow Daoist Li Dongsan!”

It was Su Buyi of the Biluo Sect.

He was a cultivator who had once served alongside Lee Hyun at the Immortal Veneration Court during their posting in Anling Kingdom. Long ago, they had watched Lu Jingtian and Ruan Qingzhao spar together. Now, Su Buyi was giving off the aura of a Foundation Establishment cultivator.

Su Buyi cupped his hands.

“So you succeeded in Foundation Establishment as well, Fellow Daoist. Congratulations.”

“Congratulations to you as well, Fellow Daoist Su.”

“It has been about twenty years for me. When did you...?”

“About ten years ago.”

“I see. Has it already been forty years since we met in Anling Kingdom?”

Su Buyi studied Lee Hyun’s face.

“I still remember how you handled a spear back then. Commander Lu and Instructor Ruan thought very highly of you.”

“Are you heading to Chishui Garden as well, Fellow Daoist Su?”

“I am. Two of us from our side will be going, including myself.”

When Tao Wenqian approached, Su Buyi once again offered a respectful greeting.

Once the cultivators had finished exchanging greetings, spirit light flared beneath their feet. They rose into the air, passed beyond the formation surrounding the realm gate, and flew east.

...

There were two burned forests along the way to Chishui Garden.

Collapsed walls and blackened water barrels could be seen among the trees. Uprooted spirit plants lay scattered across slopes that had once been spirit fields, and only deep pits remained where formation flags had stood.

Mei Sujun looked down below.

“Most of what’s left there is unusable.”

...

The spirit fields of Chishui Garden.

Tao Wenqian hovered above the center of the spirit fields, while Yue Wugou and the Biluo Sect cultivators surveyed the surroundings from different altitudes. Below them, Mei Sujun and Lee Hyun were gathering medicinal ingredients.

Mei Sujun carefully spread apart the red petals.

Fine red lines ran neatly along the inside of the petals.

“We can take this one.”

She planted a small wooden marker beside the plant.

“Junior Brother Li, the roots extend a long way sideways, so check from this side first.”

“Understood.”

Lee Hyun placed a hand on the ground.

He could faintly sense the roots extending beneath the soil. As he moved his fingers, the earth around the Fire-Heart Orchid gently split apart.

Scrrk–

A small clump of earth containing both roots and soil rose from the ground. Though surprised, Mei Sujun quickly placed it inside the jade casket she had prepared.

“Heavens... I’ve never seen anyone use the Soil-Turning Art this well.”

“Haha....”

The two moved through the field, checking the medicine age of each plant, separating the roots, and sealing them inside jade caskets. Since the secret realm had yet to be secured, they intended to harvest anything usable before another attack ruined the spirit fields.

Lee Hyun had just crouched beside the next plant when his Keen Hearing Art caught a very faint but sharp sound cutting through the air.

‘Hm?’

Humm–

Spirit Light Shields appeared on all sides of Lee Hyun.

Clang-clang-clang!

Dozens of bone needles coated in pitch-black deadly poison struck the shields and sent sparks flying across their surfaces.

At the same moment, a white bone sword swept out through the reeds across the waterway and shot toward Lee Hyun’s neck.

One of the Spirit Light Shields, already being battered by the bone needles, was pierced through by the sword tip. Lee Hyun dodged sideways. The bone sword grazed past his neck, changed direction in midair, and curved around behind him.

A second bone sword rose from the front.

Mei Sujun had already put away the jade casket and risen into the air. A strip of blue-green silk unfurled from her sleeve and was just about to cover Lee Hyun’s back when black saber light slashed diagonally upward from within the forest.

“Not so fast!”

Mei Sujun flipped her wrist. The softly hanging silk snapped taut and met the saber light head-on. The force of the collision burst beyond the spirit field, and a saber-wielding cultivator emerged between the trees.

Mei Sujun immediately split the end of the silk in two and stabbed toward both of his shoulders.

Explosions rang out one after another overhead as well.

Yue Wugou’s iron plaques blocked sword light flying in from every direction, while Su Buyi’s blue jade ring shot toward a flag spewing poison mist.

Tao Wenqian swept out a hand, sending a long stream of red flames forward. Talismans drifting downward like falling leaves caught fire in midair, but several cultivators hidden behind them changed altitude and launched their magic tools again.

Meanwhile, the black-iron longspear had already appeared in Lee Hyun’s hands below.

His figure blurred as he shifted position, and the black-iron longspear skimmed across the side of the first bone sword.

Clang!

Almost simultaneously, another collision rang out. The first bone sword was knocked away and struck the second bone sword head-on in midair.

The cultivator behind the reeds froze for an instant at Lee Hyun’s almost unbelievable maneuver. To make two magic tools controlled by his own Sword Control Art collide like that... it was difficult to believe Lee Hyun had done it intentionally.

‘Was that bastard just lucky?’

Two more cultivators shot out from behind the reeds and rocks.

The cultivator controlling the bone swords also soared into the air, conjuring a skull-shaped seal above his palm.

A blood-red hooked chain and a ghastly blue yin wind surged in from either side. As the two attacks narrowed Lee Hyun’s escape routes, the seal overhead came crashing down.

Just as the three attacks were about to converge, Lee Hyun’s figure swayed strangely.

The Square-Inch Step flowed directly into the Distance-Shrinking Step, leaving overlapping afterimages where he had stood. Lee Hyun, black-iron longspear in hand, seemed to split apart and shoot toward all three cultivators at once.

“...!?”

A flash like lightning seemed to pierce through all three directions, then two of the figures dissolved into illusions.

But the last one, reflected in the eyes of the cultivator who had been about to recall his bone swords, was no illusion.

Flash!

A dazzling single-point thrust, stripped of every unnecessary motion.

A streak of spear shadow tore through the bone token and body-protecting spirit light the cultivator had hastily raised, then pierced his right chest like a thunderbolt.

The impact transmitted through the spear shaft made his eyes roll back, while the seal overhead and the bone swords all lost their light at once.

“...!”

Far away, Su Buyi froze in place as he flew over while retrieving his jade ring.

‘How... did he do that?’

Of the three Foundation Establishment cultivators who had ambushed Li Dongsan, two had been fooled by the illusions, while the last hung limp with his chest pierced through.

Su Buyi could even tell that the illusory figures he had just seen had not been created by a technique. Li Dongsan had displayed an absurd feat purely through his attainment in the martial path.

The image of Li Dongsan turning aside the attacks of Lu Jingtian and Ruan Qingzhao on the training ground in Anling Kingdom flashed through his mind.

Even then, Su Buyi had thought it strange. But had it truly been a skill capable of overturning the deadly attacks of three Foundation Establishment cultivators at once and bringing down one of them in a single strike?

Su Buyi poured spiritual power into his jade ring again. Even as he knocked away a black flag flying toward him, the movement of that spear tip refused to leave his mind.

The remaining two cultivators around Lee Hyun did not charge in again.

Bang!

One released a poisonous smokescreen while the other swung his chain across Lee Hyun’s path. Using the opening, the two retreated in different directions.

...

Meanwhile, the battle overhead was also winding down.

When Tao Wenqian’s flames swept across the sky above the spirit fields, the enemy’s offensive faltered. Yue Wugou caught a fleeing cultivator’s flying sword between his iron plaques and snapped it, while the cultivator who had been fighting Mei Sujun also hastily withdrew.

The remaining enemies immediately scattered. Yue Wugou raised an iron plaque toward the fleeing cultivators as they spread out vertically by dozens of zhang (on the order of a hundred meters), but Tao Wenqian lifted a hand to stop him.

“Do not pursue them. Let us account for our people first.”

A short while later, the fellow disciples descended beside Lee Hyun.

Tao Wenqian placed his fingers against the fallen cultivator’s neck to check his pulse, then sprinkled medicinal powder over the wound in his chest and placed restrictions on his dantian and limbs in succession. Only after confirming that the bleeding had slowed did he turn to Lee Hyun.

“Junior Brother Li made quite a showing. Are you hurt anywhere?”

“No.”

“Well done.”

...

The administrative hall of Chishui Garden.

The Biluo Sect cultivator who had come with Su Buyi pressed a blue talisman between the prisoner’s brows. He then formed a hand seal, and the talisman’s pattern slowly sank into the prisoner’s forehead.

“Aaaaargh!”

The prisoner twisted and screamed. When the cultivator stopped forming the hand seal and repeated his question, the tightly sealed lips finally opened.

The prisoner confessed that he came from the Haigu Island branch of the Yin Bird Sect, which belonged to the Nanming Twelve-Sect Alliance.

As his account continued, the expressions of the listening Danxiao Sect and Biluo Sect cultivators grew increasingly grave.

According to him, war had not ceased even once in several hundred years in the waters occupied by the Nanming Twelve Sects.

Wars of slaughter between sects over spirit veins, along with raids to seize sea routes and resource islands, had become part of everyday life. Whenever one faction was driven out, the conflict spread elsewhere and stained another place with blood. Cultivators had to survive amid killing and ambushes from the time they entered Qi Refining.

The prisoner himself claimed that even after reaching Foundation Establishment, the combined time he had spent away from the battlefield over the past thirty-odd years did not amount to three full years. Most of even that time had been spent recovering from injuries.

According to the prisoner, the twelve sects had formed their alliance to reduce excessive competition among themselves and redirect their cultivators’ fighting strength overseas. They had invaded Lan Kingdom long ago, and while subsequently extending their influence as far as Cang Kingdom, they appeared to have discovered a realm gate leading into the Huatian Secret Realm.

Tao Wenqian examined the identity token taken from the prisoner.

“Where is that realm gate?”

“I don’t know.... My eyes and divine sense were sealed when I came through. They were only released after I arrived here....”

“Who guided you?”

The prisoner’s head sagged, and he could no longer answer.

The Biluo Sect cultivator examined his condition and shook his head.

“If we push him any further now, he will die.”

Tao Wenqian set the identity token down.

“Send him to the main force.”

...

Lee Hyun was examining the medicinal ingredients taken from the Haigu Island cultivator’s storage pouch.

The unfamiliar jade plaques, talismans, and objects bearing restrictions had already been set aside.

Aside from the spirit stones, what caught his attention were several small wooden boxes.

The boxes were packed with young Fire-Heart Orchids.

The soil clinging to their roots varied from plant to plant, and their sizes were inconsistent. Since none bore the markers used in sect spirit fields, they seemed to have been gathered from plants growing wild inside the secret realm.

Beside them were two sacks filled with red soil.

Lee Hyun pinched up a little, and warm energy touched his fingertips.

‘Were they planning to try growing them outside too?’

Tao Wenqian approached.

“Interested in the soil?”

“I was looking because they brought both the Fire-Heart Orchids and the soil with them.”

“It seems they intended to transplant them. Our sect has tried that as well.”

“Does it still fail even if the soil is moved with them?”

“We tried bringing the soil and water, even stones from beneath the spirit fields. Some of the plants survived. But we could not obtain the medicinal potency we needed.”

Tao Wenqian looked down at the box.

“Their medicine age is low, and some even have damaged fine roots mixed in. None of them are usable as medicinal ingredients. Just take them, Junior Brother. You can experiment with cultivating them or examine their medicinal potency. After all, you were the one who subdued that guy.”

“Thank you.”

After Tao Wenqian left, Lee Hyun examined the Fire-Heart Orchid roots again. The soil inside the box had not dried out, and vitality still remained in the roots.

Lee Hyun packed away the young plants the Yin Bird Sect cultivator had collected, then stored the red soil separately.

Three days had passed since they entered the secret realm.

The battle situation was growing steadily worse.

They had repelled the enemy at Chishui Garden, and the other units had captured or slain quite a few foreign cultivators as well, but the territory held by their side continued to shrink.

Cultivators escorting a supply convoy were attacked, and two cultivators sent to retrieve the wounded never returned. Those who remained behind to guard reclaimed spirit fields were ambushed during the night.

...

The next day.

An order arrived telling them to gather the remaining medicinal ingredients at Chishui Garden and the supplies in its storehouse, then withdraw to the stone fort in the west.

Tao Wenqian lowered the voice-transmission talisman.

“We will leave before the day is out.”

Mei Sujun looked toward the spirit fields.

“What about the young plants?”

“Leave them.”

“Understood.”

She studied the map briefly, then pointed to two locations marked for harvesting.

“Then we will only harvest up to these two places.”

Lee Hyun rose as well.

He first went to the open ground in front of the administrative hall and took a yellow formation plate and nine formation flags from his storage pouch.

Yue Wugou looked over.

“A defensive formation?”

“The Nine-Bend Dust and Sand Formation. I thought it would be useful to set it up where we are gathering the supplies.”

Lee Hyun moved around the clearing, planting the formation flags.

Some were placed inside the stone wall, while others were set between the waterway and the storehouse. When he inserted spirit stones into the formation plate, faint lines of light linked the nine formation flags.

Humm–

Lee Hyun slipped the formation plate into his robe and headed toward the spirit fields.

...

It was shortly past noon.

Mei Sujun returned to the clearing in front of the administrative hall and finished sealing the last jade casket.

“We’re finished over here.”

Yue Wugou descended from the roof of the hall.

“The western route is still clear.”

At the western wall, the two Biluo Sect cultivators were keeping watch over the surroundings. The supplies collected from the storehouse had also been gathered on one side of the clearing.

Tao Wenqian nodded.

“Then let us organize the supplies and....”

He stopped speaking.

The sound of waves came from somewhere.

Whoooosh–

Lee Hyun raised his head.

Chishui Garden contained only waterways and a small pond. There was no body of water large enough to make such a sound.

At that moment, the Essence-Protecting Seal within his sea of consciousness lit up.

Hummm–

The Primordial True Qi that normally flowed in a faint trickle was suddenly drawn away at great speed, and multiple layers of patterns rotated around his primordial spirit.

Lee Hyun’s expression changed.

“Guard against the sound!”

The eerie sound of waves appeared to contain the principles of soul-seizing, bewildering the primordial spirit and numbing the senses.

Mei Sujun’s pupils briefly unfocused, and she nearly dropped the jade casket in her hand. Even Yue Wugou’s iron plaques veered off course.

But Tao Wenqian, Eldest Senior Brother at Foundation Establishment Stage 9, was different.

“How dare you use such sinister tricks!”

Violent energy erupted from Tao Wenqian’s dantian. His roar, infused with spiritual power, exploded like thunder, briefly cutting off the empowered voice boring into the group’s ears.

“Retract your divine sense and guard your primordial spirit!”

Mei Sujun and Yue Wugou snapped back to their senses. But a pale streak of light was already flying toward them.

Fwoooosh!

The light split in midair, simultaneously targeting Mei Sujun’s back, Yue Wugou’s neck, and Tao Wenqian’s chest.

Lee Hyun unleashed his Spirit Light Shields while activating the formation plate inside his robe. Sand surged up from the surroundings, covering the clearing in multiple layers of yellow curtains.

Boom-boom-boom!

Two streaks aimed at Mei Sujun and Yue Wugou pierced the curtains and struck the Spirit Light Shields.

Tao Wenqian stood outside the Nine-Bend Dust and Sand Formation, but he had already stretched out a hand and wrapped the projectile flying toward him in flames. The stench of burning bone spread through the fire as a finger-sized bone nail, charred black, fell to the ground.

After confirming that his three fellow disciples were safe, Tao Wenqian immediately thrust out both hands. Two fire dragons carrying immense spiritual power tore through the air and instantly vaporized the water curtain that had risen from the waterway in front of the hall.

Rooooar–

A cultivator hidden behind the water curtain while forming a hand seal was engulfed in flames and screamed. Yue Wugou’s three iron plaques spun through him, mercilessly crushing his chest as they passed.

Mei Sujun also reacted quickly, sending three defensive talismans into the air to layer another barrier over their defenses.

At the western wall, Su Buyi and the Biluo Sect cultivator beside him were battling the enemy.

Lee Hyun looked farther away.

On a rock beyond the spirit fields.

A cultivator in a blue-gray robe stood there.

A huge clam floated before him, and ripples of sound streamed continuously from its open shell.

The aura he revealed was no weaker than Tao Wenqian’s. When he pressed down on the upper shell, the blue ripples gathered into one point, and the head of one of the advancing fire dragons burst apart from the inside.

Four sword cultivators rose into the air from behind the rock, while another five or six cultivators emerged from the forest. In an instant, more than ten enemies were closing their encirclement from all sides.

Amid the rain of sword light filling the sky, Lee Hyun spread his fingers.

Fwoosh–

The flames split into slender flame threads.

Dozens of strands slipped through gaps in the sand curtains and swept across the sword cultivators’ path. Some pursued their flying swords, while others clung to the body-protecting spirit light around the cultivators themselves.

In that brief interval, Tao Wenqian completed his hand seal.

Red flames swelled violently and cut menacingly through the space between the sword cultivators.

“West!”

Tao Wenqian shouted.

“Fellow Daoist Su, you two clear the way. Junior Brother Yue, collect the remaining supplies!”

Mei Sujun was already placing the jade caskets into her storage pouch.

Yue Wugou’s three iron plaques spread out in different directions. He used them to cover the clearing while sweeping the remaining supplies into his storage pouch.

Lee Hyun gripped the formation plate and watched beyond the sand walls.

After battering the Nine-Bend Dust and Sand Formation several times, the enemies began spreading out to either side.

At a gesture from Lee Hyun, all the remaining sand surged upward at once and blanketed the front of the hall.

Using the opening, the nine formation flags pulled free and flew toward him. Lee Hyun retrieved both the formation flags and the formation plate, then kicked off the ground.

The four from Yanxia Peak followed the Biluo Sect cultivators ahead of them and vaulted over the low stone wall behind the hall.

Tao Wenqian’s flames opened the path ahead, while Yue Wugou’s iron plaques intercepted magic tools flying in from behind.

The four rapidly advanced between the shadows of the rocks. Whenever the ground dropped away, they floated low through the air, then immediately darted beneath the next rock wall.

Flying high would leave them nowhere to hide. The sword cultivators followed above the group, raining down their flying swords, while the other cultivators spread out on either side and waited for the instant the group emerged between the rocks. Each time sword light swept past, chunks were sliced from the edges of the cliffs.

Spirit light flashed beyond the western canyon. The Biluo Sect cultivators ahead were clearing the way. The group changed direction toward them and raced along the rock wall near a stone bridge.

Tao Wenqian and Mei Sujun crossed first.

Yue Wugou had just reached the middle of the bridge when three sword cultivators pursuing Lee Hyun simultaneously lowered their altitude. The sword light that had been widely scattered moments earlier converged between the two at the rear.

Boom!

The center of the stone bridge collapsed.

Yue Wugou swung his iron plaques beneath his feet to block the sword light and flew to the far side. Lee Hyun also launched himself into the air behind him, but at that instant, water surged up from the canyon below.

Splaash–

The water curtain curled around him, surrounding Lee Hyun from the front and both sides. The three sword cultivators overhead redirected their flying swords in different directions, pouring sword qi into every position from which he might cross the water curtain.

“Junior Brother Li!”

At that moment, amid the chaos, a blue-green bell rose into the air.

Boom-boom-boom!

Sword light crashed into the bell from every direction, producing ear-splitting bursts. Fine cracks appeared across the Protective Bell, a high-grade magic tool, while its spirit light shook violently.

Amid that storm, Lee Hyun’s voice transmission struck Tao Wenqian’s ears.

[Go on ahead! I’m confident in my ability to escape!]

As soon as he finished speaking, Lee Hyun used the Thousand-Jin Drop while anchoring his Earth-Origin Force to the bedrock at the bottom of the canyon, dragging his own body downward.

Fwoooosh– Boom!

His rapidly accelerating figure tore through the rushing water and slammed into the ground. The instant dirt and stone erupted like an explosion, he was sucked beneath the earth without leaving a trace.

“...!”

Li Dongsan had even managed to retrieve the bell-shaped magic tool in the middle of all that!

After witnessing the unbelievable sight before them, Tao Wenqian and the others stopped worrying about Li Dongsan and hurried west.

...

Earth and stone continuously flowed around Lee Hyun’s body.

Rather than descending deeper immediately, he first moved sideways through the canyon bedrock to get away from the spot where the enemies had been attacking. Once the impacts shaking the earth grew distant, he turned west, in the direction his fellow disciples had gone.

Along the way, he rose close to the surface several times and peered outside through gaps in the rocks. Only after confirming that the enemies pursuing his fellow disciples had finally abandoned the chase did Lee Hyun slow down.

He could have done more if he truly wanted to, but revealing his full strength in front of his fellow disciples while maintaining the identity of Li Dongsan, a Foundation Establishment Stage 2 cultivator, would have been troublesome. Of course, if his fellow disciples had been placed in danger, he had intended to reveal his abilities if necessary to save them, but fortunately there had been no need.

Lee Hyun poked his head out from beneath a rock on a deserted slope and took out a Tier 2 voice-transmission talisman.

[This is Li Dongsan. I escaped safely. I’ll take a detour underground, so please don’t take any risks trying to find me. I’ll keep watch for signs of the enemy and take my time rejoining you.]

The voice-transmission talisman gathered light and flew away.

Lee Hyun slipped back beneath the rock and gradually descended deeper, putting ample distance between himself and the surface. As he did, a warm, clear energy brushed past his body.

He paused and examined his surroundings. The lesser yang qi he had sensed in the spirit fields above was flowing upward from below through thin fissures in the bedrock.

‘Huh? I do happen to be alone now... should I try looking for the source of the lesser yang qi...?’

Chapter 56

Lee Hyun turned toward the direction from which the lesser yang qi was flowing.

Rustle─

As he descended through the gaps in the bedrock, the warm energy gradually grew clearer.

At first, all he had to do was follow the energy seeping through the cracks between the rocks, but before long, the flow split into several branches.

Lee Hyun chose the direction where it felt strongest.

After traveling for quite some time, he stopped.

'This isn't it.'

No new lesser yang qi was emerging here. Energy flowing in from all directions had merely been blocked by the bedrock and temporarily pooled in one place.

Lee Hyun retraced his route. Before long, he found another faint stream of energy rising from below and changed direction toward it.

...

The sounds of the surface had vanished long ago.

Whenever his body, wrapped in Primordial True Qi, passed through, the soil and stone softened around him before hardening again.

How far had he descended?

Lee Hyun estimated the direction and distance he had traveled.

'Even measuring it vertically, I think I've descended almost forty li (about 15.7 km).... In the human realm, I usually reached the earth-vein stratum after going down around twenty-five li. Is the earth-vein stratum deeper in this secret realm?'

'Could it be... the reason the Danxiao Sect couldn't transplant the Fire-Heart Orchids outside was because they didn't have a Foundation Establishment cultivator capable of investigating this deep?'

Being able to use the Earth Escape Art did not mean one could freely roam around at such depths.

His spiritual power continued to drain even as he changed directions while tracing the energy. If he took a wrong route, he had to retrace the entire distance he had traveled.

On top of that, he also had to reserve enough spiritual power for the return trip.

Nor could every Foundation Establishment cultivator use techniques like the Breath-Sealing Art and Air-Clearing Art to deal with problems related to breathing.

'I see. Even with my level of mastery over these techniques, it takes this much spiritual power... Even if the Danxiao Sect sent a cultivator at Great Perfection of Foundation Establishment, investigating all the way down here would be difficult.'

Fortunately, Lee Hyun still had plenty of spiritual power.

He continued downward.

...

After Lee Hyun had descended for a while, the bedrock began to grow warm.

Lee Hyun slowed down.

Dense Fire spiritual qi was flowing from cracks in the rock ahead.

'Is this the earth-vein stratum?'

He avoided the place where the scorching energy was strongest and circled around it.

A short while later, he sensed a small hollow space beyond the bedrock.

Rustle─

Lee Hyun emerged from the stone wall.

It was a narrow cavern barely large enough for three or four people. On one side of the floor was a fissure of unfathomable depth, and a faint red glow flickered beneath it.

Whoooosh─

A hot wind lifted the hem of his long robe.

Lee Hyun thickened his Qi Sphere Barrier.

'Earth fire runs beneath here.'

Most of the surrounding rock was dark reddish-black, but an orange ore vein ran across the cavern wall, its surface marked with what looked like thin crimson cracks.

Lee Hyun approached it.

"Hm?"

The flow detected by his Aura-Reading Art was strange.

Dense Fire spiritual qi rising from below seeped into the lower part of the ore vein, while a slightly different kind of energy flowed out from above.

Warm, yet clear energy.

It was the lesser yang qi he had felt in the Fire-Heart Orchid spirit field on the surface.

Lee Hyun brought his palm close to the ore vein.

After examining it for a long while, his gaze changed.

'It's coming from here?'

He examined the ordinary surrounding rocks one after another.

The lesser yang qi merely passed through them. The flow of energy itself began at the surface of the orange ore vein.

Lee Hyun lightly tapped the ore with his fingertip.

Tap. Tap.

It was quite hard.

He broke off a finger-sized piece from the edge of the vein.

He could still sense lesser yang qi from the detached ore, but when he carried it to the opposite side of the cavern and waited a moment, the energy rapidly weakened.

Before long, it became nothing more than a warm piece of stone.

"So it really won't work if I take it outside?"

Lee Hyun stared down at the ore, then turned his gaze back toward the earth-fire vein.

Hot energy continued to flow into the lower part of the ore vein.

'Wait....'

Lee Hyun supported the piece of ore with spiritual power and moved it close to the fissure in the floor.

Whoosh─

Heat and Fire spiritual qi rising from the earth-fire vein enveloped the piece of stone.

A short while later.

The patterns within the ore began to glow very faintly. Soon afterward, lesser yang qi began flowing from its surface.

"Oh...."

When he moved the ore away again, the energy weakened.

This time, he placed an ordinary black stone near the earth-fire vein. The stone grew scorching hot, but no matter how long he waited, the same change never occurred.

Lee Hyun switched the positions of the two stones and repeated the test several more times. Lesser yang qi only emerged when the orange ore was supplied with heat and Fire spiritual qi.

'It's not releasing energy stored inside it. This stone is producing lesser yang qi!'

To borrow a term from his previous life, it seemed similar to a catalyst.

He would have to investigate its mechanism and lifespan further, but as long as the necessary conditions were met, it seemed like it could be used elsewhere.

Lee Hyun's expression brightened.

'Then I just need to find an earth-fire vein like this beneath Tunnel No. 3. I could place these stones nearby and build a spirit field where the orchids can absorb the lesser yang qi without being exposed to the direct heat.... I can make a separate water reservoir as well.'

He was beginning to see a way to cultivate Fire-Heart Orchids.

Lee Hyun looked at the ore vein.

The exposed section stretched across one side of the cavern wall. When he extended his divine sense, he discovered that the same ore continued dozens of zhang (each about 3.3 m) deeper into the rock.

'Considering the size of this secret realm, there should be plenty of this ore... Taking some of it shouldn't cause any problems.'

...

One shichen (about two hours) later, Lee Hyun had mined enough ore to fill an entire room and stored it in his storage pouch.

Lesser yang qi continued to flow from the remaining ore vein almost exactly as before.

"I wonder what this is called. Maybe it isn't something known outside."

After thinking for a moment, he took out a wooden tag and wrote on it.

「Lesser Yang Stone.

Ore involved in the production of lesser yang qi.

Requires earth-fire heat and Fire spiritual qi.」

He could always change the name later once he learned its official one.

Lee Hyun placed the wooden tag inside his storage pouch.

...

The journey upward was far faster than the descent.

He no longer needed to wander around following the flow of energy.

At some point, he heard the sound of running water.

When he poked his head out and looked around, he saw a valley flanked by rocky cliffs, with a small river flowing between them.

Nearby stood something resembling a white dog.

'Hm?'

Its torso was constructed from bones of various thicknesses, with four long, sharp legs attached to it. Its head resembled a giant rat more than a dog.

A thin green light flickered within its empty eye sockets.

'A bone demon beast? No, its aura resembles that bone sword I saw not long ago... Is it a puppet?'

Just then, Lee Hyun's Keen Hearing Art picked up the sound of something approaching.

His gaze rose.

Three Foundation Establishment cultivators were descending from the low clouds overhead.

'They spotted me.'

A Foundation Establishment cultivator's divine sense could survey a radius of over a hundred zhang. However, in an open area, the distance one could see using the Farsight Art was far greater.

In other words, even if Lee Hyun's divine sense surpassed his opponents', someone looking down at him with the Farsight Art from high in the sky beyond its range could still spot him first.

Lee Hyun emerged completely from the rock and stood beside the river. With no fellow disciples around, there was no need to flee or conceal his strength.

A young cultivator in a black long robe descended at the front.

He was a pale-skinned man with narrow, elongated eyes. Behind him stood a white-bone puppet taller than a man, with three arms protruding from each side of its torso.

Its six hands each held a magic tool, including a sword, saber, shield, hook, and other weapons.

Lee Hyun examined the fluctuations of spiritual power emanating from the young cultivator.

'Great Perfection of Foundation Establishment.... I can't let my guard down.'

Behind him, a middle-aged cultivator in a brown robe and an elderly one-eyed cultivator flew in at different altitudes.

The one-eyed old cultivator was at late Foundation Establishment, while the middle-aged cultivator was at mid Foundation Establishment.

The young cultivator's fingers moved lightly.

The Six-Armed Bone Puppet raised its head.

Crack. Crack.

Its bone joints straightened one after another.

"Are you from the Danxiao Sect?"

The young cultivator asked.

"Who knows."

A black-iron longspear appeared in Lee Hyun's right hand.

The young cultivator narrowed his eyes.

"Kill him."

Boom!

The bone puppet on the ground kicked off the bedrock with all four legs and charged.

At the same time, two blood-red flying hooks shot from the brown-robed cultivator's sleeves, tracing sharp arcs toward Lee Hyun's neck and knees.

Above them, the one-eyed old cultivator sent a flying sword plunging downward with an eerie shriek as it tore through the air.

Swish.

Lee Hyun's left hand slid smoothly down the shaft of the black-iron longspear.

The instant the longspear traced a crescent through the air, the Primordial True Qi condensed just beneath its spearhead erupted into an enormous vortex.

Wooooong─

"!?"

The descending flying sword veered off course and was dragged toward the spear blade. The two hooks aimed at his neck and knees curved toward it as well.

CLAAANG!

The instant the three magic tools collided, the butt of the longspear swept across the ground and shattered the bone puppet's jaw.

Twisting at the waist, Lee Hyun caught the gathered enemy magic tools around his spear blade and swept them into a single rotation.

SPLAAAAASH!

Lee Hyun pushed off the river’s surface and leaped into the air. The water below coiled upward like a dragon’s tail.

The two flying hooks and the flying sword suspended in the air followed the exact path traced by Lee Hyun's spear tip, spiraling through the sky.

"My magic tools!?"

"What trick is this!"

The brown-robed cultivator hurriedly changed his hand seal. But before he could reclaim his magic tools, Lee Hyun leveled the spearhead at the two cultivators.

THOOM!

The anchor of the Earth-Origin Force seized the two men this time.

"Urgh!?"

The one-eyed old cultivator, who had been trying to gain altitude, suddenly plunged downward.

The brown-robed cultivator pitched forward as well, and the two men who had been hovering at different heights were dragged toward a single point in an instant.

Amid the chaos, four bronze flying swords radiating wondrous light spread outward with the dazzling brilliance of the rising sun.

'No...'

SHNK!

Brilliant white lines flashed, and the brown-robed cultivator's upper body came apart and spilled downward.

"Damn it─"

The one-eyed old cultivator went deathly pale and hurriedly produced a round shield, desperately trying to retreat.

But,

SHRAAAK!

Two bronze flying swords burst through the spray like the talons of a bird of prey and pierced straight through the back of the old cultivator's neck.

SPURT!

His lone eye bulged as though it might pop from its socket.

The other flying swords returned immediately afterward and pierced through his dantian.

Lee Hyun lightly shook his spear and withdrew the force of attraction.

The river water that had coiled into the sky came pouring down like rain.

The two cultivators' corpses crashed onto the pebbles of the riverbed amid the spray.

Splash! Thud!

Within the gently drifting mist, six bronze flying swords swam smoothly around Lee Hyun.

"......."

The arrogance and composure had completely vanished from the face of the last remaining young man.

His name was Guo Zhenming.

He was the successor of Haigu Island and one of the foremost heaven's prodigies among the Yin Bird Sect's Foundation Establishment cultivators.

Yet while his two companions were being killed, he had not even found an opening to intervene.

'That monster.'

The man before him was in a completely different league from the Danxiao Sect disciples he had fought until now.

He appeared to be an early Foundation Establishment cultivator, but his ruthless methods and mastery of techniques rivaled those of the old monsters of Haigu Island!

'Is he a true-inheritance disciple raised by one of the Danxiao Sect's Nascent Soul old monsters? Why is someone like that here...? And what the hell is that spear? What kind of magic tool has a flight-suppressing restriction built into it!'

Guo Zhenming pulled a White Bone Banner from his robe and waved it.

SKRIEEEEE─

A ghostly wail violent enough to shake the valley and rupture one's eardrums erupted.

The yin poison released by thousands of resentful spirits enveloped Lee Hyun's body, while their wails bored into his sea of consciousness.

The Qi Sphere Barrier blocked the energy. Within his sea of consciousness, the Essence-Protecting Seal merely glowed faintly, and Lee Hyun's gaze never wavered.

Guo Zhenming instantly realized his opponent was unaffected and emptied his storage pouch.

Three bone puppets, each twice the size of a man, appeared.

Their torsos were wrapped in layer after layer of thick spirit bone, and each held a bone hammer as large as a boulder in both hands.

The Six-Armed Bone Puppet also stepped forward, its six weapons gleaming.

The four bone puppets erupted with power, shot into the air, and descended upon Lee Hyun from every direction.

The leading puppet swung its bone hammer down as though to smash Lee Hyun's skull apart.

Whoooooosh!

Amid the savage shriek of tearing air, Lee Hyun released his longspear to float in midair and opened his hand.

Wooooong─

Primordial True Qi condensed, and an enormous hand more than three zhang in size appeared.

It was the Condensed-Essence Grasping Hand.

At the exact instant the bone hammer came crashing down, Lee Hyun's five fingers clenched with rock-hard force.

"Get lost."

BANG!

With an explosive roar, the enormous fist struck the bone hammer and the puppet's upper body head-on.

The hammer and the puppet's bones exploded apart simultaneously. Fragments of the shattered bone hammer and clouds of bone dust scattered through the air, forming a white haze, while the puppet's remaining lower half plunged into the river.

The two puppets to either side rushed into the opening, but Lee Hyun spread his hand and seized the one on the left.

The gigantic fingers wrapped around its waist and snapped it in half.

CRUNCH!

Lee Hyun swung his arm, smashing the captured puppet into the one on the right. The Condensed-Essence Grasping Hand crushed both puppets together into a single mass and rammed them straight into the cliff face!

RUMBLE!

Dozens of zhang of the cliff cracked and collapsed.

While the three bone puppets were being reduced to scrap, the Six-Armed Bone Puppet crossed its sword and saber and slipped into Lee Hyun's blind spot.

Swish-swish!

Lee Hyun leaned his upper body back, grabbed the floating longspear, and thrust it between the two blades.

SKRRAAAAPE!

The two weapons slid along the blade of the longspear and sliced through empty air.

The spear butt slammed into the puppet's knee joint. Lee Hyun let the off-balance puppet tumble past him and looked toward Guo Zhenming.

Beneath Guo Zhenming's skin, his bones warped as blood-red flames burst forth.

"Die!"

A dark-red bone nail one cun (about 3.3 cm) long shot from between Guo Zhenming's fingers!

Flash!

'Fast!'

The instant Lee Hyun's divine sense detected it, the blood-red flash was already right in front of him.

Lee Hyun immediately swept the black-iron longspear vertically upward. At the same time, he twisted his upper body and erected three layers of Spirit Light Shields in front of his flank.

CLANG─

The bone nail scraped violently along the side of the longspear.

The impact was so violent that it felt as though the skin of his palm might be torn away, and the spear shaft was knocked backward.

The deflected bone nail pierced through all three Spirit Light Shields and tore through his body-protecting spirit light as well.

SKRRAAAPE! BOOM!

His long robe ripped apart as the dark-red flash slammed into his side.

KRRRCH!

The bone nail scraped a long line across the scales of his Black Scale Inner Armor before ricocheting away.

The impact sent Lee Hyun's body spinning half a turn through the air.

BOOOOOOM!

Behind Lee Hyun, an enormous section of the cliff exploded as though struck by lightning.

Blood-red cracks spread from where the bone nail had embedded itself, and boulders as large as houses came crashing into the river.

Amid the swirling clouds of dust and powdered stone, Lee Hyun stepped onto a falling boulder and regained his balance.

'That was dangerous.'

His side burned.

But Guo Zhenming was the one who was truly shocked.

It had been his life-bound bone nail, infused with his own essence blood. Seeing Lee Hyun deflect it head-on and stand effortlessly atop the falling rocks with nothing more than a slightly torn robe filled Guo Zhenming with soul-devouring terror.

"Y-you goddamn monster...!"

Guo Zhenming recalled the White Bone Banner and shot into the sky. The Six-Armed Bone Puppet raised its six weapons and blocked Lee Hyun's path to cover its master's retreat.

Killing intent filled Lee Hyun's eyes.

"Where do you think you're going?"

The ferocious pull of the Earth-Origin Force anchor erupted from Lee Hyun's hand.

Guo Zhenming, weakened from firing his life-bound bone nail, was unable to resist. His body folded at the waist as he was violently dragged backward. When he raised his head, six bronze flying swords split around both sides of the Six-Armed Bone Puppet and streaked toward him in a spectacular formation.

'N-no...'

SHNK─

Guo Zhenming plummeted toward the ground, spraying fresh blood. The Six-Armed Bone Puppet, having lost its master, also fell powerlessly from the sky.

Thud! Crash!

...

The valley fell silent.

Lee Hyun surveyed his surroundings with divine sense and various detection techniques, but sensed no one else nearby.

He pulled open the front of his robe. A few thin scratches marked the black scales of the Black Scale Inner Armor. When he rubbed them with his fingertips, they did not seem deep, but a long bruise had already formed across the skin underneath.

Lee Hyun looked toward the cliff where the bone nail was embedded.

'I was careless. I should've taken out the Profound Iron Buckler immediately.'

In that urgent moment, he had instinctively used the Spirit Light Shield he was accustomed to.

It was not enough to merely finish bonding a new magic tool. He needed to practice with it so that he could draw it instantly at moments like this.

He straightened his clothes and walked toward the fallen cultivators.

...

Three storage pouches and the various magic tools were gathered in one place.

Most of the bone puppets had been shattered beyond recognition. Lee Hyun picked out the pieces whose joints and formation inscriptions remained intact.

'Maybe I should study puppets too.'

He placed the usable wreckage into his storage pouch one piece at a time.

His hand paused briefly when he came to the Six-Armed Bone Puppet. Small spirit stones had been embedded inside its chest. Countless patterns extended from them along the bones, while several tiny restrictions overlapped around the shoulder and elbow joints.

Lee Hyun examined its structure for quite some time.

'So this is how they're inscribed.'

The Six-Armed Bone Puppet had only suffered minor damage to the joints of its knees and arms. Compared to the other puppets, it was nearly intact. Lee Hyun stored the puppet away.

Lastly, he gathered the corpses in one place.

Whoosh─

After burning the bodies and their bloodstained clothes, he collected the ashes and the bloodstained soil.

Only after burying them deep within the bedrock beneath the valley did he leave.

...

Half a shichen later, Lee Hyun set down the three storage pouches in a small underground cavern far from the site of the battle.

"Let's see."

He erased the remaining traces of divine sense and restrictions from each storage pouch one by one.

The first contained ten mid-grade spirit stones, restorative pills, and several kinds of bone materials.

The second belonged to the one-eyed old cultivator.

It contained around twenty mid-grade spirit stones. There were also metal fragments that could likely be used to repair a flying sword, along with several unused talismans.

Then he opened the young cultivator's storage pouch.

Lee Hyun's gaze changed.

Clatter.

Several pouches filled with spirit stones spilled onto the ground.

Jade caskets, medicine bottles, and long pieces of bone followed one after another.

Lee Hyun first gathered all the spirit stones together.

There were more than two hundred mid-grade spirit stones alone!

'That's more than enough to recoup all the spirit stones I spent before setting out.'

He stared at the pile of spirit stones for a moment before placing them in his own storage pouch.

The jade casket he opened next contained jade slips and books.

A black jade token rested on top.

One side was engraved with a pattern resembling white bones, while the other bore a name and status.

「Guo Zhenming, true-inheritance disciple of Haigu Island, Yin Bird Sect.」

'So he was a true-inheritance disciple.'

Tiny characters were engraved onto the jade slip beneath it.

《Profound Yin White Bone True Scripture》
