After removing the remaining restrictions, Lee Hyun pressed the jade slip to his forehead. Keeping the Essence-Protecting Seal active, he gradually sent his divine sense into it.

In the past, he would have been reluctant to pour divine sense into an unknown jade slip, but now that he had a means to protect his primordial spirit, he felt considerably more at ease.

A long mnemonic formula and an image of the human body entered his mind.

Countless patterns ran across the skeleton in the diagram. Spiritual power circulated through the meridians while also seeping deep into the bones, and energy gathered at specific points before extending outward beyond the body.

Lee Hyun opened his eyes after reading the opening general principles.

"Oh...."

This was the sect-defining cultivation art of the Yin Bird Sect's Haigu Island!

TL Note: Bonus chapter for the review posted on NovelUpdates by 'Impy_imp'.

Chapter 57

Lee Hyun pressed the jade slip to his forehead again.

「The flesh rots away within a hundred years, but white bone endures for a thousand years even when buried beneath the earth, a vessel for the true self. Cast off the blood and flesh of mortals and inscribe the Profound Yin of the Nine Heavens into every joint of your bones.」

After the general precepts of the Profound Yin White Bone True Scripture came the Qi Refining Section and the Foundation Establishment Section. At the end, there was also a portion of an essential method for refining true essence in preparation for Core Formation, but there was no cultivation method for after forming a golden core.

‘Looks like the later cultivation methods are only passed down after forming a golden core...’

That was a little disappointing, but as befitted a sect-defining cultivation art, the secret arts recorded in the Foundation Establishment Section were anything but ordinary.

They ranged from the White Bone Refining Art, which tempered the skeleton like a magic tool, to the White Bone Yin Fire, which compressed yin qi to melt away an opponent's body-protecting spirit light, and even the secret method for crafting the life-bound bone nail, which carved bone into a deadly concealed weapon. It also contained the Soul-Binding Spirit Control Art, which gathered weak souls and bound them to the White Bone Banner. Its methods were remarkably varied.

Lee Hyun removed the jade slip from his forehead and opened the book that had been stored with it. Its pages were densely filled with notes Guo Zhenming had written while cultivating.

Those notes also revealed the Haigu Island Lord's cultivation realm.

Early Nascent Soul.

Although Haigu Island was a branch of the Yin Bird Sect, it was a powerful lineage in its own right, with a Nascent Soul cultivator of its own.

‘So the bastard had quite the background.’

Lee Hyun set the book down and examined the jade slip again.

Ultimately, the essence of the Profound Yin White Bone True Scripture lay in refining spiritual qi into Profound Yin White Bone True Qi and putting it to use. The inheritance resembled a demonic cultivation art, which made him reluctant to cultivate it himself.

‘There's no reason to switch my cultivation art to the Profound Yin White Bone True Scripture....’

Still, the sections explaining the mnemonic formula and properties of Profound Yin White Bone True Qi caught his interest. Profound Yin White Bone True Qi was needed when refining the bones used to make bone puppets.

Moreover, the inheritance's anatomical knowledge of bones and its arrangement of restrictions seemed to offer plenty of insights into controlling the body as well. Even without cultivating the inheritance itself, the knowledge alone held considerable value.

After studying the mnemonic formula closely, Lee Hyun concluded that he might be able to transform Primordial True Qi into Profound Yin White Bone True Qi.

‘If so, I might be able to make bone puppets too.’

The latter part of the inheritance contained detailed instructions for making bone puppets: how to judge bone quality, the order in which to remove impurities from each type of bone, and even how to join bones with different properties into a single body.

Lee Hyun blinked as he read the section describing the materials.

‘Most of them use demon beast bones.’

The sea surrounding Haigu Island was home to many marine demon beasts.

Among them, demon beasts with sturdy skeletons possessed bones far tougher than those of ordinary cultivators of the human race at the same realm. They were also much larger, so a single beast yielded far more bone material.

By contrast, unless a cultivator of the human race was a body refiner, reaching Foundation Establishment did not automatically make their bones good material for magic tools. Only an exceptional human body refiner would have bones comparable to those of a demon beast, so in most cases there was little reason to go out of one's way to obtain human bones.

Lee Hyun took the Six-Armed Bone Puppet out of his storage pouch.

Thud.

The six-armed bone puppet lay on the floor of the cavern.

The bones forming its chest had gentle curves, while the bone material used for its arms was excessively long and straight. They were clearly not human bones. It seemed to have been fashioned into a roughly human shape by cutting, fitting together, and refining various demon beast bones.

Now that he had read the inheritance, Lee Hyun noticed things he had missed before. His attention settled on a green stone wedged among the spirit stones inside the puppet's chest. The sensation was different when his divine sense touched it.

‘So this wasn't a spirit stone....’

He reread the relevant section of the jade slip.

Soul stone.

It was a type of spirit material capable of storing soul power and was said to be indispensable not only for bone puppets, but also for puppets made from spirit wood or metal.

Of course, merely inserting a soul stone would not make a puppet move on its own. A spell formula for carrying out commands had to be engraved into the processed soul stone, then connected to the restrictions throughout the puppet's body.

‘I see. It needs something that acts as a brain... Just as cultivators have essence, qi and spirit, a bone puppet needs a center of intelligence in addition to bones and spiritual power. This part might be pretty difficult.’

Lee Hyun examined the restrictions around the soul stone more closely.

Several connections were damaged, but the soul stone itself was intact. According to the inheritance, it could be reused after clearing its master's ownership imprint and the commands recorded within it.

‘I should make sure the soul stone stays intact for now.’

He took out a sheet of paper and sketched the bone puppet's structure, then carefully separated the damaged knee and arm joints first. He marked the direction of each connection before storing the pieces separately, leaving the torso containing the soul stone untouched.

He would not be able to learn the Puppet Art immediately, but this bone puppet would serve as a valuable specimen for future research.

‘If I learn how to handle puppets... couldn't I use them later to tend or guard the spirit fields in the tunnels?’

Lee Hyun's gaze then shifted to the White Bone Banner lying off to one side. A faint presence of resentful spirits leaked from within.

‘What an ominous thing.’

He added a Spirit-Sealing Talisman to the White Bone Banner and placed it inside a separate jade casket.

He examined the restrictions and energies of the remaining items and sorted them by type.

He gathered the bone material used for repairs, the medicinal liquid applied to puppets, and the pieces of bone that had yet to be refined in one place. Among the bone material were several pieces that appeared to come from Tier 2 demon beasts.

Lee Hyun's hand stopped as he inspected the medicine bottles. Two small jade bottles bore the same name.

「Spirit-Nourishing Pill.」

"This is... something I heard about during a lecture..."

The Spirit-Nourishing Pill was a Tier 2 pill that strengthened divine sense.

‘The cultivators of Haigu Island must consider strengthening their divine sense important because they have to control several puppets at once. If this pill checks out, I could take it myself.’

Lee Hyun carefully set the two bottles aside, then sorted the other medicine bottles as well.

Next, he took out the magic tools the cultivators had used.

There were two blood-red flying hooks, the one-eyed old cultivator's flying sword, and a round shield.

The flying hooks were a paired set of high-grade magic tools. The restrictions on the two hooks resonated with each other, and the inner edges of their blades were densely engraved with patterns designed to tear through body-protecting spirit light.

The one-eyed old cultivator's flying sword was also a high-grade magic tool. The round shield, whose owner had died before he could even use it properly, bore only a few scratches along its rim.

Selling just those four items at a fair price should bring in at least eighty mid-grade spirit stones.

He marked the items whose uses he could not identify and stored them separately.

‘I can examine them more closely after I return to the Danxiao Sect.’

Unlike before, he took most of the suspicious items with him as well.

Even if some hidden tracking method had been left among the items, it would be difficult for anyone to come all the way into the Danxiao Sect and act against him immediately. Still, he would have to thoroughly check whether any tracking methods remained once he returned.

‘If I find anything suspicious, I can just bury it somewhere in the Danxiao Range instead of taking it back to Tunnel No. 3.’

After sorting everything, Lee Hyun felt a warm sense of satisfaction as he looked at his now-bulging storage pouch. There were so many new things to examine that excitement rose in him naturally. He doubted he would be bored for quite some time.

More than anything, he was curious whether the Lesser Yang Stone could be used to grow Fire-Heart Orchids. Lee Hyun calmed his excitement and stood.

‘For now, I should return to my fellow disciples.’

That evening, Lee Hyun emerged from behind a boulder on the western slope near the stone wall by the realm gate.

The side of his long robe was torn, and dirt and dust clung to his sleeves and hair. Before approaching too close to the stone wall's formation, he took out his identity token.

A cultivator standing watch atop the stone wall spotted him.

"Which group are you with?"

"I am Li Dongsan of Yanxia Peak."

A moment later, a passage opened in the formation's barrier.

As Lee Hyun stepped inside, Yue Wugou, who had been walking out from one of the halls, stopped in his tracks.

"Junior Brother Li!"

He strode over.

"Why are you so late? We received your voice-transmission talisman, but...."

Yue Wugou's gaze settled on the torn long robe.

"Were you hurt?"

"Just a scratch. It doesn't interfere with my movement."

Tao Wenqian and Mei Sujun also came out from the hall.

Tao Wenqian examined Lee Hyun's face and aura before finally relaxing his shoulders.

"Good to have you back."

Mei Sujun brushed the dirt from Lee Hyun's sleeve.

"You startled me when you disappeared underground. I was worried whether you'd managed to get away afterward. I'm glad you're safe."

"I hid my presence in a deep crevice underground. Once things above quieted down, I took a roundabout route back."

"No one followed you?"

"No."

Tao Wenqian nodded.

"Good. We brought the goods back safely, and no one on our side suffered any serious injuries. Now that Junior Brother has returned too, we can finally rest easy."

Su Buyi approached from the neighboring hall as well.

"Fellow Daoist Li. If we get the chance next time, I'd like you to give me some pointers on the Earth Escape Art. After seeing it today, I began thinking I ought to learn it myself."

"It takes some time to become proficient."

"I expected as much."

‘It really does take a long time, though...’

...

After being assigned quarters within the walled encampment, Lee Hyun used the Cleansing Art to remove the dirt from his body and clothes.

He applied medicine to his bruised side and changed out of his torn long robe.

Then he took the Profound Iron Buckler from his storage pouch.

Hummm–

The palm-sized shield expanded until it was large enough to cover his upper body.

Lee Hyun put the shield away and summoned it again. He changed the direction in which he extended his hand, repeating the same motion even while turning his body.

He also inspected the cracked Protective Bell, but it did not seem capable of withstanding any powerful attacks for the time being.

Lee Hyun stored the Protective Bell separately, then put away the Profound Iron Buckler once more.

Several days later.

New information reached the stone wall.

A Biluo Sect scouting group had found the route leading to the enemy's realm gate. The testimony of a newly captured liaison had apparently provided the clue.

The atmosphere in the stone wall changed as soon as the news spread.

"We finally caught their trail."

"Now those bastards have somewhere they have to defend too."

Cultivators with bandages wrapped around their arms came out of the halls, while even those who had remained silent for some time went around looking for maps. Many cultivators of the Danxiao Sect and Biluo Sect were filled with fierce resolve to take revenge.

Still, no order to attack came immediately.

Tao Wenqian gathered his fellow disciples and explained the plan.

"As scheduled, reinforcements will arrive on the fifteenth day. At that time, we'll send only some of the wounded out first. The rest of us will postpone our rotation and join the attack."

Yue Wugou asked,

"What about the places we've been guarding?"

"We'll withdraw additional personnel from several spirit fields. We still need enough forces to guard the realm gate and the stone wall, so our only option is to gather those scattered throughout the area."

Tao Wenqian looked at Lee Hyun.

"How is your condition, Junior Brother Li?"

"I'm fine."

"Then come with us."

"Understood."

...

On the fifteenth day after entering the secret realm.

New cultivators emerged from the realm gate one after another.

Some took charge of the wounded, while others distributed the formation flags and talismans they had brought to the cultivators stationed there.

Starting that night, the attacking force split into several groups and left the stone wall.

Lee Hyun moved with Tao Wenqian's group. They flew low along the valleys and forests confirmed by the scouting group, while neighboring groups advanced in parallel with mountain ridges separating them.

...

Lee Hyun sat in the shadow of a boulder and looked toward the mountain ridge ahead.

The enemy's realm gate lay beyond that mountain.

It was a little over two thousand li (about 784 km) from the realm gate managed by the Danxiao Sect, in an area without spirit fields that normally saw little traffic.

A short distance away, two cultivators spoke quietly.

"Then does that mean there's another realm gate outside as well, two thousand li from the Danxiao Range?"

"I don't think so. I've heard distances inside a grotto-heaven don't necessarily correspond directly to distances outside."

"Then it could be in the Lan Kingdom or the Cang Kingdom."

"It could even be tens of thousands of li away."

Lee Hyun listened for a moment before Tao Wenqian returned from the meeting of the group leaders.

"Our group will enter along the southern slope. Another group will handle the formation at the front. Stop any enemies trying to flee the main camp, but don't pursue them all the way to the realm gate."

Mei Sujun folded the map.

"Understood."

...

The attack began.

Flash!

A gigantic sword light rose beyond the ridge.

Dozens of streaks of spirit light followed, pouring into the valley from different heights. As magic tools and talismans hammered against the enemy's outer formation, a barrier resembling blue scales appeared in what had been empty air.

Boom-boom-boom!

Explosions thundered one after another.

Enemy cultivators flew up from the halls and behind boulders. Some moved to fill gaps in the formation, while others scattered left and right in an attempt to circle around the attacking force.

The cultivators concealed on the southern slope revealed themselves at that moment.

"Move!"

A long stream of crimson flame shot from Tao Wenqian's sleeve.

Yue Wugou's iron plaque hurtled toward two enemies flying low to evade the flames, while Mei Sujun's blue-green silk swept between the trees to block another cultivator's path.

Lee Hyun floated the Profound Iron Buckler a short distance behind them.

Thud!

A blast of energy from within the forest struck the shield, sending violent ripples across its surface.

A deep blue chill bloomed over the shield.

Lee Hyun turned his head.

A cultivator in an indigo long robe walked out from between the trees. He was a man at roughly Foundation Establishment Stage 5.

At his waist hung a bizarre blue-black gourd as large as a human head. Fish-scale patterns protruded across its surface, and dense cold air streamed from its mouth.

The cultivator removed the gourd from his waist, gripped it in one hand, and lightly struck its base with his palm.

Hissss–

Cold water mist poured from the mouth of the gourd and spread in every direction, forming a dense curtain in an instant.

"A Danxiao Sect brat thinks one shield is enough to make him fearless."

The cultivator gave a sinister laugh and formed a hand seal.

Rooooar–

The sound of rushing water burst from inside the gourd, and twelve gleaming flying blades shot out through the deep-blue chill.

The crescent-shaped flying blades cut through the mist like fins as they surged forward. They resembled a school of piranhas that had scented blood and rushed in to tear apart their prey.

Lee Hyun angled the Profound Iron Buckler.

Clang-clang-clang-clang!

Three or four of the leading flying blades ricocheted off the shield's edge. Yet the deflected blades twisted their trajectories in midair as if lashing their tails, then hid themselves in the mist and drove toward Lee Hyun's blind spots.

Lee Hyun drew the Profound Gate Sword.

The blade shifted briefly to the side.

Clang!

A flying blade that had slipped through the mist toward his flank struck the sword and bounced into the air.

Lee Hyun took half a step back and watched the man.

The cultivator flicked his fingers and realigned the flying blades. The scattered twelve blades swam through the mist, constantly changing positions as frostlike energy overlapped along the paths they traced.

Lee Hyun relaxed his grip on his sword slightly.

‘For now, I just need to keep this guy occupied.’

...

Clang! Clang!

The Profound Gate Sword knocked aside the descending flying blades one after another.

Lee Hyun retreated with the recoil of each collision while surveying his surroundings with divine sense.

Roughly forty zhang (about 132 m) to his right, Mei Sujun was driving back her opponent. Yue Wugou and Su Buyi were doing much the same.

‘Everyone's doing well.’

At that moment, a flying blade shot up from beneath his feet.

Swoosh!

Lee Hyun sidestepped and used the Profound Gate Sword to knock away the flying blade that followed immediately after. Then he lowered his shield slightly and extended the Profound Gate Sword.

When the flying blade struck the sword and flew back, Lee Hyun saw the man beyond the mist grit his teeth.

It must have been an incredibly frustrating battle for him.

Lee Hyun's cultivation realm was lower than the man's, and he had exposed openings several times. Yet every attack missed by a hair, and whenever a strike came from an angle difficult to block with a magic tool, Lee Hyun escaped with strange footwork.

When the flying blades intertwined and rushed at him again, Lee Hyun retreated a little farther this time.

Two flying blades crossed through the place where he had been standing.

The center of the valley briefly came into view beyond the scattered mist.

BOOM!

One side of the enemy's outer barrier was collapsing.

Late Foundation Establishment and Great Perfection cultivators surged through the breach. Tao Wenqian had also driven away the enemies near him and was blocking those trying to flee south with a wall of flame.

The familiar sound of waves echoed from afar.

The owner of the shell-shaped magic tool that had attacked Chishui Garden seemed to be inside the valley as well. This time, however, its empowered sound could not continue for long because of the sword lights from Biluo Sect cultivators converging on that area.

Lee Hyun turned his attention back to the enemy before him.

The cultivator in the indigo long robe thrust the gourd in front of his chest.

"You vermin... I'll grind even your bones to dust!"

Rumble–

The gourd's mouth opened wide, and a raging torrent burst forth, swallowing the twelve flying blades circling through the air.

The torrent and flying blades intertwined into the shape of a massive flood dragon. Razor-sharp blades flashed throughout the churning water as it crashed toward Lee Hyun with enough force to pulverize every tree in the forest.

At the same time as the man unleashed the attack, he flung himself sideways. No longer obsessed with killing Lee Hyun, he was trying to retreat toward the valley where some of his allies still remained.

‘Time to end this.’

Mei Sujun's opponent had already fallen, and Yue Wugou and Su Buyi were dealing with the remaining enemies.

Just then, a tremendous explosion erupted from the center of the valley, sending a violent wave of spiritual power outward. Everyone's attention turned in that direction.

At that instant, the black line running across the center of the Profound Gate Sword's blade blazed so brightly it hurt the eyes. Lee Hyun's arm moved like a bolt of lightning.

Slice!

Sword light flashed, cleanly severing the enormous torrent and the dozen flying blades in midair.

Crack-crack! BOOM!

Fragments of broken flying blades scattered in every direction as the torrent lost its form and dispersed.

At the same time, Lee Hyun's body slipped into the water mist.

‘What the hell...?!’

The retreating man went deathly pale and shoved the gourd in his hand in front of the sword while driving his body-protecting spirit light to its limit.

However,

Flash!

The sword light did not merely cleave the gourd cleanly in two. It sliced straight through the body-protecting spirit light and the man's upper body as well.

The man's eyes widened.

‘How...?’

It was the same sword his opponent had used throughout their dozens of exchanges only moments before.

He had never imagined that the same magic tool could unleash such power. While he had been fighting with everything he had, just how little strength had his opponent been using against him?

The man's body collapsed into the water mist.

Lee Hyun took the storage pouch from the falling man's waist. He also caught the two halves of the shattered gourd and several broken flying blades before they reached the ground.

He flicked the remaining water from his sword.

The mist that had spread throughout the area gradually began to thin.

...

As Lee Hyun walked out from between the trees, Mei Sujun turned her head.

"Junior Brother Li, are you all right?"

"Yes. You weren't hurt either, were you, Senior Sister?"

"I'm fine. Let's go to Eldest Senior Brother."

Lee Hyun put away the Profound Gate Sword and Profound Iron Buckler, then rose into the air and followed her.

The fighting inside the valley was also drawing to a close.

Once the outer formation collapsed, the enemies retreated to the low stone platform surrounding the realm gate. A narrow crack ran through the rough rock wall there, and formation flags erected around it anchored the light within the fissure.

When several cultivators jumped through the realm gate first, those holding the rear could no longer maintain their positions.

Cultivators from the Danxiao Sect and Biluo Sect surged in from both sides.

Swoosh!

A cultivator fleeing toward the realm gate was struck in the thigh by a flying sword and fell. Another looked back at him, but before he could even reach out, another sword light came flying.

The last remaining enemies detonated all their talismans at once.

Rumble-BOOM!

Amid the light engulfing the space in front of the stone platform, several streaks of spirit light disappeared beyond the realm gate.

"Do not cross!"

The cultivator commanding the attacking force shouted.

"Stop! We don't know what's on the other side!"

The pursuing cultivators halted in midair.

A cultivator who had let the last enemy escape gritted his teeth and recalled his flying sword.

While the guarding cultivators aimed their magic tools at the realm gate, the formation masters stepped forward. They planted formation flags in front of the realm gate and deployed a formation to seal the passage.

Hummm–

A barrier covered the crack in the rock wall. The surging light within the fissure narrowed, and the faint scenery visible beyond the realm gate vanished.

Long sighs of relief escaped the cultivators standing guard nearby.

"We sealed it."

Someone muttered.

Tao Wenqian looked over Yue Wugou, Mei Sujun, and Lee Hyun in turn. Including Su Buyi and the Biluo Sect cultivator who had moved with him, all six were present. Only then did the flames lingering in his hand die away.

...

Even after sealing the realm gate, several groups scattered through the forest and rocky cliffs to search the area. There could still be enemies remaining inside the secret realm.

Under the protection of the reinforcements, the formation masters began setting up a defensive formation that would encompass the entire encampment. The Danxiao Sect intended to build a stone wall here as well and station defenders so that even if the passage were reopened from the outside, the enemy would not be able to immediately force their way through.

Lee Hyun sat on a boulder along the slope.

Yue Wugou approached while applying medicine.

"You really are fine, Junior Brother."

"Were you hurt, Senior Brother?"

"I got a small cut on the back of my hand. Hardly worth calling an injury, yet here I am putting medicine on it...."

Yue Wugou chuckled and closed the medicine bottle.

...

Three days later.

In front of the realm gate of the Huatian Secret Realm that connected to the Danxiao Sect.

Tao Wenqian checked the group one final time before holding out his identity token.

"Four from Yanxia Peak. We are returning."

The cultivator guarding the realm gate marked the register.

"Confirmed. You may pass."

Lee Hyun glanced back at the stone wall behind him.

They were not returning as a group of roughly one hundred and fifty, as they had when setting out.

Some had already left. Some remained behind to stand guard. And some would never return.

"Let's go."

Tao Wenqian entered the realm gate first.

Lee Hyun followed.

Shhhhh–

A strange sensation swept over his body as he passed through the realm gate.

The next moment, a cool breeze touched his face.

He stood in a gorge of the Danxiao Range.

Beyond the stone platform guarded by Golden Core Elders, he could see the blue sky and familiar mountain peaks.

Five days after their return.

The Lecture Hall on Yanxia Peak.

When Tan Yunsheng entered, around twenty disciples rose to their feet in unison.

"Greetings, Master."

"Sit."

Tan Yunsheng looked over the four who had returned from the secret realm one by one.

"I heard what happened in the secret realm. You've all done well."

His gaze stopped on Lee Hyun.

"Among you, our youngest, Dongsan, distinguished himself unexpectedly."

Chapter 58

The disciples seated in the Lecture Hall all turned their attention to Lee Hyun.

Lee Hyun cupped his hands.

“It was thanks to the guidance of my Senior Brothers and Senior Sisters.”

Tan Yunsheng spoke again.

“I heard you contributed to capturing a prisoner at Chishui Garden, and that the formation you set up in advance also bought time for the retreat?”

“Yes.”

“Well done.”

Yue Wugou chimed in from beside him.

“If not for that formation, Junior Sister Mei and I might have been hit by those bone nails.”

Mei Sujun also spoke.

“That’s right.”

Tan Yunsheng nodded.

“All of you should learn from your youngest junior brother’s preparedness. In any case, the four of you who went to the Huatian Secret Realm this time will be excused from your regular alchemy duties for the next month. Get some rest, and if you were injured anywhere, make sure you treat it properly.”

“Thank you, Master.”

The four of them bowed together.

“Since all four of you have just returned from the secret realm, I’ll begin today’s lecture with spirit plants that require lesser yang qi. Sujun, among the things harvested at Chishui Garden...”

The Lecture Hall once again filled with discussion of medicinal ingredients and fire control.

...

After the lecture ended.

As Yue Wugou descended Yanxia Peak, he stretched both arms overhead.

“Let’s take it easy for the whole month.”

Tao Wenqian said,

“The External Affairs Court is settling our contribution points. They say we can collect them starting today, so stop by when you have time.”

Tao Wenqian was the first to rise into the air, while Yue Wugou and Mei Sujun also flew toward their respective cave abodes.

...

The Mission Hall of the External Affairs Court.

Several cultivators who had returned from the secret realm had gathered inside the hall.

When Lee Hyun presented his identity token, the steward in charge placed it on a formation plate.

Hummm―

“Fellow Daoist Li Dongsan of Yanxia Peak...”

The steward opened a ledger.

“The basic contribution points for your deployment and extended rotation come to eighty. Fifty points for your contribution to securing a prisoner, and thirty points as your allotted share of the joint merit for preserving the harvest and supporting the retreat.”

His finger moved down to the next line.

“Forty points for confirmed battle merits from the final fight. Two hundred points in total.”

Lee Hyun examined the ledger.

It included a record of the Haigu Island cultivator he had first captured alive, Tao Wenqian’s report, and the details of the harvested materials they had handed over. Naturally, there was no mention of Guo Zhenming or the other two cultivators Lee Hyun had killed alone in the valley.

“I’ve confirmed it.”

The steward placed a hand on the formation plate.

The flame pattern on the identity token brightened, and Lee Hyun’s available contribution points increased to 712.

‘That’s built up nicely.’

As Lee Hyun was about to put away his identity token, the steward pointed outside the hall.

“If you have anything from the secret realm you want to dispose of, try the Artifact Court. They’re accepting spoils separately this time.”

“Don’t they normally buy magic tools anyway?”

“This time, they also want to investigate items from the cultivation world on the other side. Apparently, they’ll pay even for things with unfamiliar restrictions or spirit materials. Of course, if it’s a useful magic tool, they’ll still offer the usual fair price even if there’s nothing exotic about it.”

“I see. Do they also identify unknown pills obtained as spoils?”

“The Pill Inspection Office of the Inner Alchemy Court handles those.”

“Thank you.”

Lee Hyun left the hall.

...

Inside the Artifact Court.

Lee Hyun placed two blood-colored flying hooks, a flying sword, a round shield, a gourd split in half, fragments of flying blades, a suspicious jade token and talisman, and several pieces of metal on the table.

The middle-aged cultivator behind the table sorted the items by type.

“These four are in good condition.”

He placed the two flying hooks side by side and infused them with spiritual power.

Hummm―

The restrictions engraved along the inner edges of the hooks resonated with each other, glowing faintly blood-red.

“A set of high-grade magic tools. You don’t intend to use them yourself?”

“I already have magic tools I’m accustomed to using.”

The cultivator did not press him further and inspected the flying sword and shield in turn.

“I’ll purchase all four for eighty-two mid-grade spirit stones.”

It was close to what Lee Hyun had expected.

“That will do.”

The cultivator then examined the gourd split in half and the fragments of the shattered flying blades. After running a fingertip along the cut surfaces, he shook his head.

“This... would be better remade from scratch. All the connections between the internal restrictions have been severed. Still, the refining method differs from that of our sect, so I can offer a few spirit stones for them.”

The cultivator pushed the gourd and flying-blade fragments to one side.

Finally, Lee Hyun took out a jade casket.

“There’s also this.”

After examining the jade casket, the cultivator placed a small formation plate on the table.

A faint curtain of light rose on all sides.

Click.

When the jade casket opened, a black banner with a Spirit-Sealing Talisman attached to it appeared.

It was the White Bone Banner.

A faint black aura seeped from the banner’s edges, and the sound of someone softly sobbing seemed to brush past their ears.

The cultivator immediately closed the jade casket.

“An item that gathers resentful spirits.”

“That’s right.”

“We normally wouldn’t handle something like this, but we’re making an exception at the moment. The appraisal will take some time, though... Will you leave this with us as well?”

“Yes. I have no use for it.”

The cultivator attached a separate wooden tag to the jade casket.

“We’ll tell you the price once the investigation is complete. Though it may be worth less than you expect.”

“That’s fine.”

...

After leaving behind the spoils that were awkward to keep, Lee Hyun also took out the Protective Bell he used.

A thin crack remained on the surface of the blue-green bell.

The middle-aged cultivator lifted it and inspected both the inside and outside.

“It took a powerful hit.”

“Can it be repaired?”

“Three mid-grade spirit stones. Come back in ten days.”

After paying the fee, Lee Hyun also took out his Black Scale Inner Armor for inspection.

Fortunately, the marks on the scales were shallow, and there was nothing wrong with the internal restrictions. He was told that all he needed to do was nurture the damaged section with spiritual power and realign the overlapping scales.

Lee Hyun decided to repair it himself using Essentials of Magic-Tool Nurturing and Refining, the basic artifact-refining art inheritance he had obtained before.

...

After that, he stopped by the Pill Inspection Office of the Inner Alchemy Court.

Lee Hyun presented two bottles of Spirit-Nourishing Pills along with several medicine bottles whose contents he could not identify.

The alchemist in charge first inspected the seals on each bottle. Then he split off small portions of the pills and examined their internal color, medicinal fragrance, and the way spiritual power flowed through them.

“They do appear to be Spirit-Nourishing Pills, but I can’t be certain with my level of skill, so I’ll ask an Elder. Come back in a few days.”

“I only need you to confirm whether they’re safe to consume.”

“Understood. I’ll also check whether they have any undesirable effects.”

Lee Hyun accepted a receipt token and left.

Deep inside his storage pouch, he still had the Profound Yin White Bone True Scripture, books containing Guo Zhenming’s cultivation annotations, the Six-Armed Bone Puppet, bone material for research, medicinal liquids, and other items, but he had no intention of turning them over to the sect.

Even if someone questioned the origins of the other items he had submitted today, he had room to make excuses. Plenty of cultivators had taken the storage pouches of enemies who fell in the secret realm, and it would not be strange to claim that he had acquired magic tools used by Haigu Island cultivators and even the White Bone Banner amid the chaos of battle.

But if he turned over the Profound Yin White Bone True Scripture, Haigu Island’s sect-defining cultivation art, he might first have to explain how he had dealt with a Foundation Establishment Great Perfection heaven’s prodigy all by himself.

Just thinking about it gave him a headache.

...

Three days later.

Qingyu Ravine.

Lee Hyun began pouring spirit stones onto a stone table.

Clatter.

After counting them, he found that he possessed a staggering 370 mid-grade spirit stones!

It was the total of the spirit stones he had owned before departing, what he had earned by selling items, and the spirit stones he had acquired in the secret realm.

That was what remained even after deducting the spirit stones consumed by the Nine-Bend Dust and Sand Formation, along with the costs of various appraisals, pill inspections, and repairing his Protective Bell.

“I made quite a lot.”

He put the spirit stones back into their pouches.

...

Lee Hyun took out the Spirit-Nourishing Pills that had finished undergoing pill inspection.

Fortunately, they had been deemed safe to consume.

Their medicinal potency was focused on nourishing divine sense, and no components had been found that would harm spiritual power refined through other cultivation arts or leave behind any separate restrictions.

Aside from the one pill used during the inspection, the remainder had been divided between the two bottles.

Lee Hyun first took out a single pill.

It was a small pill with a gray surface. When he brought it near his nose, he caught a medicinal fragrance.

Gulp.

After swallowing the pill, Lee Hyun lay comfortably on the floor of the cultivation chamber and circulated the Primordial One-Qi Art.

A short while later, the gentle medicinal strength rising along his meridians slowly spread toward the back of his neck and head.

Lee Hyun did not rush, calmly observing its flow.

...

Two shichen (about four hours) passed.

Lee Hyun opened his eyes.

When he spread out his divine sense, several subtle currents of spiritual power that had previously seemed to overlap were now slightly easier to distinguish.

Lee Hyun extended a hand, and six bronze flying swords emerged from his storage pouch and floated into the air.

Ssssh―

The flying swords slowly circled the cultivation chamber. After some time, he recalled them.

“It definitely works. Controlling my divine sense feels easier than before.”

The actual increase in his divine sense was not very large. Fortunately, even after he had fully digested the medicinal strength, he felt no particular discomfort.

Lee Hyun stored the remaining Spirit-Nourishing Pills separately. Just in case, he intended to space out the doses considerably and take them one at a time.

...

The next day.

The Inner Pavilion of the Scripture Pavilion.

Lee Hyun examined the shelves containing inheritances related to puppets.

There were not many of them. The Danxiao Sect was a sect that primarily specialized in alchemy.

Every one of the Hundred Cultivation Crafts was deep and profound, so even sects large enough to have Nascent Soul cultivators generally excelled in only certain fields.

Still, generations of disciples and Elders had accumulated materials over many years, so basic information on Puppet Art could also be found there.

There were methods for making wooden puppets, designs for puppets that hauled loads in mines, and instructions for constructing small puppets that moved underwater.

Lee Hyun spent eighty contribution points to study Introductory Guide to Soul Stone Inscription.

It was an inheritance covering how to process soul stones and inscribe commands into them, as well as how to connect them to the restrictions in a puppet’s body.

Whether the puppet he intended to make was constructed from wood, metal, or bone, the contents would still be useful.

...

After leaving the inheritance chamber, he mainly searched for materials concerning earth fire and cave-abode construction.

Essentials of Channeling Earth Fire

Record of Underground Cave Abode Construction

They required forty and thirty contribution points respectively.

The former covered methods of drawing earth fire up directly, or separately utilizing its heat and fire qi. The latter explained what kinds of terrain to avoid when constructing an underground cave abode and how to reinforce caverns.

Lee Hyun spent especially long reading the second inheritance. It contained explanations for things he had avoided until now out of a vague sense of unease.

‘I should’ve read something like this ages ago. If I follow what it says, expanding the caverns and enlarging the spirit fields shouldn’t be difficult at all.’

After studying the three inheritances, he had 562 contribution points remaining.

...

Danxiao Immortal City.

Lee Hyun returned to the Spirit Materials Hall where Jade-Condensing Grass seeds were sold.

“I’d like to buy Jade-Condensing Grass seeds.”

“How many would you like?”

“Two hundred and seventy.”

The Qi Refining clerk’s hand froze as he was opening a wooden box.

“Are you serious?”

“I am.”

When Lee Hyun first planted Jade-Condensing Grass, he had not even known whether he would ever be able to cultivate Fire-Heart Orchids. He had bought thirty seeds simply because he thought they would eventually prove useful if he planted them in advance.

But now that he had obtained Lesser Yang Stones, the situation was different. If he could personally cultivate Spirit-Storing Ginseng, Jade-Condensing Grass, and now Fire-Heart Orchids as well, he would be growing all three main ingredients in the Danxiao Sect’s Foundation Establishment Pill recipe.

That brought Lee Hyun face-to-face with a practical problem.

‘With my current skill, how many plants of each main ingredient would I need to refine fifty Foundation Establishment Pills?’

Tan Yunsheng could produce five Foundation Establishment Pills from a single set of main ingredients.

But there was no guarantee Lee Hyun could do the same. At first, he might succeed only once in five refinement attempts, and even when he succeeded, he might only produce one or two usable pills.

‘I can just plant plenty. Anything left over can be sold for spirit stones anyway.’

Buying more seeds now did not cost many spirit stones. But if he only realized several hundred years later that he lacked enough ingredients, it would no longer be a problem that a few spirit stones could solve.

The clerk brought out several wooden boxes.

Lee Hyun checked the life force of the seeds one by one before paying eight mid-grade spirit stones and ten low-grade spirit stones.

...

He still had many more places to visit after that.

Formation devices for channeling earth fire, piping that could withstand fire qi, heat-insulating stone slabs, spirit trees for reinforcing narrow passages, and materials needed to irrigate the spirit fields.

He spent twenty-six mid-grade spirit stones on materials and formation devices.

Two soul stones for puppet research, inscription tools, and practice materials cost another ten mid-grade spirit stones.

...

Ten days later.

Tunnel No. 3.

Bzzzz―

A swarm of familiar golden balls of fluff rushed toward him amid the buzz of wings.

“There, there. Have you all been well?”

Squeak! Squeak squeak!

The fuzzbees clung to Lee Hyun’s shoulders, head, and the hem of his long robe.

The three Tier 2 fuzzbees and several dozen Tier 1 fuzzbees released from the spirit-insect pouch immediately flew into the swarm as well.

Lee Hyun first inspected the water reservoir and spirit fields, confirming that everything was safe and sound.

...

Spirit Field No. 3-2, where he had planted Jade-Condensing Grass.

Using Record of Underground Cave Abode Construction as a reference, Lee Hyun expanded the existing cavern enough to grow seventy additional plants without disturbing the thirty already planted there.

He planted seventy more Jade-Condensing Grass seeds in the newly expanded area.

Then, using neighboring caverns, he created two more spirit fields in the same manner and planted one hundred Jade-Condensing Grass seeds in each.

He also connected new bamboo irrigation pipes from the reservoir and laid down the necessary formation inscriptions.

Finally, he planted wooden plaques.

「Spirit Field No. 3-3」

「Spirit Field No. 3-4」

Lee Hyun recorded the sowing date and number of seeds in his ledger. He was now cultivating three hundred Jade-Condensing Grass plants across the three spirit fields.

...

Below Tunnel No. 3.

Roughly twenty-five li (about 9.8 km) underground.

Lee Hyun moved through cracks in the bedrock.

A short while later, a small cavern appeared.

A narrow fissure in the floor leaked a faint red glow.

‘This should work.’

Lee Hyun took out a Lesser Yang Stone from his storage pouch and supported it with spiritual power, positioning it near the fissure.

A hot wind brushed the bottom of the stone, while Fire-aspected spiritual qi seeped into it.

A moment later, the patterns on the ore’s surface glowed faintly, and a warm, pure energy began rising from it. It was the same lesser yang qi he had sensed in the spirit fields of the Huatian Secret Realm.

“Oh....”

...

Two days later.

Lee Hyun was inspecting the new spirit fields.

「Spirit Field No. 3-5」

「Spirit Field No. 3-6」

「Spirit Field No. 3-7」

Three hundred of the healthiest young Fire-Heart Orchids he had brought back from the secret realm had been divided among the three spirit fields.

Heat-insulating stone slabs had been erected between the fissure and the spirit fields, with the layout arranged so that only the lesser yang qi emanating from the Lesser Yang Stone would flow inside.

The floors had been made from a mixture of nearby soil and red earth brought back from the secret realm, allowing the lesser yang qi to permeate them evenly. Dedicated water reservoirs, irrigation pipes, and drainage channels had also been installed for the three spirit fields.

‘All three main ingredients for the Foundation Establishment Pill are finally in Tunnel No. 3!’

“Haha.”

Lee Hyun sat comfortably on the earthen floor.

Before him, the still-young Fire-Heart Orchids quietly swayed their leaves.

‘Now I just need to improve my alchemy and wait for them to grow.’

...

After returning to the sect and spending the remainder of his rest period, Lee Hyun resumed his regular alchemy duties. Whenever he rested at Qingyu Ravine, he practiced Puppet Art by working with bones, soul stones, and inscription tools.

Three months later.

Hummm―

At Lee Hyun’s fingertips, the clear and gentle Primordial True Qi gradually took on a gloomy quality.

“I did it!”

Lee Hyun had succeeded in producing Profound Yin White Bone True Qi!

Although the efficiency was not very good, making it impractical for combat, it was more than sufficient for researching Puppet Art.

...

One year later.

Qingyu Ravine.

The Six-Armed Bone Puppet stood on the floor.

Hummm―

A faint light appeared inside the puppet’s eye sockets.

When Lee Hyun sent out his mental intent, the puppet moved its six arms one after another.

“I finally got it moving.”

...

Ten days later, Tunnel No. 3.

While testing the puppet, Lee Hyun encountered a serious problem.

When he controlled it directly, it moved quite well. But having it work on its own through inscribed commands was another matter entirely.

For example, when he ordered it to clear the stones from a passage, the puppet moved every stone on the floor and still did not stop. In the end, it even started trying to pull out stones embedded in the walls.

‘This is way too complicated...’

In his past life, Lee Hyun had mainly used computers for gaming and had never designed a program before. Writing commands that allowed the puppet to act on its own according to the situation was truly difficult!

‘Is this why they call it a craft...?’

...

That night.

Lee Hyun lay on the floor of the cultivation chamber, staring at a sheet of paper on which he had drawn the puppet’s structure.

‘It’s useful enough when I control it directly... but it doesn’t suit the way I fight.’

If he had to control the puppet as well, it became difficult to focus on moving his own body and magic tools.

‘It’d be better if I could have it guard the tunnel while I cultivate.’

But to use it as a sentry, it needed to be able to assess situations without Lee Hyun giving it instructions for every little thing. That was exactly where Lee Hyun was stuck.

Just then, a small sound came from beside his pillow.

Squeak.

A Tier 2 fuzzbee rolled over and rubbed its back against Lee Hyun’s finger.

Suddenly bored, Lee Hyun used the Spirit-Nurturing Seal to command it to bring over the Six-Armed Bone Puppet.

‘There’s no way that’ll work, right?’

Bzz―

The fuzzbee immediately flew off, grabbed the Six-Armed Bone Puppet by the shoulder with its stubby body, and came flying back while carrying it.

“Huh!? You’re incredibly strong!”

The fellow set the Six-Armed Bone Puppet down beside him. Then, as if showing off, it pointed at the puppet with one foot and squeaked proudly.

Squeak squeak!

Lee Hyun looked back and forth between the fuzzbee and the paper.

“Wait... could I put this fellow inside the puppet and have it control it?”

Chapter 59

Lee Hyun placed a fuzzbee on his palm.

"You understand what I say pretty well, don't you?"

Squeak.

"If I told you to bring me that stone, you wouldn't go so far as to tear one out of the wall."

The fuzzbee rubbed its antennae with its short forelegs.

Lee Hyun opened the chest of the Six-Armed Bone Puppet beside him.

Between its thick ribs were grooves for inserting spirit stones and a bone socket securing the soul stone. Around them, countless fine restrictions leading to every part of the body had been densely engraved.

There was more than enough room for a single fuzzbee.

Lee Hyun pointed inside with a finger.

"Want to go in?"

Bzz–

The fellow flew in beside the bone socket, circled around inside a few times, then wedged itself between two ribs.

A tuft of golden fur poked out slightly between the white bones.

"Isn't it cramped?"

Squeak squeak.

The fuzzbee waved its antennae.

Lee Hyun looked back and forth between the soul stone and the fuzzbee.

First, he had to find a way to transmit the fuzzbee's mental intent to the soul stone.

...

Fifteen days later.

Qingyu Ravine in the Danxiao Range.

Lee Hyun released the fuzzbees he had brought from the tunnel into the cave abode.

There were three Tier 2 fuzzbees and several Tier 1 fuzzbees. In one corner of the storeroom, he had also prepared a jar containing spirit insects for them to eat and a box of soil where they could roll around and rest.

Lee Hyun spread out the papers summarizing 《Introductory Guide to Soul Stone Inscription》 alongside Guo Zhenming's cultivation annotations.

'Let's leave the part that moves the body as it is.'

He had considered modifying the skeleton to suit the fuzzbees' bodies, but that would require completely reworking every restriction engraved into the joints. At his current level, where he could barely repair an existing puppet, it was too much to handle.

'I can make one in whatever shape I want later. For now....'

Lee Hyun attached a small bone fragment beside the bone socket in the puppet's chest.

Simply entering the puppet would not allow a fuzzbee to control it automatically, so he intended to first guide the fuzzbee into transmitting its mental intent to the soul stone while clinging to the bone fragment.

...

Three months later.

Hummm–

A faint green light appeared in the Six-Armed Bone Puppet's eye sockets.

Inside its chest, a fuzzbee clung to the small bone fragment.

Lee Hyun withdrew the connection he had been using to control the puppet directly with his divine sense. Then, through the Spirit-Nurturing Seal, he sent his mental intent to the fuzzbee.

He was telling it to pick up the block of wood in front of it.

Crrrk.

The puppet moved one of its right arms.

Its fingers grasped at empty air in front of the block, then opened again. When it reached out a second time, the hand went too far and pushed the block aside.

Clatter.

The block rolled across the floor.

The bone puppet turned toward it.

Thud. Thud.

Its two legs moved one after the other.

The puppet stopped in front of the block and bent at the waist. This time, its fingers closed properly around the wood.

"Bring it here."

The bone puppet turned around.

It held the block in one hand, while its other five arms swung somewhat awkwardly beside its body.

Thud. Thud.

When the puppet stopped in front of Lee Hyun, the hand holding the block slowly rose.

"Oh...."

Lee Hyun took the block.

"Well done."

Squeak squeak!

Inside its chest, the fuzzbee fluttered its wings as though puffing itself up with pride.

This time, Lee Hyun pointed toward a stone bowl on the other side.

The puppet walked toward it.

He focused his divine sense and examined the flow of spiritual power inside the puppet. The restrictions that received commands from the soul stone drew power from the spirit stones and sent it into the joints and skeleton.

No matter how strong the fuzzbee was, he could not have it move the puppet through brute strength alone. That would amount to nothing more than wearing a heavy shell and throwing its bare body around inside it.

To draw out the puppet's true power, its joints had to be driven by the power of the spirit stones embedded within it.

After the puppet brought back the stone bowl, Lee Hyun stopped it and removed the spirit stone from its chest.

Hummm–

The light in its eye sockets went out.

The fuzzbee moved around several times inside, but the bone puppet remained standing where it was.

A moment later, the golden tuft of fur flew out of its chest.

Squeak?

"It's not broken."

Lee Hyun showed it the spirit stone.

"It needs this to move."

The fellow tapped the spirit stone with its foreleg.

Lee Hyun inserted the spirit stone again and sent the fuzzbee back inside. A moment later, the puppet moved its right arm once more.

"That does it."

This was already a sufficient result.

The fuzzbee decided where to go and what to pick up. The existing spell formula received its mental intent and handled the actual work of moving the legs and curling the fingers.

Still, the fuzzbee seemed to need time to adapt to the bone puppet's unfamiliar body structure. Even now, whenever it picked something up, it used only the arm that was easiest for it to move.

'I'll think about combat later. I can't accomplish everything overnight.'

Lee Hyun lightly patted the bone puppet's shoulder.

"You ought to have a name too. How about Bonefuzz?"

Squeak.

It showed no sign of objection.

Lee Hyun took out a small wooden plaque and wrote on it in Hangul (Korean).

「Bonefuzz No. 1」

He tied the wooden plaque inside the bone puppet's chest cover.

...

A few days later.

The cultivation chamber in Qingyu Ravine.

Lee Hyun held a small jade bottle upside down.

Tap. Tap.

Nothing fell into his palm. He had finished all the Spirit-Nourishing Pills.

Perhaps because he had taken them at sufficiently long intervals, there had been no particular side effects. At first, he had thought their effects were not especially impressive, but after fully refining them all, the difference was quite noticeable.

Even after the medicinal strength of the Spirit-Nourishing Pills had completely dispersed, sufficient rest restored his depleted divine sense to a slightly stronger state than before.

'To think pills can permanently expand the foundation of one's divine sense... The world of immortal cultivation truly is wondrous.'

Lee Hyun suddenly remembered the Poison-Warding Pill and reviewed the pill recipe he had examined some time ago.

It was a pill made by extracting the toxic qi from the Purple Poison Orchid, then adding several auxiliary medicinal ingredients to the refined Purple Venom Extract and Harmonizing their medicinal potency.

Back then, he had examined it merely because he wanted to know the uses of the spirit plants he was raising. Thinking about it now, it seemed worth taking himself.

The cultivators he had encountered in the Huatian Secret Realm had used a wide variety of methods. Some coated their magic tools with poison, while others released the yin poison of resentful spirits.

There was no guarantee he would always be able to block every form of toxic qi with the Qi Sphere Barrier or body-protecting spirit light.

'Should I make some?'

But once he actually looked over the alchemy process, it began to seem rather troublesome.

He would have to purchase the required auxiliary medicinal ingredients and adjust the fire control and proportions to suit the medicinal potency of the Purple Poison Orchids he possessed.

Most importantly, there was no reason to use his long-aged Purple Poison Orchids right now.

'The oldest Purple Poison Orchids I have are 466 years in medicine age... It would be such a waste to use them just to refine a Tier 2 pill. I have plenty of spirit stones anyway... Couldn't I just buy Poison-Warding Pills?'

Being an alchemist did not mean he had to personally make every pill he consumed.

Lee Hyun did not always need fifty times as many pills as everyone else. Poison-Warding Pills had little to do with whether one's dantian was confined to the lower dantian or spread throughout the entire body, so he only needed to take as many as anyone else.

...

Danxiao Immortal City.

Lee Hyun entered a hall that dealt in pills.

Jade bottles and medicine cases lined the shelves along the walls. A small wooden plaque bearing the pill's name and grade hung in front of each compartment.

As he approached the counter, an early Foundation Establishment cultivator rose from his seat.

"What are you looking for?"

"I'd like to see Tier 2 Spirit-Nourishing Pills and Poison-Warding Pills."

"We have Poison-Warding Pills. As for Spirit-Nourishing Pills... wait a moment."

The cultivator searched the shelves in the back, then brought over two jade bottles and placed one pill from each onto a small jade tray.

The Spirit-Nourishing Pill was slightly paler than the ones Lee Hyun had taken before, perhaps because it had been refined using a different method. The Poison-Warding Pill was deep purple with a thin band of white markings around it.

Lee Hyun examined their medicinal fragrance and the flow of spiritual power within them.

The aura of the Spirit-Nourishing Pill was familiar. The Poison-Warding Pill also matched what he remembered from the pill recipe.

Lee Hyun asked to make sure.

"Is this Poison-Warding Pill taken before entering poisonous mist, or is it taken regularly to build resistance to poison?"

"It is taken regularly to increase one's resistance to poison. However, you must not take too many at once. Fully refine the medicinal strength and leave enough time before taking the next one. I'll include the consumption instructions in the bottle as well. Of course, taking a few does not mean you'll become immune to every poison."

The cultivator returned the Poison-Warding Pill to its jade bottle.

"If you keep taking the same pill, there may come a point when it no longer produces much change. Once that happens, there's no need to insist on taking the same amount."

"Is it similar with Spirit-Nourishing Pills?"

"It depends on how well fellow Daoist refines them, but once you develop a tolerance to their medicinal potency, it becomes difficult to see the same improvement as at first. Even so, they're still highly valued by those who constantly push their divine sense to the limit."

Lee Hyun nodded.

"Three of each, please."

"The Spirit-Nourishing Pills are nine mid-grade spirit stones, and the Poison-Warding Pills are three."

...

Next, Lee Hyun visited the Inner Pavilion of the Scripture Pavilion.

Since he had already taken the Spirit-Nourishing Pills, this time he intended to look for an inheritance on training and controlling divine sense.

The strength of divine sense ultimately depended on how thoroughly one had tempered the primordial spirit, so what Lee Hyun sought was effectively a primordial-spirit cultivation art.

Lee Hyun's gaze stopped on one jade slip in the list of inheritances.

《Spirit-Refining Essentials》.

It was an inheritance dealing with methods for stabilizing divine sense, dividing it for simultaneous use, and gathering it again after depletion.

From the description, it contained no methods for directly attacking another's primordial spirit. Instead, with long practice, it would reduce interference when divine sense was split into several streams and make it easier to maintain intense concentration on a single point.

Its contents were useful for alchemists, puppet masters, and cultivators who used multiple magic tools at once.

Lee Hyun handed his identity token to the disciple in charge and paid 120 contribution points, then examined the inheritance inside the inheritance chamber.

...

A few days later, Qingyu Ravine.

"Training the primordial spirit really isn't easy."

With an aching pressure between his brows, Lee Hyun put down the jade slip and steadied his breathing.

"I might as well clear my head by testing a Poison-Warding Pill."

Lee Hyun took out a Poison-Warding Pill and swallowed it. As the purple pill slid down his throat, a bitter taste lingered on the tip of his tongue.

Following the consumption instructions, he circulated the medicinal strength, then took out his ledger and briefly recorded the date he had taken it and the changes he felt.

He decided to take the Spirit-Nourishing Pill on another day, since mixing their medicinal strength might cause problems.

...

After that, several new things became part of Lee Hyun's daily routine.

Whenever he returned from completing the sect's regular alchemy duties, he cultivated the Primordial One-Qi Art. When his divine sense had enough room to spare, he practiced the Spirit-Refining Essentials, and at sufficiently long intervals he took either a Spirit-Nourishing Pill or a Poison-Warding Pill.

He also continued having the fuzzbees control Bonefuzz.

All three of them greatly enjoyed moving the puppet. The fellows gradually became more skilled at controlling Bonefuzz No. 1.

One day, Lee Hyun came out after finishing his cultivation and found a strange figure standing in the middle of the dim cave abode in Qingyu Ravine.

"You startled me... What is that?"

Looking more closely, he saw that Bonefuzz No. 1 was holding a small water bowl.

A sound came from inside its chest.

Squeak squeak.

Lee Hyun filled the bowl with the Spirit Rain Art.

Bonefuzz then set the bowl down on the floor and stopped. A moment later, the fuzzbee emerged from its chest and drank the water.

"You could've just asked. Why scare me with Bonefuzz?"

Squeak.

...

Once every six months, Lee Hyun also visited Tunnel No. 3.

After filling the water tanks, he inspected the water supply pipes and drainage channels, the soil in the spirit fields, and the condition of the Lesser Yang Stones.

Fortunately, both the Fire-Heart Orchids and Jade-Condensing Grass were growing well.

He went around the other spirit fields as well, recording their medicine ages.

He also brought Bonefuzz No. 1, which had completed its tests in Qingyu Ravine, back to the tunnel several times.

Whenever a Tier 2 fuzzbee controlled Bonefuzz No. 1, the Tier 1 fuzzbees would land on the puppet's head and shoulders.

Then, whenever the Tier 2 fuzzbee emerged from Bonefuzz No. 1, the other fuzzbees crowded around it. The fellow that had just come out strutted about with its antennae held stiffly upright, as though being hailed as a hero.

Sometimes, after controlling Bonefuzz No. 1, the Tier 2 fuzzbee would touch antennae with one of the Tier 1 fuzzbees surrounding it, then the two would quietly disappear together into some secluded crack in the tunnel!

Once, when Lee Hyun tried to follow them, the fuzzbee in front turned back.

Squeak squeak!

The fellow shoved Lee Hyun's finger away with its forelegs while beating its wings fiercely.

"You don't want me to follow?"

Squeak!

When Lee Hyun stopped, the fellow turned around and followed the other fuzzbee into the tunnel again.

Lee Hyun still had no idea how the fuzzbees reproduced.

The fellows did not gather nectar from flowers, nor did they seem to have a queen. In the first place, "fuzzbee" was merely a name Lee Hyun had given them based on their appearance.

...

In the sixth year since Bonefuzz No. 1's first test.

A small banquet was held at Yanxia Peak.

It was a celebration for Eldest Senior Brother Tao Wenqian, who had been allotted a Golden Core Condensing Pill.

He had already reached Foundation Establishment Great Perfection four years earlier. Since then, he had continued performing regular alchemy duties and outside missions to accumulate the remaining contributions he needed, and at last he had earned the opportunity to attempt Core Formation.

Each stone table was set with spirit fruit, spirit wine, spirit vegetables, spirit meat, and other delicacies, while Yue Wugou had brought a larger wine bottle than usual. Tan Yunsheng sat in the seat of honor, watching his disciples.

"Eldest Senior Brother, today of all days, you have to accept a drink."

Tao Wenqian smiled and held out his cup.

Across from him, Lee Hyun raised his teacup as well.

"Congratulations, Eldest Senior Brother."

"Thank you."

The Golden Core Condensing Pill.

It was a Tier 3 pill consumed by Foundation Establishment cultivators to form a golden core.

Lee Hyun still did not understand the profound principles behind Core Formation, but he did know that attempting it without the aid of a pill was a desperate gamble with only the slimmest chance of survival.

"How many Golden Core Condensing Pills did our sect refine this time?"

When Fang Jiyun asked, Tao Wenqian answered.

"Four. It's been twenty-seven years since the last batch was refined."

"Did it take that long to gather the ingredients?"

"I heard one of the main ingredients was nearly impossible to obtain. Several Elders of the Inner Alchemy Court took part in this refinement."

Fang Jiyun set down his wine cup.

"One of those precious pills went to our Eldest Senior Brother, so today we ought to celebrate to our hearts' content."

Lee Hyun nodded.

Tao Wenqian had said that receiving this pill had consumed most of the contributions he had accumulated over more than a century. Even after gathering enough contributions and being deemed qualified, one still had to wait if the pill storehouse had none in stock.

Tao Wenqian set down his cup.

"For the time being, I intend to reduce my alchemy duties and outside work."

He looked toward Tan Yunsheng. Once Tan Yunsheng nodded, Tao Wenqian continued.

"After I finish making a few preparations, I intend to enter secluded cultivation."

Mei Sujun asked,

"Are you planning to enter soon?"

"I should hand over the work I'm responsible for first."

Tao Wenqian looked at Fang Jiyun and Lee Hyun in turn.

"I'm thinking of asking Junior Brother Fang to take care of the communal Alchemy Hall. Junior Brother Li may find his workload increasing a little as well."

Yue Wugou said,

"We can divide the remaining work among ourselves. Eldest Senior Brother, you should focus solely on Core Formation."

Tao Wenqian smiled.

With his wood-fire dual spiritual root, he was considered quite talented even among Tan Yunsheng's disciples. The true essence he had accumulated over many years was abundant, and even after reaching Great Perfection, he had spent several more years stabilizing his realm.

Now that he had obtained a Golden Core Condensing Pill as well, it was only natural that his fellow disciples had high hopes for him.

...

Three months later.

Tao Wenqian entered secluded cultivation.

The assignment roster at the communal Alchemy Hall changed, and his duties were divided among several junior brothers.

Lee Hyun also received slightly more work inspecting and processing medicinal ingredients.

At first, whenever a question arose, he would instinctively look for Tao Wenqian. Then he would remember that his Eldest Senior Brother was in secluded cultivation and go to Fang Jiyun or another Senior Brother instead.

The seat where Tao Wenqian had always sat in the Lecture Hall remained empty.

...

One day in the year after he entered secluded cultivation.

Spiritual qi began gathering over a valley west of Yanxia Peak.

That was where Tao Wenqian's cave abode lay.

Lee Hyun noticed it while leaving the communal Alchemy Hall and looked in that direction.

The thin mist drifting along the mountainside was slowly changing direction. Even the spiritual qi scattered in the distance was being drawn toward the same place.

"He's begun."

Fang Jiyun murmured beside him.

...

The following day, near sunset.

The energy gathered above the cave abode suddenly shook violently.

The inward flow reversed in an instant and scattered in every direction.

The formation surrounding the mountainside flared brightly.

A moment later, even that light faded away.

By the time Lee Hyun arrived at Yanxia Peak, the other fellow disciples were gathering one by one.

Not long afterward, Tan Yunsheng returned.

Fang Jiyun approached with a pale face.

"Master. Eldest Senior Brother...."

Tan Yunsheng wore a bitter expression.

"Wenqian is gone. His true essence reversed, tearing through his dantian and meridians, and the shock reached his sea of consciousness. He couldn't stop his primordial spirit from dispersing."

...

Even after they saw Tao Wenqian off, time did not stop on Yanxia Peak.

Fang Jiyun distributed medicinal ingredients, and the disciples entered their respective alchemy chambers.

The lectures, which had been suspended for several days, resumed as well.

Tan Yunsheng sat in his usual place and examined the pills his disciples had made.

...

The years continued to pass.

A new disciple joined Yanxia Peak.

His surname was Liu, and his given name was Zhengyuan. He was a cultivator who had performed alchemy in the Outer Alchemy Court before successfully reaching Foundation Establishment, and he looked to be around forty.

On his first day, it was Lee Hyun who took him to the communal Alchemy Hall.

"For the time being, process the medicinal ingredients beside me."

"Yes, Senior Brother Li."

...

As the years passed and the effects of the Spirit-Nourishing Pills gradually weakened compared with the beginning, Lee Hyun increased the intervals between doses.

He continued practicing the Spirit-Refining Essentials and making sure to rest sufficiently. The rate at which the strength of his divine sense increased had slowed, but his skill in controlling it was still gradually improving.

Regularly taking Poison-Warding Pills had also borne fruit. When processing toxic medicinal ingredients, his qi and blood now rarely became disturbed even without using the Detoxification Art.

It had been twelve years since the fuzzbees first succeeded in controlling the Six-Armed Bone Puppet.

The cultivation chamber in Qingyu Ravine.

Hummmmm–

Spiritual qi gathered by the Qi-Gathering Formation seeped into Lee Hyun's body as he lay there.

Then, at a certain moment.

Thump.

The hem of Lee Hyun's long robe lifted slightly.

At the same time, the surrounding spiritual qi surged into him all at once.

"I did it!"

He had reached Foundation Establishment Stage 3.

Lee Hyun examined his body inwardly for a moment.

The rest of his body was still at the beginning of Qi Refining Stage 9.

Lee Hyun sat up, took out a wooden board, and changed the writing on its surface.

【Age: 1,464 years】

【Realm: Foundation Establishment Stage 3 (lower dantian)】

【Spiritual Power: 1,396 → 1,420】

Lee Hyun returned the wooden board to his storage pouch and took a spirit fruit from his fruit pouch.

It was a perfectly ripe Stone Honey Peach.

When he bit into it, cool, sweet juice spread through his mouth.

Lee Hyun ate the fruit and lay back down on the floor.

...

Five days later.

When Lee Hyun arrived at the communal Alchemy Hall, Liu Zhengyuan rose from his seat.

"Senior Brother Li."

"You're here."

Even after finishing his greeting, Liu Zhengyuan continued looking at Lee Hyun for a moment.

"Could it be that your realm...."

"I've reached Stage 3."

"Congratulations!"

Fang Jiyun, who had been examining medicinal ingredients inside, looked up as well.

His divine sense lightly swept over Lee Hyun's aura.

"So you really did. When did you break through?"

"Five days ago."

"Have you stabilized your realm properly?"

"Yes."

Fang Jiyun nodded.

"Congratulations. Leave today's work to Junior Brother Liu and come with me for a while."

Lee Hyun blinked.

"Where are we going?"

"Master is asking for you. It has nothing to do with your breakthrough. He was planning to summon you today anyway."

Lee Hyun briefly explained to Liu Zhengyuan the order in which today's medicinal ingredients should be processed, then followed Fang Jiyun out.

...

Yanxia Peak.

Tan Yunsheng was sitting at a stone table beneath a pine tree.

Two jade slips and several letters were spread across the table. Beside them sat a small wooden box containing dried roots and fragments of leaves.

Fang Jiyun cupped his hands.

"Master. I've brought Junior Brother Li."

Tan Yunsheng's gaze rested on Lee Hyun for a moment.

"Dongsan, you've reached Stage 3. Congratulations."

"Thank you, Master."

Tan Yunsheng gestured toward the opposite side.

"Sit."

Once the two had taken their seats, Tan Yunsheng picked up one of the letters spread before him.

"A letter arrived requesting that the Inner Alchemy Court appraise and purchase a collection of goods."

He slid the letter toward Fang Jiyun.

"It seems a sect is trying to clear out an old medicinal storehouse along with some of its inheritances. Judging from the list, some items can be put to use immediately, but quite a few have names and descriptions that do not match."

Fang Jiyun unfolded the letter.

Tan Yunsheng looked toward Lee Hyun.

"I intend to send Jiyun to inspect the goods in person. You will accompany him and assist with sorting and inspection."

"What kind of goods are they?"

"Most are spirit plants and medicinal ingredients that have been stored for a long time. They say some of the mother plants are still alive. They also intend to dispose of fragments of pill recipes and detoxification methods."

Tan Yunsheng opened the wooden box.

Inside were two dried leaves and a piece of root.

"These are samples they sent in advance. They weren't stored very well, but some medicinal potency remains. They also claim that some of the actual goods include Tier 3 spirit plants, so that part will need to be verified."

Lee Hyun examined the contents of the box.

The leaves were so old that their original color was difficult to discern.

He extended a little divine sense toward them, then looked at Tan Yunsheng.

"If they're Tier 3 spirit plants, I don't think we're skilled enough to appraise them properly."

"Do not handle such things carelessly. Record their condition and seals instead. If they can be transported, bring them back intact. I will perform the final appraisal."

"Understood."

"There are three things you need to examine. Whether the ledgers match the actual goods, how much medicinal potency remains, and whether there is a way to transport the living spirit plants safely to our sect. Do not simply take the other cultivators' written claims at face value when deciding their worth."

While reading the letter, Fang Jiyun asked,

"Are we intending to purchase the inheritances as well?"

"If there is anything useful."

Tan Yunsheng picked up another sheet of paper.

"However, they have placed rather high prices even on inheritances they no longer use. They claim those prices are based on records from previous generations, but we'll have to see the actual contents before we know their worth."

Lee Hyun listened quietly.

Having to travel outside was somewhat troublesome, but the opportunity to personally see new spirit plants and inheritances was not unwelcome.

"Which sect is it?"

"Qinghe Valley in the Great Yan Kingdom."

'Huh?'

It had been a long time since Lee Hyun had even heard the name Qinghe Valley.

Tan Yunsheng continued.

"It was once a fairly renowned sect in the northwest, but the quality of its spirit vein began declining several hundred years ago. I hear it has been a long time since they last produced a Golden Core cultivator."

Fang Jiyun looked down at the letter.

"Is that why they're selling their medicinal ingredients and inheritances?"

"That does not seem to be the only reason. It appears they have also suffered losses in trade recently."

Tan Yunsheng picked up another letter.

"Reports say demon beasts have been appearing more frequently along the coast southwest of Qinghe Valley over the past several years. Merchant groups that traded with Qinghe Valley have also lost ships, and some routes have reduced the number of sailings."

Fang Jiyun asked,

"Has anyone discovered why the demon beasts suddenly increased?"

"Not yet. There are claims that creatures normally seen only far out at sea have begun appearing near the coast, but there aren't enough reports to draw any firm conclusions."

Tan Yunsheng pushed the letter aside.

"Learn the details of Qinghe Valley's circumstances once you arrive. The terms of the transaction will differ depending on whether they urgently need spirit stones right now or whether they can no longer maintain their medicinal storehouse and are clearing it out."

"Understood."

Tan Yunsheng handed Lee Hyun one of the jade slips on the table.

"This is the list they sent us. Read through it before you leave. If there are any names you don't understand, ask me."

Lee Hyun accepted the jade slip.

"When are we leaving?"

"I'm thinking in about fifteen days. Until then, finish arranging your current duties and make your preparations."

"Yes, Master."

Chapter 60

Fifteen days later.

A massive flying boat was soaring beneath the clouds.

There were twelve cultivators aboard in all. Along with Lee Hyun and Fang Jiyun, they were Foundation Establishment cultivators selected from several peaks of the Inner Alchemy Court. Some were skilled at appraising and transplanting spirit plants, while others had mainly been responsible for examining old pill recipes and medicinal ingredients.

The Elders had divided up the list sent by Qinghe Valley and assigned their respective disciples to inspect the items.

The leader of the group was Xu Zhenyue, a late Foundation Establishment cultivator with extensive experience in external dealings and escort missions.

Lee Hyun sat to one side of the deck and read the jade slip again.

「Tier 2 Poison-Warding Pill recipe and detoxification notes.

Tier 2 Spirit-Calming Pill recipe.

Fragment concerning the harvesting and drying of yin-aspected spirit plants...」

Spirit-Calming Pill.

The name had caught his attention ever since he first read the list before their departure.

Long ago, Senior Brother Lu had told him that Yin Soul Grass was the main ingredient in the Spirit-Calming Pill. It was used to calm the mind and treat heart demons and qi deviation, and it could also temper the primordial spirit and divine sense.

Yet he had been unable to find the pill recipe in the Danxiao Sect's Pill Recipe Pavilion.

‘So Qinghe Valley still had the pill recipe.’

Lee Hyun recalled the report Gray Mountain Goat had submitted to the Two Heavens Society more than seventy years ago.

- Purple Poison Orchid is indeed one of the main ingredients in the Poison-Warding Pill. Of the nearby places that practice alchemy for Poison-Warding Pills, Qinghe Valley in the Great Yan Kingdom is the closest.
