Lee Hyun considered it no great difficulty to deal with a Foundation Establishment Great Perfection cultivator, yet he had never once thought he could contend with a Golden Core cultivator.

Long ago, he had witnessed a battle between Golden Core cultivators at the Changchun Sect's External Affairs Market. The methods they employed had been on an entirely different level.

So he could not even begin to imagine how powerful a Nascent Soul cultivator, someone beyond even them, might be.

And an existence like that had returned injured.

What would happen if Tier-4 cultivation nations went to war?

If Lee Hyun took part in the war and Nascent Soul cultivators happened to fight nearby, even being caught at the edge of the aftermath could put his life in danger.

‘Maybe running away really would be best? It is about time I left the Danxiao Sect....’

Around the time he had first been dispatched to Haimen Port, he had decided to remain in the Danxiao Sect for no more than another fifty years.

That time was almost up, but that did not mean he could simply leave without a care.

Lee Hyun considered himself fortunate when it came to choosing good sects. Both the Changchun Sect and the Danxiao Sect had been full of good people.

He had grown attached to them in his own way, so simply turning his back on them and leaving did not sit quite right with him.

As long as it did not put him in danger, he thought he would actually feel more at ease helping the Danxiao Sect a little.

‘For now, let's see how things develop. There's no guarantee a war will actually break out.’

...

A few days later, in the morning.

Dooong―

A low bell tolled in the distance.

The first toll spread between the mountain peaks and lingered for a long time. A moment later, a second toll followed.

‘That's the summons....’

...

The plaza in front of the Danxiao Grand Hall was packed with people.

Foundation Establishment cultivators stood in groups according to their respective peaks. As newly arriving disciples continued filling the gaps, the number gathered soon approached a thousand.

As Lee Hyun headed toward the Yanxia Peak disciples, Liu Zhengyuan spotted him first.

“Senior Brother Li! Over here.”

Lee Hyun joined the Yanxia Peak disciples and looked toward the Danxiao Grand Hall.

Golden Core Elders stood on the stone platform in front of the hall.

Tan Yunsheng was among them.

Instead of the plain long robe he normally wore during lectures, he was dressed in an enchanted robe embroidered with cloud patterns, and a small gourd Lee Hyun had never seen before hung at his waist.

Around twenty Golden Core Elders had appeared. It was Lee Hyun's first time seeing the Elders of the various peaks and Courts gathered in one place. Many of them were faces he had never even seen before.

Low conversations among the inner disciples continued without pause across the plaza.

“I heard one of the strongholds in Cang Kingdom fell.”

“Didn't they say a Nascent Soul Elder was injured?”

“There's no way the Wangu Sect would collapse that easily....”

Not long afterward, the doors of the Danxiao Grand Hall opened, and the Elders on the stone platform all turned at once.

A white-haired cultivator wearing a purple-gold enchanted robe with broad sleeves walked out from inside the hall.

The noisy plaza fell silent the moment he appeared.

Lee Hyun unconsciously slowed his breathing as well.

The man made no display of power whatsoever, yet knowing that he was a Nascent Soul Elder made Lee Hyun afraid even to meet his eyes.

The disciples all lowered their gazes.

Tan Yunsheng and the other Elders cupped their hands.

“We greet the Supreme Elder.”

The disciples gathered in the plaza also saluted in unison.

The white-haired cultivator stepped to the front of the stone platform.

“Raise your heads.”

His voice was not loud, yet it carried clearly all the way to the far end of the plaza.

“Not long ago, an envoy arrived from the Wangu Sect of Cang Kingdom. Many rumors have been circulating because of it, so I will begin by telling you the facts that have been confirmed.”

A Golden Core Elder standing to one side of the stone platform swept out his sleeve, and an enormous map rose into the air.

A long coastline stretching from north to south, mountain ranges, and numerous islands appeared in light. Red dots marked the southern portion of the map, and among them, one narrow waterway shone brightly.

“This is Qingshui Strait in southern Cang Kingdom.”

The Supreme Elder pointed toward it.

“Not content with occupying Lan Kingdom long ago, the cultivators of the Nanming Twelve-Sect Alliance crossed the sea and advanced north, seizing this strait. Of the six major strongholds the Wangu Sect established in the southern waters, the supply routes to four have already been cut.”

As four points on the map turned red, sharp intakes of breath sounded throughout the plaza.

The Supreme Elder continued.

“One of the Wangu Sect's Nascent Soul Elders went to relieve an isolated stronghold and engaged a mid-stage Nascent Soul cultivator known as the Blood Sea Patriarch. The enemy had prepared a blood-path formation near the strait. The Wangu Sect Elder's life-bound spirit insect suffered severe damage there, and his own nascent soul was injured as well. He returned alive, but I am told he will be unable to return to the battlefield for some time.”

The disciples pressed their lips tightly together.

The white-haired cultivator watched their reactions for a moment before continuing.

“The Nanming Twelve-Sect Alliance is estimated to have at least twenty Nascent Soul cultivators in total.”

‘More than twenty Nascent Soul cultivators!?’

The entire plaza erupted into murmurs.

The Supreme Elder waited for the noise to subside.

“However, only three Nascent Soul cultivators have currently been confirmed on the Cang Kingdom front. We are still determining who else may have crossed over.”

One of the Golden Core Elders on the stone platform spoke.

“They must have left a considerable number of forces behind in Lan Kingdom as well.”

“Indeed. They must defend both their original territories beyond the Nanming Sea and the lands they occupy in Lan Kingdom. The interests of the twelve sects do not always align, so it will be difficult for them to redirect their full strength here all at once. They once fought fiercely among themselves, which will also make internal unity difficult.”

The Supreme Elder pointed toward the northern portion of the map.

Cang Kingdom and Kun Kingdom lit up in succession.

“The Wangu Sect has three Nascent Soul cultivators, while our sect and the Biluo Sect each have two. Even excluding the Wangu Sect's injured Elder, that still leaves six. If we make use of our existing strongholds and defensive grand formations and concentrate our forces where necessary, we should be able to oppose them. Furthermore....”

The Supreme Elder paused briefly before continuing.

“The Qianyang royal house has also responded to the Wangu Sect's request, promising to send several Tier-3 gu warriors as support.”

If the Nanming Twelve-Sect Alliance continued north, Qianyang Kingdom, which bordered Cang Kingdom, would also be affected, so there was nothing strange about them offering assistance.

The Supreme Elder swept his gaze over the disciples.

“Of course, we cannot be certain that this alone will be enough to confront the Nanming Twelve-Sect Alliance. For now, we will maintain the defenses of our headquarters while sending manpower and supplies to Cang Kingdom. At the same time, we will reinforce the major strongholds throughout Kun Kingdom.”

As he lowered his hand, the map slowly rolled itself up and vanished.

“Each of you will have a role to play. Until your assignments are decided, do not leave the headquarters. Wait for instructions from your respective peaks and Courts.”

The disciples cupped their hands in unison.

“We obey!”

Their voices filled the plaza.

...

Three days later.

Six disciples, including Lee Hyun and Liu Zhengyuan, had gathered in Yanxia Peak's Lecture Hall.

A newly issued deployment document lay on the table.

Tan Yunsheng looked first at Lee Hyun.

“Dongsan. This time, I want you to coordinate the work.”

Lee Hyun picked up the document.

「Support for Sanmen Island, Cang Kingdom.」

Below it were the assigned personnel, supplies, and duties.

“Sanmen Island... so we’re being sent offshore?”

“Yes.”

Tan Yunsheng unfolded a map.

An island was marked in the broad waters north of Qingshui Strait, with numerous shipping routes of varying sizes branching around it.

“It serves as a receiving point for cultivators and supplies withdrawing from the southern strongholds. The Wangu Sect requested assistance. Our sect and the Biluo Sect will each send personnel, and I am told that smaller local sects are already there.”

Liu Zhengyuan asked,

“Could the enemy appear there as well?”

“It is not the front line, but if fighting continues around the strait, more wounded cultivators and merchants fleeing the fighting will gather there. It seems the local alchemists cannot handle the demand on their own.”

Lee Hyun studied the map.

‘This is practically the front line....’

Tan Yunsheng pointed to the section listing their duties.

“What is most urgently needed right now are Tier-2 Qi-Restoring Pills and Tier-2 Detoxification Pills. The local stronghold will provide the medicinal ingredients required for alchemy and give priority to supplying the ingredients for those two pills. You will handle alchemy there and provide combat support if necessary.”

Lee Hyun did not take his eyes from the map.

Sanmen Island was surrounded entirely by ocean.

‘If I go in there and the sea routes get blocked....’

There would be no land on which to use the Earth Escape Art.

Going beneath the seabed would not solve the problem either. Charging blindly into a place where he knew neither the water depth nor the geological layers could lead to anything.

If a Golden Core cultivator pursued him, escaping would be difficult.

And what if a Nascent Soul cultivator attacked the island?

‘There's nothing I could do about that.’

Tan Yunsheng continued.

“Golden Core Elders will be stationed there. Personnel from our sect's Dharma Protector Court will accompany you as well. Even so, you must be prepared to protect yourselves.”

“When do we depart?”

“In fifteen days. Until then, finish your current work and inspect the medicinal ingredients and pill furnaces you will be taking.”

Lee Hyun set down the deployment document.

“Understood.”

...

A few days later.

Yanxia Peak had grown quite busy.

At the communal Alchemy Hall, there was never a pause in preparing medicinal ingredients. Even during hours when the disciples would normally have been resting in their own residences, they came out to affix seals to jade bottles and medicine boxes.

Just then, a streak of light flew toward Yanxia Peak, and a Foundation Establishment steward descended.

“Is anyone here assigned to Sanmen Island?”

Lee Hyun looked up.

“What is it?”

“The deployment to Sanmen Island has been put on hold. Those assigned are ordered to remain at their respective peaks and await further instructions.”

After handing over a document, the steward left, and Liu Zhengyuan approached Lee Hyun.

“Senior Brother. Has something happened?”

“I don't know yet.”

At that moment, Tan Yunsheng also came down from the direction of the Lecture Hall, holding a voice-transmission talisman.

The disciples saluted him.

“Master. The Sanmen Island deployment....”

“I heard. The situation has changed.”

Tan Yunsheng looked at his disciples.

“Qianyang Kingdom has sided with the Nanming Twelve-Sect Alliance.”

...

Even after all the disciples had entered the Lecture Hall, no one spoke for some time.

Tan Yunsheng placed a jade slip on the table.

“I am told that the Qianyang royal house has broken the alliance it made with the Wangu Sect and sent an official state letter declaring that it will submit to the Nanming Twelve-Sect Alliance.”

Liu Zhengyuan asked,

“Is that true? Just a few days ago, they promised to send support....”

“It seems that was a deception. Cultivators from the Nanming Twelve-Sect Alliance have appeared throughout Qianyang Kingdom's Gu-Rearing Institutes.”

Tan Yunsheng let out a short breath.

“The problem is no longer merely losing the support of their Tier-3 gu warriors. We are now in a position where we must suppress them.”

‘Hmm....’

Lee Hyun recalled the terrain of northern Qianyang Kingdom.

The long border adjoining Anling Kingdom, along with the spirit veins and passes around it.

‘If cultivators from the Nanming Twelve-Sect Alliance come through there....’

They could choose weak points in Kun Kingdom's defenses and attack them.

The route leading to Haimen Port and the various cultivator markets throughout Anling Kingdom would also be affected.

Qianyang Kingdom occupied a broad expanse of land west of Kun Kingdom and Cang Kingdom, and its far western edge bordered the sea. Leaving it alone would threaten the supply routes running from Kun Kingdom to Cang Kingdom. If the enemy advanced east and seized the major routes, the movement of supplies and personnel between the two cultivation nations could be cut off.

One disciple asked cautiously,

“How can a mere Tier-3 martial nation like Qianyang Kingdom betray Cang Kingdom and Kun Kingdom? Wasn't Qianyang Kingdom the Wangu Sect's lackey?”

“It was. Long ago, when the Qianyang Divine Demon killed a Golden Core cultivator from Kun Kingdom, the Wangu Sect even stepped in to prevent him from being punished.”

“Then why....”

Tan Yunsheng looked at the jade slip.

“I am told there is a sect in the Nanming Twelve-Sect Alliance called the Dongming Sect.”

Lee Hyun's eyes widened.

‘The Dongming Sect! Aren't those the same characters used in Life-Bound Gu?’ [TL Note: Dongming (同命) is the same compound used in Life-Bound Gu (同命蠱), literally meaning “sharing the same life”.]

“The Qianyang royal house has always kept the cultivation methods of the Gu Path completely hidden from outsiders. But cultivators of the Dongming Sect recently confirmed within Qianyang Kingdom used methods remarkably similar to theirs. Reports say even the way they handle symbiotic spirit insects and the characteristics that appear when they employ the Gu Path are alike.”

Tan Yunsheng tapped the jade slip with a fingertip.

“Their inheritances have not yet been directly compared. Still, it seems highly likely that the Qianyang Divine Demon had some sort of connection to the Dongming Sect.”

“Wasn't the Gu Path something the Wangu Sect created for them?”

“There were rumors to that effect, but in truth, the Wangu Sect never claimed to have created the Gu Path.”

Tan Yunsheng paused briefly to choose his words before continuing his explanation.

“Come to think of it, their methods are entirely different. Simply handling gu does not mean everyone uses the same methods. The Wangu Sect excels at raising and commanding spirit insects. They center their forces around a powerful life-bound spirit insect, using it to command several insect swarms, with different species assigned to attack, defense, poison, and tracking.”

Lee Hyun thought of his fuzzbees.

Tan Yunsheng continued.

“At lower realms, they directly control a small number of spirit insects. Once they reach higher realms, however, they are also said to command entire groups through lead insects. A Nascent Soul cultivator of the Wangu Sect can supposedly control tens of thousands of insects in this manner. Of course, keeping the insect swarms from interfering with one another while coordinating them with one's own techniques requires great proficiency in both the Insect Control Art and the manipulation of divine sense. It is an extremely difficult style of combat.”

“Then the Gu Path inheritance of Qianyang Kingdom must have originated from the Dongming Sect rather than the Wangu Sect....”

“At present, that seems the most reasonable conclusion. The Wangu Sect has no Gu Path lineage like the one practiced in Qianyang Kingdom. But the origin of an inheritance and whether the one who obtained it actually belonged to that sect are separate matters.”

Tan Yunsheng looked around at his disciples.

“It seems the Wangu Sect suspects that the Qianyang Divine Demon traveled to the Nanming Sea long ago. There are even claims that he fled the Dongming Sect with its inheritance. If he never advanced beyond a Tier-3 gu warrior, his lifespan should have run out by now. His successors may have sought the Tier-4 gu warrior inheritance that they themselves lacked. However, it has not yet been confirmed how long the Qianyang royal house has been secretly colluding with the Nanming Twelve-Sect Alliance.”

Lee Hyun organized his thoughts as he listened. Whatever the truth might be, one thing seemed certain: the gu warriors of Qianyang Kingdom were now enemies.

“Master.”

Lee Hyun spoke.

“Back at Haimen Port, I once sent spirit insects implanted inside demon beasts to the headquarters. Then could those spirit insects also have been....”

Tan Yunsheng nodded.

“I suspect they were probably the work of the Dongming Sect.”

“I see.”

When the Lecture Hall fell quiet again, Tan Yunsheng rose from his seat.

“The headquarters will determine a new response. Until then, do not travel far. Remain here and wait.”

“Yes, Master.”

Lee Hyun thought it was actually fortunate that he no longer had to go to the island in the south.

...

The headquarters grew even busier.

Lights remained on late into the night at the External Affairs Court and Intelligence Hall, while the number of voice-transmission talismans flying between the peaks increased sharply.

Several Golden Core Elders had already left through the Mountain Gate with their disciples.

...

The next day, Tan Yunsheng summoned his disciples once more.

“Our Yanxia Peak will be going here.”

Tan Yunsheng's finger stopped over southeastern Anling Kingdom on the map floating in midair.

It was some distance from the border with Qianyang Kingdom.

“One of the joint defensive strongholds of the Danxiao Sect and Biluo Sect will be established here.”

One disciple asked,

“Master, will you be coming with us as well?”

“Yes.”

Tan Yunsheng called out the names of ten disciples, including Lee Hyun.

“You will follow me. Those who remain will handle the headquarters' alchemy work. We will also take support personnel from among the Qi Refining disciples.”

“What about supporting the Wangu Sect?”

“Some Elders have already left for Cang Kingdom, and medicinal ingredients and pills are being sent through other routes.”

Tan Yunsheng moved the small markers placed on the map.

One marker moved down toward Cang Kingdom, while the others clustered densely along the border with Qianyang Kingdom.

“We will establish strongholds centered around Golden Core Elders. The Nascent Soul Elders will watch the movements of the enemy's Nascent Soul cultivators and keep them in check.”

Lee Hyun studied the terrain around his destination.

A long mountain range stretched to the east, while a supply route extended northwest. That road connected to various cultivator markets in Anling Kingdom and continued toward Haimen Port.

‘About twenty thousand li (about 7,840 km) from Tunnel No. 3... If anything, I suppose this battlefield is close to home for me.’

Tan Yunsheng continued.

“Our sect and the Biluo Sect have also requested support from the Azure Cloud Sect, Taixuan Sect, and Jinding Sect of Xuan Kingdom, a Tier-4 cultivation nation. If Kun Kingdom falls into crisis, they will hardly remain unaffected.”

Tan Yunsheng put away the map.

“We depart in ten days. Until then, inspect your magic tools and pills. Once we march out, there is no telling when we will return through the Mountain Gate. Those of you who have saved up contribution points should obtain whatever you need now. Do not hoard them until you lose the chance to use them at all.”

“We will keep that in mind.”

...

The following day.

Out of curiosity, Lee Hyun visited the Artifact Court, but Foundation Establishment cultivators were waiting in line outside the hall, while carts loaded with supplies constantly came and went.

From what he heard, stockpiles were being depleted rapidly as more supplies were sent to the front. The cost of importing replacements from outside had risen as well, so the exchange prices had increased not only for combat magic tools, but also for all kinds of formation plates, formation flags, talismans, and pills.

Even so, disciples continued crowding in, making it difficult to obtain the items they wanted.

‘Everyone's thinking the same thing.’

Lee Hyun considered what he already possessed.

The Profound Gate Sword, six bronze flying swords and the black-iron longspear, the Black Scale Inner Armor and Profound Iron Buckler, and the Protective Bell. He also had the Nine-Bend Dust and Sand Formation, a Tier-2 defensive formation he could deploy in an emergency.

‘I certainly don't lack magic tools.’

...

After returning to Qingyu Ravine, Lee Hyun arranged jade caskets from his storage pouch across the table and floor.

He took out his talismans one by one and examined how much spiritual power remained in their talisman inscriptions.

Thanks to buying a large stockpile along the way, he still had quite a few usable ones left.

He broke the seals on his pills as well and checked their condition.

Having worked as a Tier-2 alchemist, he naturally had plenty of spare pills for his own use.

Next, he took the Bonefuzz puppets from his storage pouch.

Over the past forty-eight years, Lee Hyun had increased their number all the way to Bonefuzz No. 20. In addition to the restriction that activated the Fireball Art, he had inscribed each Bonefuzz with a flight-suppressing restriction that employed Earth-Origin Force.

The flight-suppressing restrictions operated by consuming spirit stones and were weaker than the Earth-Origin Force Lee Hyun could wield himself, but when several Bonefuzz puppets combined their strength, they were quite useful.

After repeated training, the Tier-2 fuzzbees had also grown accustomed to activating both types of restrictions while controlling the Bonefuzz puppets.

‘Hopefully I won't need to use even these....’

Lastly, Lee Hyun examined his identity token. Over the past fifty years, he had accumulated contribution points through alchemy work and other duties, and after spending what he needed, he still had 1,780 points remaining.

‘They're worthless if I never spend them, right?’

...

The Inner Pavilion of the Scripture Pavilion.

There were more people here as well, though it was not as chaotic as the Artifact Court. After all, cultivation arts and techniques could not be put to immediate use merely by reading them right before a war.

Even so, several people had crowded around the list of combat techniques near the entrance.

Lee Hyun first examined the list of Way of the Sword inheritances beside it and soon found a familiar name.

The fee to access the 《Great Unity Heavenly Dipper Sword Canon》 was still 370 contribution points.

Following the lineage of inheritances below it, he came across a similar name.

《Great Unity Earthly Fiend Sword Canon》

A Tier-3 Way of the Sword inheritance for Golden Core cultivators.

The contribution points required to access it amounted to a staggering 950!

Lee Hyun read the overview.

Building on the condensing and refining of sword qi, sword forms, and light splitting taught in the Great Unity Heavenly Dipper Sword Canon, it continued the Way of the Sword at a level suited to the Golden Core realm.

‘I can't use any of this right now, but....’

There was no guarantee he would have another chance to access it later.

Moreover, it was the successor inheritance to the sword art he had already learned. It was better to secure this than to reach the Golden Core realm and begin learning an entirely different Way of the Sword from scratch.

‘Let's take this first. That'll leave me with 830 contribution points.’

Lee Hyun wrote down the name of the inheritance he intended to access, then headed toward the section containing skill inheritances.

‘The sect might collapse, so I should secure the inheritances I need to become a Tier-2 formation master and artifact refiner as well.’

Keeping his remaining contribution points in mind, he went through the lists one by one.

Collections of completed formation diagrams and secret refining methods for specific magic tools also caught his attention. However, if he chose those as well, he would run short on contribution points.

What he needed immediately was the foundation required to advance from Tier 1 to Tier 2. He could obtain more specialized inheritances later if the opportunity arose.

For formation inheritances, he first chose the 《Definitive Explanation of Formations》 and 《Commentary on Formation Deployment by Terrain》. They cost 120 and 140 points respectively.

The former covered the fundamentals of formation inscriptions and spiritual-power manipulation required for Tier-2 formations, while the latter explained how to examine terrain and the flow of spirit veins when deploying formations. They seemed likely to help him gain a deeper understanding of the formations he already knew and improve the formations in his tunnels.

For artifact-refining inheritances, he chose the 《Spirit Material Refining Method》, 《Comprehensive Guide to Magic-Tool Restrictions》, and 《Essentials of Restriction Inscription》.

They cost 160, 220, and 180 points respectively.

Together, the inheritances covered everything from refining spirit materials to the principles behind constructing restrictions and the techniques used to inscribe them into magic tools. They were well suited to organizing what he had learned while making Bonefuzz puppets and filling the gaps in his knowledge.

Lee Hyun added up the prices of the inheritances he had chosen once more.

The five skill inheritances cost 820 points, and adding the 950 points for the Great Unity Earthly Fiend Sword Canon brought the total to 1,770.

‘Ten points left, huh....’

That seemed like a very efficient use of them.

Lee Hyun placed the Great Unity Earthly Fiend Sword Canon first on the list, followed by the two formation inheritances and three artifact-refining inheritances.

Once he had organized the list, he approached the cultivator in charge.

“I would like to access these inheritances in order. Please begin with the Great Unity Earthly Fiend Sword Canon.”

The man looked over the list and raised his eyebrows slightly.

“If you begin studying these now, I doubt you'll be able to make use of them before you depart.”

“I intend to study them later.”

The cultivator in charge asked no further questions. He took Lee Hyun's identity token and deducted the access fees for all six inheritances.

Ten contribution points remained.

He handed back the identity token together with an inheritance chamber token.

“Go to Inheritance Chamber Two.”

...

After entering the inheritance chamber, Lee Hyun received the jade slip containing the Great Unity Earthly Fiend Sword Canon and poured his divine sense into it.

Its contents were vast and difficult, but for now, memorization took priority over understanding.

He then accessed the remaining inheritances one after another. After returning to Qingyu Ravine, he copied the contents of all six inheritances in full into blank jade slips and stored them safely in his storage pouch.

...

He spent the rest of his time inspecting Yanxia Peak's supplies for the campaign.

Together with the disciples in charge, Lee Hyun verified the quantities and separated the prepared supplies from those that had yet to be processed.

Liu Zhengyuan closed a jade casket and said,

“I ended up buying a shield.”

“Did you find one you liked?”

“Yes. I spent quite a lot of contribution points, but... I felt like it would keep bothering me if I left without buying one.”

“Good choice. Have you finished bonding with it?”

“I finished last night.”

Lee Hyun nodded.

Liu Zhengyuan hesitated briefly before continuing.

“Senior Brother, you don't seem particularly nervous.”

“Me?”

“Yes. You're acting just like usual.”

“Being nervous won't change anything.”

“...I suppose not.”

“Empty your mind and focus on what you can do. It's easier that way.”

...

The night before their departure.

Lee Hyun slowly looked around Qingyu Ravine, clearing away every trace of himself that remained in his residence.

He used the Cleansing Art to gather and eliminate even the dust accumulated in the corners. He did not leave behind so much as a single strand of hair.

...

The next morning.

Flying boats rose beneath the clouds over the Danxiao Range.

The ornate flying boats at the front carried Golden Core Elders, while vessels carrying disciples and supplies followed in a long line behind them.

Restrictions securing various materials and boxes of medicinal ingredients to the decks glimmered faintly.

Lee Hyun checked the final seal before withdrawing his hand.

Liu Zhengyuan and the other disciples also organized their respective belongings. Inside the cabins, the Qi Refining disciples reread the transport manifests and their assigned duties.

A short while later, Tan Yunsheng crossed over from the flying boat ahead and landed on the deck.

“Have you forgotten anything?”

“We've checked everything.”

Tan Yunsheng nodded, then stood beside the railing and gazed back at the receding Yanxia Peak.

Through the mist, the roof of the communal Alchemy Hall and the pine trees were still visible.

He turned toward Lee Hyun.

“Dongsan.”

“Yes, Master.”

“You are skilled in combat. I would like you to look after your less experienced Junior Brothers. If an enemy you cannot handle appears, inform me.”

“Of course.”

Tan Yunsheng looked around at the more senior disciples, including Song Qiming, Yue Wugou, Mei Sujun, Fang Jiyun, and Chen Xiaoying.

“The same goes for all of you.”

“Yes.”

The disciples bowed their heads. The flying boat gradually picked up speed.

The peaks of the Danxiao Range receded behind them, while vast forests and winding rivers spread out below.

Chapter 67

A few days later.

Blackened rooftops came into view below the flying boat.

Nestled between two low mountains, this place had originally been known as Qingshi Market, where nearby Qi Refining cultivators often gathered. Now, however, it was little more than ruins.

The road running through the middle of the cultivator market was crisscrossed with chaotic wagon tracks, while broken jars and charred timber could be seen beyond the collapsed walls.

‘Have Qianyang Kingdom’s gu warriors already looted this place?’

To the northeast, several rogue cultivators were moving along a narrow path.

Some of those leaving the cultivator market stopped when they saw the Danxiao Sect’s flying boats, then turned around and headed back.

...

The flying boats from the Danxiao Sect landed in a wide clearing on the northern side of the cultivator market.

Cultivators from the Danxiao Sect and Biluo Sect who had arrived earlier came to greet the group. Behind them were cultivators in unfamiliar attire from nearby minor sects and cultivation clans.

When Tan Yunsheng stepped down from the lead flying boat, a Golden Core Elder from the Biluo Sect approached. After exchanging courtesies, the two began to talk.

From what Lee Hyun happened to overhear, they seemed to be discussing the layout of the defensive stronghold and where to install the grand formation.

The two Elders disappeared inside, and Eldest Senior Brother Song Qiming gathered the surrounding disciples and began assigning them tasks.

“We’ll restore the three halls to the northeast and use them for alchemy. For now...”

...

Everyone remained busy for the next several days.

Many cultivators carried out the groundwork needed to install a Tier 3 grand formation at the cultivator market, while the Qi Refining disciples moved stone and timber or prepared living quarters for the people.

Tan Yunsheng traveled around the area with other Golden Core cultivators.

On one occasion, he did not return for half a day. Near sunset, a great burst of red light rose into the southwestern sky.

A short while later, thunderous booms sounded from beyond the distant mountains.

The disciples preparing for alchemy in the courtyard gazed anxiously toward the distant sky, but Eldest Senior Brother Song Qiming merely looked up once before calmly instructing them.

“Don’t worry. Keep doing what you were doing.”

One month later.

Lee Hyun was patrolling the northwestern side of the cultivator market with four Qi Refining disciples.

As the encampment became established, their patrol range had also expanded.

Lee Hyun had been assigned the road leading into the cultivator market and the low mountain ridges around it.

The road was filled not only with refugees, but also with quite a few people who had left after hearing that the cultivator market had been devastated, only to return once they heard that the great sects had arrived.

One disciple was counting the wagons visible in the distance when he spoke.

“Martial Uncle. I think there’s fighting over there.”

Lee Hyun had already sensed it as well.

Spiritual power fluctuated violently in the valley ahead. Soon, a burst of red flame rose between the trees before scattering.

“Follow me. Don’t get too close.”

As soon as he finished speaking, Lee Hyun kicked off the ground.

...

Dozens of wagons had overturned in the middle of the road, and mortals lay prone behind them.

In front of them stood an elderly mid Foundation Establishment cultivator, shielding several fallen Qi Refining cultivators behind him.

Opposite him were three Tier 2 gu warriors from Qianyang Kingdom.

The man in front grinned and twisted his long spear.

“We’re at war. Don’t blame me for this.”

The spearhead smashed into the flying sword hovering in midair.

Clang!

The moment the flying sword was knocked aside and buried itself in a tree trunk, the force extending from the spearhead slammed head-on into the shield held by the elderly Foundation Establishment cultivator.

Boom!

As the old cultivator staggered, another man circled around from the side and aimed a short blade at his neck.

Clang!

A streak of sword light suddenly flew in and knocked the blade away. The man clutched his wrist and retreated.

Lee Hyun landed between them.

“Fall back.”

The expressions of all three gu warriors changed.

The spear-wielding man saw the pattern embroidered on Lee Hyun’s robe and curled his lips.

“The Danxiao Sect has come this far.... So what? That’s only one more bastard. Let’s finish this quickly.”

Before he had even finished speaking, one of the men in the rear shot forward.

His target was not Lee Hyun, but a Qi Refining cultivator who was helping the wounded behind the wagons. He intended to strike a killing blow.

But Lee Hyun moved his left hand lightly, and a hand formed from blue spirit light appeared and viciously slammed the man into the ground.

Bang!

At almost the same instant, the spear-wielding gu warrior surged toward Lee Hyun with ferocious momentum.

Whoosh!

Lee Hyun merely stood in place and raised his sword at an angle.

The spiritual power flowing along the blade layered upon itself. The faint sword light became dazzlingly bright, then condensed until even the light itself vanished.

Great Unity Heavenly Dipper, Third Form: Vertical Slash.

Flash!

A brilliant sword light suddenly appeared and split the black force erupting from the spearhead cleanly apart to either side.

The gu warrior hurriedly pulled back the spear shaft, but the sword light had already passed between his hands.

His eyes widened.

Slice!

His body split in two.

At that moment, the gu warrior who had been smashed into the ground by the Condensed-Essence Grasping Hand struggled upright and let out a savage roar.

Something writhed beneath his robe, and his back and shoulders swelled dramatically.

Lee Hyun turned his sword tip toward him, and sword light flashed once more.

Slash!

The sword light cleanly severed the body-protecting spirit light and carved straight through his chest.

The man’s body went limp.

The final gu warrior was already fleeing, leaping above the trees.

Great Unity Heavenly Dipper Sword Qi shot from Lee Hyun’s sword like a bolt of lightning.

Great Unity Heavenly Dipper, Twelfth Form: Bending Turn.

The streak of light seemed to chase the path the gu warrior had taken, then smoothly changed direction in midair and swept beneath his legs.

“Aagh!”

His body lost balance in the air and crashed into the bushes beside the road.

Lee Hyun dragged him out with the Condensed-Essence Grasping Hand, immobilized him with acupoint striking, then set him down at the side of the road.

The surroundings fell silent.

...

One by one, the people crouching behind the wagons raised their heads.

The elderly Foundation Establishment cultivator holding the shield stared openmouthed between the corpses on the ground and Lee Hyun.

Lee Hyun asked,

“Are you badly hurt?”

“N-No. I’m fine... only my magic tool took a little damage... Thank you for saving my life!”

“Are these members of your household?”

“They are. We didn’t even know war had broken out when Qianyang Kingdom’s gu warriors suddenly invaded. We were on our way to seek refuge...”

The cultivator bent deeply at the waist once more.

“Thank you for saving us!”

“There’s no need to be so formal, fellow Daoist. I’m only a Foundation Establishment cultivator myself.”

‘A Foundation Establishment cultivator...? Are Foundation Establishment cultivators from great sects really this powerful?’

The old cultivator raised his bowed head, but lacked the courage to meet Lee Hyun’s eyes and quickly lowered his gaze again.

After witnessing the overwhelming might of the powerful cultivator before him firsthand, he could no longer bring himself to address Lee Hyun as a fellow Daoist.

The Danxiao Sect’s Qi Refining disciples finally arrived as well and stared blankly at Lee Hyun.

One of them was looking at the spot where the fallen gu warrior had swung his spear. A deep gouge had been carved into the hard road, and a nearby tree had been torn apart around the middle of its trunk.

The disciple asked cautiously,

“Martial Uncle. Were all of them Tier 2 gu warriors?”

“Seems that way.”

Lee Hyun answered while inspecting the corpses.

Their clothes were all different, but the insides of their belts and shoes bore markings that looked military in nature. An iron badge identifying its owner also hung from one man’s waist.

When the fuzzbees inside the spirit-insect pouch began moving restlessly, Lee Hyun sent them his mental intent through the Spirit-Nurturing Seal and calmed them.

‘Not now.’

One disciple whispered to the person beside him.

“Are Tier 2 gu warriors normally that weak...? They were all down by the time we got here?”

“You idiot. Martial Uncle Li is simply that strong.”

When Lee Hyun turned his head, the two immediately shut their mouths.

“Help the fallen people.”

“Yes!”

The disciples answered more loudly than usual.

...

After interrogating the captured gu warrior, they learned that all three men belonged to Qianyang Kingdom’s military. However, the attack had not been ordered by the army. It seemed they had acted on their own to seize spoils.

The men had apparently spent the past few days robbing cultivators from Kun Kingdom throughout the surrounding area.

According to the captive, gu warriors had to constantly invest resources into raising their Life-Bound Gu as well. They needed resources both for their own cultivation and to feed their Life-Bound Gu, so their hunger for resources seemed even greater than that of Foundation Establishment cultivators.

Tan Yunsheng read the report and nodded.

“Good work.”

“It was nothing major.”

“Perhaps not to you.”

His gaze shifted toward the Qi Refining disciples standing beside Lee Hyun. Their robes were stained with dirt and blood, but none of them were injured.

“Remember what you saw today. If you cultivate diligently every day like Dongsan does, even frightening situations can be handled with ease. In this world, strength matters above all else.”

“We will remember!”

After the disciples withdrew, Tan Yunsheng spoke to Lee Hyun.

“We should increase the number of people patrolling the northwest.”

“I’ll keep a closer watch on that area for the time being as well.”

“Good. Coordinate your alchemy duties with Qiming.”

Three months later.

Qingshi Market looked completely different from before.

It had become a massive stronghold under the constant protection of a Tier 3 grand formation, and countless halls and pavilions had risen over the ruins. Judging merely from the number of Foundation Establishment cultivators one encountered on the streets, it looked far more prosperous than the cultivator market had been before the war.

But once inside, the atmosphere was extremely grim.

Swift avian spirit beasts and voice-transmission talismans constantly flew in and out of the cultivator market, and cultivators continued entering and leaving even late at night or before dawn.

A certain unspoken line had also formed in how they clashed with Qianyang Kingdom’s gu warriors.

If a Golden Core cultivator took the field, a Tier 3 gu warrior from the opposing side would respond. While the higher-level forces on both sides kept each other in check, Foundation Establishment cultivators and Tier 2 gu warriors fought over roads and mountain ridges.

Of course, there was no agreement to spare enemies of a lower realm. Anyone who saw an opportunity would strike. But if someone ventured too deeply into enemy territory to hunt weaker opponents, they could be surrounded by enemies of equal strength, while the enemy might also exploit the position they had left vacant.

In the end, no one could act recklessly.

No matter how many victories the Foundation Establishment cultivators won, it would be difficult to hold the stronghold if the Golden Core Elders were defeated.

Interestingly enough, even the Tier 3 gu warriors and Golden Core cultivators thought the same way!

The direction of the war would ultimately be decided by which side prevailed in the battles among the Nascent Soul cultivators. With the balance between the highest-level forces still unresolved, there was no reason for them to be the first to stake everything on a life-or-death battle.

They were willing to fight for their sects, but few were willing to die alongside them. More than a few cultivators were already considering where they would flee if their faction lost.

And so the strange standoff continued. Small-scale clashes repeatedly broke out mainly between opponents of equal strength, while everyone waited to see which way the struggle between the Nascent Soul cultivators of the Nanming Twelve-Sect Alliance, Kun Kingdom, and Cang Kingdom would tilt.

There were even rumors circulating that Nascent Soul cultivators from Xuan Kingdom had appeared to aid Kun Kingdom and Cang Kingdom, but even inner disciples like Lee Hyun did not know whether those rumors were true.

...

Late one evening, Song Qiming passed around a jade slip received from the main sect for the disciples of Yanxia Peak to examine.

“This is newly acquired intelligence. It concerns the Shenlou Sect of the Nanming Twelve-Sect Alliance.”

Lee Hyun examined the illustrations inside the jade slip.

They depicted a gourd engraved with fish-scale patterns, a shell-shaped magic tool, and thin, curved flying blades.

‘There was someone who used things like these.’

He recalled the cultivator in dark blue robes he had fought long ago in the Huatian Secret Realm. The man had hidden twelve flying blades within an icy water mist and sent them flying at him. Lee Hyun had not known which sect he belonged to at the time, but the method of operating the magic tools described in the illustration looked quite similar.

He also remembered the late Foundation Establishment cultivator who had used a shell-shaped magic tool.

Song Qiming continued.

“They’re skilled in water- and wind-aligned techniques, and they use the shells and pearls of a demon beast native to the Nanming Sea called the Mirage Clam in various crafts. If you encounter mist, don’t trust the distance your eyes tell you. Even the presences detected by divine sense can overlap.”

“Illusion arts?”

“So it seems.”

Mei Sujun read the next section of the jade slip.

“Dream-Illusion Coral....”

She stared for a while at the illustration marked with red spots.

“So that powder from last time was this.”

“They compared it against wounded cultivators who displayed similar symptoms. Apparently they mix it into mist or use it through magic tools. Its toxicity isn’t especially strong, but coming into contact with it during battle can still be dangerous.”

...

A little over four months after they arrived at Qingshi Market.

In a valley roughly a thousand li (about 392 km) from the cultivator market, Yue Wugou’s iron plaque slammed into the mist.

Boom!

One side of the curtain caved inward deeply, but the man standing beyond it rippled like water and scattered away. The moment the iron plaque swept through empty air, two flying blades shot in from the opposite side.

Mei Sujun’s blue-green silk ribbon shot sideways.

Clang!

The spirit light gathered over the ribbon’s surface deflected the flying blades. Immediately afterward, she twisted her wrist, and the long unfurled ribbon swung back to wrap around the front of the group.

“Senior Brother, don’t send it too far!”

“I know!”

Yue Wugou recalled the iron plaque.

Three Foundation Establishment cultivators were gathered at the bottom of the valley.

Two from the Danxiao Sect and one from the Biluo Sect.

The Biluo Sect cultivator was leaning against a boulder with a deep gash in his thigh. Clutching a small formation plate, he sent spiritual power into the formation flags planted between the rocks.

It should have been an ordinary patrol.

The group had checked several locations as usual and was on its way back when water mist suddenly surged up at the mouth of the valley.

When they tried to escape upward, gu warriors appeared. When they tried to turn back, other enemies had already blocked their path.

Their first voice-transmission talisman was sliced apart by a flying blade before it could leave the mist. They had no idea how far the ones sent afterward had gotten.

Yue Wugou steadied his breathing and looked outside.

There were eight enemies.

Five Tier 2 gu warriors from Qianyang Kingdom and three Foundation Establishment cultivators from the Shenlou Sect.

“Surrender, and we’ll spare your lives.”

A deep voice came from beyond the mist.

Yue Wugou snorted.

“And why should I believe that?”

One of his iron plaques flew forward again.

This time, it was no illusion.

A black fist emerged from the mist and struck the iron plaque head-on.

Bang!

The iron plaque rebounded, and Yue Wugou’s arm jerked violently.

The gu warrior spread his hand and fired out strands like spiderwebs, while the Shenlou Sect cultivators behind him sent a barrage of flying blades forward.

Mei Sujun gritted her teeth and unfurled her silk ribbon.

Several of the flying blades were illusions, but real ones were mixed among them, making them extremely difficult to block.

While she tried to distinguish and intercept the real blades, two gu warriors sprang in from either side, using the rocks as footholds.

Boom! Boom! Boom!

The defensive light curtain shook violently, and blood trickled from the corner of the Biluo Sect cultivator’s mouth as he held the formation plate.

...

At the same time.

Lee Hyun was on a mountain ridge east of the valley.

He had been returning after inspecting the area assigned to him when he saw three streaks of red signal light shoot into the sky. They failed to rise very high and dispersed midway. They could not have reached very far.

As he drew closer, he heard the sound of spiritual power colliding.

Lee Hyun crouched on the ridge rather than descending into the valley immediately.

When he spread out his divine sense, he detected numerous presences within the mist filling the valley. They were divided into a group huddled in one place and another group circling around them while launching repeated attacks.

‘Senior Sister Mei?’

A familiar blue-green ribbon appeared briefly through the mist.

‘Senior Brother Yue must be with her. Are they surrounded?’

Lee Hyun surveyed the surroundings.

Far to the south, powerful fluctuations of spiritual power rose from time to time. Reports had said that Golden Core Elders and enemy Tier 3 gu warriors had been confronting one another in that direction since morning.

‘I need to rescue them quickly before anyone else arrives. The enemy... Eight of them?’’

It was not beyond what he could handle alone. However, protecting his fellow disciples while also finishing off enemies who might scatter in every direction within a short time would be somewhat troublesome.

‘In that case...’

...

Bang!

One side of the defensive light curtain cracked, and a gu warrior thrust a long spear through the opening.

Mei Sujun’s ribbon wrapped around the spear shaft, but another gu warrior following behind punched the ribbon.

Thud!

Her body was forced backward.

Yue Wugou stepped forward and slammed down his iron plaque, forcing the gu warrior to release the spear and retreat.

Behind him, a Shenlou Sect cultivator raised a gourd. The water mist grew even thicker, and three flying blades appeared to split into six, then twelve.

Yue Wugou stopped relying on the trajectories visible to his eyes and focused on his divine sense, but even the presences detected by his divine sense overlapped one another.

‘Damn it....’

Then it happened.

The sound of rocks breaking came from every direction in the valley.

At first, they thought the cliffside was collapsing from the aftermath of the battle.

But a white leg emerged from between cracks in the ground, followed shortly by a round body.

Click.

As it braced itself against the ground and crawled out, identical objects appeared from crevices in the rocks nearby.

One, two, three.

Their hard white bodies moved in perfect order without colliding with one another.

Yue Wugou’s hand paused.

‘Puppets?’

They resembled enormous ants made of bone.

More and more such puppets crawled from cracks beneath the cliffs and from behind fallen trees.

One of the Shenlou Sect cultivators shouted,

“Haigu Island?”

The gu warriors also slowed their attacks, and the man who appeared to be their leader turned around.

“No one said reinforcements were coming.”

A cultivator in black robes walked out from behind the white bone puppets.

A distorted voice came from beneath a turtle mask.

“You’re making quite a racket in the lands of the great Anling Kingdom.”

The gu warrior frowned.

“What bullshit are you spouting? Since when has a kingdom of the mundane world like Anling ever been great?”

“Wait, Haigu Island isn’t our enemy...”

The masked cultivator raised a hand, and the restrictions engraved into the puppets’ bodies all lit up at once.

Hummm–

Unlike the Shenlou Sect cultivators, the gu warrior at the front instantly sensed that the puppet master before him was an enemy and launched himself into the air first.

Just as he tried to leap over the bone puppets and charge straight at the masked cultivator, his body abruptly sank.

The gu warrior’s expression changed.

‘A flight-suppressing restriction!?’

He unleashed a surge of Gu Origin True Qi, and his sinking body began to rise again.

At that exact moment, the heads of three other Bonefuzz turned toward him.

Thoom!

Four streams of Earth-Origin Force overlapped upon a single body, and the gu warrior plunged straight down from midair.

As he clenched his teeth and tried to rise, his vision turned red.

‘Fireball Art?’

Boom-boom-boom-boom!

A succession of exploding fireballs hammered against the gu warrior’s body-protecting spirit light.

The man crossed his arms to shield his face, but the continuous explosions bent his upper body backward.

Other bone puppets moved swiftly around him, each turning its head toward a different gu warrior as the restrictions on their bodies lit up.

One gu warrior tried to sprint sideways, only to drop to his knees.

Another leaped low into the air and slammed shoulder-first into a boulder.

While their bodies were trapped by Earth-Origin Force and unable to move as they wished, red fireballs rained down upon them.

Booom! Bang!

The water mist filling the valley was dyed red by the flames.

...

Yue Wugou stared openmouthed for a moment.

The gu warriors who had been pressing them from every direction only moments ago were now pinned in place and being pummeled.

The white bone puppets around them moved without pause, while the light of spirit stones flashed rapidly from inside their bodies.

[Senior Brother Yue!]

Mei Sujun’s voice transmission snapped Yue Wugou back to his senses.

She was already helping the wounded Biluo Sect cultivator to his feet.

[It looks like they’re fighting among themselves! Let’s get out of here now!]

[Ah... right!]

The bone puppets did not pursue them as they withdrew.

Yue Wugou and Mei Sujun had believed they would die today, so they were overjoyed by this heaven-sent opportunity and retreated at full speed.

...

Lee Hyun confirmed that Senior Brother Yue and Senior Sister Mei had left the valley, then lightly rolled the wrist holding his sword.

At that moment, one Shenlou Sect cultivator formed a hand seal. A violent torrent burst from his gourd and swallowed several fireballs.

A flat shell-shaped magic tool rose from another cultivator’s hand.

Snap!

The shell opened and released a blue ripple.

When one of the Bonefuzz at the front was shoved sideways, three flying blades shot through the gap.

Crack!

One of its front legs was severed.

But Bonefuzz did not fall. It lowered its body on its remaining legs and continued maintaining the flight-suppressing restriction on one of the gu warriors.

The Shenlou Sect cultivator frowned.

‘Strange. This isn’t how the Yin Bird Sect’s Haigu Island puppets I know behave....’

As he tried to move his flying blades again, sword light shot in from the side.

Clang!

One flying blade was knocked away in midair.

The cultivator in the turtle mask had already closed to within striking distance.

The instant the Shenlou Sect cultivator saw that sword light, his expression hardened. This man was not merely skilled at controlling puppets.

“Kill the puppet master first!”

At the shout, the remaining flying blades changed direction toward Lee Hyun.

The gu warriors also thickened their body-protecting spirit light, enduring the fireballs as they joined the attack. Black force extending from their fists and thin strands of insect silk converged on Lee Hyun all at once.

Lee Hyun advanced with his sword raised.

Hummm–

As the sword qi being condensed and refined along the blade gave off a wondrous light, the surrounding water mist was pushed away in a circular wave.

The expression of the cultivator holding the shell hardened.

‘That’s an incredibly high-level inheritance...’

Lee Hyun shifted half a step sideways, and a flying blade passed close enough to graze his robe. He twisted his waist, allowing a black fist shadow to shoot past his shoulder, then lowered the tip of his sword and severed the insect silk aiming for his ankle.

With a single footwork movement, all three attacks came to nothing.

The upright opening stance of his sword had already transformed into a circular sword form. The light extending from the sword tip curved into an arc and split into three streams.

At the same time, Lee Hyun’s left hand clenched the empty air.

Thoom!

A gu warrior’s upper body abruptly folded forward.

An overwhelming pulling force, on an entirely different level from the flight-suppressing restrictions used by the bone puppets, descended upon them.

“What...!”

Even the gu warrior beside him who had been firing insect silk had both feet lifted from the ground.

The nearby gu warriors, followed by the Shenlou Sect cultivators forming hand seals in the rear, began to be dragged toward Lee Hyun as though caught in an invisible vortex, pulled within a radius of dozens of zhang (roughly 70–300 m) around him.

A flying blade grazed a companion’s shoulder. A gourd spewing water was lifted into the air, and even the raging current was dragged into the vortex.

At that exact moment.

Great Unity Heavenly Dipper, Twenty-Ninth Form: Three Lights Divide into Nine.

The sword of the turtle-masked cultivator moved too fast for words.

Flash!

The three rotating streams of sword light split into nine and erupted in every direction!

‘Dammit...’

Those being dragged inward hurriedly brought out every defensive means they possessed, but their stances had already collapsed, and the rain of sword light was far too fast to block.

Crack!

The Shenlou Sect cultivator’s shell shattered, and sword light pierced straight through his chest.

“Aagh!”

The gu warriors’ screams followed.

Thud, thoom, thud.

In an instant, two Tier 2 gu warriors and two Shenlou Sect cultivators died.

...

The face of the lone Shenlou Sect cultivator who had survived by being slightly farther away went deathly pale.

Twenty puppets were still moving independently, yet the puppet master himself was wielding a sword in battle.

‘How....’

How could he divide his divine sense to control the puppets’ movements and activate their restrictions, yet still display such terrifying martial prowess himself?

The cultivator gritted his teeth and struck his gourd.

Rumble–

Dense water mist poured from the mouth of the gourd and spread through the valley. The rocks, corpses, and even the flames left by the bone puppets’ Fireball Art all became blurred in an instant.

The Shenlou Sect cultivator concealed himself within the water mist.

Lee Hyun sent his mental intent through the Spirit-Nurturing Seal.

[Keep the gu warriors pinned down.]

He began walking.

Within the water mist, the Shenlou Sect cultivator’s retreating figure split into three. One leaped toward the top of the cliff, another fled deeper into the valley, and the last hid behind a boulder.

The mist carried a sweet yet fishy smell.

The inside of Lee Hyun’s throat stung briefly, but it grew no worse.

When Lee Hyun circulated the Detoxification Art, the faint toxic qi seeping into his body was forced back out. Perhaps because of the resistance he had built up by taking Poison-Warding Pills, he suffered no other effects.

‘Is this the Dream-Illusion Coral powder I heard about...?’

The illusion arts that disrupted divine sense were also insufficient to deceive him.

Back in the Qi Refining realm, his entire body had undergone a baptism of spiritual power. Since then, he had cultivated the Spirit-Refining Essentials while consistently taking Spirit-Nourishing Pills and Spirit-Calming Pills.

The degree to which Lee Hyun had tempered his primordial spirit and divine sense was on an entirely different level from ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivators.

Sword light shot from the Profound Gate Sword.

Clang!

A flying blade was knocked out of seemingly empty air, revealing the Shenlou Sect cultivator.

He instinctively thrust his gourd forward to unleash a violent torrent, but,

Booom!

Lee Hyun’s sword flashed, and the gourd burst apart in an instant.

The turtle mask approached through the scattering droplets. The cultivator’s eyes widened.

“How...!? Why do neither the illusion arts nor the coral poison work on you...!”

Instead of answering, Lee Hyun’s sword light flashed.

The watery body-protecting spirit light tore apart, and the man’s final words were cut off along with his neck.

...

Explosions were still sounding from the opposite side of the valley.

The leader of the gu warriors covered his head with both arms as he endured the fireballs.

Blood ran beneath his blackened robe. Maintaining his body-protecting spirit light was consuming a considerable amount of Gu Origin True Qi.

He could withstand the attack of a single puppet. The problem was that no matter which direction he moved, several layers of pulling force held his body in place. If he knocked away a fireball in front of him, another would come flying from the side.

Whenever he tried to destroy the nearest puppet, that one retreated and another behind it moved forward. Their infuriating habit of taking turns fighting him made the gu warrior furious.

“You damned things!”

The gu warrior roared, and the muscles in his arms and neck bulged.

Within the Earth-Origin Force pressing down on him, his bent back gradually began to straighten.

The joints of eight Bonefuzz creaked.

The man took a step, crushing the stone beneath his foot.

“You think these pathetic things can...!” At that moment, another gu warrior screamed nearby.

The man turned his head and saw the turtle-masked cultivator already pulling his sword from the back of one of his subordinates. Behind him lay the corpse of the remaining gu warrior.

Before he knew it, he was the only one still alive.

Then a voice came from beneath the mask.

“That’s enough. Save the spirit stones.”

The lights within the puppets’ bodies went dark, and the force bearing down on the man’s shoulders and knees vanished all at once. He forcibly lowered his body, suppressing the impulse to spring upward.

‘He dropped his guard. Does he think I’m just like the other gu warriors...? Heh heh.’

Chapter 68

Stone shattered beneath the gu warrior’s feet.

Boom!

His crouched body shot forward, almost skimming the ground. His hand swept past the storage pouch at his waist, and a broad saber was suddenly in his grasp.

A scorching force surged from the man’s lower abdomen. The spiritual qi refined by his Life-Bound Gu mingled with his own blood qi, and the fierce, overpowering Gu Origin True Qi flowed down both arms and gathered in the blade.

Hummm―

The saber aura that had instantly extended several zhang (roughly ten meters or more) rapidly thinned, its black radiance condensing into a single line along the blade.

He had already reached the Profound Realm and become a grandmaster of the martial path before ever taking a Life-Bound Gu into his body.

He was different from those martial artists who entered the Gu-Rearing Institute and had spirit insects implanted as soon as they reached the Transformation Realm. For decades, he had wrestled with the question of how to fight cultivators or gu warriors with his inadequate internal energy.

Thanks to that, even when he had still been a Profound Realm martial artist, he had cut Tier 1 gu warriors and Qi Refining cultivators in half more than once.

And after stepping onto the path of a gu warrior, what he had gained was the power to unleash the martial learning he had honed throughout his life without restraint.

The saber in his hand now carried Gu Origin True Qi comparable to the spiritual power of a Foundation Establishment cultivator.

‘Take this!’

Whoosh!

The tip of his saber aura skimmed the ground, drawing a black line across the solid bedrock.

A delayed roar erupted as the ground split apart and the heaps of stone on either side heaved upward.

Through the gap, a chilling streak of saber light shot forward, seeking to cleave diagonally from Lee Hyun’s neck to his side.

The ninth move of the Boundary-Cleaving Saber Art, One Line Severs the Mountain.

It was a supreme art left behind long ago by Lu Zhi, a grandmaster of the martial path from the Qianyang Kingdom.

By then, Lee Hyun had already raised his sword at an angle.

The gu warrior’s eyes widened.

It was an opening stance he knew all too well.

Clear light gathered over the Profound Gate Sword.

Flash!

The two streaks of light collided, and through the tiny gap where they were slightly misaligned, Lee Hyun’s sword light slipped through like a ghost.

Clang!

The broad saber blade split in two.

An oblique line appeared across the gu warrior’s body-protecting spirit light immediately afterward.

Spurt!

Blood burst from his chest.

The gu warrior was driven backward. Clutching the broken saber, he stumbled back two whole steps. But that was as far as he got.

His knee struck the ground.

He looked down at his chest, then at the puppet master’s sword.

The move the puppet master had just used was unmistakably... one of the legendary martial arts passed down through the Qianyang Kingdom since ancient times, the very ninth move of the Boundary-Cleaving Saber Art he himself had just used.

Worse, its level was so high that it seemed like something beyond even the Boundary-Cleaving Saber Art he knew.

‘He didn’t counter with a move that had an advantage over mine. He unleashed the same move after me and knocked mine aside... What kind of heaven-and-earth-shaking ghostly technique is this...?’

“You bastard... how did you... the Boundary-Cleaving Saber Art... how....”

The turtle mask tilted slightly.

A voice tinged with regret came from beneath it.

“That’s not how you’re supposed to do it....”

The gu warrior’s lips twitched.

He tried to say something more, but only blood came out. The broken saber slipped from his hand, and his body slowly toppled sideways.

...

Lee Hyun put away the Profound Gate Sword and looked south.

Faint fluctuations of spiritual power drifted from beyond the distant mountains. The Golden Core Elders and Tier 3 gu warriors still seemed to be moving about in that direction.

‘I need to clean this up quickly.’

The lower abdomen of one fallen gu warrior stirred. Thin strands of tissue writhed between his torn clothing and gaping wound before a long, pale insect revealed itself.

He sensed similar movements from the other corpses.

Inside the spirit-insect pouch, things had already descended into chaos.

The fuzzbees inside the Bonefuzzes were much the same, but Lee Hyun ordered them to yield. Rather than feed the Life-Bound Gu to those that had already become Tier 2 fuzzbees, he intended to give them to the Tier 1 fuzzbees.

Buzz buzz buzz―

When Lee Hyun opened the pouch, golden balls of fur poured out.

One Life-Bound Gu crawled free of a wound and dropped onto the dirt. It twisted its body and tried to burrow into a crack between the stones, but the fuzzbees descending from above swarmed it in an instant.

The aura of the Life-Bound Gu, deprived of its host, was rapidly weakening. Some struggled quite fiercely, but they were no match for the fuzzbees.

Chirp, chirp!

The other bees scattered toward the corpses as well.

While they fed, Lee Hyun collected the eight storage pouches from the bodies.

He did not forget the various spirit tablets worn separately beneath their clothes or the vambraces on their wrists. He also gathered the broken saber, fallen flying blades, shattered shell pieces, and gourd fragments into one place.

After sorting out the spoils, Lee Hyun retrieved the Bonefuzzes one by one.

By the time he had found and collected even the severed fragments of the Bonefuzzes, the fuzzbees had begun returning one after another.

The insects, their bellies swollen, landed on his arms and shoulders.

“If you’re done eating, get inside.”

Chirp.

After confirming that the final bee had entered the spirit-insect pouch, Lee Hyun waved a hand.

Fwoosh―

Flames erupted over the corpses.

He used the Soil-Turning Art to overturn the earth and buried whatever remained after the fire deep underground. He also churned up the patches where large amounts of blood had pooled.

Lee Hyun used the Cleansing Art to remove everything that had gotten on his clothes and body, then left the area.

...

Only after putting some distance between himself and the valley did he remove the mask and black robe.

Lee Hyun changed back into the familiar robes of the Danxiao Sect, straightened his disheveled hair, and lowered himself toward the ground.

His body soon began gliding across the surface while lying flat.

Shhhk―

The undergrowth swept rapidly past him.

Lee Hyun crossed the lower mountainsides using the Reclining Escape Art. Whenever the ridgeline rose higher, he sank into the earth and emerged again on the opposite side. Any place where he detected the presence of people, he gave a wide berth.

‘It’d be nice if I got back before Senior Brother and Senior Sister...’

...

The northern entrance to Qingshi Market.

When Lee Hyun presented his identity token, the disciple standing guard checked the records.

“You’ve returned, Martial Uncle.”

“Nothing unusual happened?”

“No.”

Lee Hyun nodded and went inside.

He was simply returning from the area under his responsibility. There was no reason to avoid anyone’s gaze or appear to be in a hurry.

After stopping by his residence to check his appearance once more, Lee Hyun headed to the Alchemy Hall used by the Yanxia Peak disciples.

The scent of medicinal ingredients being prepared filled the interior.

A Qi Refining disciple approached carrying a jade casket.

“Martial Uncle Li. I separated the medicinal ingredients you mentioned earlier and put them over here.”

“Good work.”

Lee Hyun opened the lid to inspect the medicinal ingredients when hurried footsteps outside came to a stop in front of the door.

“Could we get some Blood-Staunching Powder and Tier 2 Qi-Restoring Pills? They’re for a Foundation Establishment cultivator.”

A moment later, Yue Wugou and Mei Sujun appeared in the doorway. Behind them, two Biluo Sect cultivators stood by the roadside supporting an injured fellow disciple.

Lee Hyun set down the jade casket.

“Were you badly hurt?”

“We’re fine. He’s the one who’s hurt.”

Yue Wugou let out a long breath.

Mei Sujun asked,

“Has Master returned?”

“I haven’t seen him yet.”

Mei Sujun nodded.

The Biluo Sect cultivator had only barely managed to stop the bleeding from his thigh.

Mei Sujun took the medicine bottles brought by the disciple, stepped outside, and handed them to the Biluo Sect cultivators.

“Take him back to your residence first. We’ll report to the Elders.”

The Biluo Sect cultivators briefly thanked her, then hurried away with their injured companion.

...

That evening.

Tan Yunsheng and a Golden Core Elder of the Biluo Sect were seated inside a hall, while Song Qiming, Lee Hyun, and several other disciples stood behind them.

The Biluo Sect cultivator who had finished receiving treatment sat leaning back in a chair, while Yue Wugou and Mei Sujun stood at the front explaining what had happened.

“...So we deployed the formation and held out. If we wanted to break free on our own, we had to force open a path, but those Shenlou Sect bastards kept filling the area with mist. We could barely even tell where the enemy was.”

When Mei Sujun finished, Yue Wugou added,

“The first voice-transmission talisman we sent was cut down right in front of us, and I don’t even know how far the others got. We tried raising a signal too, but....”

Tan Yunsheng nodded.

“And then the puppet master appeared?”

“Yes. All of a sudden, white-bone puppets began crawling out of the ground and from cracks in the rocks.”

Yue Wugou spread both hands.

“They looked like ants about this big. Dozens of them poured out from every direction.”

“Dozens?”

The Biluo Sect Elder repeated the word.

Mei Sujun thought for a moment before answering.

“I think there were around twenty. We didn’t have time to count them exactly.”

“When they all activated their restrictions at once, the gu warriors were slammed into the ground. Then they started raining fireballs on them....”

Yue Wugou slapped the table once with his palm.

“Oh, and he said this was the land of the great Anling Kingdom and told them not to make such a racket.”

Silence fell for a moment.

The Biluo Sect Elder stroked his beard.

“Anling Kingdom....”

Yue Wugou continued.

“The Shenlou Sect cultivators called out ‘Haigu Island’ when they saw him. They seemed to think he was on their side. But when the puppet master attacked immediately anyway, they looked confused too.”

The Biluo Sect Elder considered this for a moment before turning toward Tan Yunsheng.

“Bringing up the Anling Kingdom sounds like nothing more than an excuse. White-bone puppets do match the methods used by the Yin Bird Sect’s Haigu Island branch. He should be around late Foundation Establishment or Great Perfection. Perhaps he is a heaven’s prodigy they have specially nurtured there. He may have held a grudge against someone in the Shenlou Sect, or perhaps he was after something they possessed. Just because the twelve sects have gathered together does not mean all their disciples get along.”

Tan Yunsheng agreed.

“Even so, we cannot conclude that the sects themselves have begun fighting each other.”

“Of course.”

Tan Yunsheng looked around at his disciples.

“If you meet him again, do not assume he is an ally. He merely chose not to attack you this time.”

“We will keep that in mind.”

...

Lee Hyun’s residence.

A Bonefuzz missing one of its forelegs lay on the table.

‘This one will take a little work.’

One of the fuzzbees Lee Hyun had left outside to watch for approaching gu warriors climbed onto the back of his hand. Outside the spirit-insect pouch, a fuzzbee could detect spirit insects from much farther away.

Chirp.

“You fought well too.”

The fuzzbee’s antennae twitched.

Lee Hyun removed the spirit stone from the Bonefuzz. Its glow had dimmed considerably.

He took out the other Bonefuzzes one by one and inspected them as well.

He did not bring them all out at once, just in case someone suddenly broke into his residence. If anything seemed amiss, he was confident he could shove at least one Bonefuzz straight into his storage pouch.

Next, he checked the spoils.

Once he erased the traces of divine sense remaining on the storage pouches and sorted their contents, the floor quickly became packed with items.

He counted the spirit stones first.

One hundred eighty-six mid-grade spirit stones and 2,740 low-grade spirit stones.

“Oh....”

A benevolent look spread across Lee Hyun’s face.

The spirit stones were only the beginning.

Even excluding the damaged ones, there were six usable high-grade magic tools: a set of curved flying blades, a spare gourd, two shields, a pair of vambraces, and a short spear. There were also several mid-grade magic tools and spare weapons.

The final gu warrior’s saber had been quite a good item, but it had already been split in two.

‘I’ll use this as spirit material when I practice the artifact-refining art.’

There were salvageable parts in the shattered shell and gourd as well, so he set aside the fragments that still retained intact formation inscriptions.

The Shenlou Sect cultivator’s storage pouch also contained a shell magic tool whose restrictions had not yet been fully engraved. Beside it were several prepared pearls and various spirit materials.

There were seventeen Tier 2 talismans alone. Some were offensive talismans that unleashed torrents of water and ice blades, while others were earth-attribute defensive talismans or wind-attribute talismans that lightened the body. Most had remained safely tucked away inside the storage pouches.

‘They probably never had time to take them out.’

That was precisely why Lee Hyun had been able to collect them like this.

There were plenty of pills as well.

He found several bottles of cultivation pills used by Foundation Establishment cultivators, including Qi-Restoring Pills, Detoxification Pills, and Blood-Staunching Pills. The amount remaining in each bottle varied, but together they added up to quite a lot.

Among them were several separately sealed small bottles. Inside was a fine powder flecked with red.

‘Dream-Illusion Coral.’

The gu warriors’ storage pouches held another kind of medicine bottle.

They contained medicinal powder made by mixing red crystals of solidified demon blood with medicinal ingredients that replenished qi and blood. Judging from the labels on the bottles and the records found in the storage pouches, they were used to raise Life-Bound Gu.

Lee Hyun gathered those separately.

There were also five jade slips. Excluding maps and transaction records, two contained parts of inheritances.

One was the first half of the Mist-Condensing Art carried by the Shenlou Sect cultivator. It contained methods for using shells and pearls as mediums to raise water mist and gather dispersed fog.

There was nothing about making human figures appear superimposed or deceiving divine sense. Even so, he thought there might be something to learn if he studied it alongside the unfinished shell magic tool.

The other jade slip recorded methods for raising Life-Bound Gu and the changes they underwent before and after molting.

The core cultivation method of the Gu Path was missing, but the ratios of medicinal ingredients mixed into their feed and the signs that appeared when the spirit insects weakened were recorded in considerable detail. After reading several passages, Lee Hyun set the jade slip aside.

‘Unfortunately, none of this looks especially precious... I guess everyone keeps their core inheritances memorized.’

Once he added the Dream-Illusion Coral powder, the pearls of the Mirage Clam, shell fragments that still bore formation inscriptions, and the various spirit materials, even roughly estimating the value of everything took some time.

The spirit stones could be used immediately, but it would be better to keep the magic tools that were clearly characteristic of the Shenlou Sect hidden for the time being. There was no reason to sell them anywhere nearby.

Not unless he wanted to advertise that he was the puppet master who appeared to come from Haigu Island.

Lee Hyun calculated for a moment.

Considering the spirit stones and magic tools he had taken as spoils, he had not suffered a loss in this battle. If anything, he had made a considerable profit.

Whether he would have come away with this much if he had fought using only the Bonefuzzes was another matter.

Having several Bonefuzzes work together to pin down an opponent while using the Fireball Art to break through a Tier 2 gu warrior’s body-protecting spirit light consumed spirit stones far too quickly.

If Lee Hyun had not finished them off himself, there was no telling how many times more he would have needed to pour into the fight. If even one or two Bonefuzzes were completely destroyed in the process, he would also have to pay for new bone material and soul stones.

‘Auto-hunting is still out of the question.’

The fuzzbee lay flat against the back of his hand, pressing its belly down as if sleepy.

Lee Hyun put it into the spirit-insect pouch and brought out another fuzzbee.

While the newly released insect climbed onto the corner of the table and raised its antennae, Lee Hyun inspected the Bonefuzz’s torso again and began writing down ideas for improvements as they occurred to him.

...

For some time afterward, daily life in Qingshi Market did not change much.

The puppet master in the turtle mask never appeared again.

By the time nearly half a year had passed since they arrived at Qingshi Market, strange rumors began to circulate.

Additional Nascent Soul cultivators had appeared on the side of the Nanming Twelve-Sect Alliance, and a major battle had taken place in the direction of the Cang Kingdom.

At the same time, the atmosphere inside the cultivator market slowly began to change. For some reason, everyone seemed anxious.

...

Several days later.

The Foundation Establishment cultivators staying at Qingshi Market had gathered in the central hall.

Disciples of the Danxiao Sect and Biluo Sect filled the seats alongside cultivators from nearby minor sects and cultivation clans. Golden Core Elders sat farther inside.
