On the morning of the fourth day.

Once a larger number of cultivators began leaving the market, Lee Hyun mingled among them and headed north.

For a while, he followed a road frequently used by merchant groups. After crossing a river, he shifted direction slightly and followed a low mountain range.

Then faint presences began moving behind him.

Those presences had been following him from a distance, keeping apart from one another. Once Lee Hyun was sufficiently far from the cultivator market, they gradually closed in.

Lee Hyun surveyed his surroundings with divine sense.

Two more were moving along the ridge ahead.

He descended onto a rocky slope sparsely covered with trees.

A short while later, a streak of blue light landed atop a boulder opposite him.

It was Wei Zongyue.

Two Foundation Establishment cultivators descended behind him. Another remained farther away, blocking Lee Hyun's retreat.

Wei Zongyue looked around once.

"I didn't expect to meet a cultivator from Haigu Island in a place like this."

Lee Hyun silently looked at him.

"As far as I know, your people have no foothold in northern Kun Kingdom. You've come quite a long way."

The blue rings on Wei Zongyue's fingers glowed.

The cultivators spread out to either side also drew their respective magic tools.

Wei Zongyue spoke.

"Did you think I'd be frightened just because you're from the Yin Bird Sect's Haigu Island? You're nothing more than someone who learned a few paltry tricks."

"If you're not afraid, why did you bring so many people?"

"I brought mourners so you wouldn't be lonely on your final journey."

He stepped down from the boulder and rapidly closed the distance between himself and Lee Hyun.

"You let me get this close without even taking out your puppet. It seems you don't have much real combat experience."

Chapter 74

A blue ring on Wei Zongyue's finger flashed, creating a halo of light one chi (about 33 cm) wide in midair.

Within the rippling space inside it, a massive sea hawk with a gleaming beak spread its wings and burst forth.

SKREEE!

The fierce wingbeats of the late Tier 2 spirit beast sent gravel sweeping in all directions across the rocky slope.

At the same time, Wei Zongyue's second ring flashed, and a flat-shelled turtle leaped out and clung to his forearm.

Wei Zongyue gave a vicious grin and charged fiercely at Lee Hyun with his arm thrust out before him.

The turtle's shell gave off spiritual power fluctuations comparable to a supreme-grade magic tool as intense demonic light blazed from it, while behind Lee Hyun, the bird of prey swooped down with its talons extended toward the back of his neck.

At that moment, Lee Hyun's shoulder tilted about half a handspan to the side.

The instant the hawk's talons brushed the collar of his robe, the Sinking Moon Sword left its sheath.

SHING.

Spiritual power from throughout his body surged into the blade at once.

Great Unity Heavenly Dipper, Eleventh Form: Overlapping Strikes.

KRAAANG!

The first sword light deeply caved in the sturdy curtain of demonic light.

Almost simultaneously, the second and third sword lights tore through along the exact same trajectory and smashed straight through the turtle's shell.

CRACK!

The shell shattered into pieces, spraying blood everywhere.

Wei Zongyue recoiled in shock, but with the quick reflexes befitting a Foundation Establishment Great Perfection cultivator, he leaned back and retreated. By then, however, Lee Hyun's blade had already blurred out of his sight.

SHNK.

"AAAAARGH!"

The right foot he was about to plant on the ground was severed, and Wei Zongyue tumbled down over the rocks.

The sea hawk spread its wings and lunged forward, demonic light wrapped around its body as it tried to save its master, but a flash of sword light cleaved through the air.

SLASH!

The hawk plummeted in a spray of blood, landing right in front of the writhing Wei Zongyue.

The startled cultivators on either side launched throwing knives and short spears, but Lee Hyun twisted without lowering his sword, and the Sinking Moon Sword swept out in a low circle.

CLANG! CLANG-CLANG!

The throwing knives shattered and ricocheted away.

Lee Hyun extended his left hand and caught the man who had thrown the spear in the pull of his Earth-Origin Force.

WHOOSH!

The man was helplessly dragged forward. He hurriedly raised his body-protecting spirit light, but a fist formed by the Condensed-Essence Grasping Hand was already right before his eyes.

BOOM!

The man, battered into a bloody mess, went flying and slammed straight into the rock face.

CRUNCH!

The cultivator who had thrown the knives trembled in terror as he tried to pull out a talisman, but,

SHNK!

A sword light grazed his shoulder and severed his arm.

"Eek...!"

The last cultivator blocking the escape route went deathly pale and stumbled backward.

Lee Hyun's shadow fell directly in front of Wei Zongyue, who was crawling across the dirt while clutching the stump of his severed leg.

Then Lee Hyun's foot abruptly froze.

THUD!

The Ground-Sense Art caught a vibration in the earth vein.

Goosebumps rose across Lee Hyun's entire body. Without the slightest hesitation, he shot into the air and pulled the Protective Bell from his storage pouch, flipping it upside down.

HUMM–

The blue-green bell expanded and was just about to envelop his body from below when,

BOOOOM!

The rocky slope exploded from within like a volcano.

Boulders the size of houses blasted in every direction, and an enormous maw surged out through the cloud of dust. Rows of razor-sharp teeth jutted forward and slammed head-on into the Protective Bell.

CRASH!

The Protective Bell shattered instantly.

Lee Hyun slipped through the flying fragments and spun twice in midair. Before he could even steady himself, a massive shadow tore through the stone dust and pursued him.

SWOOSH!

A single beat of its wings pulverized the boulders behind it. Lee Hyun hurriedly swept out his sword and twisted aside, and the talons aimed at his neck struck the sword light in an explosion of sparks.

Golden eyes flashed between its mane.

It had a lion-like head and a sleek body covered in black scales. Two wings sprouted from its back, with long, blade-like feathers extending from their tips, while its mane and tail flowed like waves through the dense mist shrouding its body.

'A Tier 3 spirit beast!?'

The remnants of an Earth Escape Talisman stuck to the spirit beast's chest burned scarlet.

Its fully spread wings cast a shadow over the rocky slope.

A thick iron chain was wrapped around the enormous beast's neck.

CLINK-CLINK.

Lee Hyun's eyes narrowed.

'That sound I heard outside the auction house's private room....'

The iron chain stretched far through the air. At its other end stood a man in a blue robe, and an overwhelming pressure poured from the ring looped around his wrist.

He was a Golden Core cultivator!

Wei Zongyue, still crawling on the ground, coughed up blood and shouted.

"Master! That bastard...!"

'If he's his master, then that must be Perfected Xuanzhao.'

Perfected Xuanzhao looked down at his disciple.

His cold gaze passed over the severed leg and the dying spirit beast.

"My disciple. If you intended to trade on my name, should you not have brought me gains worthy of it?"

"I... I'm sorry! It's just that he... Haigu Island...."

"Haigu Island? I thought you'd only lost a leg. Have you gone blind as well?"

Perfected Xuanzhao's gaze settled on the Sinking Moon Sword in Lee Hyun's hand.

The iron chain ripped through the air like a bolt of lightning.

BOOOOM!

The ridge split in two as rocks and earth erupted upward like a waterfall.

Lee Hyun barely threw himself aside before Perfected Xuanzhao twisted his fingertips above him.

Azure seal-script characters swirled through the air, and an enormous seal formed from water-attribute magical power stamped downward.

THUD!

The air seemed to solidify in an instant.

As though crushed beneath the pressure of the deep sea, Lee Hyun's airborne body plunged straight down.

The very instant his movements were locked in place, the enormous beast below opened its jaws and spewed out sea mist. Dozens of streams of water honed like blades surged upward, threatening to tear his entire body apart.

There was nowhere to retreat.

Lee Hyun twisted the Sinking Moon Sword and slashed upward.

FLASH!

A chilling sword light split the storm-like sea mist. Lee Hyun twisted his body through the opening and savagely cut into the blue seal pressing down from above.

CRACK!

The seal-script characters forming the seal burst apart.

Perfected Xuanzhao's eyes widened.

'A Foundation Establishment cultivator broke my Boat-Sinking Seal?'

Yet even in his surprise, he did not hesitate. Three dark-blue bolts of light, each no larger than a droplet of water, shot from his fingertips.

POP! POP! POP!

Violently compressed currents swirled within the bolts as they hurtled toward Lee Hyun's brow, chest, and shoulder.

The Profound Iron Buckler Lee Hyun hurriedly pulled out screamed under the impact.

SCREEECH! BOOM!

The shield's surface buckled as its restrictions burned away.

Then the massive iron chain came crashing down, folding the shield in half and smashing it into the rock wall.

Lee Hyun severed his divine-sense connection to the shield without hesitation and used the recoil to tumble through the air.

The enormous beast's wing sheared away an entire section of the cliff face. Lee Hyun twisted aside to avoid the debris, only for its gaping jaws to rush straight toward his face.

He pulled out the black-iron longspear and thrust it diagonally beneath the beast's jaw, but the shaft could not withstand its monstrous strength and snapped in two.

CRACK!

Lee Hyun slipped around its side through the opening and swept the Sinking Moon Sword upward in a clean slash.

SHRAK!

Several scales covering its neck fell away as blood welled beneath them, and the enormous beast roared and jerked its head aside.

At that moment, a dark-blue flash shot in from behind Lee Hyun, grazing past his cheek and punching straight through the rock wall.

BOOM!

As fragments of the collapsing rock rained down, Wei Zongyue stared up at the scene in a daze.

'That monster.... He's enduring Master's spirit beast, Black Tide Chain, and techniques one after another?'

Lee Hyun poured all six bronze flying swords from his storage pouch.

"You never run out of trash to pull out."

Along with Perfected Xuanzhao's cold voice, the iron chain swept toward Lee Hyun's ankle.

At the same time, Lee Hyun's flying swords scattered in every direction, shooting toward the chain and the enormous beast's eyes. But Perfected Xuanzhao shifted the chain's trajectory by a handspan, smashing them apart one after another.

Only the final flying sword slipped back inside Lee Hyun's sleeve.

Space warped overhead once more as the blue seal stamped downward, while bolts condensed from immense water-attribute magical power came hurtling in from both sides.

Instead of resisting the crushing pressure, Lee Hyun threw himself in the same direction.

Straight toward the enormous beast's massive head.

Dense sea mist gathered inside its gaping maw, leaving the wound on its neck completely exposed.

Lee Hyun's sword moved with terrifying speed in that instant.

The sword light tore through the wound and burst out behind its ear. As the beast writhed in pain, the demonic light surrounding it shifted to one side.

At that moment, the bronze flying sword shot from Lee Hyun's hand like a lightning bolt, propelled by the principles of the Divine Finger-Flick Art.

BANG!

THUNK–BOOM!

GRAAAARGH!

The flying sword buried deep in the beast's right eye could not withstand Lee Hyun's spiritual power and exploded. As the beast thrashed its head wildly, the sea mist gathered in its mouth erupted in the wrong direction and swallowed the entire mountainside.

Perfected Xuanzhao's face twisted.

He had to pull on the chain and press a Spirit-Commanding Seal between the spirit beast's brows, making his fingertips a beat too slow.

Lee Hyun did not miss that brief opening. Without hesitation, he slipped inside Perfected Xuanzhao's guard.

As the silver-gray sword tip rushed at him, Perfected Xuanzhao moved his fingers.

Protective armor made of scales interlocked in three layers over his chest and blocked the sword.

KRAAANG!

The brilliantly glowing Sinking Moon Sword pressed deeply into the scales.

Veins stood out across Lee Hyun's arm as the spiritual power throughout his body poured into the sword tip.

Perfected Xuanzhao's upper body was forced backward.

'This bastard dares...!'

His iron chain shot forward.

The instant Lee Hyun caught the Black Tide Chain sweeping toward his flank with the Sinking Moon Sword, a blue seal burst from Perfected Xuanzhao's free hand.

Lee Hyun pulled out the Profound Gate Sword with his left hand and met the incoming seal.

The blade bent beneath the overwhelming magical power. Lee Hyun flooded the Profound Gate Sword with a brutal amount of spiritual power all at once, then let go.

BOOOOM!

The Profound Gate Sword exploded.

The blue seal caught in the blast shook violently, and Lee Hyun used the opening to pull away.

One of the razor-sharp fragments scattering in every direction along with the compressed spiritual power grazed Perfected Xuanzhao's cheek.

At the same time, the Black Tide Chain caught against the Sinking Moon Sword slid along its edge.

THUD!

The end of the chain slammed into Lee Hyun's side.

The Qi Sphere Barrier, Spirit Light Shield, and body-protecting spirit light flashed into existence in an instant, and the Black Scale Inner Armor lay beneath his robe, but none of them could fully absorb the heavy impact.

Lee Hyun was hurled away before righting himself, though his side ached slightly.

Perfected Xuanzhao flew into a rage at the fresh blood running down his cheek.

"How dare you!"

Without even wiping away the blood, he brought both hands together.

The scattered sea mist and water-attribute magical power gathered into a massive vortex, and a seal large enough to seemingly swallow the entire mountainside rose into the air.

RRRRUMBLE–

Solid boulders were crushed down into the earth, and the surrounding trees began shattering into pieces all at once.

A massive seal of magical power descended from the sky, the one-eyed spirit beast attacked from the front, and the iron chain swept in from beneath his feet.

Lee Hyun's gaze hardened as he poured an enormous amount of spiritual power into the Sinking Moon Sword.

HUMM.

The Sinking Moon Sword's Light-Retracting Restriction responded, and the edges of its sword light blurred like water mist.

His target was not the spirit beast's neck.

It was the base of its left wing, where the scales had spread apart as it fiercely thrust out its foreleg!

In an instant, Lee Hyun's hand blurred, and the Sinking Moon Sword traced a sweeping arc.

KRAANG!

The chain shot upward to block the sword light, but it failed to fully catch the blurred trajectory and slid aside.

The backlash traveling through the magic treasure forced Perfected Xuanzhao's arm backward, and the deflected sword light carved deep into the inside of the spirit beast's wing.

SPURT!

GRAAAARGH!

With its left wing severed, the enormous beast screamed and plunged toward the cliff.

Perfected Xuanzhao's iron chain pulled taut as he tried to support the falling spirit beast.

'Now!'

Great Unity Heavenly Dipper, Thirteenth Form: Returning Flow.

A mysterious radiance surged from Lee Hyun's blade, and enormous Great Unity Heavenly Dipper Sword Qi swept outward in every direction like a spinning storm!

Perfected Xuanzhao hurriedly pulled back his iron chain.

KRAAAAANG!

The magic treasure and sword qi collided.

Amid the tremendous shock wave, Lee Hyun rode the storm generated by Returning Flow and withdrew in an instant. Evading the blue seal crashing down from above, he shot straight toward the ground.

THUD.

Lee Hyun struck the ground and vanished underground without slowing in the slightest.

Almost simultaneously, the Black Tide Chain smashed into the spot where he had disappeared.

BOOOOM!

The bedrock exploded dozens of zhang (well over 60 m) deep, but the presence Lee Hyun had left within Perfected Xuanzhao's divine sense had already descended deep into the common soil stratum and vanished without a trace.

Perfected Xuanzhao was startled.

'His Earth Escape Art is that fast...?'

...

Perfected Xuanzhao silently looked down at the ruined mountainside.

Behind him, the enormous beast that had lost a wing panted painfully. The sword qi embedded in its wound scattered its demon power, preventing the bleeding from stopping.

Perfected Xuanzhao touched the cut on his cheek with his fingertips.

'What was that bastard?'

His spiritual power fluctuations had clearly been those of a Foundation Establishment cultivator.

But there was no conceivable way a Foundation Establishment cultivator could have unleashed sword strikes capable of forcing back his Black Tide Chain, a magic treasure, and severing the wing of a Tier 3 spirit beast.

'I see. A Golden Core cultivator concealing his realm. What an extraordinarily profound Aura-Concealing Art.... To have mastered it to such a degree. What an utterly sneaky bastard.'

Just then, a voice came from behind him.

"M-Master...."

It was Wei Zongyue.

Supported by a surviving cultivator, he looked up at his master with a deathly pale face.

"Is... is he dead?"

Without answering, Perfected Xuanzhao shifted his gaze to Wei Zongyue's severed leg.

"Tsk, tsk. You're broken now.... I'll need to find a new disciple."

"...What?"

CLINK-CLINK.

The black chain wrapped around Wei Zongyue's waist and lifted him into the air, causing the cultivator supporting him to recoil in terror and let go.

"Master? Master, wait...!"

Perfected Xuanzhao lightly stroked the spirit beast's neck. The enormous beast, bleeding and missing one eye, turned its head toward them with its remaining eye bloodshot red.

The last trace of color drained from Wei Zongyue's face.

"Master! Wait, I...!"

Fifteen days later.

Beneath a remote mountain in northern Xuan Kingdom, Lee Hyun opened his eyes inside a small natural cavern deep underground.

He slowly drew in a breath.

The pain from the bruise on his side had already faded.

Lee Hyun looked down at the items laid out on the ground.

The Black Scale Inner Armor and the Sinking Moon Sword.

Those were all the magic tools he had left.

The Profound Iron Buckler had been smashed apart by the bolts of light and iron chain, while the Protective Bell had shattered as well.

The black-iron longspear had snapped, and he had detonated the Profound Gate Sword himself. He had even lost all six bronze flying swords. Magic tools he had grown accustomed to over many years had been completely wiped out in a single battle.

"Hmm... I did use them for a long time."

He had used some of the magic tools for so long that he could no longer even remember when he had gotten them.

Lee Hyun picked up the Sinking Moon Sword.

The blade shone with a clear silver-gray light, without so much as a scratch.

When he fed a little spiritual power into it, the restrictions within responded smoothly.

'This really was a good purchase.'

While his other magic tools had shattered helplessly before a Golden Core cultivator's magic treasure, only the Sinking Moon Sword had taken a direct strike from that magic treasure and still pierced the spirit beast's hide.

He had never given the importance of magic tools much serious thought before, but after fighting a truly powerful opponent, he realized that the difference in equipment was enormous.

'One reliable exceptional supreme-grade magic tool is better than five mediocre ones.'

Lee Hyun stared at his own eyes reflected in the blade for a long while.

The combat strength of a Golden Core cultivator, something he had experienced for the first time, was overwhelming.

In truth, Perfected Xuanzhao was a beast tamer, so he likely was not particularly strong in close combat.

Even so, the relentless combination of techniques and magic treasure attacks he unleashed at close range had left almost no openings.

'What would have happened if we'd kept fighting?'

Even after such an intense battle, Lee Hyun still had plenty of spiritual power left.

'I think I actually had more spiritual power in sheer quantity.... But because of the difference in the quality of our spiritual power and our equipment, I couldn't guarantee victory. No, there wasn't any reason to fight a life-and-death duel in the first place.'

They had been within the territory of the Nanming Twelve-Sect Alliance. If even one more Golden Core cultivator had appeared, the situation would have become far more dangerous.

There was no need to throw himself into a battle where victory was uncertain. He had plenty of time. He could cultivate slowly, take life easy, and only fight when it was truly necessary.

'It's a bit of a shame that I lost most of my high-grade magic tools, but it's not as though I'm short on spirit stones. If anything, I fought a Golden Core cultivator and came out of it alive, so I gained valuable experience. Now I understand just how powerful Golden Core cultivators are, and how important magic tools and magic treasures can be.'

Lee Hyun sheathed the Sinking Moon Sword.

'If possible, I should get more exceptional supreme-grade magic tools.'

One month later.

At a cultivator market in western Xuan Kingdom.

After passing through streets dyed red by the setting sun, Lee Hyun stopped in the rear courtyard of an old shop on the outskirts of the cultivator market.

Instead of his familiar badger mask, he took out a cicada mask and placed it over his face.

Descending a narrow staircase behind an old warehouse, he found a complex web of underground passages.

When he pressed sections of the stone wall at a dead end in a certain sequence, the wall rotated with a heavy rumble, revealing another staircase leading deeper underground.

After descending for quite some time, he finally arrived in a spacious underground stone chamber.

Three or four cultivators wearing masks of all shapes and designs sat scattered throughout the chamber in silence.

At the center sat a man wearing an eagle-owl mask, radiating an oppressive presence.

He was a Golden Core cultivator!

Sensing Lee Hyun's presence, the eagle-owl mask slowly raised his head and looked at him.

"Newcomer?"

Chapter 75

“This is my first time here, but I’m not a newcomer.”

Lee Hyun answered as he stepped inside.

The eyes behind the eagle-owl mask swept over him from head to toe. The divine sense that briefly brushed against him before withdrawing held no particular hostility.

A cultivator wearing a goose mask, who had been seated by the wall, rose to his feet.

“Did you bring a letter of introduction?”

Lee Hyun handed him a small jade token.

The cultivator in the goose mask flinched after sending his divine sense into the jade token. He looked back and forth between it and Lee Hyun, then promptly returned the token with both hands.

“So you’re Inspector Cicada. I received word about you.”

At those words, the cultivators in the stone chamber all turned their attention toward him, and the man in the eagle-owl mask straightened slightly in his seat.

“Inspector Cicada?”

“That’s right.”

“Then the item we contacted you about before....”

“I brought it.”

The man in the eagle-owl mask rose from his seat.

“It seems I misjudged our guest. This way.”

He opened a stone door in one wall, and Lee Hyun followed him inside.

Once the stone door closed, the sounds from outside grew faint.

It was a private room furnished with a small table and chairs, and restrictions were engraved into the walls to prevent divine sense from passing through.

“Have a seat.”

The man in the eagle-owl mask gestured with one hand.

Lee Hyun sat across from him and studied the man.

A Golden Core cultivator.

Once, Lee Hyun would never have dared sit at the same table as a cultivator of such a lofty realm. Now, the man was personally offering him a seat.

Of course, Cicada was not receiving such treatment merely because he was an inspector of the Two Heavens Society.

The other man was hoping for something from Inspector Cicada.

Lee Hyun took a small jade bottle from his storage pouch.

When he removed the Spirit-Sealing Talisman and opened the stopper, a faint medicinal fragrance drifted out.

The eagle-owl-masked man’s gaze immediately fixed on the jade bottle.

“Please take a look.”

A round pill rolled out onto the table.

The man in the eagle-owl mask picked it up between his fingertips.

He examined its color, smelled its medicinal fragrance, then slowly sent a thin thread of divine sense into it. After remaining silent for quite some time, he nodded.

“It is indeed a Foundation Establishment Pill. Its medicinal strength is sufficient as well.”

“It was refined fairly recently.”

“So it seems. It has been well preserved too....”

The man in the eagle-owl mask carefully set the pill down.

Lee Hyun looked at the jade bottle.

Of the seventy-two Foundation Establishment Pills he had made when breaking through to Whole-Body Foundation Establishment, he had consumed sixty and kept the remaining twelve.

It had been less than two years since they were refined, and they had remained sealed with Spirit-Sealing Talismans the entire time, so there was no reason for much of their medicinal strength to have dissipated.

The man in the eagle-owl mask spoke.

“I was worried you might not be able to obtain the full quantity I requested. Foundation Establishment Pills are not particularly expensive to a cultivator of my realm, but regardless of their price, they are remarkably difficult to acquire.”

“Fortunately, Society Head procured them for us.”

“Then I should show you the item I promised as well.”

The man in the eagle-owl mask flicked his sleeve.

Clack.

A long blue-green metal plate appeared on the table.

It was about the length of an adult man’s forearm, and its surface was densely covered with lines resembling leaf veins.

Lee Hyun’s gaze moved to the side of the metal plate.

Six thin plates were stacked together without the slightest gap.

“The Six-Leaf Shield.”

The man in the eagle-owl mask lightly tapped one of the shield plates with his finger, producing a clear metallic ring.

“It is an artifact this old man once used.”

He stroked the shield plates for a moment.

“Since acquiring a defensive magic treasure, I have had no reason to take it out, but there was a time when I treasured it as dearly as my own life.”

The man in the eagle-owl mask infused it with energy, and the stacked shield plates slowly separated.

Shrrrk.

Six blue-green leaves rose above the table.

Each shield plate curved gently along one face. Tiny silver formation inscriptions repeatedly appeared and vanished between the lines that resembled leaf veins.

Lee Hyun examined the magic tool closely.

He noted the curved surfaces, the diagonally beveled edges, and the slightly different arrangement of formation inscriptions on each shield plate.

It was clearly a magic tool designed to be used with all six plates moving together.

“It is even listed in 《Yunzhou Artifact Appraisal》. I hear the latest edition ranks it eighty-third.”

Yunzhou Artifact Appraisal.

Lee Hyun had heard the name before while serving as society head of the Two Heavens Society.

The nine nearby cultivation nations, including Xuan Kingdom and Xu Kingdom, were collectively known as the Nine Kingdoms of Yunzhou.

The Nine Kingdoms of Yunzhou referred to the cultivation nations north of Kun Kingdom, and their territory did not overlap with that of the Nanming Twelve-Sect Alliance.

Yunzhou Artifact Appraisal compiled the assessments of numerous artifact refiners and appraisers to rank the two hundred finest magic tools circulating among those nine nations.

What did it mean to rank among the two hundred finest magic tools in the Nine Kingdoms of Yunzhou?

There were tens of thousands of Foundation Establishment cultivators in those nations alone. Between them, they must have possessed at least a hundred thousand magic tools.

Simply ranking among the top two hundred made it a rare treasure, one that would be difficult even to lay eyes on no matter how many ordinary cultivator markets one searched.

Yunzhou Artifact Appraisal was similar in nature to the Nanming Hundred Artifacts Register, differing only in the region it covered.

Cultivators seemed rather fond of comparing things and assigning them rankings.

Mortals regarded cultivators as Immortals, but from what Lee Hyun had seen, the cultivators of the lower world were at least quite far removed from the Immortals mortals imagined.

If anything, they were even more worldly and greedy than mortals.

Lee Hyun studied the floating Six-Leaf Shield.

If it ranked eighty-third in Yunzhou Artifact Appraisal, then not only was it an exceptional supreme-grade magic tool, but depending on how it was used, it might even be better than the Sinking Moon Sword, which ranked eighth in the Nanming Hundred Artifacts Register.

Even among exceptional supreme-grade magic tools, their purposes differed, and rankings were influenced not only by actual performance but also by recognition and the reputation of their users.

“The restrictions seem to be linked together.”

“That’s right. The force striking one plate can be distributed across the others.”

“Impressive.”

The man in the eagle-owl mask moved his hand.

The six shield plates spun in a circle, then instantly converged into a large shield with their edges slightly overlapping.

A moment later, they separated again and moved around him to the front, rear, left, and right.

“You can gather them together to block in one direction, or separate them to defend from all sides. Against a powerful attack, however, it is better to stack the shield plates or interlock them at an angle.”

“Can it withstand an attack from a magic treasure?”

The man in the eagle-owl mask nodded.

“It can. It will not be damaged merely by clashing with a low-grade magic treasure.”

The man in the eagle-owl mask continued.

“That does not mean I am telling you to fight someone wielding a magic treasure. Fighting a Golden Core cultivator is a foolish thing to do regardless.”

“Of course.”

“And... there is one problem. Judging solely by its defensive power, it would not be strange for it to rank even higher. This is also why it does not.”

The man in the eagle-owl mask withdrew his hand, and the Six-Leaf Shield stacked itself plate by plate before settling onto the table.

“What is it?”

“It consumes a great deal of spiritual power. When you move only one or two plates, it is manageable enough. But if all six restrictions are linked and you take a powerful attack, you can actually feel your spiritual power draining away. Even this old man could only use it properly after reaching Foundation Establishment Great Perfection.”

“May I try controlling it myself?”

“Of course. Infuse it with your spiritual power.”

Lee Hyun placed a hand on the Six-Leaf Shield and sent spiritual power into it.

Before long, all six shield plates on the table rose into the air.

He immediately began changing their positions. Two plates stacked in front of him while the others moved to either side and behind his back, and there was no noticeable resistance in their movement.

The positions and angles of the shield plates shifted constantly through a variety of configurations.

The man in the eagle-owl mask was startled.

‘He may be an inspector of the Two Heavens Society, but he’s only a mid Foundation Establishment cultivator at best... and he can control it this easily on his very first attempt?’

In addition to powerful divine sense and abundant spiritual power, Lee Hyun possessed Tier-2 artifact-refining art and considerable attainments in formations, allowing him to quickly grasp the magic tool’s structure.

Hummm.

As faint azure light connected the shield plates, the rate at which his spiritual power drained noticeably increased.

‘As expected... an ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivator would have trouble using this.’

But consumption at this level placed little burden on Lee Hyun.

The man in the eagle-owl mask waited for a while, yet there was no change in Cicada’s breathing or the flow of his spiritual power.

‘Impressive. It seems becoming an inspector directly under the society head truly isn’t a position entrusted to just anyone.’

Lee Hyun spoke.

“Are you sure you want to sell such a fine item instead of passing it down to your disciples?”

The man in the eagle-owl mask looked down at the Six-Leaf Shield.

“Unfortunately, none of them are likely to become capable of handling an exceptional supreme-grade magic tool anytime soon. Most are younger fellows who need Foundation Establishment Pills far more.”

The man in the eagle-owl mask had apparently once served as an Elder of a small sect in Xuan Kingdom.

A few years ago, its sect master had been murdered and the sect had collapsed, scattering its surviving members in all directions. The man in the eagle-owl mask seemed to have taken several disciples who followed him and founded another small sect.

“With Senior’s realm, other sects would surely welcome you.”

“I cannot allow the lineage of my sect to end with my generation.”

“To devote yourself to those below you even after reaching such a realm... Senior’s disciples are fortunate indeed.”

“Hoho, there’s nothing particularly remarkable about it. Some are of my own blood, and I am old in any case. I’m only at early Golden Core and have no hope of becoming a Nascent Soul cultivator....”

The man in the eagle-owl mask continued.

“In any case, the Two Heavens Society is convenient. I don’t have to reveal my name or my disciples’ backgrounds every time I make a transaction.”

He lightly pointed at the jade bottle.

“Though I never expected it would be able to procure something like this.”

“Society Head will surely hope our dealings continue regularly as well.”

“Just who is Society Head? A Golden Core cultivator? And how long has the Two Heavens Society existed?”

“I don’t know that myself.”

The man in the eagle-owl mask pushed the Six-Leaf Shield toward the center of the table.

“In any case, I’ll make the trade. Nine Foundation Establishment Pills and five hundred mid-grade spirit stones. You can still honor the terms we agreed on before, yes? They haven’t changed at this late stage, have they?”

“Of course not.”

The man in the eagle-owl mask inspected the Foundation Establishment Pills one by one, while Lee Hyun watched as the ownership imprint remaining inside the Six-Leaf Shield was thoroughly erased.

After receiving the spirit stones as well, the man in the eagle-owl mask took out another small jade slip.

“It contains the Six-Leaf Shield’s artifact-control formula, along with some observations this old man made while using it.”

“Thank you.”

Lee Hyun put away the jade slip and the Six-Leaf Shield. He resealed the remaining three Foundation Establishment Pills and returned them to his storage pouch.

...

After the man in the eagle-owl mask left first, Lee Hyun called the cultivator in the goose mask aside.

“Show me the recent transaction records of the organizations under your command.”

“Yes, Inspector.”

The cultivator in the goose mask took out several jade slips he had prepared.

Lee Hyun read through them one after another.

“As expected, pills make up the largest share of trade.”

“That’s right. Cultivators are always short of pills. Fortunately, Xuan Kingdom has many rogue cultivator alchemists who carry on the lineages of former Danxiao Sect members who joined the Two Heavens Society in large numbers long ago, so we also have many members selling pills.”

“Are Poison-Warding Pills, Bone-Forging Powder, Spirit-Calming Pills, Origin-Opening Pills, and Profundity-Penetrating Pills in high demand?”

“Bone-Forging Powder? Baoguang Temple in Xu Kingdom buys it steadily. The same goes for Poison-Warding Pills.”

The cultivator in the goose mask paused briefly, then added.

“Spirit-Calming Pills sell well across even more countries. They would likely be popular anywhere in the Nine Kingdoms of Yunzhou. Pills that temper divine sense are extremely rare. I have never personally handled Origin-Opening Pills or Profundity-Penetrating Pills, so I cannot say for certain, but I’m sure they would be popular as well.”

“I see. I intend to entrust you with small quantities of those five. Look into selling them for me.”

“You’ll be supplying the goods?”

“That’s right. The Two Heavens Society has capable alchemists.”

“Haha, it is an honor to be given work by you, Inspector, but I worry whether I can represent the Two Heavens Society properly....”

“Don’t worry. I’m not assigning this only to you. Several branches will be given the same request, so there’s no need to feel too burdened. Just charge the brokerage fee according to the rules.”

The cultivator in the goose mask sounded a little more cheerful.

“There are also some things I want you to acquire.”

“Please tell me.”

“Purchase small quantities of various cultivation pills suitable for Foundation Establishment cultivators. The Two Heavens Society is studying the pill market. It doesn’t matter if they are made by members of the society itself.”

“Understood.”

Lee Hyun put down the last jade slip.

“And gather information about exceptional supreme-grade magic tools as well. Defensive magic tools such as enchanted robes and inner armor, offensive magic tools, anything is fine as long as it is worthwhile.”

The cultivator in the goose mask asked cautiously.

“Should I go so far as to purchase them?”

“No. Information only. They can be items coming up for auction or ones private owners are looking to sell. If there are artifact refiners who accept custom commissions, find out about them too. I’ll decide after seeing the goods.”

“Understood.”

Two months later.

Tunnel No. 3.

Six blue-green shield plates moved rapidly through the spacious cavern.

Shrrrk!

The shield plates that had gathered on Lee Hyun’s left suddenly scattered, then interlocked diagonally above his head.

They immediately began revolving around his waist before splitting into pairs and moving between his front, rear, left, and right.

When Lee Hyun curled a finger, all six shield plates stacked together at once.

Click.

Their movements were far smoother than when he had first obtained them.

The time he had spent bonding with the artifact and practicing its artifact-control formula had paid off.

‘Using it together with the Sinking Moon Sword should be no problem. Still, I should keep practicing until I’m fully accustomed to it.’

Lee Hyun put away the Six-Leaf Shield and walked toward the spirit fields.

Several Bonefuzzes in the distance raised their heads.

“Chirp!”

A ball of golden fluff poked its face out from inside one of the skeletons.

When Lee Hyun raised a hand, the fuzzbee promptly ducked back inside. Bonefuzzes had always been popular with the fuzzbees, and the little fellows treated the insides of the skeletons as their own homes.

Familiar medicinal fragrances drifted between the spirit fields.

They came from Yin Soul Grass, Purple Poison Orchids, and Bone-Rot Flowers.

Among the older plants were younger spirit plants that had been planted at staggered times.

Lee Hyun walked slowly while inspecting those suitable for alchemy.

Whenever he dug up and used spirit plants of the proper medicine age from a spirit field, he replanted seedlings in the empty spaces.

Anything planted now would take a long time before it could be used, but there was nothing wrong with having spirit plants of various medicine ages growing together.

The same applied to the main ingredients of Foundation Establishment Pills. He had replanted young seedlings in the spaces left behind after harvesting, which seemed likely to form the basis for steadily supplying the Two Heavens Society with Foundation Establishment Pills in the long term.

Since Lee Hyun cultivated the plants and performed the alchemy alone, the quantities were not enormous. Even so, the mere fact that the Two Heavens Society could independently supply a certain number of Foundation Establishment Pills when necessary would make it appear to be an organization with substantial reserves.

As Lee Hyun inspected the spirit fields, he stopped in front of the Spirit-Storing Ginseng.

He gently pushed aside the leaves, examined the color of the roots protruding slightly above the soil, then checked the record planted beside the spirit field.

‘These have passed 380 years as well.’

Lee Hyun took a jade slip containing a pill recipe from his storage pouch.

Origin-Opening Pill.

It was a pill used to advance from Foundation Establishment Stage 3 to Stage 4, and according to its pill recipe, the acceptable medicine-age range for Spirit-Storing Ginseng was from 200 to 390 years.

‘At this rate, they might exceed the medicine-age limit.’

In this place, three years had to pass for a spirit plant’s actual medicine age to increase by roughly one year, so he still had close to thirty years to spare.

But if he cultivated without thinking and let another hundred or two hundred years pass as he had in the past, the Spirit-Storing Ginseng before him would no longer be usable as an ingredient for Origin-Opening Pills.

Pills used to break through minor-realm bottlenecks were not easy to obtain in large quantities, so it was more convenient to refine and consume them himself whenever possible.

Lee Hyun examined another jade slip.

Profundity-Penetrating Pill.

It was a pill used to advance from Foundation Establishment Stage 6 to Stage 7.

This recipe also required Spirit-Storing Ginseng, but the acceptable medicine-age range was wider, from 250 to 450 years.

Midnight-Noon Grass, another main ingredient, likewise had an upper medicine-age limit of 450 years. Its current medicine age was more than 150 years lower than that of the Spirit-Storing Ginseng, giving him even more time.

‘The spirit plants for Profundity-Penetrating Pills are still nowhere near exceeding their medicine-age limits, so there’s no need to rush to Foundation Establishment Stage 6....’

Lee Hyun counted on his fingers.

‘The main ingredients for Origin-Opening Pills need to be harvested within thirty years at the latest. I could refine them ahead of time and seal them away... but if possible, it would be better to refine and consume them as soon as they’re harvested....’

The problem was that he needed to raise his entire body to Foundation Establishment Stage 3 before he could properly use an Origin-Opening Pill, while it was currently only at Foundation Establishment Stage 1.

That was also why Lee Hyun had ordered members of the Two Heavens Society to collect various cultivation pills for Foundation Establishment cultivators.

If he found pills with decent effects, he intended to purchase them in bulk with spirit stones and accelerate his cultivation.

‘First, let’s hurry and push it to late Stage 3. I’m rich, after all.’

...

After returning to the cultivation chamber, Lee Hyun took out several small jade bottles.

They contained Tier-2 pills for spiritual-power cultivation that a few branches had recently acquired for him.

Each bottle was labeled with the pill’s name and price, along with a brief description of its medicinal potency.

When he opened one bottle, a clear medicinal fragrance spread through the air.

Lee Hyun took out a pill, examined it briefly, then placed it in his mouth.

Gulp.

After that, he began taking each type of pill on different days to test its effects.

When choosing pills, medicinal strength was important, but so were the time needed to refine their medicinal strength, the burden they left on the body, and above all, how much cultivation progress he actually gained per spirit stone spent.

After spending nearly half a year testing pills and preparing a supply of pills for sale, Lee Hyun finally began cultivating in earnest.

Eleven years later.

The cultivation chamber in Tunnel No. 3.

Dense spirit light rippled over Lee Hyun’s reclining body.

The light began at his chest and spread into his limbs before eventually seeping evenly throughout his body from head to toe.

Huuuummm―

Liquid spiritual power flowed slowly beneath his skin.

Every part of his body outside the lower dantian produced spiritual power that was denser than before. Lee Hyun guided it without haste, circulating it through his entire body several times.

A long while later.

He slowly opened his eyes.

“Finally, Stage 3.”

Whole-Body Foundation Establishment Stage 3.

It had taken five years to reach Stage 2, then another six years of cultivation to reach this point.

Lee Hyun sat up and opened and closed his hand.

A thin layer of blue spirit light covered his skin before fading away. Even though he used the same hand seal, the power he could draw up from his entire body was noticeably greater.

He removed the stone tablet attached to the wall, used the Soil-Softening Art to erase the old writing, then carved new words into it with the Yang Metal Art.

【Age: 2,154】

【Realm: Foundation Establishment Stage 6 (lower dantian), Foundation Establishment Stage 3 (rest of body)】

【Spiritual Power: 3,672 → 5,828】

【Constitution: Primordial Body, Foundation Establishment Stage 3】

【Cultivation Art: Primordial One-Qi Art (Foundation Establishment Section)】

Lee Hyun floated the stone tablet in front of himself and admired it for quite some time.

His mood remained excellent until he looked at the ledger lying beside it.

...

Over the past eleven years, he had consumed a total of 3,600 cultivation pills.

That number excluded the ones he had taken while initially testing their effects, as well as pills used for detoxification or recovery.

He had mainly consumed three kinds.

Essence-Augmenting Pills, Dew-Condensing Pills, and Jade Marrow Pills.

All three were Tier-2 pills used by Foundation Establishment cultivators to accumulate spiritual power, but their medicinal potency and prices differed.

Essence-Augmenting Pills released their medicinal strength evenly, making it easy to refine within the body. Including brokerage fees, their average purchase price was three mid-grade spirit stones each, and these were the pills he consumed most often.

Dew-Condensing Pills had slightly weaker medicinal strength, but they were mild in nature and cost around two mid-grade spirit stones each. He mainly took them when the effects of Essence-Augmenting Pills began to diminish or when his meridians needed time to rest.

Jade Marrow Pills possessed the strongest medicinal strength of the three. Even after their medicinal strength had been absorbed, heat lingered in his meridians, but when taken while his body was in good condition, they produced clear progress in his cultivation. Each cost around four mid-grade spirit stones.

In total, he had spent 10,200 spirit stones.

And that was entirely in mid-grade spirit stones!

‘To think I ate my way through enough money to buy five Sinking Moon Swords and still have some left....’

Lee Hyun touched his somewhat lighter storage pouch.

‘Spending spirit stones really does make things faster.’

Had he not taken pills, there was no telling how much longer it would have taken to reach the same realm.

Lee Hyun had also taken the effect on the market into account when purchasing pills.

If a single branch continuously bought only one type, the supply would diminish and the price would rise. Whenever that happened, he sourced goods from another region or increased the proportion of other pills.

It would have been far more troublesome if the Two Heavens Society had not extended across several cultivation nations.

Most of the spirit stones needed for his cultivation were earned through alchemy.

Over the past eleven years, he had sold around one thousand packets of Tier-2 Bone-Forging Powder through the Two Heavens Society, along with nine hundred Poison-Warding Pills and six hundred Spirit-Calming Pills.

Before brokerage fees, their sale prices were generally two mid-grade spirit stones per packet of Bone-Forging Powder, three per Poison-Warding Pill, and nine per Spirit-Calming Pill.

He had also released two hundred forty Origin-Opening Pills and sixty Profundity-Penetrating Pills in several batches.

Origin-Opening Pills sold for around ten mid-grade spirit stones each, while Profundity-Penetrating Pills sold for about twenty.

Altogether, the proceeds came to roughly 13,700 mid-grade spirit stones.

However, around three thousand were spent just on supplementary medicinal ingredients, replenishing supplies needed for alchemy, and paying the Two Heavens Society’s brokerage fees.

He made pills and sold them, bought pills to consume with the spirit stones he earned, then made more pills.

Whenever he needed a large sum of money, he also separately sold spirit plants with high medicine ages. Over those eleven years, he had additionally sold two Tier-3 Yin Soul Grass plants and two Purple Poison Orchids.

Lee Hyun opened his spirit-plant ledger.

The main ingredients consumed in refining Bone-Forging Powder, Poison-Warding Pills, and Spirit-Calming Pills for sale amounted to one hundred twenty Bone-Rot Flowers, one hundred seventy Purple Poison Orchids, and one hundred eighty Yin Soul Grass plants respectively.

All of them had been selected from later generations of spirit plants sown at staggered times, choosing those whose medicine ages suited the Tier-2 pill recipes.

Once he grew proficient, a successful furnace batch generally yielded ten packets of Bone-Forging Powder, six Poison-Warding Pills, or four Spirit-Calming Pills.

The quantities of main ingredients recorded in the ledger also included those lost to failed alchemy attempts or discarded along the way.

...

Of course, consuming that many pills had not been entirely without consequences.

Even mild cultivation pills caused pill toxins to accumulate in the body after thousands were consumed.

Whenever that happened, Lee Hyun stopped taking them and sat beside the pond in the spirit fields. He peeled and ate Yin Water Lotus seeds while breathing slowly, pushing the turbid qi out of his body.

During this process, he also made an unexpected discovery.

It was the Stone Honey Peach.

One day, after taking Jade Marrow Pills repeatedly, Lee Hyun noticed that even after expelling most of the pill toxins, his mouth remained dry and heat still lingered in his meridians.

Out of habit, he picked a Stone Honey Peach and bit into it.

A short while later, however, the cool energy spreading from his stomach felt unusually distinct, and his parched meridians gradually began to relax.

‘Huh?’

After trying them several more times whenever similar symptoms appeared, he found that on days when he ate a Stone Honey Peach, both the heat and thirst subsided more quickly. His spiritual power also flowed much more smoothly when he began his next qi circulation.

This was especially true of fruit picked from the three oldest trees.

They seemed to help restore a body that had grown stiff from repeatedly absorbing powerful medicinal strength.

...

Lee Hyun closed the ledger and rose from his seat.

‘I should stop taking pills for a while. Once my body has recovered, I’ll finish cultivating to the peak of Stage 3.’

...

Some time later.

A Two Heavens Society contact point in western Xuan Kingdom.

The cultivator in the goose mask placed two jade slips in front of Lee Hyun.

One contained the settlement details from their previous transactions, but the other was unfamiliar.

“What is this?”

“We’ve finally received information about an exceptional supreme-grade magic tool. It actually ranks fifty-sixth in Yunzhou Artifact Appraisal.”

TL NOTE:

Cover Drop:

Chapter 76

“What kind of magic tool is it?”

Goose slid a jade slip forward.

“The Three-Molt Silkworm Robe. It’s said to be an exceptional supreme-grade enchanted robe worn beneath one’s outer garments.”

“A silkworm robe....”

Lee Hyun infused the jade slip with divine sense.

An image of a thin silk garment that covered the entire body appeared, along with a brief description. Three small cocoon-like designs were embroidered in gold thread on the inside of the chest.

「Yunzhou Artifact Appraisal, Rank 56: Three-Molt Silkworm Robe.」

It was described as an enchanted robe made by refining the shed skin of a Tier-3 spirit insect, protecting its owner through three molts.

“Does the magic tool become useless after three uses?”

“No. The spirit molts formed by the robe as it absorbs spiritual power tear apart in its place to block attacks. After they’re used, spend some time nurturing the robe and new spirit molts will form. The robe itself also has defensive properties, so a spirit molt is only shed when it takes an attack too powerful for the robe itself to withstand.”

“I see.”

‘I can sell the Black Scale Inner Armor and wear this instead.’

If the Six-Leaf Shield blocked attacks from the front while the Three-Molt Silkworm Robe caught anything that slipped through, he would feel much safer.

“Where is the item being offered?”

“At Yinyue Valley Market in western Heng Kingdom. I’m told it’ll appear at a private exchange meeting held in fifteen days.”

Heng Kingdom was a Tier-4 cultivation nation east of Xuan Kingdom.

“What’s a private exchange meeting?”

“It’s a gathering where cultivators who have been introduced to one another bring out items and trade among themselves. It’s similar to a small auction. You can think of it as a way to avoid the fees charged by large auctions.”

“Were you the one who contacted the other party?”

“Yes. I’ve traded several times with a cultivator there who brokers goods.”

“Then come with me. I’ll need you to guide the way.”

Fifteen days later.

A gentle valley nestled among the low mountains of western Heng Kingdom.

Inside a mist-shrouded Tier-2 grand formation stood rows of halls and shops, while channels diverted from a river flowed between the alleys.

The valley glowed faintly beneath the moonlight.

Yinyue Valley Market was jointly operated by three nearby Foundation Establishment clans. Built around a Tier-2 spirit vein, most of the cultivators who came and went were at Qi Refining or Foundation Establishment.

It was a relatively small cultivator market for an exceptional supreme-grade magic tool to appear in, but some Foundation Establishment cultivators actually preferred smaller markets like this, so it was nothing particularly unusual.

Goose led the way into a shop deep within an alley.

The shopkeeper checked the jade token Goose presented, then immediately opened the rear door.

“Two of you?”

“That’s right.”

“They’re waiting inside.”

Beyond a long corridor lay a small garden.

Around twenty cultivators were seated inside the hall across the garden. Most had concealed either their faces or their auras.

Tea had been set on every table, but no one was drinking it.

Quiet glances passed back and forth as everyone studied each other’s clothing, storage pouches, and the fluctuations of spiritual power they revealed.

‘Doesn’t look like there are any Golden Core cultivators.’

Lee Hyun first examined the hall’s structure and restrictions.

It was an ordinary formation that blocked divine sense from outside and prevented sound from leaking out. There was also a defensive formation around the garden, but it did not look capable of lasting long if several Foundation Establishment cultivators clashed.

A veiled female cultivator rose from farther inside.

“You must be the ones from the Two Heavens Society I’ve heard about.”

When Goose nodded, several cultivators glanced briefly at the two of them.

The woman asked for no further introductions and simply gestured toward a table.

“Please sit.”

...

Once the remaining guests had taken their seats, the female cultivator spread a faded silkworm robe across the table.

Aside from the gold embroidery on the chest, the garment had no other decoration.

“This is the Three-Molt Silkworm Robe. It is indeed the item recorded in Yunzhou Artifact Appraisal. Please examine it first.”

She took out a wooden doll the size of her palm and infused spiritual power into the robe. The garment shrank and wrapped itself around the doll.

Then a blue flying sword rose from the female cultivator’s sleeve.

Whoosh!

The flying sword slashed down at the doll’s chest.

At that instant, a single molt swelled outward from the doll’s body.

Rip!

The molt, pierced by the blade, tore apart and peeled away. The flying sword was caught inside it and jerked to a sudden halt.

As the molt scattered into fine threads, the completely unscathed doll was revealed.

One of the cocoons embroidered on the chest had lost its glow.

“When struck by a powerful attack, it sheds one layer like this to block it. It can even withstand a single blow from a low-grade magic treasure.”

“What happens once all three layers are used?”

One cultivator asked.

“It must be nurtured again. That takes around ten days. However, if the robe is attacked after all three layers have been shed, the robe itself may be damaged.”

Once the female cultivator recalled her flying sword, Lee Hyun also stepped forward to inspect the robe.

It was thin and light. When he sent spiritual power through his fingertips, he could sense the overlapping restrictions woven into its interior.

Their level was extremely high. Even Lee Hyun, who considered himself to have at least reached the threshold of a Tier-2 artifact refiner, could not imagine reproducing something like this.

The Three-Molt Silkworm Robe was closer to the work of a Tier-3 artifact refiner capable of crafting magic treasures.

The other cultivators examined the item one after another.

Once the appraisal was over, the female cultivator placed the robe in the center of the table.

“I will only accept mid-grade spirit stones. Bidding starts at five hundred.”

“Six hundred.”

“Seven hundred.”

Two cultivators called out prices in succession.

A low voice came from across the room.

“Eight hundred.”

It belonged to a man in a yellow robe.

His eyebrows were unusually thick, and black metal rings encircled two fingers of his right hand. He gave off the aura of late Foundation Establishment.

When he looked around, the cultivators who had bid earlier fell silent.

Lee Hyun spoke.

“One thousand.”

The man’s gaze shifted toward him.

“Eleven hundred.”

“Twelve hundred.”

Lee Hyun answered immediately.

For the past decade or so, he had covered the cost of pills for his cultivation through alchemy. Combined with the money he had separately earned from selling Tier-3 Yin Soul Grass and Purple Poison Orchids, this had left him with roughly 4,000 mid-grade spirit stones in his storage pouch.

The yellow-robed man paused for a moment.

“Twelve hundred and fifty.”

“Thirteen hundred.”

The man’s eyes narrowed.

The female cultivator’s voice brightened.

“Any higher bids? This is by no means an expensive price. At a large auction, it would certainly have gone higher.”

Instead of raising the price, the yellow-robed man looked Lee Hyun up and down.

The Cicada mask, the robe, the storage pouch at his waist.

Eventually, the corners of his mouth curled upward.

“You said you were from the Two Heavens Society? I’ve heard of you. They say you’re vein vermin who cling beneath other people’s spirit veins and suck away their spiritual qi.”

Goose spoke.

“That is going too far.”

“Is that why you’re wearing a cicada mask?”

The man laughed, and a cultivator beside him snickered as well.

“The bugs have managed to save quite a few spirit stones. Is that the money you saved by stealing other people’s spiritual qi?”

Lee Hyun looked at the female cultivator.

“If no one else intends to bid, I would like to complete the transaction.”

The smile vanished from the yellow-robed man’s face.

Three cultivators seated near him slowly rose.

One walked toward the door, while the other two positioned themselves on either side of the table.

Goose’s shoulders stiffened.

“Withdraw your bid.”

The yellow-robed man spoke.

“I’ll be taking that robe.”

“Fellow Daoist.”

A middle-aged steward seated farther inside the hall rose to his feet.

“The item goes to whoever offers the highest price. In this market....”

“Steward, you should concern yourself with the other guests. We are speaking among ourselves, are we not?”

The steward looked at the four men now spread around the room and could not immediately continue. None of them looked easy to deal with, and as someone affiliated with a Foundation Establishment clan, he was reluctant to make enemies of them.

Goose stepped forward.

“If you want the item, then bid for it. How can you disrupt a trade like this?”

The man twitched his fingers, and a thin beam of light shot from one of the black rings.

Whoosh!

The beam aimed at Goose’s throat curved through the air like a snake.

“Since when does a bug get to lecture me....”

Shrrk!

A teal shield plate slid between them.

Clang!

The beam struck the shield plate and ricocheted away.

Just as Goose hurriedly began drawing on his spiritual power, Lee Hyun’s voice sounded.

“Stay behind me.”

The remaining five shield plates appeared in succession.

At the same time, the cultivators on either side moved.

Flying swords and flying blades came at them from every direction. The cultivator beside the door also raised both hands and formed a hand seal.

The yellow-robed man bared his teeth.

Clang! Claaang!

The flying swords and flying blades were stopped by the Six-Leaf Shield.

One shield plate tilted toward two slender golden needles that had slipped beneath the others.

Ting-ting!

The golden needles struck the teal shield plate and bounced away.

At that instant.

The sword drawn by the Cicada-masked figure was already blazing with intense light.

Flash!

Cross-shaped lightning erupted inside the hall.

BOOOOM!

Four streaks of sword light engulfed the four cultivators.

Boom! CRACK!

Sword scars starting at the Cicada-masked figure’s feet stretched all the way outside the hall.

Once the room fell silent, the cultivators who had retreated came closer to inspect the surroundings.

“.......”

The yellow-robed man had been cleaved in half along with his black shield.

The cultivator beside him had been bisected while still twisted in the posture of trying to dodge.

A hole had been blasted through the chest of the cultivator holding a flying blade, while the last cultivator had been torn open from shoulder to waist before he could even use the talisman in his hand.

Someone sucked in a breath.

The steward overseeing the exchange meeting stood frozen in shock, while the female cultivator had already gathered up the Three-Molt Silkworm Robe and could not take her eyes off Lee Hyun.

The Sinking Moon Sword slid back into its sheath.

Shnk.

At the sound, a nearby cultivator flinched.

Goose stood behind Lee Hyun with his mouth hanging open.

‘...What?’

There had been four of them.

One late Foundation Establishment cultivator and three others.

And they were dead.

All in a single strike!

‘Was the inspector a Golden Core cultivator!?’

There was no other way something like this could have been possible.

‘Someone like this is only the Society Head’s inspector....’

Then what realm was the Society Head at?

‘Could it be... Nascent Soul...?’

...

Lee Hyun held out 1,300 mid-grade spirit stones to the female cultivator.

“The price I bid earlier.”

Only then did the female cultivator regain her composure enough to check the spirit stones before handing over the Three-Molt Silkworm Robe and a jade slip containing its artifact-control formula.

Lee Hyun checked for any remaining divine-sense imprint or suspicious aura, then put the items away.

When he looked toward the steward, the man’s back immediately straightened.

“Is there a shop here that purchases goods?”

“...Pardon?”

“I’d like to dispose of their belongings.”

When Lee Hyun pointed at the corpses, the steward’s gaze followed his fingertip.

“Ah, yes. The market’s communal warehouse....”

“Could you call an appraiser over?”

The steward was speechless for a moment before nodding.

“I’ll summon one immediately.”

...

Lee Hyun first searched the four cultivators’ storage pouches and obtained around 800 mid-grade spirit stones.

He placed the remaining magic tools, talismans, and medicine bottles on the table.

A short while later, an appraiser from the warehouse spoke cautiously.

“If you hand these items over to us... we can offer you up to... 480 mid-grade spirit stones.”

After speaking, the appraiser studied Lee Hyun’s mask, but the Cicada mask showed no expression.

“Fine.”

Lee Hyun glanced back at the fractured floor.

“How much will the repairs here cost?”

“That....”

“Deduct it from the purchase price.”

The steward looked back and forth between Lee Hyun and the floor before carefully bowing his head.

...

Once everything had been settled, Lee Hyun rented a private room, removed the Black Scale Inner Armor, and put on the Three-Molt Silkworm Robe.

When he formed the hand seal, the robe shrank to fit his body. After pulling his outer robe over it, it felt as though he were wearing only one extra thin underlayer.

When Lee Hyun left the hall, Goose followed one step behind him.

Goose was considerably less talkative than on the way there.

Lee Hyun turned his head.

‘Did I scare him?’

“I’ll give you fifty mid-grade spirit stones as your brokerage fee.”

“Thank you!”

Ten years later.

Tunnel No. 3, Spirit Field No. 2-5.

Lee Hyun brushed the soil from the roots of the Spirit-Storing Ginseng plants and stored them one by one in his storage pouch.

Over the past ten years, he had cultivated while occasionally taking pills and had finally reached the very peak of Foundation Establishment Stage 3.

It was time to refine the Origin-Opening Pills he would take himself.

...

A few days later.

The alchemy chamber in Tunnel No. 3, twenty-five li (about 9.8 km) underground.

When the lid of the pill furnace opened, round pills emerged through the curling mist.

They were Origin-Opening Pills.

He had refined them countless times for sale through the Two Heavens Society, so there was nothing particularly difficult about the alchemy process.

Lee Hyun divided the completed pills among several jade bottles.

...

Cultivation chamber.

Lee Hyun lay down comfortably and swallowed the first Origin-Opening Pill.

As the pill dissolved, warmth spread through his abdomen.

He slowly guided its medicinal strength.

Hummm―

At some point, one of the blocked areas opened.

With his eyes closed, Lee Hyun examined the quality of the spiritual power newly forming in that area. Once he confirmed that it was sufficiently stable, he moved on to the next.

...

One month later.

The spirit light surrounding his entire body brightened, then gradually settled.

After a long while, Lee Hyun opened his eyes.

“Finally...!”

Whole-body Foundation Establishment Stage 4!

At last, his entire body had entered mid Foundation Establishment.

After thoroughly examining his body, he rose to his feet.

Then he took out the stone tablet, erased the old writing, and carved new characters into it.

【Realm: Foundation Establishment Stage 6 (lower dantian), Foundation Establishment Stage 4 (rest of the body)】

【Spiritual Power: 5,828 → 7,396】

【Constitution: Primordial Body, Foundation Establishment Stage 4】

He mounted the stone tablet on the wall and gazed at it with satisfaction.

A moment later, he took a small wooden box from his storage pouch.

Inside were Mei Sujun’s letter and jade slip.

Lee Hyun read their contents again for the first time in a long while.

Baoguang Temple’s Golden Core Condensing Pill.

‘Hmm... Is it about time I started looking into the Golden Core Condensing Pill recipe?’

Ten years later.

Lee Hyun had intended to enter Baoguang Mountain, but when the time actually came, he found the prospect bothersome and ended up spending ten years reading pulp novels he bought in Heng Kingdom.

Just as he was beginning to grow bored, he heard that Baoguang Mountain was recruiting disciples.

...

Xu Kingdom, Baoguang Mountain.

The smell of incense could be detected from the foot of the mountain.

Shops selling tea and food lined both sides of the road, while people in monastic robes mingled with ordinary cultivators moving back and forth.

In the distance, tiered halls supported by pillars rose along the mountainside. Beyond them, the higher peaks were obscured by thin clouds.

Lee Hyun read the notice posted before the Mountain Gate.

Below the dates and qualifications for accepting young disciples was a separate notice.

「Cultivators skilled in alchemy, artifact refining, talisman crafting, formations, and other crafts should register separately at the Guest Hall.」

The entry procedure was written below it.

From what Lee Hyun had learned, Baoguang Temple accepted cultivators as disciples even if they practiced other cultivation arts, provided their skills were sufficient.

...

Lee Hyun’s face looked like that of an ordinary middle-aged man around forty. It was the sort of appearance most commonly seen among Foundation Establishment cultivators.

A Foundation Establishment cultivator who looked like this might actually be fifty or a hundred and fifty years old depending on when they entered cultivation and when they achieved their breakthroughs, making age difficult to judge from appearance alone.

This time, he had decided to use the alias Li Dongsi and set his public age at seventy.

By adjusting the dosage and timing of the Bone-Forging Powder he took, he had also made sure beforehand that his bone age would register accordingly on magic tools used to examine it.

The aura he revealed was Foundation Establishment Stage 4.

Thanks to the Aura-Concealing Art and Spirit-Concealing Art he had practiced for so long, he could disguise himself as a cultivator who had reached Foundation Establishment Stage 4 only in his lower dantian.

As for his identity, he chose to present himself as a rogue cultivator alchemist.

...

A late Foundation Establishment guest-receiving monk was assigned to guide him.

“You applied to the Lotus Court.”

“That’s right.”

“This way, please. Not many people have come to register today, so you shouldn’t have to wait long.”

Lee Hyun followed the monk up the stairs, then looked at the back of his head.

His hair was long.

His black hair was tied behind his head, and the ends had a bluish tint.

“You don’t have to shave your head?”

“No.”

The monk glanced back briefly.

“I can’t cut mine because of my vow, but some people do shave theirs.”

What exactly was a vow?

From the brief research Lee Hyun had done before coming to Baoguang Temple, the sect derived its Buddhist power from vow cultivation.

Vow cultivation was a method of accumulating power by making a pledge to oneself and gaining strength for as long as one kept it.

Spiritual roots were still necessary for their cultivation.

However, they added the vow power gained through vow cultivation to the spiritual or magical power produced by absorbing spiritual qi through their spiritual roots, creating true qi suited to Baoguang Temple’s cultivation arts.

Lee Hyun spoke again.

“Is the color at the ends of your hair also related to your vow?”

The monk touched his hair.

“No, I just dyed it.”

“...I see.”

Lee Hyun was slightly taken aback.

‘This is a little different from the Buddhism I had in mind...’

As they climbed farther, the path widened.

Lee Hyun slowed when he saw the paintings hanging on the walls to either side.

At first, he thought they depicted Immortals and celestial maidens enjoying themselves.

But on closer inspection, their clothing was far too revealing.

Some paintings showed men and women exchanging cups of wine inside pavilions, while others depicted figures gazing at one another through curtains of thin silk.

A woman in one of the paintings slowly turned her head.

When her eyes met Lee Hyun’s, she smiled.

‘!?’

As Lee Hyun tried to look again, the monk guiding him stopped walking.

“Is this your first time seeing them?”

“I didn’t expect to find something like this in a temple.”

The monk pointed to a wooden plaque on one wall.

「All paintings here are for cultivation.

If your heart is stirred, your cultivation is lacking.

If your heart remains unmoved... you are already a Buddha.

However, do not steal the paintings.」

“This....”

The monk guiding him spoke with complete seriousness.

“They were painted personally by a Golden Core painter monk. They’re used to observe how one’s heart responds to beautiful things.”

“If your heart remains unmoved even after seeing them, then you’re fine?”

“These are only for beginners. People passing through the Mountain Gate can see this area as well... There are paintings farther inside that are much more stirring.”

...

In the broad courtyard at the top of the stairs, monks were carrying wooden crates.

One crate rattled, and a short claw poked through a hole.

Grrr.

It was the cry of a small beast.

“Carry them carefully.”

“Yes, Martial Uncle.”

One monk leaned his head closer to a wooden crate, and the growling inside grew louder.

The monk nodded.

“You’ve grown well. May you live a long life after you’re released into the forest.”

Lee Hyun asked,

“Is this where you raise spirit beasts?”

“This is the Life-Release Court. We’re moving the young ones that will be released into the Cangmang Forest today.”

Lee Hyun looked at the wooden crates.

“I didn’t realize you even raised young demon beasts yourselves just to release them.”

“It is a way of accumulating merit.”

The monk smiled contentedly.

Just then, one of the monks carrying a wooden crate shouted,

“Martial Uncle, they say the Black-Horn Deer we released in the western valley has formed a demon core!”

The face of the monk stroking the wooden crate brightened.

“Oh, at last our paths have crossed again! Inform the Demon-Subduing Court. If they’re too late, something else might eat it.”

“Yes!”

The monk guiding Lee Hyun spoke.

“Accumulate merit, and karmic connections will arise.”

...

In front of the inner hall stood a stone stele engraved with Baoguang Temple’s monastic rules.

「Eat spirit-beast meat with enjoyment. Forcing yourself to eat it is disrespectful to the offering.

Grain tea is grain.

Do not transmit the Dharma to those without affinity.

Do not mock another’s vow. Yours is stranger.

Refrain from pointless killing. For what counts as beneficial killing, inquire at the Life-Release Court.」

When Lee Hyun looked at the stele, the monk guiding him spoke.

“The founding patriarch said that clinging to precepts is itself another form of attachment. Shaving your head doesn’t make worldly troubles disappear, and refusing to eat meat doesn’t make your heart pure.”

“Then does everyone simply cultivate however they wish?”

“For the most part. But you must keep the vows you make for yourself.”

The monk opened his palm, and a faint golden aura seeped between the lines of his hand.

‘Is this the famed Buddha-Light True Qi...?’

It was gentle, yet carried a peculiar quality that made it difficult to disperse.

The abilities of Baoguang Temple’s monks were the real thing.

“Many of our temple’s Dharma teachings imbue one’s true qi with one’s vows. A vow you have faithfully upheld becomes a source of strength, but if you break it, that same power can turn against you.”

...

Lotus Court Guest Hall.

The Lotus Court was the division of Baoguang Temple responsible for crafts such as alchemy, spirit-plant cultivation, and formations. Research into medicinal ingredients and the refining of Golden Core Condensing Pills were also carried out here.

Seated across from Lee Hyun before a small pill furnace was an elderly monk with thick eyebrows and a broad jaw. He was an early Golden Core Elder.

The monk examined the documents Lee Hyun had filled out along with several items, then asked him to demonstrate some basic alchemy techniques.

After Lee Hyun demonstrated several skills over the course of one ke (about fifteen minutes), the Elder set down the documents and closely studied his fingertips.

At last, the monk raised a hand.

“Excellent!”

After writing something on the documents, the monk looked up again.

“Why do you wish to enter Baoguang Temple?”

“I want to learn more about alchemy. I’ve heard few places can compare with Baoguang Temple when it comes to handling materials from demon beasts.”

The monk nodded.

“Our Court does possess many such inheritances. But joining us does not guarantee you will be allowed to learn everything......”

“I’ll work hard.”

“Can you really?”

The monk opened a thin booklet lying beside the documents.

“The Clear Yang Purifying Fire Art is one of the Dharma teachings most commonly used in the Lotus Court! It is used to purify the turbid and fierce qi mixed into the flesh, blood, and demon cores of demon beasts. The requirement for learning this Dharma teaching is absolutely brutal. You cannot even imagine it.”

“What sort of requirement could be that severe?”

The monk’s expression turned grave.

“To master this Dharma teaching deeply, you must preserve your primordial yang!”

Lee Hyun nodded.

“I see.”

The monk paused and studied Lee Hyun’s face carefully.

“Do you actually understand what that means?”

“You mean I must not lose my primordial yang, correct?”

“Yes. But....”

The monk leaned forward.

“It is harder than you think.”

Lee Hyun waited.

The monk set down the brush in his hand.

“I am not talking about a few days or a few months. You must maintain it for as long as you practice the Dharma teaching. It could be decades. It could exceed a hundred years.”

“Yes.”

“I’m telling you, this isn’t something you should answer so casually!”

His voice rose.

The monk leaned back against his chair, then pitched forward again.

“There are many beautiful female cultivators in this world. Through immortal affinity, you might meet someone who asks to cultivate together with you. Could you refuse even then?”

“I think I could.”

“You think?”

The monk’s eyes widened.

“Answer with certainty. It means you cannot marry, and you cannot go chasing women! You cannot even sleep with a woman from the mundane world who isn’t a cultivator! This is not about enduring it for a little while. If you endure today, you must endure tomorrow. If you endure next year, you must endure the year after that!”

The monk’s expression grew increasingly solemn.

“Are you prepared to endure all those years of abstinence and restraint? Can you remain in the Lotus Court, staying away from women and cultivating alone for more than a hundred years?”

Lee Hyun be like:

Chapter 77

“Yes.”

At Lee Hyun’s matter-of-fact reply, the old monk fell silent for a while.

“You are seventy years old... and in all that time, you have never taken a Dao companion, nor even shared a brief relationship with a woman?”

“Yes.”

“Huh....”

The monk looked Lee Hyun up and down.

His limbs were perfectly sound, and his face was ordinary enough.

The old monk rose from his seat.

“I thought highly of your alchemy skills, but if you are a man who lies, I cannot allow you into Baoguang Temple.”

He opened a small shrine niche set into the wall of the Guest Hall.

Inside, a round object wrapped in red cloth had been enshrined.

The monk placed it on the table and removed the cloth, revealing a mirror about the size of two palms placed side by side.

Flames and lotus blossoms were engraved alternately around its golden rim.

“This is the Yang Essence Mirror.”

“A magic tool for examining primordial yang?”
