Hundreds of years ago, while watching Chen Xiaoying's demonstration, he had wished he could make a pill like that himself someday.

Back then, it had only been a vague hope. Now that it was happening before his eyes, he was delighted, but also a little bewildered.

Lee Hyun let his smile fade and focused on his fingertips.

Then it happened.

Boom.

‘Hm?’

Spiritual pressure comparable to that of an early Golden Core cultivator erupted in the distance.

He turned to see a black speck rapidly growing larger in the sky across the valley.

Lee Hyun used the Farsight Art, gathering spiritual power into his eyes.

Spirit light flowed between the feathers of its outstretched wings, and its eyes flashed silver.

‘A Silver-Eyed Sea Eagle?’

It was a Tier 3 demon beast with keen eyesight!

‘Of all times to show up... I checked the surroundings thoroughly before I started the alchemy...’

The dark cloud summoned by Lee Hyun's pill tribulation was only a little over one zhang (about 3.3 m) across. It neither darkened the entire sky nor shook the mountains and rivers.

Only a few flashes of lightning had appeared beneath the cloud as it hovered dozens of zhang in the air.

Yet from beyond the reach of his divine sense, the bastard had apparently spotted the pill tribulation's flashes with its exceptional eyesight.

Six blue-green shield plates immediately flew out of Lee Hyun's storage pouch and took position around the pill furnace.

The Six-Leaf Shield's shield plates hovered low, their edges overlapping at an angle to enclose the sides and bottom.

Only the top was left open so the lightning tribulation could descend.

The Threefold Shield's two plates rose outside them, followed by the yellow Mountain-Suppressing Seal and the Sinking Moon Sword.

Lee Hyun checked the direction from which the Silver-Eyed Sea Eagle was approaching.

He could not move the pill furnace while the tribulation lightning was descending.

Unlike in the past, a mere Tier 3 demon beast no longer frightened him, but he did not want to lose this chance to refine a Dao pill.

‘I just have to hold it off for a little while!’

The Threefold Shield's two plates flew forward first.

At that moment, the dark cloud in the air contracted, and the spiritual qi circling the pill suddenly surged inward.

‘Here it comes!’

A slender bolt of purple lightning shot down from beneath the cloud.

Lee Hyun sent three flame threads upward.

The first to make contact scattered instantly, and the next flame thread snapped in the middle.

His fingertips stung.

But the last strand grazed the tip of the lightning and curved toward the side of the pill.

In that brief instant, Lee Hyun shifted the medicinal strength inside the pill.

He recalled the sight of flames splitting apart at Chen Xiaoying's fingertips hundreds of years ago.

Why had she left an opening in the pill when it was nearly complete?

‘I see. If the tribulation lightning strikes a fully sealed pill head-on, it won't be able to withstand the impact, no matter how evenly the medicinal strength has condensed. She left that opening on purpose.’

Lee Hyun adjusted his fire control to lower the heat.

As one of the interlocking currents inside the pill loosened, the third flame thread curved through the opening.

The tip of the lightning touched the pill.

Bzzzzzt!

Purple light spread across its surface, sending the medicinal strength surging violently.

At the same time, a piercing cry rang out from beyond the valley.

Screeeech!

Dozens of deep-blue wind blades came pouring down, tearing through the air.

The first Threefold Shield plate blazed with spirit light and met them head-on, but it was not enough to stop a Tier 3 demon beast's attack.

KABOOM!

The wind blades that swept past gouged chunks out of the valley's rock walls, and the flying fragments battered the Six-Leaf Shield around the pill furnace like torrential rain.

Clang! Clang-clang!

Even as the storm shook everything around him, Lee Hyun's eyes remained fixed on the pill.

He was growing anxious, but his extraordinary mastery of the Flame-Threading Art kept the flames moving exactly as he intended.

Wherever the lightning passed, the medicinal strength unraveled, then condensed again.

At that moment, the bastard swooped down and crushed the first Threefold Shield plate in its talons.

Crunch!

Before the shield fragments had even scattered, the bastard drove its talons down again without losing any of its ferocious momentum.

The remaining Threefold Shield plate tilted at an angle, forcing the fellow's vicious strike off course.

Bang!

Thrown off balance, the bastard was shoved sideways, sending an enormous wing crashing into one of the rock walls. As rocks tumbled down, the Silver-Eyed Sea Eagle savagely drove its beak through the second shield.

Crack!

The shield's light went out.

‘Now.’

Lee Hyun poured spiritual power into the Mountain-Suppressing Seal, exceeding the limit the magic tool's restrictions could withstand.

The patterns on its surface blazed, and the yellow seal swelled to the size of a house before hurtling forward.

The Mountain-Suppressing Seal caught the Silver-Eyed Sea Eagle just as it spread its wings and slammed mercilessly into its chest.

KABOOOM!

A deafening crash echoed through the valley as the demon beast was driven deep into the rock wall. Pushed beyond its limit, the seal shattered as though it had self-destructed, spraying yellow fragments in every direction.

“Krrk! You think that pathetic rock can stop me?!”

‘It can talk?’

Just then, the lightning rampaging inside the pill completed one final circuit.

Lee Hyun curled his fingers, closing the opening he had left in the flow of medicinal strength.

Hummm–

The light flashing over the pill's surface sank inward.

A single silvery-purple tribulation marking remained on its round surface, formed from the fusion of lightning qi and medicinal strength!

‘Success! I made a Tier 2 one-mark Essence-Cultivating Dao Pill!’

He wanted to admire it a little longer, but overhead, the demon beast was already roaring as it burst back through the collapsed rock wall.

With lightning-fast movements, Lee Hyun opened a jade bottle, placed the one-mark Essence-Cultivating Dao Pill inside, and affixed a Spirit-Sealing Talisman.

He then gathered the five pills left in the pill furnace into another bottle.

After stowing the pill furnace in his storage pouch as well, he looked up to find an enormous talon filling his vision.

...

The Silver-Eyed Sea Eagle thought the human before it was as good as caught.

Two shields had shattered, and even the seal that had flown at it with considerable force had broken apart.

Every trick its opponent had used was pathetically weak!

With the human distracted by something, this was the perfect chance to devour him, bones and all.

When sword light surged toward its neck, the Silver-Eyed Sea Eagle twisted its wing almost mockingly and launched a wind blade.

It happened at that very moment.

Something invisible stabbed into its mind.

“Kree!?”

The Silver-Eyed Sea Eagle's wings faltered. The demon power it had been gathering dispersed, and the wind surrounding one wing vanished for an instant.

Light flashed in that fleeting opening.

Shhk!

The feathers at the base of its wing were sliced apart, and blood sprayed out.

The Silver-Eyed Sea Eagle hurriedly folded its injured wing and twisted in midair. Terrified, it tried to put some distance between them, only to find the sky overhead already suffused with gold.

A gigantic palm.

The golden light forming the palm and fingers knit together seamlessly.

The Silver-Eyed Sea Eagle desperately opened its beak and spewed demon power, sending a whirlwind spiraling upward.

But the golden palm crushed through the gale of demon power and plummeted like a meteor!

KABOOM!

The Silver-Eyed Sea Eagle slammed into the valley floor.

Rock split apart, and clouds of dust erupted into the air.

The golden palm did not disappear.

The center of the palm bore down heavily on its back, while the five fingers clamped around its wings and neck, pinning it firmly to the ground.

Whenever the demon beast struggled, the golden light blazed brighter, holding the fellow firmly in place.

It was the Sumeru Mountain-Suppressing Seal.

Maintaining his hand seal, Lee Hyun took a step forward through the thick dust.

The Silver-Eyed Sea Eagle opened its beak in one final, desperate attempt to resist.

As the glow of demon power gathered inside, the Sinking Moon Sword flashed through the air and came to rest against its throat.

“Give up.”

The Silver-Eyed Sea Eagle's neck went rigid as sharp sword qi bit into its feathers.

A moment later, the light inside its beak gradually faded.

The Silver-Eyed Sea Eagle turned its silver eyes toward Lee Hyun.

“What was that thing you threw first?”

“The Mountain-Suppressing Seal? It's a magic tool.”

“You had a technique like this all along... Krrk. Did you throw that pathetic yellow rock first to trick me?”

“I was planning to destroy it anyway.”

That was the truth.

To stop a Tier 3 demon beast's charge even briefly, he had needed to sacrifice something on the level of the Mountain-Suppressing Seal.

Losing it was a pity, but his first Dao pill was worth far more.

Besides, ever since learning the Sumeru Mountain-Suppressing Seal technique, Lee Hyun had found the Mountain-Suppressing Seal magic tool a little irritating. Their names were too similar.

Such things were hardly rare in the cultivation world.

Even trivial techniques learned by Qi Refining cultivators often had grandiose names about overturning the heavens or suppressing mountains. In different regions, pills made from different pill recipes and having different effects were sometimes given the same name.

Lee Hyun put those thoughts aside and carefully assessed whether the Silver-Eyed Sea Eagle still had any means of counterattacking.

“I have a few questions.”

The fellow's beak clicked shut.

“You think I'll answer?”

One finger of the Sumeru Mountain-Suppressing Seal pressed harder against the Silver-Eyed Sea Eagle's neck.

“Krrrk.... Enough... I'll answer.”

“Why have guys like you been appearing in Yunzhou more often lately?”

The reports he had received through the Two Heavens Society had contained similar stories.

Cultivator markets along the coast had been attacked by demon beasts, and demon beasts native to the sea had been spotted on spiritual mountains inland.

The Silver-Eyed Sea Eagle opened its beak.

“Where is Yunzhou?”

“The place you're pinned to right now.”

“I don't know what this place is called. I only came looking for somewhere with spiritual qi.”

“The sea must be far larger.”

The Silver-Eyed Sea Eagle's eyes widened indignantly.

“There's nowhere to build a nest!”

A harsh metallic edge crept into its voice.

“Those bastards from the human race have set up camp on every island. They drive pillars into underwater spirit veins and send ships out whenever we get close. The big guys steal the little guys' nests, and the little guys get driven farther out.”

“Were you driven out too?”

Its beak clacked together.

“Hmph! I merely left to find a better nest!”

“I see. Why not go to the Cangmang Forest? I heard it's the domain of demon beasts.”

The feathers on the back of the Silver-Eyed Sea Eagle's neck bristled.

“That rotten forest.... The ones inside won't let us in!”

“Why?”

“They called us uncivilized. Some worthless bastard I could kill with one peck shoved a stone tablet in my face and told me to turn back!”

“A stone tablet?”

“It had marks carved into it like trails left by crawling insects. Whose land it was, who could come and go, what we weren't allowed to eat... Krrk! It rattled off all sorts of pointless nonsense!”

Lee Hyun's interest was piqued.

‘Demon beasts can write?’

“Was that guy as strong as you?”

“No!”

“Even a demon beast that weak could speak?”

“Even the weak guys in there can chatter away. They can learn to speak, maybe because their spiritual intelligence awakens when they're young. They imitate the culture of the feeble human race. They carve marks into stone, read them, and pass them back and forth.”

The Silver-Eyed Sea Eagle's talons scraped the ground.

“When I tried to kill that bastard, a bigger guy appeared from behind.”

“I see.”

Lee Hyun recalled the demon cores he had seen at Baoguang Temple.

But he had never heard that those demon beasts could read, establish rules, or buy and sell goods.

When Lee Hyun asked about that, the Silver-Eyed Sea Eagle snorted harshly through its nostrils.

“The guys living outside the forest were driven out. How could they be the same as the ones inside?”

“Are their bloodlines different?”

“They boast about their noble blood. Something about ancestors who descended from the heavens.... Hmph! Those bastards would bleed the same red blood if I drove my beak into them, yet they act as though they're so special.”

‘A bloodline from the upper realm? I doubt any bloodline that extraordinary exists in the human realm... Perhaps they're just glorifying their ancestors.’

In any case, it seemed the highly intelligent demon beasts within the Cangmang Forest really could speak and had rules and a culture of their own.

“How vast is the Cangmang Forest?”

“I don't know.”

“What else do you know about the interior?”

“I don't know.”

“How far in did you get?”

“The outskirts! Krrk!”

The Silver-Eyed Sea Eagle watched Lee Hyun warily, then opened its beak slightly.

“I've answered your questions. Now take your talons off me.”

It seemed to be asking him to release the Sumeru Mountain-Suppressing Seal.

Lee Hyun spoke.

“I understand your circumstances. But that doesn't change the fact that you attacked my pill furnace. You'll have to pay for the magic tools you broke. More importantly... I suspect letting you go would spell trouble for anyone from the human race living nearby.”

“You bastard...!”

The Sinking Moon Sword moved.

...

Lee Hyun removed the Silver-Eyed Sea Eagle's demon core first.

It belonged to an early-stage Tier 3 demon beast and was completely undamaged.

‘If I use this to refine a Golden Core Condensing Pill ahead of time, its medicinal strength will dissipate... I'll have to exchange it for spirit stones again.’

He also collected the talons and beak separately.

He planned to use a few of the large wing bones in his research on bone puppets. The rest could be sold along with the demon core.

The Threefold Shield and the Mountain-Suppressing Seal were ruined, but a Tier 3 demon beast's corpse was worth more, so he had actually come out ahead.

Lee Hyun reopened the jade bottle and admired the Essence-Cultivating Dao Pill, its tribulation marking glowing softly.

“Ah...”

Lee Hyun burned away the bloodstains and scattered feathers. He also cleaned up the torn ground, broken rocks, and scattered fragments of the destroyed magic tools. After checking outside the valley once more, he descended underground and traveled on, changing direction along the way.

A few days later, in Tunnel No. 3.

Lee Hyun took the Essence-Cultivating Dao Pill from the jade bottle, swallowed it, and set the Primordial One-Qi Art in motion.

The medicinal strength released in his dantian spread throughout his body.

Compared with an ordinary Essence-Cultivating Pill, its medicinal strength was far more concentrated, yet it flowed smoothly through his meridians.

He had expected its effects to be harsh after it absorbed the lightning tribulation, but the opposite was true.

Moreover, the medicinal strength was astonishingly pure!

It was not entirely free of pill toxins, but compared with an ordinary Essence-Cultivating Pill, it contained next to no impure qi.

‘It certainly deserves to be called a Dao pill!’

...

The next day.

Lee Hyun examined the spiritual power throughout his body.

The increase was tiny, but his capacity for spiritual power had definitely grown.

Cultivating his entire body was so difficult that he could barely feel any difference after taking a single ordinary Essence-Cultivating Pill. Yet after just one Dao pill, he could actually feel a slight improvement.

‘That's about ten pills' worth!’

He seemed to have gained nearly as much medicinal strength as he would from ten ordinary Essence-Cultivating Pills of comparable quality.

The medicinal strength of Essence-Cultivating Pills was too fierce for him to take them frequently.

Over the past twenty years, Lee Hyun had adjusted his intake several times.

When he took large quantities for a while, his spiritual power increased rapidly.

Over time, however, his qi circulation cycles grew sluggish, and he absorbed medicinal strength more slowly. At that point, he had to stop taking the pills and eat Yin Water Lotus seeds to expel turbid qi.

Once he accounted for the time spent refining the medicinal strength and recovering, it was actually better to take roughly sixty pills a year at a steady pace.

Dao pills were different.

They gave him far more medicinal strength while leaving much less strain on his body. He could even take them during his breaks from ordinary Essence-Cultivating Pills.

‘This means... I could change my cultivation plan.’

Assuming he could continue refining Dao pills, Lee Hyun began calculating how long it would take to bring his entire body to Great Perfection of Foundation Establishment.

‘How many spirit stones will it cost to keep refining Essence-Cultivating Dao Pills?’

Lee Hyun walked through his spirit fields, checking his spirit plants against his ledger once more.

「Bone-Rot Flowers: 438 plants.

Medicine age around 870 years, with some over 900 years.

Yin Soul Grass: 1,160 plants.

Medicine age around 870 years, with some over 900 years.

Purple Poison Orchids: 310 plants.

Medicine age around 870 years, with some over 900 years.」

These were all that remained of the groups he had planted long ago.

Later generations of spirit plants, replanted in the spaces left after harvesting, were counted separately.

The Tier 3 spirit plants he had sold to help Wang Shulin were also recorded in the ledger: twenty-four Bone-Rot Flowers, thirty-six Yin Soul Grass plants, and eighteen Purple Poison Orchids.

Those were the combined totals of the few plants he had sold every few decades.

He had used others in his own alchemy and research or sold them in other transactions. A small number had also been spoiled during periods when he had not tended them properly.

Lee Hyun moved to another spirit field.

「Earlier planting of Spirit-Storing Ginseng: 532 roots.

Medicine age approximately 750 years.

Later planting of Spirit-Storing Ginseng: 276 roots.

Medicine age approximately 610 years.」

The number of older Spirit-Storing Ginseng roots had barely decreased.

By the time he had begun refining Foundation Establishment Pills in earnest, their medicine age had already exceeded the recipe's upper limit.

The only roots he had sold were twenty during his stay at Baoguang Temple.

The later planting, on the other hand, had steadily dwindled as he refined Foundation Establishment Pills, Origin-Opening Pills, and Profundity-Penetrating Pills.

He had planted young Spirit-Storing Ginseng in those empty spaces as well.

...

Lee Hyun noted down estimated prices beside his ledger.

‘Based on past auction prices and recent trading reports...’

「Estimated market prices, in mid-grade spirit stones.

Bone-Rot Flower: 1,000.

Yin Soul Grass: 1,200.

Purple Poison Orchid: 900.

Spirit-Storing Ginseng, first planting: 750.

Spirit-Storing Ginseng, second planting: 450.」

If he sold all of them at their full value, his total wealth would exceed 2.5 million mid-grade spirit stones!

He already had around 8,000 mid-grade spirit stones on hand, making him extraordinarily wealthy compared with other Foundation Establishment cultivators. Yet even to him, 2.5 million was an unimaginable sum.

“....”

But if he harvested everything and put it all on the market at once, prices would plummet, and bandit cultivators would come after his wealth.

Besides, the plants would only become more valuable with time. There was no reason to sell more than he needed.

He excluded the Earth Vein Flowers from his calculations because uprooting them would weaken the spiritual qi in the spirit fields. As for the Yin Water Lotuses and Stone Honey Peaches, he was better off continuing to grow them for his own consumption.

After visiting the rest of his spirit fields and updating his ledger, Lee Hyun opened the pill recipe for the Essence-Cultivating Pill.

Essence-Cultivating Pills required Spirit-Storing Ginseng, but even the later planting in his tunnels was over six hundred years old and could no longer be used. The newly planted seedlings, meanwhile, still lacked the necessary medicine age.

Lee Hyun wrote down the ingredient costs.

‘Twenty-four furnace batches a year, 600 mid-grade spirit stones for ingredients and consumables, up to six pills per furnace batch... If I refine 130 pills a year, I can take sixty myself and sell the rest, with the Dao pills counted separately...’

A rough calculation put his annual costs, including other expenses, at 700 mid-grade spirit stones. Even after selling the surplus Essence-Cultivating Pills, he would still be about 300 short.

‘If I sell one Bone-Rot Flower, one Purple Poison Orchid, and two Yin Soul Grass plants every ten years, I'll have more than enough to cover the shortfall.’

At that rate, he could keep going for hundreds of years without selling many of his old spirit plants.

The proceeds from selling his newly acquired demon core and materials could supplement his funds as well.

He could take occasional orders for Bone-Forging Powder, Poison-Warding Pills, Spirit-Calming Pills, Foundation Establishment Pills, and the like, but he left that income out of his calculations for now.

He needed to set aside additional spirit stones in case a good magic tool appeared at auction or some other opportunity arose.

...

With the spirit stone problem settled, he turned to calculating the time required.

His circumstances were different from when he had lived at Baoguang Temple.

If he simply moved between the Two Heavens Society's vein seats and accumulated spiritual qi, it would likely take more than 2,000 years to bring his entire body to Great Perfection of Foundation Establishment.

He consulted his past cultivation records and compared the effects of the pills.

Adding the medicinal strength of Essence-Cultivating Pills to the spiritual qi he naturally absorbed would reduce the time required to roughly 800 years.

‘Now, if I factor in the effects of Dao pills...’

If he refined twenty-four furnace batches a year, a ten-percent success rate for Dao pills could shorten that period to 650 years, while a thirty-percent success rate could bring it down to 460 years.

‘What if I made more? If I refined forty-eight furnace batches a year and produced a Dao pill once every two furnace batches... Taking all of them could get me to Great Perfection of Foundation Establishment in just 250 years, couldn't it?’

But doubling his alchemy would also double his ingredient costs.

Lee Hyun calculated again.

If his success rate for Dao pills reached fifty percent, he would be left with a little over 230 ordinary Essence-Cultivating Pills a year.

After setting aside sixty for himself, he could sell 160 of the remaining pills for 912 mid-grade spirit stones after brokerage fees.

With 1,200 for ingredients and another 100 for other expenses, his annual shortfall would be 388 mid-grade spirit stones.

‘Wait, even then I'd only need to sell four plants every ten years?’

Lee Hyun set up a new stone tablet and inscribed it with the Yang Metal Art.

「Goal: A fifty-percent success rate for Essence-Cultivating Dao Pills.」

One month later.

A small medicinal ingredient shop in eastern Xu Kingdom.

The cultivator wearing a Goose mask looked up from the jade slips Lee Hyun had presented.

“You intend to keep procuring this much? Even the Tier 2 Spirit-Storing Ginseng alone amounts to a considerable quantity.”

“Start by securing a year's supply. If their medicine age is suitable and they've been stored properly, I intend to continue doing business with you.”

The cultivator in the Goose mask nodded, but inwardly grew nervous.

‘Is the Two Heavens Society finally making its move? If they're doing this much business through my branch alone... could they be preparing for war?’

Lee Hyun slid another jade slip across the table.

It listed the types and estimated quantities of pills he would supply in the future.

The cultivator in the Goose mask lowered the jade slip from their forehead.

“If you entrust them to me, I can guarantee that they will all sell.”

“Good. There is also something else I'd like you to look into.”

Lee Hyun took out a small jade casket and opened the lid.

“This is... Tier 3 Yin Soul Grass!”

“Are there any Golden Core members who might be interested?”

“There are some.”

...

The Two Heavens Society had steadily grown in influence, and its members had spread to far more places than Lee Hyun had expected. For the past several hundred years, he had been able to sell his Tier 3 spirit plants within the society rather than put them up for auction.

Of course, there were still only a few Golden Core members.

That was unavoidable.

The Two Heavens Society had originally been founded so that cultivators could steal spiritual qi from other sects and cultivation clans to use in their own cultivation.

That was an appealing prospect for Qi Refining and Foundation Establishment cultivators, but it did not suit Golden Core cultivators.

For example, residual-vein pockets found around a Tier 3 spirit vein generally offered a cultivation environment comparable to only a Tier 2 spirit vein.

For a residual-vein pocket that could be approached in secret to offer conditions approaching those of a Tier 3 spirit vein, the main spirit vein would have to be Tier 4.

Outside Tier 5 cultivation nations, however, Tier 4 spirit veins were the most precious of all, and a Nascent Soul cultivator could be found at nearly every one.

So for a Golden Core cultivator to establish a vein seat and cultivate in keeping with the Two Heavens Society's original purpose, they would have to steal spiritual qi right under a Nascent Soul cultivator's nose!

Put simply, it was madness.

Nascent Soul cultivators had deep reserves of power and an enormous range of abilities, making them extremely difficult to predict.

Even if a Golden Core cultivator reckless enough to attempt it did exist, they would usually cultivate alone in a residual-vein pocket.

Only if several such Golden Core cultivators used the same residual-vein pocket and got in one another's way would there be a need for mediation.

But how many such residual-vein pockets were there, and how often would Golden Core cultivators actually encounter one another in them?

Ultimately, even when Golden Core cultivators stole spiritual qi, they rarely needed an organization like the Two Heavens Society to coordinate their activities.

The few Golden Core cultivators who had joined the Two Heavens Society were less interested in its vein seats than in trading goods, sharing information, and finding the people they needed without revealing too much about themselves.

And they had the means to buy Lee Hyun's Tier 3 spirit plants.

The cultivator in the Goose mask spoke.

“Our branch can contact only a few Golden Core members, but I believe we can find a buyer.”

...

Afterward, Lee Hyun visited several more contact points.

At some, he wore the Badger mask. At others, he wore the Cicada mask.

Following his prepared plan, he divided his pill sales among different outlets and placed orders for medicinal ingredients.

During these visits...

Lee Hyun noticed something strange.

...

A contact point in northern Xuan Kingdom.

A cultivator wearing a Mountain Goat mask sat across from Lee Hyun, who wore the Cicada mask.

After they checked each other's jade tokens, the other cultivator took the initiative and offered him a jade slip.

“Someone has expressed interest.”

“A Golden Core cultivator?”

“Yes. They had no particular objection to the price, either. They did say it would need to be appraised first. And we'd like our side to handle this transaction through to completion.”

Lee Hyun looked up from the jade slip.

“Your side?”

The cultivator in the Mountain Goat mask hesitated.

“I heard you also placed requests with members of nearby branches.”

“Is there anything strange about asking around in several places?”

“That isn't what I meant. It's just that lately... the senior elders have been arguing over how transactions are handed off.”

‘Senior elders? What's this about?’

“Senior elders? What are you talking about?”

“Which side arranged a transaction, who should receive a share of the proceeds....”

Lee Hyun set the jade slip down on the table.

He had established rules for dividing the proceeds precisely to minimize such problems.

Even when several members were involved, he had required them to agree on their respective shares before passing a request along.

“Can't you simply divide the proceeds according to the established rules?”

The cultivator in the Mountain Goat mask fidgeted awkwardly.

“That was how things worked before, but some people now insist on taking affiliations into account.... As I understand it, Inspector, you do business with all sides. We have no intention of making things difficult for you.”

Apparently, factions he knew nothing about had formed within the Two Heavens Society he himself had created.

He eyed the cultivator in the Mountain Goat mask suspiciously.

Perhaps interpreting Lee Hyun's silence differently, the other cultivator hurried on.

“You can trust us. The item is so rare that they said they would inspect it personally.”

“Who?”

“Society Head Badger.”

‘Huh?’

Chapter 92

‘Society Head Badger is going to inspect it personally?’

When had he ever made such a promise?

Of course he hadn't.

Lee Hyun picked up the jade slip on the table again. At the very end was a phrase he had never seen before.

「Guaranteed by the Northern Xuan Council of Senior Elders.」

“That... society head. Does he come here often?”

Mountain Goat nodded.

“He presides over a gathering once every year.”

“Since when?”

“For about thirty years. Normally, the senior elders handle matters, but this time the item is so valuable that he said he would inspect it personally.”

‘Thirty years....’

Was this an aftereffect of the time he had spent shut away in his tunnel?

Even so, around that time he had gradually begun recovering and had occasionally appeared at contact points wearing the Badger mask. Granted, none of those gatherings had involved the Northern Xuan Council of Senior Elders that Mountain Goat was talking about.

“I may be an inspector directly under the society head, but that man isn't the Society Head......”

“Truly?”

Confusion entered Mountain Goat's voice.

“I heard that you have served since the predecessor's time, Inspector, so I naturally assumed you already knew.”

Lee Hyun's hand stopped.

“The predecessor?”

“Yes. I was told the current society head is his successor.”

‘Ah.’

Rather than someone imitating his face and presence, they had simply taken advantage of his long disappearance and turned him into the dead ‘predecessor society head’!

‘I’m still alive...’

“I warned everyone not to trust masks or titles. What made you believe that man was the successor society head?”

“I had my doubts at first as well, but the Golden Core senior elders who have mediated disputes between contact points over the past several decades vouched for him through separate channels. They all said he had inherited the position from the predecessor society head.”

“Did you personally verify some token of succession or a message sent by the predecessor society head?”

“There was nothing wrong with the senior elders' jade tokens or letters of introduction. However, every message concerning the succession came through them. Since the same news arrived from different contact points....”

Mountain Goat hurriedly added,

“How could a Foundation Establishment member like me question the guarantees of Golden Core senior elders above me?”

“So even the supposed wishes of the predecessor society head amount to nothing more than their word. Then when did this whole system of senior elders come into existence?”

“That much I do not know....”

Lee Hyun scratched his head.

When he thought about it, the situation was not especially strange.

No matter how compartmentalized an organization was, strength ultimately mattered most in the cultivation world.

The Two Heavens Society operated through a cell-based structure in which each member was linked to only a handful of contacts.

That also meant that if a Golden Core member started doing something suspicious, the Foundation Establishment cultivators who were supposed to oppose them had only a few people they could turn to for help.

What if several Golden Core cultivators positioned between those cells colluded, declared themselves senior elders, and vouched for one another?

If they used their Golden Core strength to fabricate even the position of society head, who could stop them?

Just because the restrictions on a jade token were intact did not mean everything its owner said was true. Separate lines of communication meant little if they all ultimately led back to the same people.

From the days of the Qutian Society through the founding of the Two Heavens Society, there had been almost no Golden Core members, so Lee Hyun had never seriously considered such a weakness.

‘Should I have banned Golden Core cultivators from joining in the first place? But having Golden Core cultivators around has its advantages too, and it is convenient... We can even sell Tier-3 spirit plants through the Society...’

Come to think of it, a member who had joined while at Foundation Establishment might later achieve Core Formation. It was not as though he could congratulate someone on successfully forming their core and then ask them to leave the Society.

‘In the end, the real problem was letting a few bastards monopolize the communication lines and vouch for one another.’

When Lee Hyun asked a little more about the Council of Senior Elders' structure and trading practices, Mountain Goat answered in detail to the extent of his knowledge.

Some contact points in northern Xuan, northwestern Heng, and even northern Jing were apparently conducting their trades through the Council of Senior Elders.

At first, the Council had earned people's trust by mediating disputes that arose during trades, covering losses when small merchant companies fled without paying, and providing escorts for long journeys.

But once enough members began following them, they had started scrutinizing which organizations their trading partners belonged to, then gradually began demanding unreasonable cuts for their own benefit.

Lee Hyun leaned back in his chair.

‘I see.’

“You will still receive payment for the purchase. You needn't worry about that.”

“I’m merely checking the terms before selling the item. Is this place called Qingshi Ridge where the successor society head wants to meet me?”

“Yes. It's an abandoned mining region in northwestern Heng Kingdom.”

After parting with Mountain Goat, Lee Hyun decided to investigate further before meeting the senior elders.

...

Three days later, at a contact point in western Xuan Kingdom.

Two jade slips lay before Lee Hyun, who was wearing the Cicada mask.

One contained an interim report on the request to purchase medicinal ingredients, while the other contained settlement records for recently completed trades.

They had yet to obtain all the Spirit-Storing Ginseng needed for the Essence-Cultivating Pills, but the other ingredients were being gathered faster than expected.

“Things are progressing well.”

“We should be able to secure everything by the next gathering.”

The member sitting across from him replied.

As Lee Hyun read the second jade slip, he pointed to one entry.

“The brokerage fee on this trade is unusually high.”

“That's because it passed through Heng and Jing. The Council of Senior Elders takes a separate share in exchange for guaranteeing the trade.”

“By guarantee, do you mean they compensate you if the other party fails to pay?”

“That was how it started... but these days they charge it on every trade that passes through the Council. It's basically a toll for using their contact network.”

The other member looked somewhat uncomfortable.

Lee Hyun was dumbfounded. Even he had made members agree on their shares in advance out of consideration for everyone involved, yet someone else was using brute force to extort spirit stones from them?

‘And here I am, the society head, not even taking my cut first...!’

“Can't you trade through somewhere else?”

“We can. But sometimes we need items available only through their side.... Since everything is connected through separate cells, it becomes inconvenient if a particular route is blocked. On top of that, the senior elders have entrenched themselves at major hubs throughout the Nine Kingdoms of Yunzhou...”

Perhaps the member across from him had accumulated quite a bit of resentment, because he subtly began reporting the Council of Senior Elders' abuses to Lee Hyun in his capacity as an inspector.

Lee Hyun nodded.

The Council of Senior Elders was definitely a problem!

If a toll was added on top of the agreed shares, the seller received less while the buyer paid more. If that reduced the volume of trade and made members distrust one another, they would eventually have no reason to use the Two Heavens Society at all.

As the society head, he could not overlook this.

“Have you ever reported this problem elsewhere?”

“There hasn't really been anyone to tell...”

...

Lee Hyun visited two more contact points afterward.

Fortunately, among the numerous contact points he knew as society head, only a small portion had been drawn into the Council of Senior Elders' dealings. There were still members who did not even know the Council existed.

Reactions varied even within areas under the senior elders' influence, but most members simply accepted it as a change in how trades were conducted.

Lee Hyun spread out the ledgers he had collected from each contact point and compared the request details and settlement amounts for the same trades.

As far as he could verify, most had adhered to the agreed shares. Yet every trade that passed through the Council of Senior Elders had inevitably acquired fees that had not existed at the outset.

‘They must have made quite a fortune by now.’

The pills Lee Hyun supplied accounted for only a portion of all trade conducted through the Two Heavens Society.

Descendants of alchemists who had split away from the Danxiao Sect long ago still remained in many places, and the network also connected families that cultivated spirit herbs with merchant companies dealing in spirit materials. Skimming even a little from all those transactions would accumulate a considerable number of spirit stones.

...

Several days later, Qingshi Ridge.

Several collapsed mine shafts remained along the mountainside. After the deposits had nearly stopped producing spirit materials, people had ceased coming here altogether.

Upon reaching the designated contact point inside a mine shaft, Lee Hyun sensed the flow of earth qi cut off unnaturally in the rock wall beside the door.

When he lightly probed with his senses, he found thick iron plates laid behind the stonework and beneath the floor.

‘Is this meant to counter the Earth Escape Art?’

While the guard checked his jade token, Lee Hyun examined the energy beneath his feet a little more carefully.

The iron plates were thick, but their composition was simple. Beyond them lay ordinary soil and bedrock, and a short distance away was the abandoned shaft he had passed on his way in.

‘Once I'm through the plate with the Metal Escape Art, I've got an escape route.’

He could also sense the energy of a formation inside the walls, but fortunately, it was a type Lee Hyun recognized. The iron plates themselves had no restrictions engraved into them to prevent escape arts.

It was suspicious, but he had no intention of turning back yet. He needed to see for himself who the false society head was and just how many of the senior elders were in league with him.

The door opened to reveal a vast cavern.

Several halls and storehouses stood inside, and they had even built a small pond in the center. Illumination stones embedded in the ceiling cast a gentle glow.

They had built an estate inside a mine shaft!

Even he, the society head of the Two Heavens Society and an expert in tunnels, had never indulged in such extravagance.

Lee Hyun walked past the pond with a dumbfounded expression, then slowed his steps.

A stone statue of a badger stood before the hall farther inside.

‘Huh?’

A stone tablet rested beneath it.

「Approach this as though you are laying the foundation for an empire where even your descendants will serve the Two Heavens Society and many families will live for generations. Final injunction of the First Society Head.」

‘.......’

Lee Hyun entered the hall.

...

A man in a brown long robe embroidered with gold thread sat in the seat of honor, wearing a Badger mask.

Heavy magical power that he had made no attempt to conceal pressed down upon the entire hall, and a presence no weaker could be felt from behind the folding screen.

An early Golden Core cultivator!

And there was more than one!

Even then, Lee Hyun found himself thinking something completely unrelated.

‘The snout on that thing is longer than the one on my real mask, and it looks way more expensive too.’

Once Lee Hyun took his seat, three people emerged from behind the folding screen.

There was Crane, radiating the magical power of an early Golden Core cultivator, White Weasel, who had reached Foundation Establishment Great Perfection, and Toad, who was at mid Foundation Establishment.

False Badger, seated at the head of the room, spoke in a low voice.

“So you are Cicada, the inspector who served the predecessor society head. I have heard of your reputation, but this is the first time we have met.”

“I don't recall seeing any record of the Council of Senior Elders selecting a new society head.”

White Weasel, one hand tucked inside a sleeve, gave Crane a slight nod.

At Lee Hyun's calm observation, Senior Elder Crane snorted.

“You're too young to know this, but our investigations show that this Society has existed longer than the lifespan of a Golden Core cultivator! What would a mere Foundation Establishment cultivator like you know to speak so recklessly? How long are you going to keep prattling about some ghost of a predecessor from ages past? When the society head exists in name alone and never so much as shows his face, isn't it only natural for those with power to step forward and take control of the organization?”

At that moment, White Weasel slid a new jade token and a red jade plaque onto the table. Faint, sinister ripples from a restriction capable of binding a cultivator's primordial spirit emanated from the jade plaque.

“There is no need for a lengthy discussion. Leave your primordial-spirit imprint on this jade plaque as proof that you will submit to the Council of Senior Elders' way of doing things. If you, who served directly under the predecessor society head, leave your imprint, the other branches that know you will find it easier to accept the Council's authority. In return, we will allow you to retain your position as inspector.”

White Weasel gestured, and the lid of a small chest in the corner opened.

More than a dozen old jade tokens with broken restrictions had been tossed carelessly inside. Several even bore dried bloodstains.

“They belonged to those who stubbornly insisted on keeping their old jade tokens. I trust that you will make a wiser choice, Inspector.”

‘These bastards... So this is how they've been putting collars around the necks of the existing members.’

Lee Hyun was thoroughly enraged.

If he had been an ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivator, trusting the Two Heavens Society would have landed him in disaster.

How could anyone establish a steadfast Dao heart after placing their primordial spirit in someone else's hands?

Lee Hyun coldly pushed the jade plaque away.

“You want me to hand over my primordial spirit? Since when did the Two Heavens Society start playing at being a heretical cult? More importantly, I came here to trade Yin Soul Grass, so let's hear the terms.”

He wanted to punish those before him immediately, but they might still have some means he had yet to see. Just because he could escape with the Metal Escape Art did not mean he had any reason to fight them in a place they had prepared for themselves.

For now, he intended to keep discussing the trade, learn more, and then use the appraisal of the spirit herb as an excuse to lure them outside the mine.

When Lee Hyun took a jade casket from his storage pouch and opened the lid, the atmosphere in the hall instantly turned eerie.

Inside was Yin Soul Grass with a medicine age of over nine hundred years, a faint spirit light flowing over it. At the sight of a perfectly intact Tier-3 spirit herb, both False Badger and Crane's eyes visibly changed.

False Badger tried to pull the jade casket toward himself with the Telekinesis Art, but Lee Hyun stopped him.

“Payment first. High-grade spirit stones are acceptable as well.”

“Excellent quality! However, attempting to circulate an item of this caliber privately without the Council of Senior Elders' prior approval is a clear violation of Society rules.”

“A violation of Society rules?”

“Indeed. Therefore, the Council of Senior Elders will confiscate all of this Yin Soul Grass as a special contribution. However, if you leave your primordial-spirit imprint on that jade plaque and come under our command, we will graciously award you a hundred mid-grade spirit stones.”

“...”

When Lee Hyun returned the jade casket to his storage pouch, Crane rose to his feet as though blocking the way out and unleashed his killing intent.

“You call yourself an inspector, yet how can you be this slow on the uptake? Now that you've entered this room, you have only two choices. Leave your imprint, or leave as a corpse.”

White Weasel was already gripping the formation plate inside his sleeve. Lee Hyun slowly rose from his seat.

“Are all the people behind this gathered here?”

False Badger shook his head.

“Give it up. These are the instructions handed down by the grand elder of northern Jing. The Golden Core senior elders are not confined to this place alone. No matter who you complain to, nothing will change, so kneel and submit at once. We're only holding back because we don't want to damage the Tier-3 spirit herb, and even our patience has limits!”

‘The so-called society head follows the grand elder's instructions?’

Apparently, that expensive Badger mask was nothing more than a figurehead.

White Weasel poured spiritual power into the formation plate.

Rrrrrumble―

The massive stone door slammed shut, and blue formation inscriptions appeared across the surrounding walls and lit up in unison. They had used the formation to seal off every section not covered by iron plates.

As the formation inscriptions intertwined along the walls and ceiling, a barrier sealing the entrance descended over the restrictions that prevented the mine from collapsing.

For cultivators, breaking through thick iron plates was not particularly difficult, but things were different in the middle of a battle.

A Foundation Establishment member would never have enough time to break through an iron plate and flee with the Earth Escape Art right under the noses of Golden Core senior elders.

“You walked into the net on your own two feet. Blame your own stupidity!”

The dust kicked up when the stone door struck the floor had yet to settle.

Moving in perfect coordination like seasoned bandit cultivators, the two Golden Core cultivators launched their magic treasures at the same time.

Rrrrrumble!

The Azure Thunder Mother-Child Rings shot from Crane's sleeve and instantly split into nine rings of lightning in midair. The cramped hall became a prison of blue lightning as the rings closed in from every direction.

At the same time, the Golden Light Pagoda thrown by False Badger swelled until it nearly touched the ceiling, then rained dozens of golden rays down upon Lee Hyun's head.

The combined assault of the two magic treasures was far faster than expected. Before Lee Hyun could even slip beneath the floor, the lightning rings had already swept in around his feet.

Their power was a clear step above even the claws of the Tier-3 Silver-Eyed Sea Eagle he had fought not long ago.

Clatter!

Just before the attacks struck, the Six-Leaf Shield shot upward. Its six shield plates interlocked and unfolded into a defensive barrier.

BOOOOM! K-K-KRANG!

A deafening explosion tore through the hall. The shockwave swept outward, pulverizing the surrounding tables and pillars in an instant.

Nine streams of Azure Thunder crashed into it from all directions while golden rays hammered down from above. Even the Six-Leaf Shield, an exceptional supreme-grade magic tool listed in the Yunzhou Artifact Appraisal, struggled to withstand the relentless barrage.

Crack!

Cracks spread across the surfaces of the two forward shield plates that were distributing the impact, and pieces broke away from their edges. The mother ring seized the opening and slammed head-on into them, sending even the remaining four plates flying in every direction.

The instant the Six-Leaf Shield's defensive formation collapsed, Lee Hyun retrieved the damaged shield plates and flung himself backward.

The violent wind shredded the hem of his robe, but the body protected by the Three-Molt Silkworm Robe remained completely unscathed.

“Looks like you got cocky because you had an exceptional supreme-grade magic tool. Now that your shield is broken, you're finished!”

Pressing his advantage, Crane tightened the nine lightning rings around Lee Hyun from all directions while False Badger's Golden Light Pagoda bore down as though intending to crush Lee Hyun, who had been driven against the wall.

At the very instant the attacks reached him, Lee Hyun slipped smoothly into the floor.

“The Earth Escape Art? Fool! That's a profound iron plate!”

False Badger burst into mocking laughter.

But in the next instant, the black iron plate exposed beneath the displaced earth rippled like water and swallowed Lee Hyun without a trace.

“Th-The Metal Escape Art?!”

The Metal Escape Art was far more difficult than the Earth Escape Art or Water Escape Art, and even among Golden Core cultivators, few had mastered it.

Crane hurriedly extended his divine sense beneath the floor, but the moment it touched the formation inscriptions sealing the seams between the iron plates, his senses scattered chaotically. It was difficult to track Lee Hyun through the soil and bedrock beyond the formation.

“Weasel! Under the floor...!”

At that moment, the floor right beside Crane rippled, and the Cicada mask emerged like a ghost.

He came out twice as fast as he had gone in!

As the masked figure shot into the air, a dazzling golden sun, bright enough to sting the eyes, rose from his left hand.

Crane, scared out of his wits, hurriedly took out a stele-shaped defensive magic treasure and raised it before himself. The instant the stele covered his entire body, the golden sun spread into an enormous palm, ripped through the air, and smashed into both the stele and Crane!

BOOOOM―

With the thunderous impact, the entire underground estate shook as though struck by an earthquake.

‘Urgh?!’

Shielded behind the stele, Crane's eyes went wide as agony twisted through his organs.

He was clearly a Golden Core cultivator, while his opponent was only at Foundation Establishment... so how could a mere technique from his opponent, not even a magic tool, carry such overwhelming might that it felt capable of toppling a mountain?

Crrrunch! Craaack!

A tidal wave of force surged through the stele. Both of Crane's knees slammed down, caving in the floor and even the iron plate beneath it.

The enormous golden fingers closed around the stele and Crane's entire body, crushing them together.

“Help me!”

As Crane screamed, False Badger unleashed a barrage of rays at Lee Hyun with the Golden Light Pagoda. At the same time, the lightning rings of the Azure Thunder Mother-Child Rings controlled by Crane viciously tore in toward both of Lee Hyun's flanks.

Even amid attacks converging from all directions, Lee Hyun maintained the Sumeru Mountain-Suppressing Seal and swung his right arm like a bolt of lightning.

K-K-KRANG!

The Azure Steel Sword flashed into Lee Hyun's right hand, then carved through the air too fast for the eye to follow, spewing out stream after stream of ferocious sword qi!

As an enormous amount of Primordial True Qi flooded into it all at once, the blade of the supreme-grade Azure Steel Sword could not withstand the pressure and exploded with a deafening bang.

But the instant the sword shattered, the unleashed storm of violent Great Unity Heavenly Dipper Sword Qi ripped through False Badger's golden rays in one sweep, then smashed into the approaching lightning rings and sent them flying in every direction.

One of them snapped a thick pillar in the remaining hall and buried itself in the wall.

‘Impossible! He's knocking aside my magic treasure with something that's not a magic treasure, not even an exceptional supreme-grade magic tool, all while suppressing Crane with one hand?!’

A chill ran down False Badger's spine. This Inspector Cicada was a monster masquerading as a Foundation Establishment cultivator!

Judging by that monster's combat power, this cramped underground estate was hardly advantageous to them. One moment of carelessness and both Crane and he would be slaughtered.

“Weasel! Release the formation and open the door! Now!”

Forget maintaining appearances, False Badger practically shrieked the words.

White Weasel, who had been cowering in the corner, jolted back to his senses and placed both hands on the formation plate to release the seal around the doorway.

At that instant,

Lee Hyun's gaze pierced through the Cicada mask and locked onto White Weasel.

Flash!

White Weasel sensed the killing intent coming straight at him and hurriedly prepared to defend himself. But the invisible divine-sense needle imbued with vow power silently split into two in midair. One strand shot directly toward his brow, while the other curved behind his head and attacked from his blind spot!

Crack―

The protective Soul-Nourishing Jade hanging from White Weasel's waist shattered in a burst of cloudy white light. It blocked the needle coming from the front, but failed to fully stop the second needle boring into the back of his head.

“Gah!”

The shock tore through his primordial spirit, and bright red blood burst from White Weasel's eyes and nose.

As he staggered, unable to steady himself, Lee Hyun, still crushing Crane beneath the Sumeru Mountain-Suppressing Seal, kicked a fragment of the shattered Azure Steel Sword lying on the floor.

Bang!

The sword fragment, condensed with Primordial True Qi, shot forth like a meteor. It smashed straight through White Weasel's body-protecting spirit light, split the formation plate in his hand in two, then pierced through the right side of his chest and hurled him into the rock wall behind him.

“Cough...!”

White Weasel spat blood and slid limply down the wall.

The barrier over the stone door, which had just begun to fade, thickened again.

The formation itself had been buried separately deep within the bedrock. What had been destroyed was merely the formation plate used to open and close the seal over the entrance. With the release hand seal interrupted midway, the stone door locked firmly in its closed state.

‘The door is sealed!’

False Badger's hair stood on end. Breaking the stone door tangled with formation inscriptions by force would require several full-strength attacks, and there was no chance that monster would simply stand by and watch in the meantime.

Desperate to survive, he pulled another magic treasure from his storage pouch, a crimson mirror.

“Die!”

False Badger poured all his magical power into the Golden Light Pagoda above his head and the mirror before his chest. Spiritual pressure flooded the hall, so intense that an ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivator would have struggled even to breathe. Golden pagoda light and blood-red radiance formed a massive wall and surged toward Lee Hyun as if to swallow him whole.

At that very moment, the Sinking Moon Sword, the exceptional supreme-grade magic tool once ranked eighth in the Nanming Hundred Artifacts Register, appeared in Lee Hyun's right hand.

With a smooth motion.

Lee Hyun's calm gaze settled upon the slender blade, which carried a faint sheen of light.

Amid the storm of radiance pouring from the magic treasures, a single line he had retraced countless times while drawing ten thousand pictures appeared before him.

It formed one unbroken path along the outer edge of the spinning Golden Light Pagoda, through the center of the blood-red mirror shielding the body behind it, and onward to False Badger's throat.

- Let intent precede the sword tip, yet never let the sword tip stray from that intent.

Divine sense and vow power tempered through the principles of the Vajra Wisdom Sword Scripture gathered atop the extremely compressed Great Unity Heavenly Dipper Sword Qi.

Some of it failed to meld with the sword qi and remained separate, but Lee Hyun forced even that unruly power down with sheer overwhelming strength and concentrated everything into the single point he had chosen.

Unable to withstand the absurd amount of brute force its master had crammed into it, even the exceptional supreme-grade Sinking Moon Sword screamed in protest.

Great Unity Wisdom Sword, First Form, Heavenly Dipper Single Point.

The instant Lee Hyun thrust the Sinking Moon Sword forward in one short motion, a streak of sword light exploded forth!

K-K-KRANG― BANG!

The launched sword qi grazed the outer edge of the Golden Light Pagoda at an angle, showering sparks everywhere. After forcibly shoving the solid pagoda aside, the sword qi did not scatter in the slightest and pierced straight through the very center of the mirror that moved to block it!

The blood-red bronze mirror cracked like a spiderweb before shattering with a sharp report.

At that exact instant, razor-sharp sword intent slammed into False Badger's mind!

‘Gah!’

His primordial spirit was momentarily paralyzed, slowing his attempt to dodge by the slightest fraction.

The sword qi seized that opening and shot onward without hesitation, its tip piercing straight through False Badger's throat.

Shnk!

False Badger felt something hot gush from his neck. He hurriedly raised a hand, but fresh blood sprayed between his fingers. A moment later, he collapsed helplessly before the tightly sealed stone door.

Thud.

Fragments of the blood-red bronze mirror scattered across the floor, while the ownerless Golden Light Pagoda shrank back down and rolled uselessly several times before losing its light.

Toad stood with his back pressed against the wall in the corner, clutching a talisman and barely daring to breathe.

Lee Hyun looked down at the Sinking Moon Sword, whose blade was now covered in hairline cracks with a small piece chipped from its tip, and clicked his tongue.

‘Hmm... Is it because I'm still inexperienced with sword condensation...? The sword can't withstand it.’

Until he reached Major Attainment in the Sword Condensation Section of the Vajra Wisdom Sword Scripture, this was not a move he could use carelessly.

At that moment, Crane, still pinned down by the Sumeru Mountain-Suppressing Seal, shouted desperately.

“F-Fellow Daoist...! Please, stay your hand! There has been a misunderstanding!”

“Weren't you planning to kill me if I refused to leave my imprint on that jade plaque?”

“Th-That was merely a rule established by that Badger and the senior elders of northern Jing! You cannot kill this old man! The trade networks throughout northern Xuan and the Heng region all pass through this old man! If this old man dies, all the payments and medicinal-ingredient trades currently tied up in those routes will be severed, and the Two Heavens Society will suffer a tremendous blow!”

Lee Hyun turned toward Toad in the corner.

“Suppose I let only one of you live. Can you take over Crane’s work?”

“O-Of course! Everything is stored in the warehouse! The ledgers record the owners of all consigned goods and every payment, and we have records of which contact points sent and received every item! I was the one who contacted the various points and settled the payments too! Crane only ordered me around and took his share!”

Lee Hyun looked down at Crane.

“You heard him. Besides, even if your death harms the Two Heavens Society, you still have to die.”

Crane's expression changed instantly. He tried to make his golden core run rampant and detonate the Azure Thunder Mother-Child Rings lying on the floor, but,

BOOOOM!

Golden light erupted from the Sumeru Mountain-Suppressing Seal and crushed Crane's chest and arms outright. Before the Azure Thunder Mother-Child Rings could even rise, sword light flashed and ended Crane's life.

The Cicada mask turned toward the corner.

“Toad, will you remain loyal to the Two Heavens Society?”

Chapter 93

At Lee Hyun’s question, Toad stared at the Cicada mask, gripped by terror.

Just who in the world was this man!?

White Weasel was a Foundation Establishment Great Perfection cultivator. He was powerful enough to command respect in most mid-sized sects, yet a single sword fragment kicked at him by the man in the Cicada mask had left him crippled.

And that was not all.

In a chamber sealed on all sides, he had taken the combined attacks of two early Golden Core cultivators’ magic treasures head-on. Then he had utterly overwhelmed and slaughtered them.

‘This man can’t possibly be a Foundation Establishment cultivator!’

Toad swallowed hard at the sight of False Badger’s and Crane’s blood spreading across the floor.

‘If even the inspector is this powerful...... what realm could the former society head he serves possibly be in?’

When Crane had scoffed at all that talk of a former society head, dismissing him as a ghost from the distant past, Toad had silently agreed. Now he could have kicked himself for it.

He was no ghost, but a genuine old monster who had been silently watching from on high all along!

Instead of answering, Toad slammed his forehead against the floor.

Thud.

“I-I pledge my loyalty! To the Two Heavens Society, to you, Inspector... to the Society Head... I’ve been loyal all along! I only followed the senior elders’ orders. I’ve never harmed any of our members!”

His cracked voice echoed through the ruined hall.

The talisman in his hand was half-crumpled and soaked with sweat. He seemed to have abandoned all thought of activating it long ago.

“Get up for now.”

Toad rose awkwardly to his feet. His knees shook so badly that he could barely stand.

Then, as though something had just occurred to him, he hurriedly rummaged through his sleeve. He brought out the new jade token he had received from the Council of Senior Elders and presented it with both hands.

“I-I’ve already surrendered my primordial-spirit imprint to the Council of Senior Elders. Weasel has the jade plaque containing it. But whatever you ask of me, Inspector...”

“If you do your job well, I’ll release your imprint later.”

“Pardon?”

Toad stared blankly at Lee Hyun.

“But in return, you’ll have to clean up this mess properly, won’t you?”

“Of course!”

Lee Hyun was not particularly fond of Toad either, but for now, he wanted to avoid losing all of the Two Heavens Society’s transaction ledgers. Too many innocent members were involved.

Besides, Toad was only at mid Foundation Establishment, so it was unlikely that he had orchestrated the affair. If he tried anything later, Lee Hyun could deal with him then.

Lee Hyun first sealed the residual energy in the two Golden Core cultivators’ corpses, then smashed their golden cores to pieces. He could no longer sense even their souls, but there was no telling whether they had learned some sinister technique.

Bang. Bang.

Toad broke out in a cold sweat at the sight.

Lee Hyun then collected the Golden Core cultivators’ storage pouches, False Badger’s mask, and all the magic treasures scattered across the floor.

Just then, a low groan came from near the wall.

It was White Weasel.

Blood was spreading around the sword fragment lodged in the right side of his chest, but a Foundation Establishment Great Perfection cultivator was not so easily killed.

Lee Hyun took Weasel’s storage pouch and the artifacts at his waist, then sent spiritual power into his body to seal several meridians. He then pressed the acupoints around Weasel’s wound. The bleeding stopped.

White Weasel’s eyes slowly regained focus. His shoulders twitched when the Cicada mask came into view.

“...Are you going to spare me?”

“I’m only keeping you alive for now because I have some questions.”

Lee Hyun crouched in front of him.

“Who is the grand elder in northern Jing Kingdom?”

White Weasel’s lips moved soundlessly for a moment before he finally spoke.

“He is called Black Wolf. He wears a Black Wolf mask, but I have never seen him unmasked.”

“Then how did you receive his orders?”

“Normally through the Council of Senior Elders’ special jade tokens and coded messages. The grand elder is extremely reluctant to meet anyone in person. I heard that even Badger... no, that man rarely met him face-to-face.”

White Weasel’s gaze shifted to the corpse lying in front of the stone door.

The mask was gone, revealing an ordinary middle-aged face above the blood-soaked, gold-threaded robe.

“His realm?”

“All I know is that he is in the Golden Core realm. He was rumored to be at mid Golden Core or higher. Even Senior Elder Crane did not dare defy his orders.”

“Which sect does he belong to?”

“I don’t know.”

“How many senior elders are there?”

“Apart from the grand elder, Senior Elder Crane, and that man, there are two more Golden Core senior elders. One in northwestern Heng Kingdom and one in northern Jing Kingdom. The senior elders know what one another looks like, but... they did not get along.”

“Would the grand elder know immediately if a senior elder died? Have they left life tablets or soul lamps in his keeping?”

White Weasel gave a weak laugh.

“There are none. The senior elders did not trust one another.”

“Where did you keep the members’ primordial-spirit imprints?”

“...The imprints of the members I oversee in northern Xuan Kingdom and Heng Kingdom are in my storage pouch. The grand elder personally holds the imprints of the members in Jing Kingdom.”

White Weasel struggled for breath.

“I’ve told you all this... please.... I was just about to attempt Core Formation. The Council of Senior Elders had even promised me a Golden Core Condensing Pill... If you spare my life, I will be yours to command once I form my golden core, Inspector.”

Lee Hyun looked at Toad.

“Bring me that chest over there.”

Toad hurried to obey.

Lee Hyun set the chest Toad brought him in front of Weasel. It was the same chest Weasel had used to threaten him earlier. Inside were old-style identification jade tokens with broken restrictions and bloodstained surfaces.

When Lee Hyun asked about the jade tokens, White Weasel claimed he knew nothing about them and had only done as the senior elders ordered.

“You seemed rather proud of them earlier.”

“I-I...”

Weasel’s gaze shifted uneasily.

Lee Hyun pushed the chest aside and opened the storage pouch he had taken from Weasel earlier. The restrictions left by a Foundation Establishment cultivator did not hold out for long.

Inside Weasel’s storage pouch was a jade case with seven thin jade plaques slotted into it.

Each jade plaque held a member’s primordial-spirit imprint. Channeling spiritual power into the jade case would torment the primordial spirits bound to those imprints.

Toad instinctively hunched his shoulders at the sight of the jade case.

Lee Hyun asked.

“Is yours in here too?”

“The third one from the left.”

Lee Hyun turned back to Weasel.

“How do I release the imprints on these jade plaques?”

Lee Hyun gave Weasel a choice: willingly explain how to release the imprints, or endure the pain of having his memories forcibly read with the Soul-Searching Art.

Golden Core cultivators who had learned the Soul-Searching Art could forcibly read another person’s memories, but Weasel would most likely be left a mindless wreck.

Of course, Lee Hyun did not know how to use the Soul-Searching Art. But Weasel had no way of knowing that!

Having witnessed Inspector Cicada’s prowess, Weasel answered without hesitation. As Lee Hyun continued to question him rather than use the Soul-Searching Art, Weasel clung to a faint hope that he might be spared and entrusted with important duties. He even volunteered information Lee Hyun had not asked for.

Lee Hyun checked Weasel’s account against the relevant jade slips from his storage pouch. He also inspected the restrictions on the jade case and jade plaques himself.

A short while later, after testing the method, Lee Hyun released most of the imprints. Pale wisps of energy drifted out of each jade plaque and dispersed.

He kept only the jade plaque holding Toad’s imprint.

“You saw me release the other members’ primordial-spirit imprints just now, didn’t you? Once the handover is complete, I’ll release yours too.”

Hope shone in Toad’s eyes as he replied.

“I pledge my loyalty!”

Weasel struggled to lift his head.

“I’ve told you everything I know...”

Lee Hyun pressed a small jade slip, also taken from Weasel’s storage pouch, to his forehead.

It recorded which members had refused to surrender imprints, as well as the punishments inflicted through the jade case. The records were quite detailed, noting dates, bases, and even the types of masks involved.

Lee Hyun questioned Toad through voice transmission and found that he knew about several of the incidents. Cross-checking Toad’s account against the records confirmed Weasel’s direct involvement.

Lee Hyun spoke.

“I understand how much you value your life. The owners of those jade tokens must have felt the same.”

The instant Weasel’s mouth fell open in shock, the Yang Metal Art flashed, punching a hole between his brows. A moment later, his primordial spirit dispersed.

...

The stone door was still tightly shut.

Toad spoke cautiously.

“The formation plate is broken... so I can’t deactivate the formation with hand seals. The senior elders brought in an outside formation master to install it. He said that breaking the door open would require a Golden Core cultivator to attack at full strength...”

Lee Hyun pressed his palm to the wall beside the stone door. As he traced the formation inscriptions with a fine thread of divine sense, he found that the energy converged at a single point deep within the bedrock beyond the iron plate.

‘There it is.’

“I’ll be back in a moment.”

Before Toad could ask what he meant, Lee Hyun sank into the floor.

The profound iron plate rippled like water and swallowed him.

When Lee Hyun rose through the floor again, the stone door was already half-open. The blue formation inscriptions on the walls were going dark one by one.

Toad stood rooted to the spot, his mouth hanging open.

Lee Hyun stepped out through the stone doorway and spread his divine sense. He could no longer sense the guard cultivator who had been checking jade tokens at the manor’s entrance.

‘He fled.’

When crashes and tremors had begun coming from a hall occupied by two Golden Core senior elders, the guard had apparently chosen to flee rather than investigate.

Lee Hyun turned to Toad.

“Let’s start by getting things in order.”

...

The warehouse stood on the far side of the pond.

Toad lifted the restriction, and the door opened.

Inside, shelves stood in tightly packed rows, laden with jade caskets, pill bottles, and bundles of medicinal ingredients. Along one wall, jade slips containing the ledgers were slotted in numerical order.

Toad pulled out one of the ledgers.

“About half the goods here were entrusted to us. They were held under the pretext of guaranteeing transactions, then withheld until the owners paid the toll. The rest was stockpiled as the Council of Senior Elders’ share.”

...

They began settling the warehouse accounts.

Separate lists were made for returning entrusted goods to their owners and refunding the spirit stones extorted in tolls by the Council of Senior Elders to the affected bases. Some of the toll money had already gone into the senior elders’ storage pouches, but as long as it was recorded in the ledgers, it could still be repaid.

Lee Hyun decided to cover the shortfall with his own mid-grade spirit stones for now. The divine-sense restrictions on the Golden Core cultivators’ storage pouches were too strong to break immediately.

As the work in the warehouse drew to a close, Lee Hyun looked again at the chest of damaged jade tokens. Their owners had been killed for refusing to surrender their primordial spirits.

He could hardly say they had died for a society head they had never met. Most had probably resisted because they refused to place their primordial spirits in someone else’s hands. For a cultivator, having their primordial spirit held hostage was little different from being cut off from the immortal path.

Even so, as society head, he could not help feeling sorry for them.

Lee Hyun also investigated the identities of the jade tokens’ owners.

“Do any of them have surviving family or known associates?”

“The ledgers list contacts for seven of them. We’ll have to look into the rest.”

Lee Hyun handed Toad a pouch of mid-grade spirit stones.

“Find them and give each of them compensation. Limit the search to what can be confirmed through our existing contacts. And from now on, Golden Core members may no longer guarantee or broker transactions. They may participate only as parties to a transaction. The position of senior elder is abolished as well.”

Toad was astonished even as he wrote down Lee Hyun’s instructions.

The inspector had ordered such generous compensation for the families of dead Foundation Establishment members! Toad had thought him utterly ruthless, never imagining that he possessed such profound benevolence and righteousness!

“What should we do if the grand elder in northern Jing Kingdom contacts us or sends someone?”

“There’s no need to hide anything. Quietly spread word among the bases that had ties to the Council of Senior Elders. Tell them an inspector acting on the former society head’s orders visited Qingshi Ridge, and the impostor society head and the senior elder who violated the society’s rules were both slaughtered there.”

“...!”

...

Lee Hyun copied all the records there. He could not trust Toad completely.

After checking the ledgers that had been handed over, Lee Hyun released Toad’s primordial-spirit imprint as promised.

When the last wisp of energy dispersed from the jade plaque, Toad touched his head in a daze.

“Thank you, Inspector!”

Lee Hyun ordered the remaining settlements to be handled at another base. He also called for several changes to the contact routes and the way transactions were processed. He told Toad to change his mask and meeting places as well. If the grand elder sent anyone after them, Toad would be the first to be seized.

After wrapping up matters at the Qingshi Ridge base, Lee Hyun parted ways with Toad.

Rather than going straight after Black Wolf or the other Golden Core members, he decided to return somewhere safe for now.

Lee Hyun did not know Black Wolf’s face, his exact realm, or where he was staying.

The man had controlled the contact network and transaction guarantees for decades. Somewhere in northern Jing Kingdom, he probably had another manor like this one, with formations and traps already in place.

Meanwhile, Lee Hyun had hardly any usable magic tools left.

The Azure Steel Sword had shattered, and the Sinking Moon Sword had developed hairline cracks. About half of the Six-Leaf Shield was unusable as well.

There was no need to charge into enemy territory without being fully prepared.

In the worst case, a great sect from Yunzhou or Nanming might be backing the remaining Golden Core senior elders.

If they were merely Golden Core rogue cultivators, Inspector Cicada’s display of strength would surely make them keep their heads down and watch their behavior within the Two Heavens Society from now on.

On the other hand, if they were not even concerned that Inspector Cicada had killed two Golden Core members, they must have good reason for their confidence. In that case, it would be safer to avoid a confrontation for now.

...

A short message was sent to the contact bases.

Those who had impersonated the society head at Qingshi Ridge and bound the members’ primordial spirits had been executed.

Members no longer needed to pay the additional fees those men had imposed, and anyone who had not yet received their goods back was to submit their transaction records.

The contact routes passing through Qingshi Ridge were also changed.

Different people were assigned to hold the goods and handle payments. A way was also established to request verification from another base if problems arose with an intermediary.

There was no telling whether these measures would solve everything, but for now, Lee Hyun would have to wait and see how things developed.

Several days later, deep underground in eastern Xu Kingdom.

A cavern lay within the natural bedrock.

Lee Hyun was struggling to break the divine-sense restrictions on the Golden Core cultivators’ storage pouches.

Wary of hidden tracking restrictions, he had not returned directly to Tunnel No. 3. Instead, he had come here, far from his tunnel.

At last, he managed to break the restrictions on both pouches!

He began taking out the contents of False Badger’s, Crane’s, and White Weasel’s storage pouches in turn.

High-grade and mid-grade spirit stones poured out!

By a rough count, there were more than 14,000 mid-grade spirit stones alone, along with a hundred gleaming high-grade spirit stones stored in several jade caskets.

One high-grade spirit stone was worth a hundred mid-grade spirit stones. That made the spirit stones alone worth more than 24,000 mid-grade spirit stones, a staggering fortune!

“...!”

He could not help smiling.

Even after accounting for the spirit stones he had advanced for the refunds and paid out in compensation, he had made an enormous profit!

He had been deeply disappointed when the Azure Steel Sword shattered and the Six-Leaf Shield and Sinking Moon Sword were damaged.

Looking at his haul now, though, perhaps he had not needed to be so upset.

...

While sifting through the rest of the spoils, Lee Hyun found a heavy box deep inside False Badger’s storage pouch.

When he removed the seal and opened the box, sharp metal qi rose from within, revealing a fist-sized chunk of metal.

It was a rare spirit material, its surface densely patterned with gold markings as fine as threads.

‘Golden-Thread Cold Iron! And it’s a Tier 3 spirit material?’
