The many-layered golden palm slammed straight down onto the off-balance Six-Armed White Bone Demon’s crown. Its skull and sternum, refined from Tier 3 bone material, caved in at once. All six arms were ripped away in different directions, and its soul stone shattered!

“You bastard!”

Yan Wuzhen’s eyes flew wide. Even an early Golden Core cultivator might not have destroyed that puppet after a prolonged struggle, yet it had been wrecked in just a few exchanges!

Pushing off the ground, Lee Hyun slid away and, without even pausing for breath, directed six yellow flying swords and the Sinking Moon Sword at once. Dozens of streaks of sword light and white-hot fireballs shot toward Yan Wuzhen again like driving rain.

...

The one-eyed Elder watched from behind a shattered boulder, his lips blue with fear.

With the spiritual power of a Foundation Establishment cultivator at Great Perfection, Lee Hyun had withstood a late Golden Core great cultivator’s magic treasure and White Bone Yin Fire, then smashed a Tier 3 bone puppet in an instant.

[Elder! Shouldn’t we ambush that bastard while he’s occupied with Perfected Yan and the remaining flood-dragon puppet?]

The Elder resented his Junior’s apparent attempt to prod him into acting, but the suggestion itself was sound. If Yan Wuzhen faltered, none of them would leave the island alive.

‘But even Perfected Yan is struggling against that bastard... An ambush is my only chance.’

The Elder thought of his hidden trump card, the life-bound bone nail. He held his breath and began pouring all his magical power into the bone nail.

Lee Hyun slipped beneath the bedrock to avoid a beam of magical power spat out by the White Bone Flood-Dragon Puppet, then emerged on the other side and turned his head with uncanny fluidity.

The instant their gazes met, the coldness in Lee Hyun’s eyes sent a shiver through the one-eyed Elder.

Whooosh–

An invisible force clamped around the Elder’s chest and wrenched him mercilessly into the air.

‘Gah?!’

Panicking, the Elder surrounded himself with body-protecting magical light and activated the Skywalking Art, but he could not stop himself from being dragged forward.

Still firing fireballs and sword light behind him at Yan Wuzhen, Lee Hyun stepped toward the Elder, who had been pulled right before him.

Hummmm–

The golden hand of the Sumeru Mountain-Suppressing Seal rose from Lee Hyun’s left hand, clenched into a fist, and struck the Elder square in the face!

Bang!

“Ghk!”

Before he could even launch his life-bound bone nail, the Elder was sent flying, spitting blood as his body smashed deep into the valley wall.

Lee Hyun flicked a finger, sending a sharp streak of light through the falling dust to pierce the Elder’s brow and primordial spirit in a single strike.

...

A chill ran down Yan Wuzhen’s spine as he watched the one-eyed Elder get dragged away and crushed in a single breath.

Even in the brief moments Lee Hyun spent killing the Elder, the barrage of sword light and fireballs bearing down on Yan Wuzhen had not slackened in the slightest!

‘Dammit, one wrong move and I could die here today!’

Yan Wuzhen struck himself just beneath the sternum with his left hand and spat out a mouthful of bright-red essence blood.

From his sleeve rose the Myriad-Soul White Bone Banner, a sinister magic treasure with pitch-black silk attached to a pole of linked human vertebrae. It drank in every last drop of essence blood.

Screeeeeech–

Thousands of resentful spirits let out ear-splitting screams as black mist poured from the White Bone Banner like a waterfall, engulfing the entire valley at once.

Within the surging mist, thousands of evil ghosts and resentful spirits of demon beasts clung to Lee Hyun’s body-protecting spirit light and gnawed away at his spiritual power. Waves of ghostly wailing shook his primordial spirit and sea of consciousness.

The Essence-Protecting Seal in Lee Hyun’s sea of consciousness vibrated ceaselessly, consuming spiritual power at an alarming rate.

Within the mist, Yan Wuzhen’s body underwent a strange transformation of its own.

Crack-crack! Crunch!

Profound Yin White Bone Armor grew out through his skin, encasing his entire body in an unbroken shell. Nine blood-red bone spears sprang up behind him and moved as one with the White Bone Flood-Dragon Puppet hidden in the mist, hemming Lee Hyun in from every side!

Nine Nether Yin Wind raged through the mist as well, while the mist rendered both sight and divine sense useless.

“It doesn’t matter how much spiritual power you have. Once you’re blind and deaf and your primordial spirit has rotted away, you’re nothing but a lump of meat.”

As Yan Wuzhen’s voice echoed from beyond the mist, the nine bone spears stabbed at Lee Hyun’s blind spots.

But at that very moment, a clear, majestic golden radiance, bright enough to sting the eyes, blossomed amid the tide of evil spirits.

Deep within Lee Hyun’s sea of consciousness, the All-Hearing Heavenly King manifestation of the Sumeru Visualization Scripture rose to its full height. The scripture had reached Major Attainment, and the manifestation repelled the surging ghostly wailing and the resentful spirits’ corrosive assault, keeping his primordial spirit clear.

Buddha-Light True Qi then burst brilliantly from Lee Hyun’s hands.

He struck out repeatedly with the Demon-Subduing Seal in his left hand and spread a web of fire with the Flame-Threading Art in his right. The golden Dharma seals and flames of the Buddhist tradition, which purified resentful spirits and ghostly entities, spun like a vast wheel, forcing back the black mist all around him.

Screeeech!

The resentful spirits screamed and evaporated into smoke as the Buddha-Light True Qi touched them, while the mist was violently driven back to either side.

Spirit Light Shields infused with Buddha-Light True Qi sprang into being once more. This time, they held firm against the White Bone Yin Fire instead of melting, golden ripples spreading across their surfaces.

The Six-Leaf Shield and yellow flying swords circling Lee Hyun struck the nine exposed spears like lightning.

Screeeech! Bang!

Riding the recoil as his flying swords and shield plates knocked away the bone spears, Lee Hyun swept the Sinking Moon Sword through an elegant arc.

Hummmm–

At that instant, dozens of streaks of silver light awoke throughout the valley, both in the open air and in the shadows of the cliffs!

They were strands of Great Unity Heavenly Dipper Sword Qi that Lee Hyun had been scattering throughout the valley since the very first exchange of his battle with Yan Wuzhen.

Their presence completely concealed until now, the strands of sword qi answered one another the instant the mist parted, turning the entire valley into a vast prison of swords!

Great Unity Heavenly Dipper, Thirty-Fourth Form: Sword Net.

‘He has the magical power of the Buddhist tradition and a sword formation too?!’

Horrified, Yan Wuzhen swung the Myriad-Soul White Bone Banner to tear through the sword formation. But dozens of streaks of sword light rained in from all directions, interlocking with white-hot fireballs glowing gold with Buddha-Light True Qi to shred the White Bone Banner’s silk!

Boom-boom-boom-boooom–

The Myriad-Soul White Bone Banner screamed as it shattered, and Yan Wuzhen spat blood from the backlash.

He hurriedly charged one wall of the sword formation, using the spears and the White Bone Flood-Dragon Puppet as shields.

Screeeeech!

Several streaks of sword light were ground apart by bone and yin wind, but before a gap could open, fresh sword qi poured from Lee Hyun’s Sinking Moon Sword and filled it at once.

Earth-Origin Force kept seizing Yan Wuzhen’s ankles and shoulders, wrenching him off course. Whenever he faltered, fireballs and sword light swept in from every direction.

‘I just have to hold out! He can’t keep using the Buddhist tradition’s techniques, a sword formation, and that strange pulling force without exhausting his spiritual power.’

Yan Wuzhen gritted his teeth and poured magical power into the Profound Yin White Bone Armor covering his body and the blue jade token.

Yet even after dozens of breaths, Lee Hyun’s assault showed no sign of weakening. On the contrary, the sword light filling the valley only grew denser.

Amid the battle, screams broke out one after another along the ridges surrounding the valley.

“Aaargh!”

“Help–”

Even while controlling the sword formation, Lee Hyun occasionally flicked strands of sword qi toward them. The four terrified Foundation Establishment cultivators abandoned their formation flags and tried to flee, only to have their body-protecting spirit light pierced as they tumbled from the ridge one after another.

Yan Wuzhen’s eyelids twitched.

Driving the Nine Nether Yin Wind Fan, the White Bone Flood-Dragon Puppet, the nine bone spears, and the blue jade token to their limits had already drained more than half the magical power within his golden core.

Yet the young man standing beyond the sword formation continued to draw on what seemed an inexhaustible reserve of spiritual power.

‘At this rate, I’ll die!’

With his life hanging in the balance, Yan Wuzhen burned his essence blood without hesitation.

BOOOOM!

He detonated all nine remaining spears against the top of the sword formation, forcibly tearing open its ceiling.

At the same time, Yan Wuzhen’s body burst apart into blood-red mist, then split into three streaks that shot across the sky in different directions!

‘Blood Escape Art? He can split himself into three...’

The sophisticated technique caught Lee Hyun off guard for a moment, but his mastery of the Aura-Reading Art and Farsight Art had reached a transcendent level, allowing him to see through all three streaks of blood-red light at once.

‘The middle one!’

Lee Hyun clenched his left hand as though trying to crush the air itself.

Whooooom–

An anchor of Earth-Origin Force, fed without restraint by the Primordial True Qi throughout his body, caught the central streak of blood-red light squarely in midair!

The upward momentum of Yan Wuzhen’s blood-light form collided head-on with the savage force dragging him down, warping the crimson figure in midair before it could escape the sword formation.

“Aaaaargh!”

The two decoy blood-shadows on either side dissolved into nothing. Trapped by the pulling force, Yan Wuzhen was forced back into his true form in midair, spitting blood!

During that brief delay, the sword formation overhead knitted itself together again, completely sealing off his escape through the sky.

With even his Blood Escape Art thwarted, Yan Wuzhen’s eyes took on the frenzy of a cornered beast.

“I’m taking you with me, you monstrous bastard!”

He forced more magical power and essence blood into the White Bone Flood-Dragon Puppet and his fan.

The White Bone Flood-Dragon Puppet swallowed the essence blood and let out a valley-shaking roar, charging Lee Hyun as though intent on blowing itself apart. His bone armor gleaming, Yan Wuzhen swept his fan downward, unleashing a pitch-black hurricane that seemed capable of splitting the valley in two.

Another brilliant golden sun blazed from Lee Hyun’s left hand.

Three Sumeru Mountain-Suppressing Seals appeared at once, blotting out the sky!

The three golden palm imprints smashed mercilessly down on the charging White Bone Flood-Dragon Puppet. It shattered as it crashed into the ground.

Yan Wuzhen’s Great Wind Blade tore through the wreckage and bore down on Lee Hyun’s face.

Crack-crack!

Spirit Light Shields sprang up and shattered in rapid succession, while the Six-Leaf Shield spun at an angle to deflect most of the impact.

The black blade that slipped through tore apart Lee Hyun’s body-protecting spirit light. Just as it was about to bite into his left shoulder, the first spirit molt sprang from the Three-Molt Silkworm Robe beneath his outer robe and intercepted it.

As Lee Hyun swung the Sinking Moon Sword, a yellow flying sword rose silently into the lower left of Yan Wuzhen’s vision.

Yan Wuzhen turned the blue jade token’s barrier toward it and prepared to attack Lee Hyun with his remaining strength. At that instant, the energy carried by the yellow flying sword suddenly transformed into something on an entirely different level!

‘Wh-what is this?!’

Yan Wuzhen’s primordial spirit seized up as though struck by lightning, interrupting the circulation of his magical power for an instant.

Deprived of its master’s control, the blue screen of light wavered. In that instant, sword light from the sword formation closing in on all sides converged on a single point, forcing the screen inward.

Screeeeech–

Yan Wuzhen snapped back to his senses and hurriedly tried to pull away, but a dazzling point of light shot into view.

Crunch!

The flying sword punched through the buckled screen of light, pierced the Profound Yin White Bone Armor around Yan Wuzhen’s neck head-on, and buried itself deep in his upper chest!

Sword qi and vow power exploded inside his chest, shredding his organs and meridians.

Yan Wuzhen’s jaw went slack, and the strength drained from the hand gripping his fan.

Without withdrawing the flying sword, Lee Hyun drove the divine sense and vow power carried by its sword qi all the way through, scattering every last trace of Yan Wuzhen’s struggling primordial spirit.

Thud!

The late Golden Core great cultivator’s corpse fell onto the shattered bedrock alongside the blue jade token, now drained of light.

The black yin wind that had howled as though it would swallow the valley died away with startling suddenness.

...

Lee Hyun remained where he was for a while, sweeping the island and its surroundings with his divine sense. Only after confirming that no other presences remained did he disperse the sword qi suspended in the air that made up the sword formation.

One spirit molt of the Three-Molt Silkworm Robe had been damaged, but it would regrow with time and nurturing. The yellow flying swords, the Sinking Moon Sword, and the Six-Leaf Shield were all intact.

To spare the Six-Leaf Shield from damage, he had relied on sheer numbers of Spirit Light Shields this time. Against White Bone Yin Fire, they had consumed far too much spiritual power for the protection they offered, but once he mixed in Buddha-Light True Qi, the basic technique had proved quite useful.

‘Late Golden Core cultivators really are strong, and they have plenty of tricks.’

A single late Golden Core cultivator was more difficult to deal with than several of the early or mid Golden Core cultivators and demon beasts he had fought before.

Should he encounter a cultivator at the Great Perfection stage of Golden Core who excelled at magical combat, even he could not afford to be careless.

He had more spiritual power, but pitting it against magical power also consumed much more of it. Having greater reserves did not solve everything as neatly as he had expected.

Fortunately, his Buddha-Light True Qi had been well suited to countering this opponent’s techniques. Against techniques that countered his own, the battle would have been far more exhausting.

After briefly catching his breath, Lee Hyun began clearing the battlefield.

He picked out Tier 3 bone fragments and pieces of shattered bone spears worth studying from the remains of the White Bone Flood-Dragon Puppet and Six-Armed White Bone Demon, then carefully gathered the magic tools, storage pouches, and formation flags scattered around the battlefield.

When Lee Hyun took the one-eyed old man’s storage pouch, he found all five pieces of bone material he had sold earlier that day untouched inside it. The discovery left him with an odd feeling.

‘This makes it look like I scammed him....’

Ten days later, in a cave beneath a deserted stretch of coastal cliffs.

Lee Hyun lowered a jade slip from his forehead, his eyes gleaming. He had found it in the late Golden Core cultivator’s storage pouch.

It was the Golden Core Section of the 《Profound Yin White Bone True Scripture》!

Chapter 97

Lee Hyun pressed the jade slip to his forehead again.

He extended his divine sense deep into the jade slip. The methods for refining bone material and the restrictions recorded within revealed principles far more profound and intricate than those he had learned in the Foundation Establishment Section.

The instructions for creating the White Bone Flood-Dragon Puppet and Six-Armed White Bone Demon that Yan Wuzhen had commanded especially caught his attention, and he unconsciously straightened his back and leaned forward.

‘Even the way the soul stone is used is different.’

Tier 3 bone puppets were on an entirely different level from their Tier 2 counterparts.

Making them involved more than simply coordinating their movements through restrictions. The distinct demonic nature embedded in the bones of different demon beasts had to be burned away, and the patterns deep within their marrow made to resonate as one.

Bones taken from several creatures had to be reforged with magical power and yin fire, fusing their bone channels and bone structure into a single whole, as though they had belonged to one enormous skeletal demon beast from birth.

With the limbs connected as a single body, all six arms could move without the slightest delay or interference the moment the soul stone issued a command.

Lee Hyun took an arm bone salvaged from the shattered Six-Armed White Bone Demon out of his storage pouch.

The battle had damaged some of the formation inscriptions covering its surface. Yet as he compared the bone with the diagrams in the jade slip, he could faintly trace the bone channels running deep within it.

‘The whole thing is linked together like one enormous, seamless magic treasure. Any impact on a bone saber is transmitted through the bone channels to the entire skeleton......’

He understood the basic principles, but creating Tier 3 bone puppets was still beyond him as a Foundation Establishment cultivator.

Even the first refining stage, which melded bones with different properties into a single whole, required a Golden Core cultivator’s core flame and magical power. His ability to convert Primordial True Qi into Profound Yin White Bone True Qi did not bridge the gulf in quality between Foundation Establishment spiritual power and Golden Core magical power.

‘Once I reach Golden Core, I’ll study it when I get bored.’

He now had nearly fifty Tier 2 Bonefuzz puppets.

But with the enemies he faced growing stronger, large numbers of Tier 2 Bonefuzz would not count for much in battle.

Moreover, operating Tier 3 bone puppets would require high-grade spirit stones, so he would probably have to reduce the number of Bonefuzz considerably.

‘The bodies themselves have to be refined to rival magic treasures... I’d be better off keeping my Tier 3 Bonefuzz to an elite force of ten at most.’

...

After skimming the cultivation methods in the main text, Lee Hyun carefully examined the various secret techniques appended at the back.

The text contained a vast store of knowledge: methods for appraising the quality of bone material, the secret teachings of Bone Cleansing for washing away residual blood qi and impure qi, techniques for tempering bone with yin fire until it was as hard as cast iron, and even principles for containing a refined bone saber’s power so it would not dissipate at the tip.

He lingered over the section on tempering with yin fire for a long time.

White Bone Yin Fire and the Clear Yang Purifying Fire he wielded had opposing yin and yang natures. Still, he saw plenty of ways to adapt his Flame-Threading Art to the technique of dividing flames into fine strands and sending them deep into the marrow.

Lee Hyun took out a blank jade slip and diligently recorded the ideas that came to him. He separated what he could practice immediately from what he would test after reaching Golden Core, and marked the sections he could compare against the actual items in his possession.

Then, while reading the basic methods for preparing bone material, he suddenly stopped writing.

He had practiced these techniques until they were second nature.

Lee Hyun took out a piece of bone material he had sold to a shop, then recovered from the one-eyed Elder’s storage pouch.

He had simply followed the Foundation Establishment Section of 《Profound Yin White Bone True Scripture》, preparing the bone material without damaging its spiritual nature. Yet that minor habit had left a telltale trace of Haigu Island.

A passage from the Seven-Aspect Disguise Method, learned long ago, came to mind. It taught that he had to alter not only his eyes, mouth, and voice, but also his gait and posture, his breathing, and even his smallest habits.

He had never imagined that a technique so ingrained he no longer noticed it could become a clue that allowed others to track him down.

Lee Hyun set down the bone material.

Would it be better to change how he prepared it from now on?

But without studying the bone-working methods passed down by many other sects and rogue cultivators, he could not tell exactly which parts of the process were unique to Haigu Island.

‘At the very least, I should avoid selling prepared bone material at cultivator markets for a while.’

Only after organizing several jade slips did he begin taking out the other spoils he had roughly sorted just after the battle.

...

260 high-grade spirit stones.

8,400 mid-grade spirit stones.

That was what he had found in spirit stones alone after emptying the storage pouches of two Golden Core cultivators and four Foundation Establishment cultivators.

Lee Hyun spent a while gazing at the high-grade spirit stones lined up on the stone table. The colors shimmering within the clear crystals were particularly beautiful.

‘What a windfall.’

He could not help smiling.

Most of the spirit stones had come from the storage pouch of Yan Wuzhen, a formidable late Golden Core cultivator. Magic tools, talismans, pills, formation flags, formation plates, and all kinds of spirit materials also spilled onto the stone table in heaps.

The Nine Nether Yin Wind Fan and the blue jade token were magic treasures, so he set them aside for now. Having faced them in a life-and-death battle, he knew all too well how devastating they were, but he could not use them properly while he remained at Foundation Establishment. Even after reaching Golden Core, their incompatibility with his cultivation art would make them unsuitable as his primary treasures.

‘I’ll have to sell these too... Since they’re from Nanming, it should be easier to avoid being traced if I sell them far away in the Nine Kingdoms of Yunzhou.’

Lee Hyun sealed the two magic treasures.

He ruled out selling the mid-sized flying boat that Yan Wuzhen’s group had arrived in. The hull construction and internal formation layouts of a great sect’s flying boats were distinctive enough that there was a serious risk of its origins being recognized even in another region.

For now, he had activated its shrinking restriction and put it in his storage pouch. He had already removed the sect markings and severed the tracking restrictions before coming to this cave.

‘I’ll keep the flying boat. After I’ve studied the artifact-refining art some more, I can completely alter its appearance and restrictions and use it myself. If that doesn’t work, I can dismantle it for spirit materials. Come to think of it, I’ve never studied flight magic tools or flying boats.’

He also carefully kept the high-quality Tier 3 bone material, along with fragments of the White Bone Flood-Dragon Puppet and Six-Armed White Bone Demon that would help him study their construction.

They would be useful for refining magic treasures or creating new Tier 3 Bonefuzz once he reached Golden Core.

He had been selling some of the many Tier 3 demon-beast bones he had accumulated through hunting, but his newfound supply of spirit stones meant there was no longer any need to take that risk.

He set aside anything unsettling and of little research value, such as the remains of the Myriad-Soul White Bone Banner, without a second thought.

Finally, Lee Hyun took out every Golden Core Condensing Pill and demon core he currently possessed. Jade caskets bearing Spirit-Sealing Talismans were lined up on the table one after another.

Thirty-six completed Golden Core Condensing Pills. And thirteen intact Tier 3 demon cores that had yet to be refined into pills.

These were the hard-won results of the past ten years spent hunting across the treacherous outer sea and traveling back and forth to Huoyun Pavilion.

Although he had failed several times while refining Golden Core Condensing Pills, the process had gone far more smoothly than he had initially feared.

‘I’m more than halfway there.’

While counting the jade caskets, Lee Hyun glanced at the mound of high-grade spirit stones beside them. Then he looked back at the caskets containing demon cores.

‘...Wait. Do I really need to hunt them all myself? Tracking down Tier 3 demon beasts one by one isn’t easy... I could just buy a few of the demon cores I still need.’

A coastal cultivator market in western Kun Kingdom.

Inside a shop that dealt in bone material, the owner swallowed hard, drenched in cold sweat. The ordinary-looking old man across from him merely sat in silence, neither smiling nor showing anger, yet the shopkeeper was close to fainting from fear.

“When did you say that young man last came here?”

“About fifteen days ago. He wore a long gray robe and looked a little over twenty. He was at Great Perfection in the Foundation Establishment realm.”

“Had he been here before?”

“Yes. Several times... But I do not know his name or which sect he belongs to.”

The old man was silent for a moment.

News had arrived from the main sect that Yan Wuzhen’s soul lamp had gone out, and the Golden Core Elder and four disciples from the coastal branch had failed to return as well. Retracing their movements had revealed one final common link: this shop and the young man in gray.

But there was no way a mere Foundation Establishment cultivator could have killed Yan Wuzhen.

“Did you ever see anyone who might have been backing him?”

“No. He always came alone.”

The shopkeeper hastily shook his head, afraid he would be beheaded.

The old man set the piece of bone material he had been turning over in his hand down on the table.

“Report it immediately if anyone comes to buy or sell bone material.”

“Yes, yes! I will remember!”

Once the old man was outside, the disciple following him sent a voice transmission.

[There have been reports that no signs of Tier 3 demon beasts have been found in several areas of the outer sea lately.]

The old man’s gaze darkened.

Three months later.

Lee Hyun happened to hear news circulating through the Two Heavens Society’s trading network. Several powerful cultivators from Nanming were going through the cultivator markets of western Kun Kingdom with a fine-tooth comb in search of someone, and bone-material transactions were now subject to much tighter scrutiny.

‘I’ll have to stop using that face. After killing an Elder of a great sect, I’d better stay well away from the markets there for a while.’

Fortunately, he had already changed his hunting base. After leaving Kun Kingdom’s western coast and moving to southwestern Xu Kingdom, he had begun studying the patrol ranges of Baoguang Temple’s monks.

The monks appeared least often along the southernmost stretch of coastline on the border between Cangmang Forest and Xu Kingdom. It lay farthest from the main temple, and the monks were more accustomed to fighting on land than at sea.

He should be able to hunt Tier 3 demon beasts in the area, provided he avoided the territories within Cangmang Forest held by Tier 4 members of the demon race, who were on par with Nascent Soul cultivators.

...

Qianlu Market in the Hua Kingdom.

In a small appraisal room, an elderly cultivator examining the magic treasures set down the Nine Nether Yin Wind Fan.

“This is from Nanming.”

“It is.”

After looking over the fan and the blue jade token in turn, the elderly cultivator began explaining the damage to their restrictions and how many spirit stones the repairs would cost. He phrased it indirectly, but he was clearly trying to drive the price down drastically.

Lee Hyun heard him out in silence before speaking.

“The Nine Nether Yin Wind restriction at its core is undamaged. If your judgment is too poor to recognize even that, I will take the fan somewhere its value will be properly appreciated.”

When Lee Hyun reached to take the fan back without hesitation, the startled elderly cultivator quickly laid a palm over it.

“Now, hold on. When did I say it couldn’t be used? Let’s discuss the price again.”

...

After a little haggling, the two magic treasures fetched an impressive 340 high-grade spirit stones. That they had commanded such a price despite their minor damage was another reminder of just how wealthy and formidable an opponent Yan Wuzhen had been.

Lee Hyun continued moving between markets and changing his face as he sold off the things he did not need.

One by one, magic tools inferior to his own, pills unsuited to his cultivation art, formation flags and formation plates that gave off a sinister aura, and useless talismans and spirit materials were all exchanged for spirit stones.

He also sold fragments that were useless as magic treasures but still had some value as materials.

The magic tools, pills, and formation supplies brought in 6,200 mid-grade spirit stones, while the remaining spirit materials and debris earned him another 1,800.

Emptying so many of his crammed storage pouches felt like finally getting over a stubborn bout of indigestion.

He now kept only a few items for combat: the Sinking Moon Sword and six yellow flying swords as his main weapons, with the Six-Leaf Shield and Three-Molt Silkworm Robe for defense.

...

Once he had finished trading, Lee Hyun returned to Tunnel No. 3 with a spring in his step.

As he passed through the long underground passage, the familiar sound of flowing water reached his ears and put him at ease.

A Bonefuzz carrying a bucket happened to be passing at the far end of the tunnel. It paused when it sensed Lee Hyun’s presence. Inside its skull, the fuzzbee wiggled its antennae in greeting; then the puppet puffed out its chest again and marched proudly on.

Lee Hyun chuckled as he watched it go.

The fuzzbees sometimes used the Bonefuzz to fetch water from the reservoir and sprinkle it over the spirit fields. Lee Hyun’s formation inscriptions and bamboo pipes already watered the plants automatically at the proper times, but the little fellows apparently grew bored playing in the tunnel and liked to pretend they had work to do.

Whenever they watered the fields, the moisture-sensing formation inscriptions adjusted their timing, delaying the activation of the Water-Drawing Inscription. It made little difference to the growing spirit plants.

“Be careful. Too much water will rot the roots.”

Lee Hyun called out the warning to the passing fuzzbees, then began a thorough inspection of the spirit fields now that he was home.

“It’s been a while. Perhaps I should go over the accounts.”

...

Lee Hyun spread his old, timeworn ledgers across the stone table.

The records from before he had begun serious research into the Essence-Cultivating Dao Pill were still intact. At the time, he had possessed 8,000 mid-grade spirit stones and planned to cover any shortfall in material costs by selling his older spirit plants a little at a time.

Over the following centuries, he had sold Essence-Cultivating Pills and spirit herbs and accepted other alchemy commissions to pay for materials.

The roughly 24,000 spirit stones he had obtained from Qingshi Ridge, together with the proceeds from selling the Golden Light Pagoda and Azure Thunder Mother-Child Rings, had once brought his holdings close to 50,000 mid-grade spirit stones. But as he bought a Tier 3 pill furnace, repaired magic tools, acquired medicinal ingredients, and rented earth fire, that mountain of wealth steadily melted away.

After all that spending, only a little over the equivalent of 6,000 mid-grade spirit stones had remained just before he encountered Yan Wuzhen’s group.

‘So this is where all those spirit stones went.’

Lee Hyun looked down at his powerful arm. His body had been transformed from head to toe, down to the very joints of his fingers. Every part of it could now refine spiritual power equal in quality to that of a Foundation Establishment cultivator at Great Perfection.

He leafed through the spirit-plant ledger.

Since his last accounting, his stock of older spirit plants had decreased by thirty-four Bone-Rot Flowers, fifty-eight Yin Soul Grass plants, twenty-two Purple Poison Orchids, and fourteen roots from the earlier planting of Spirit-Storing Ginseng.

Most had been sold; some had gone into his research.

The spirit plants he had sold for Wang Shulin long ago had already been deducted in an earlier ledger. After carefully cross-checking the records, Lee Hyun copied down the remaining quantities.

「Bone-Rot Flowers: 404 plants.

Yin Soul Grass: 1,102 plants.

Purple Poison Orchids: 288 plants.

Earlier planting of Spirit-Storing Ginseng: 518 roots.

Later planting of Spirit-Storing Ginseng: 276 roots.」

The young spirit plants replanted in place of the harvested ones were recorded separately.

While inspecting the spirit fields, he noticed that one Bone-Rot Flower was a slightly different shade from those around it.

‘This is definitely...’

With a touch of excitement, Lee Hyun carefully inspected the other spirit fields as well.

He singled out four Bone-Rot Flowers, six Yin Soul Grass plants, and two Purple Poison Orchids. All had crossed the threshold of a thousand years in medicine age, causing their medicinal potency to change.

He had finally grown Tier 4 spirit plants!

Back when he had left Qinghe Valley and first planted seeds in his tunnel, he had imagined that such a day would come. Even so, it had seemed no more than a vague, distant prospect.

It felt like only yesterday that he had grinned at a single fifty-year-old Bone-Rot Flower, wondering how much it would fetch. Those tiny shoots had grown into Tier 2 spirit plants, then Tier 3, and now they held a thousand years of medicinal potency, enough to attract even a Nascent Soul cultivator’s attention.

‘Time really does fly.’

Most of the older plants, however, were still just short of a thousand years in medicine age. There was little he could do about it; these were not high-grade spirit fields brimming with heaven-and-earth spiritual qi.

Still, pride welled up in him at the thought that he had nurtured them this far in the barren earth with nothing but time and care.

Lee Hyun marked the locations of all twelve plants separately. He had no intention of selling them for the time being.

He also inspected the fields of Jade-Condensing Grass, Fire-Heart Orchids, and Midnight-Noon Grass in turn. There had been so many rounds of harvesting and replanting that, rather than tracking the original planting numbers, it was far easier to record how many of each spirit herb had reached a medicine age suitable for immediate use.

Although he had spent hundreds, even thousands, of years selling spirit herbs to support his cultivation, the spirit fields remained abundant, and their value continued to grow by the day.

...

Lee Hyun moved on to the Ringless Divine Tree and checked his old records.

‘Has it been about 1,760 years since it sprouted...?’

The first dark-blue lightning markings were said to appear at two thousand years, so its first transformation was drawing near. Of course, his original goal of obtaining Profound Nether Frost Lightning required five thousand years, leaving him with a long wait ahead.

Lee Hyun checked the moisture around its roots before moving to the next spirit field.

Beneath the stone ceiling he had widened around it, the Heaven-Origin Divine Tree steadily spread its branches. He had tended it for roughly a thousand years since bringing it here, yet there were still no flower buds at the tips of its branches.

Lee Hyun compared the jade slip he had received long ago with his own observation records. Judging by the thickness of the trunk, the veins of the leaves, and the qi flowing through its branches, the tree appeared to have accumulated a medicine age of only a little over three hundred years.

‘That’s about what I first expected. Unlike the Ringless Divine Tree, this one really does seem to depend heavily on the surrounding spiritual qi.’

This was the only field he had enclosed in a Tier 1 Qi-Gathering Formation. If the tree could make so little progress even with that assistance, its spiritual qi requirements had to be greater than those of his other spirit plants.

Lee Hyun replaced the low-grade spirit stones in the Qi-Gathering Formation with fresh ones.

Gazing up at the familiar branches he had painted countless times long ago brought him a quiet sense of satisfaction, even though neither the Ringless Divine Tree nor the Heaven-Origin Divine Tree had yet produced the results he was waiting for.

For now, reaching Golden Core came first. With so much to research, there was no time to dwell on the two divine trees’ slow growth.

The outer sea southwest of Xu Kingdom.

Rough waves surged between the reefs, churning white foam. Hidden in a crevice among the rocks on the seabed, his presence concealed, Lee Hyun quietly watched the enormous shadow passing before him.

It was a Tier 3 demon beast with broad bony plates rising from its back. The creature had been hunting for food in these waters for several days.

Lee Hyun had followed the shell fragments and claw marks scattered across the seabed to find where it lived. Now he lay in wait along its usual route.

Just as its tail swept over a rock, an enormous golden hand shot up beneath its belly, cleaving through the seawater.

Boom!

The seawater exploded upward. Just as the ambushed beast opened its mouth to unleash a jet of water, Lee Hyun shot out from the crevice like a streak of light.

Flash!

As the demon beast twisted, sword light plunged deep beneath its jaw.

Its massive body convulsed a couple of times, then went limp and sank to the seabed.

Lee Hyun first located the demon core with his divine sense. Fortunately, it was intact, without so much as a crack.

‘Good.’

He dragged the demon beast’s heavy carcass up onto a nearby reef.

As always, the fight was over quickly. Far more time and effort had gone into finding the beast’s route, waiting in silence, and positioning himself for a single killing strike that would leave the demon core unharmed.

Lee Hyun expertly butchered the demon beast and retrieved its demon core, then quickly picked out only the valuable parts of the carcass.

...

When he was not out hunting, he traveled through the inland and coastal cultivator markets of the Nine Kingdoms of Yunzhou, purchasing Tier 3 demon cores.

Buying demon cores at cultivator markets required particular care. Unlike those he obtained through his own hunts, many had been stored so poorly that much of their vital essence had already dissipated. Others looked intact on the outside but had hairline fractures in the demon markings within.

At sea, he avoided lingering aimlessly in the same waters, wary of leaving a trail. He hunted only where there were recent signs of demon beasts and readily crossed off his sea charts any hunting grounds that had remained empty for months.

Whenever trading took him inland, he also made the effort to visit markets in other regions in search of demon cores. He paid a premium whenever necessary for high-quality demon cores and materials suitable for alchemy.

Five years passed.

A refining chamber at Huoyun Pavilion.

Red earth fire burned evenly beneath the Demon-Suppressing Three-Legged Furnace. Lee Hyun divided his Clear Yang Purifying Fire into fine threads and wrapped them densely around the pill furnace’s surface.

Inside the pill furnace, the last demon core was slowly melting. As medicinal liquids with different properties combined one after another, Lee Hyun lowered the flames a fraction and gently resolved any clashes between their properties.

He had repeated the process dozens of times over the years until it was second nature, yet he took his time right to the end.

...

The next day.

Lee Hyun’s fingertips moved with crisp precision. Guided by the Pill-Condensing Seal, the medicinal strength scattered throughout the furnace converged on a single point.

Hummmmm―

The pill furnace hummed, clear light spilling from beneath its lid. Lee Hyun changed his hand seal and calmly drew off the residual fire qi before slowly opening the furnace.

A round pill with a faint glow floated up. He carefully caught it in the jade casket he had prepared. Only after checking its surface and confirming with his divine sense that the medicinal strength inside was intact did he let his shoulders relax.

“It’s finished.”

Over the past five years, he had obtained another twenty-three intact demon cores through hunting and purchased ten from various cultivator markets, choosing only those of exceptional quality. Together with the thirteen he had kept from before, that made forty-six.

Six attempts at refining them had failed. The nature of the demon markings varied from beast to beast, and even seemingly sound demon cores sometimes behaved unexpectedly once they melted, their medicinal strength flowing in ways he had not anticipated.

Each time, however, he carefully recorded the cause of the failure and avoided making the same mistake in his next attempt.

He had successfully refined forty new Golden Core Condensing Pills. Added to the thirty-six he had already made, that brought the total to seventy-six.

Lee Hyun lined the jade caskets bearing Spirit-Sealing Talismans up on the table and counted them one by one. He counted once, blinked, then counted again.

Seventy-six.

‘That’s enough.’

It was a full twenty-six more than his minimum target of fifty. If he still failed after taking this many, it would not be for lack of Golden Core Condensing Pills.

Lee Hyun picked up a jade casket. An ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivator might risk their life to obtain just one of these pills.

With seventy-six of those precious pills to his name, his chest swelled with pride.

‘But I have to swallow all of these in one sitting.... I’m not going to explode, am I?’

...

After returning to Tunnel No. 3, Lee Hyun went over his accounts one final time before entering secluded cultivation.

Adding his previous balance, the spirit stones taken from Yan Wuzhen’s group, the proceeds from selling his spoils, and the 5,600 mid-grade spirit stones he had earned from demon-beast materials over the past five years, his total came to an astonishing 88,000 mid-grade spirit stones.

Out of that, he had paid for the ten Tier 3 demon cores he needed and the supplementary ingredients for the Golden Core Condensing Pills. He had also rented earth fire at Huoyun Pavilion, replenished his Spirit-Sealing Talismans and jade caskets, tended the spirit fields, maintained the Bonefuzz, and stocked up on everything he would need for secluded cultivation.

Those expenses totaled roughly 20,000 mid-grade spirit stones, leaving him with 68,000.

Lee Hyun put away the spirit stones before him.

“610 high-grade spirit stones, and about 7,000 mid-grade spirit stones...”

That excluded the small amount he kept in low-grade spirit stones and his miscellaneous consumables.

‘Even after reaching Golden Core, I won’t have to worry about spirit stones for a while.’

He closed the ledger.

His gaze fell on the jade caskets of Golden Core Condensing Pills neatly arranged on one side of the stone table.

He still had plenty of spirit stones, and his spirit plants had continued to grow. Even all the pills for his breakthrough were ready...

Lee Hyun settled comfortably against the back of his chair, savoring the abundance he had quietly built up over the long years.

Over the next few days, he peeled and ate ripe Stone Honey Peaches and read the rest of the popular novels he had started, letting his mind settle into a peaceful calm.

...

Ten days later, Lee Hyun finished preparing to leave Tunnel No. 3. He had chosen a separate location outside where he would take the Golden Core Condensing Pills and enter secluded cultivation.

He had read the passages of 《Primordial One-Qi Art》 countless times and spent more than three thousand years tempering his body. But until he attempted it himself, he could not know how violent a storm of spiritual power would erupt when the true essence throughout his body condensed all at once.

From what he had seen and heard, merely breaking through to Golden Core in the human realm did not provoke a heavenly tribulation.

But his Core Formation process was different from everyone else’s.

He had a feeling that if the Primordial One-Qi Art’s original cultivation method was linked to methods of the immortal realm passed down since antiquity, the heavens might respond by sending down a heavenly tribulation.

Even without a heavenly tribulation, the medicinal strength of dozens of Golden Core Condensing Pills surging at once might destroy his formations or bring the bedrock crashing down.

Attempting that beside spirit plants he had lovingly tended for thousands of years was far too great a risk.

Lee Hyun made one final inspection of the reservoir, water pipes, and drainage channels, then laid out the Bonefuzz’s daily tasks once more. He also replaced the spirit stones in the Tier 1 Qi-Gathering Formation with fresh ones.

After taking one more look at the Ringless Divine Tree and the Heaven-Origin Divine Tree, he turned to the fuzzbees flying between the spirit fields.

“Take good care of this place.”

...

The site he had chosen for his breakthrough was an uninhabited island in the outer sea, just over three thousand li (about 1,180 km) from Xu Kingdom’s southwestern coast. It lay in waters relatively close to the end of Cangmang Forest’s coastal woodland.

After discovering the island on a previous hunting trip, Lee Hyun had returned several times to search the surrounding area thoroughly. It was a barren, rocky island without a spirit vein or any valuable mineral deposits.

The volcano at its center had cooled long ago. From the sea, only a black, rocky mountain could be seen towering above the water, with nothing to give either cultivators or mortals a reason to stay.

Since he had already hunted down all the nearby Tier 3 demon beasts, these were, in a sense, the quietest waters around.

A thick, unbroken layer of basalt lay beneath the island.

Deep within it, Lee Hyun had excavated a small stone chamber. There was only enough room for him to sit in the lotus position and set up his formations.

It was hardly a hideout he could call Tunnel No. 4, merely a temporary secluded cultivation chamber he would demolish and abandon after the breakthrough.

He installed a spare Tier 2 Spirit-Concealing Formation he had made in advance to stop any qi from leaking out, then surrounded the chamber with basic warning formations.

...

Seated in the stone chamber, Lee Hyun examined his surroundings once more.

The formations were operating silently. All he could hear was the occasional drip of water seeping through distant cracks in the rock.

One after another, he took the jade caskets containing Golden Core Condensing Pills out of his storage pouch and arranged them before him.

Seventy-six jade caskets crowded the floor of the dark stone chamber.

Lee Hyun closed his eyes and slowly went over the passages from the Golden Core Section of 《Primordial One-Qi Art》 in his mind. After a long meditation, when his breathing had settled into a calm, steady rhythm, he opened his eyes and peeled the Spirit-Sealing Talisman off the first jade casket.

As he opened the lid, the fragrance of medicine drifted through the stone chamber.

He picked up the pale-blue pill, studied it for a moment, then placed it in his mouth without hesitation.

Gulp.

The Golden Core Condensing Pill slid down his throat.

Chapter 98

A short while later, a wave of heat surged up from deep within his stomach.

Its medicinal strength was far fiercer than that of any Essence-Cultivating Dao Pill he had taken before. The tightly packed energy unfurled, violently pushing aside the true essence that filled his body.

Lee Hyun frowned.

‘I have to take seventy-five more of these?’

For a moment, the thought frightened him.

Yet within a few breaths, that fear gave way to an entirely different kind of bewilderment.

As he followed the mnemonic formula of the Primordial One-Qi Art and put the method of Embracing Unity and Returning to the Elixir into practice, the energy throughout his body whirled into motion, from head to toe, and began devouring the medicinal strength.

Cr-r-rack!

An ordinary cultivator would have needed every ounce of concentration to control that tidal surge of medicinal strength. Yet once it dispersed throughout his entire body, a vessel fifty times the size of a single lower dantian, it was consumed in an instant, like a dipperful of water poured into parched desert sand.

The true essence throughout his body had merely grown a little denser. Not a single part of it showed even the slightest sign of condensing.

‘I needn't have worried about taking too much.’

Without interrupting his qi circulation cycle, Lee Hyun tore the Spirit-Sealing Talisman from the next jade casket.

The second, the third, the fifth...... Only after he swallowed several pills in succession did the true essence filling his body begin to change.

The true essence permeating his fingertips and toes, his sinews and bones, and his internal organs began to condense independently in each part of his body.

Lee Hyun let out a long breath, suppressing the energy that was trying to solidify on its own and binding it into a single flow.

The essence of Embracing Unity and Returning to the Elixir was to shape the entire body into a single core. No part of it could be allowed to solidify before the rest.

He also had to balance the subtle differences in medicinal strength from one demon core to the next.

The number of empty jade caskets scattered across the floor climbed rapidly past twenty, then thirty. Large beads of sweat ran down Lee Hyun's forehead.

By the time he swallowed the fiftieth Golden Core Condensing Pill, his body had grown as heavy as lead, and a thin, invisible boundary began taking shape just beneath his skin.

Again and again, it seemed about to enclose his entire body, only to unravel. It felt like the first sign of a forming core shell. Suppressing his excitement, Lee Hyun continued to disperse the medicinal strength evenly.

It happened the moment that medicinal strength spread throughout his body.

Hummm!

Every part of him resonated at once, from beneath his fingernails and the soles of his feet to the inside of his skull and the base of his spine.

The liquid true essence flowing in separate currents was finally beginning to coalesce into one immense whole.

Crimson heat rose like mist from every pore. Whenever medicinal strength merged with his true essence, demon markings originating from the demon cores surfaced beneath his skin. The markings, spread throughout his body along the flow of true essence, released strange pulses of demonic nature all at once.

Bzzzt! Crack!

The formation inscriptions of the Spirit-Concealing Formation carved into the stone chamber's floor blazed wildly, and the spirit stones slotted into its formation stations exploded one after another.

Just as Lee Hyun hurriedly tried to extend his divine sense, something enormous stirred beyond the thick basalt ceiling.

Ruuumble―

A crushing shock reached deep underground, showering stone dust from the chamber ceiling.

Lee Hyun's eyes snapped open.

‘I was afraid this might happen......!’

The heavens had reacted to his attempt to forge his entire body into one enormous golden core.

A hush settled over the sea around the volcanic island, like the calm before a storm. The rolling waves seemed to hold their breath, while brilliant shafts of five-colored light gathered high in the sky to form a vast band of multicolored clouds.

Above them, pitch-black storm clouds piled up like mountain ranges, flashing with dark-blue lightning.

...

A thousand li (about 392 km) from the island, out over the open sea.

A diminutive old man in neat silk scholar's robes hovered motionless in the air. His amber eyes, with vertical pupils unlike those of the human race, gleamed behind the thin green jade spectacles perched on his nose.

Pointed fox ears covered in white fur twitched faintly amid his neatly combed-back white hair.

Pushing up his jade spectacles, Master Hu frowned at the tribulation cloud gathering in the distance.

He had originally come to these waters because of recent reports that Tier 3 demon beasts were disappearing along the southeastern outskirts of Cangmang Forest.

Since Tier 3 demon beasts rivaled the human race's Golden Core cultivators, the disappearance of dozens in such a short time could mean the human race was preparing to invade Cangmang Forest.

Instead of an invading enemy, however, he had encountered an upheaval in heaven and earth on an unimaginable scale.

“That's... a Human-Form Transformation Lightning Tribulation, isn't it?” [TL Note: Human-Form Transformation Lightning Tribulation (化形雷劫): This can also be translated as "Metamorphosis Tribulation".]

Such upheavals in the skies of the lower world were almost unheard of outside a Human-Form Transformation Lightning Tribulation.

Upon breaking through to certain realms, members of the demon race gained the ability to reshape their bodies in the likeness of the human race. The heavenly tribulation that descended during that process was called the Human-Form Transformation Lightning Tribulation.

The exact point varied with bloodline. Some faced the tribulation as early as their breakthrough to Tier 3, while others did not encounter it until reaching a much higher realm. In the lower world, however, it most commonly occurred upon breaking through to Tier 4, which corresponded to Nascent Soul.

As the tribulation cloud continued to gather, Master Hu flew toward the volcanic island, enveloped in light.

Pulses erupting from deep within the rocky mountain resonated violently with the five-colored clouds in the sky.

Rumble!

The five-colored radiance within the clouds converged on a single point. The next instant, a bolt of dark-blue lightning plunged toward the earth.

KABOOM!

The rock at the volcano's summit split apart, and a massive fissure spread along the mountainside.

Amid the boulders hurled into the air by the blast, six blue-green shield plates and streaks of yellow sword light locked into an intricate pattern, deflecting the lightning at an angle.

CRACK!

But the lightning's power was ferocious.

Two shield plates shattered, and the lightning that slipped through fused the underground stone chamber's walls into glass.

As the dust settled, it revealed a young man seated in the lotus position at the bottom of the enormous crater gouged out by the blast.

Shock flashed through Master Hu's amber eyes.

‘A human? The lightning tribulation has only just begun, yet his human-form transformation is already perfect?’

Without a single horn or scale, he looked no different from any member of the human race.

Yet strange demon markings shimmered beneath the young man's skin, along with a metallic sheen. The fluctuations radiating from his entire body mingled with those of the tribulation cloud, leaving even Master Hu unable to judge the true extent of his demon power.

‘What bloodline is he from? Was there a genius near Cangmang Forest that even I knew nothing about?’

Just then, Lee Hyun raised his head from the bottom of the crater. The moment their gazes met in midair, cold sweat ran down his back.

‘Nascent Soul......!’

The old man had revealed only the faintest trace of his presence, but Lee Hyun, who had slaughtered Yan Wuzhen and many other Golden Core experts, recognized it at once.

It was the oppressive presence of a higher being.

That instant of alarm made the true essence within him surge, and the energy in his right arm began condensing ahead of the rest.

As Lee Hyun gritted his teeth and forced the flow back under control, the old man's gentle mental intent echoed in his ears.

[I've startled you. Pay me no mind and concentrate on the tribulation.]

The voice held no hostility, but Lee Hyun had no way of knowing whether he could trust its owner. At the moment, however, he had no other choice.

When he looked away and tossed another Golden Core Condensing Pill into his mouth, Master Hu smiled with interest.

‘He's even brought pills and magic tools. He's learned to make good use of what the human race has to offer. Whatever clan this Junior comes from, I approve of his preparations.’

The second and third bolts descended in succession, branching into dozens of streaks.

The two yellow flying swords barring their path melted away, and the remaining plates of the Six-Leaf Shield shattered one after another.

Yet Master Hu's gaze was fixed not on the breaking magic tools, but on the young man's body.

Whenever lightning struck, golden pulses flared all along the young man's body at once, from head to toe. His energy had no single focal point; his whole body seemed to function as one.

“Once the core is formed, even ghosts and gods cannot tolerate it...... So this is what the maxim in Lulin Pavilion's Record of Transformation from antiquity meant!”

Once the core is formed, even ghosts and gods cannot tolerate it!

He had thought the words referred to an ordinary Human-Form Transformation Lightning Tribulation, but the scene before him seemed to fit them far better.

Then it happened.

Master Hu sensed something, and for a moment his expression hardened. He flicked a finger toward the sea, sending a thread of demon power beneath the surface.

Having unleashed three bolts, the tribulation cloud rumbled as it began gathering heaven-and-earth spiritual qi once more.

...

One ke (about 15 minutes) later, the sky southeast of the island seemed to split open as two streaks of light came hurtling in.

The leading light was dark and sinister; the one behind it was a cold, smooth silver, like mercury in sunlight.

When the streaks of light came to a halt, two human cultivators appeared, each surrounded by the immense spiritual pressure characteristic of Nascent Soul.

The middle-aged man on the left had skeletal, hollow cheeks and corpse-pale skin. A short black-jade flute rested in the abnormally long fingers protruding from the sleeves of his green robe.

The white-haired old man on the right wore gray robes and kept his hands clasped behind his back. Silver liquid streamed ceaselessly from beneath his fingernails, swimming through the air as though alive.

Master Hu's gaze turned cold.

“Nascent Soul cultivators of the human race, I see.”

The pale middle-aged cultivator glanced between Master Hu and Lee Hyun at the bottom of the crater, then curled his lips into a smile.

“To think a Tier 4 great demon from Cangmang Forest would venture this far. It seems you've decided to take even the outer sea's wild demon beasts under your protection. Will you be planting the forest's prohibition markers in these waters next?”

“That is no business of yours.”

Master Hu warned them calmly.

“Try to lay so much as a finger on our Junior while he undergoes his Human-Form Transformation Lightning Tribulation, and you had better be ready for the consequences.”

The white-haired old man controlling the silver liquid gave a derisive snort.

“Does the Nanming Twelve-Sect Alliance need the forest's permission to hunt demon beasts now? This old man is Yan Baishou of Liujin Valley. Let me hear these consequences you speak of.”

The pale middle-aged cultivator added, stroking his black-jade flute.

“I am Nie Xingya, Supreme Elder of the Yin Bird Sect's Profound Nether Path. Five years ago, an Elder of my sect was killed in this area. That bastard down there may have had something to do with it, so I'll be taking him with me to find out.”

After Yan Wuzhen's death, the Yin Bird Sect's branches had repeatedly searched the waters west of Kun Kingdom. Meanwhile, report after report had indicated that the areas where demon beasts vanished without a trace were shifting westward.

On this patrol, Nie Xingya had been investigating those reports himself. He had happened upon Yan Baishou of Liujin Valley, who was surveying the nearby waters for resources. While they were comparing their information, they spotted the ominous tribulation cloud rising in the northern sky and flew over together.

Of course, there was no evidence linking that member of the demon race to Yan Wuzhen's death. But a pretext was all Nie Xingya needed.

Once a demon beast capable of summoning a tribulation cloud of this scale completed its human-form transformation, its corpse would be worth a fortune. There was no reason to pass up the chance to hunt it while it was trapped by the lightning tribulation.

As he dealt with the lingering effects of the lightning at the bottom of the crater, Lee Hyun swallowed back his rising nausea.

‘What rotten luck...’

He had chosen a remote island with neither a spirit vein nor a mineral vein and cleared out every demon beast nearby. Even so, he had not expected Core Formation to cause an upheaval in heaven and earth on this scale, or Nascent Soul experts to flock to it one after another.

Above him, Master Hu removed his jade spectacles, tucked them into his sleeve, and smiled.

“If I bite you both to death right here, then insist that you might have been planning to invade Cangmang Forest, would you find that explanation convincing?”

At that very moment, an enormous swell rose from the sea below.

Ruuumble―

Mountainous walls of water parted, and a hulking man nine chi (about 3 m) tall strode out across the spray. The bronze muscles and thick neck visible above his drenched dark-blue clothes were covered in a dense pattern of hexagonal turtle-shell markings. The giant spoke in a voice like thunder.

“Master, what race is that child down there?”

“I don't know yet, Tan Yue. More importantly, those bastards of the human race intend to seize him while he's undergoing his tribulation.”

A crooked grin spread across Tan Yue's round, rugged face, exposing thick, sharp fangs like those of a wild beast.

“Then there's nothing more to discuss!”

He rolled a shoulder, and his joints cracked like thunder over the sea. Yan Baishou's eyelids twitched.

“A Tier 4 Dark-Armored Sea Turtle...!”

A sinister light flashed through Nie Xingya's eyes as he raised the black-jade flute to his lips.

“Mere beasts! You'll learn the hard way who rules heaven and earth.”

The instant his pale fingers moved over the flute's holes, every sound in the world vanished as though it had never existed.

Waves still battered the reefs and rocks still tumbled down. Only the sound was gone, leaving an eerie, unnatural silence.

Black sonic inscriptions rose behind Nie Xingya and overlapped one another. The magical power concentrated at the tip of his flute streamed out as an invisible sonic current, carving a long gash through the sea's surface.

Water froze white in its wake as the Profound Nether Yin Frost Qi swept toward Master Hu's throat.

Master Hu's amber pupils narrowed to slits.

Cr-r-rack!

The neatly dressed old scholar's jaw gaped wide as silver fur and sharp teeth sprouted in an instant. The savage likeness of a white fox overlaid his face, and four white tails unfurled behind him, seeming to fill the sky.

Fwoooosh―

The pure-white true flame Master Hu exhaled opened like the maw of an enormous beast and tore into the air.

KRAAANG!

Only then did the suppressed roar of the collision burst forth all at once.

The white flame, capable of burning primordial spirit and magical power alike, ripped the sonic current apart on contact. The sound waves deflected to either side carved deep channels a hundred zhang (about 330 m) long through the sea and obliterated an entire cluster of black reefs farther out.

“Crude tricks!”

Master Hu kicked off the air. His four tails snapped out to propel him, and his slight figure vanished without a trace, as though he had used the Distance-Shrinking Art. Then he appeared above Nie Xingya, behind him, and on both sides, all at once.

Claws wreathed in white flame ripped Nie Xingya's body-protecting magical light to shreds from every direction.

“Hmph!”

Without removing the flute from his mouth, Nie Xingya formed a hand seal with his left hand.

Three palm-sized jade gui tablets slipped from his sleeve. The holes pierced through the centers of the flat jade tablets pointed toward Master Hu.

Nie Xingya took the flute from his lips.

Yet the sound art did not stop.

The empowered sound he had just played burst from the three jade gui tablets, each sounding on a different beat!

BOOM! KRAANG!

While the white flame was still tearing apart the first sound wave, the next slipped through it. Just as Master Hu swung a tail around to block it, the third jade gui tablet sent a blast of sound hammering into his chest.

Blood trickled from the corner of Master Hu's mouth.

‘So those magic treasures store sound.’

Master Hu spread his four tails. Two knocked aside the sound waves, while white flame extending from the other two swept over the sides of the jade gui tablets.

Nie Xingya immediately scattered the jade gui tablets and changed the note he was playing on the flute.

When Master Hu struck one of the retreating jade gui tablets with his claws, the vibration inside it traveled up his claws and into his arm.

The demon power in his wrist threatened to freeze solid. Baring his teeth, Master Hu wreathed even his own arm in white flame.

White flames and dark-blue cold qi continued erupting across the sky.

...

At the same time, Yan Baishou and Tan Yue were clashing over another stretch of sea.

Yan Baishou spread both hands. Silver liquid poured from his sleeves like waterfalls, transforming in an instant into more than a hundred sharp silver flying swords and chains.

A rain of metal swords filled the sky, their paths crisscrossing as they plunged toward Tan Yue.

Tan Yue did not dodge. He stamped down with both feet, striking through the air to pound the sea's surface.

KABOOM!

A vast Dharma manifestation of a Dark-Armored Sea Turtle rose behind Tan Yue and roared, its dark-blue form spanning a hundred zhang (about 330 m).

The surface waters within a radius of several li converged beneath his feet. Massive currents coiled upward into the sky, forming layer upon layer of barriers.

Suffused with demon power, the water became as heavy as heavy water. As the hundred-odd flowing metal flying swords pierced those barriers, they slowed sharply, as though mired in a swamp.

Krrrrrk―

Silver chains and massive blades that broke through the heavy walls of water struck Tan Yue's shell and forearms, throwing off sparks.

As Tan Yue was driven back several zhang, the silver blades liquefied and spread like a web, seeping into the gaps around his joints and the nape of his neck.

“That tickles!”

Tan Yue laughed viciously, grabbed the silver liquid wrapped around his arm with his left hand, and brought it to his mouth. Black plates sprouted on his cheeks, and his jaws filled with the crushing power of a gigantic sea turtle.

CRUNCH! CRACK!

Demon power surged through his fangs, crushing even the restrictions within the flowing metal. When Tan Yue spat the severed mass of silvery metal into the sea, Yan Baishou's expression turned cold.

Yan Baishou twisted his wrist.

The remaining flowing metal pulled taut and became two enormous metal rings lined with inward-facing spikes, closing around Tan Yue's shell from above and below.

Krrrrk!

The rings spun in opposite directions, tightening as they bit into the seams between his shell plates. While Tan Yue forced them outward with both arms, the remaining flowing metal outside them transformed into dozens of serrated discs.

The discs shot past Tan Yue's back toward the uninhabited island where Lee Hyun sat.

“Not so fast!”

Tan Yue inhaled, and enough seawater to engulf a ship was sucked into his mouth in an instant.

The shell plates on his neck and chest bulged as his torso expanded to its limit. The spiked rings around his shell could no longer hold; they were forced open and fell away. A moment later, he spat out a rapid barrage of compressed water projectiles.

BOOM! BOOM-BOOM-BOOM!

Every water projectile exploded hard enough to make the surrounding space buckle, crumpling the silver serrated discs and hurling them in all directions.

The stray shockwaves smashed the reefs around the island to pieces, and they vanished in clouds of spray.

Even Yan Baishou could not withstand that ferocious force head-on. He had to conjure several flowing metal shields to deflect the projectiles.

Yet there was no sign of panic in his eyes.

Amid the scattering spray, flowing metal divided into particles too fine to see was seeping into cracks in the island's bedrock.

...

While four Nascent Soul-level monsters wreaked havoc across sea and sky outside the crater, five-colored core tribulation lightning rained down relentlessly on Lee Hyun.

KABOOM-BOOM-BOOM―

One after another, the remaining yellow flying swords burned through their sword qi and disintegrated. Even the Three-Molt Silkworm Robe's three protective spirit molts, his last defense, burned to ash as they absorbed the lightning.

He angled his treasured Sinking Moon Sword to deflect a bolt of lightning, but a hairline crack appeared along its blade, forcing him to put that away as well.

At last, the robe covering Lee Hyun's upper body was torn to shreds, and ferocious lightning power poured directly into his bare flesh.

“Urgh......!”

When the lightning power first pierced his shoulder, it was not the pain of his scorched skin that made him cough up blood. His true essence had surged toward that spot all at once, trying to solidify there before the rest.

Yet amid the agony, Lee Hyun recalled the alchemy process for the Essence-Cultivating Dao Pill, which he had spent more than 330 years struggling to master at his pill furnace.

‘Heaven and earth are the pill furnace now, and my body is one enormous pill!’

Deep within his sea of consciousness, Lee Hyun calmly set the mind seal he had forged through the Sutra of Refining Intent into Vow aglow.

The unwavering focus he had honed by painting the same branches and refining his brushstrokes tens of thousands of times now held fast to the energy threatening to run wild throughout his body.

He tightly bound the true essence throughout his body, allowing none to escape. The heavenly lightning crashing down on him became a giant smith's hammer, pounding and tempering his body inside and out as though it were a mass of red-hot iron.

With his right hand paralyzed, Lee Hyun groped for the jade caskets on the floor with his left and tipped the remaining Golden Core Condensing Pills into his mouth one at a time, even as he coughed up blood. The rate at which their medicinal strength was released, the degree of compression in his true essence, and the time the lightning power took to complete a qi circulation cycle through his entire body all meshed like clockwork in his mind.

As he swallowed the sixtieth Golden Core Condensing Pill, Lee Hyun felt that his body had taken in all the medicinal strength it needed.

‘Time to finish this!’

The long years of his life passed through his mind.

He had read countless popular novels, yet there were still so many stories he wanted to read.

He had known love and become a father.

His thoughts flickered to the spirit fields he had left in the tunnel far away, the fuzzbees proudly ferrying water, and the Heaven-Origin Divine Tree that still had not formed a flower bud.

Memories of all he had learned and lost in more than three thousand years of life settled quietly within him.

Lee Hyun raised his eyes to the sky.

As he faced the lightning tribulation descending upon him, stubborn defiance stirred within him.

‘Come at me, then!’

As though in answer to Lee Hyun's thoughts, the five-colored clouds and black storm clouds covering the island began rapidly folding inward from their outer edges.

The clouds were not dispersing; all the heaven-and-earth spiritual qi and lightning power were being compressed into a single point.

Still fighting outside the crater, Master Hu sent out his mental intent.

[Tan Yue! This is the final strike of the lightning tribulation!]

That was when it happened.

Yan Baishou, who had been waiting for an opening, sent Nie Xingya a brief voice transmission.

[Hold them there for a moment!]

His eyes blazing, Nie Xingya bit the tip of his tongue and spat essence blood onto the black-jade flute.

Blue veins bulged in his neck. The three jade gui tablets shot off in different directions, and the sonic inscriptions engraved inside them flared to life at once.

Along with the empowered sound he had played into them earlier, the Profound Nether true sound he had nurtured over many years was unleashed all at once. The glow of the jade gui tablets rapidly grew murky as demonic notes of different pitches overlapped.

KABOOOOOM!

Assailed by lethal sound waves that bored directly into flesh and primordial spirit, the Dark-Armored Sea Turtle's Dharma manifestation reeled, while the white flames rising from Master Hu's four tails scattered.

A fleeting opening appeared.

Yan Baishou vanished from the air, leaving only a silver afterimage.

The flowing metal hidden in the cracks of the island's bedrock linked together. Enveloped in metallic light, he raced along the route he had prepared and shot straight to the lip of the crater.

It was an escape art from Liujin Valley's secret teachings!

“You bastard!”

Tan Yue whirled around at once, but a jade gui tablet in front of him released its remaining true sound. He was stopped in his tracks as the impact drove deep beneath his shell.

Swallowing a mouthful of blood, Master Hu blocked the sonic current with one tail, compressed the remaining white flame at the tips of his claws, and fired it toward Yan Baishou's back.

Five streaks of white fire caught up with the streak of silver light.

Yan Baishou twisted his body. Three streaks were blocked by flowing metal armor he hastily drew around himself, but the other two grazed his left shoulder and tore away chunks of flesh.

Blood sprayed from the wound, but Yan Baishou pressed on without slowing and crossed the crater's rim.

There, however, he paused.

At that instant, the lightning, condensed to a single point at the center of the now-clear sky, descended upon the crown of Lee Hyun's head.

FLASH!

───!

A beat later, an explosion thundered out, and Lee Hyun's vision went pure white.

There were no more magic tools he could use. The pressure was so extreme that even the boundaries between his hands and feet, his bones and internal organs seemed to vanish. The true essence he had built up throughout his body with sixty Golden Core Condensing Pills compressed with terrifying force.

He was poised on a razor's edge. A moment's delay would let the lightning power tear through his organs; sealing the core shell too soon would make his body explode from the pressure within.

With every fiber of his being, Lee Hyun held on to the remembered sensation of that split second at the pill furnace when he formed the final Pill-Condensing Seal.

Every part of his body was perfectly united, from head to toe. There was nothing left to adjust.

‘Now!’

Hummm!

The sound of the Dao rang out from deep within Lee Hyun's flesh and bones.

Countless points of golden light beneath his skin joined as one, from his fingertips to his shoulders, from his neck to his chest and waist, from his toes to the crown of his head, leaving not a single gap.

Rather than escaping, the light sank into the skin itself and solidified into the Leakless Golden Body, whose golden radiance surpassed that of any divine iron in the world!

The last remnants of lightning power flowed along that smooth golden skin before vanishing without a trace.

Yan Baishou lunged at him the very next instant.

‘The material is ready!’

Greed blazed in his eyes.

A demon beast that had just completed its Human-Form Transformation Lightning Tribulation would have severely depleted its qi and blood as well as its demon power, and would not yet be accustomed to its new body.

It was the perfect moment to hunt it!

Yan Baishou was a Nascent Soul old monster, and he kept his guard up to the very end.

He wrapped his chest and neck in three layers of flowing metal to form thick armor, fashioned flowing metal chains in his left hand to bind his opponent's limbs, and invoked a secret art in his right that would seal demon power and primordial spirit on contact. Then he reached for Lee Hyun's shoulder.

Just before his fingertips touched him, two eyes flashed open amid the blackened ash.

‘!?’

BANG―

With a deafening crash, something shrouded in silver light was hurled away at tremendous speed.

BOOOM!

The figure tore into the sea, throwing up a plume of spray dozens of zhang high as it plunged beneath the surface.

Tan Yue and Nie Xingya both stared wide-eyed.

Master Hu landed at the rim of the crater and stared down, his mouth hanging open.

The bedrock below was scorched black and cracked.

The young man slowly lowered his fist.

Chapter 99

Lee Hyun slowly opened his hand.

Blackened ash flaked from the back of his throbbing hand, revealing unblemished skin beneath.

‘...So this is what the Leakless Golden Body can do!’

But there was no time to celebrate.

Three Nascent Soul-level monsters still remained above him, including the two who had helped him.

Outwardly, Lee Hyun calmly shook out his fist. Inwardly, he swiftly examined his newly acquired body from head to toe.

‘My entire body really has become a golden core.’

His true essence, having undergone a qualitative transformation, had already become clear, refined magical power that filled every part of his body.

The quality of that magical power was at the level of an early Golden Core cultivator. But its production and storage were not confined to his lower dantian alone.

His flesh and bones, his internal organs, even his skin—his entire body was absorbing heaven-and-earth spiritual qi and nurturing magical power within the single continuous golden core it had become!

A surge of exhilaration rose from deep within him at the realization that the body he had only ever seen in ancient records had finally become his own.

That was when it happened.

BOOM!

A silver figure burst upward through the white spray.

It was Yan Baishou.

The armor, deeply dented over his chest, rippled back into its original shape.

“Cough!”

Fresh blood ran between the fingers covering his mouth.

‘Damn...’

The moment that fist struck him, tremendous force drove through his armor and shook his internal organs. If he had not instinctively drawn up his magical power to protect his body, he would have been badly injured.

His gaze fell on the young man still standing in the crater.

‘What bloodline is he from? How can a Tier-4 demon beast that only just completed its human-form transformation be this strong?’

Nie Xingya's voice transmission reached him just then.

[We should withdraw.]
